spyir nas khong gis rgyal bor blo dkar bcangs na yang / bya ba 'dis khra hri ten nyi'i re dogs chen po bslangs/ rgyal bos pe lis sa leg dbyi tha li mang tshogs kyi blo la ches cher 'bab par sems khral byas te myur ba myur du kho rang con hri tan ten pa'o la phyir bos pa dang / dmag dpon 'dis rgyal kha'i ngang ki thi'i rgyal bo dang rgyal khab de'i rin po che khyer nas phyir rang rgyal du log ste rgyal bor phul/ 'on kyang thengs 'dir phyir log pa na khor srid gzhung gis mi legs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / cang ma 'gor bar shar phyogs su phor zin rgyal bor 'gog rgol byed du mngags/ phor zin rgyal bo khi zo los pe krin then tshad las brgal ba'i stobs shugs can du 'gyur bar phrag dog langs nas myur du chings yig med brlag byas te 'thab 'khrug bslangs/541lo nas 5slobar pe lis sa lig gis me so po'u ta nyi ya'i(4rsālo7sko༅)dmag 'thab la bkod 'doms byas pa dang / thengs mang po zhig la pho ra zin pham par byas te tha na 'thab res byed mi dgos par g.yul las rnam par rgyal bas phor zin rgyal bo'i dmag dpung skrag nas phyir bros/ kho rang ras tshags kyis bzos pa'i dmag sgar zhig tu bsdad yod la/ rgyas spros che ba'i 'tsho ba longs su spyod par mos mthun de 'dra med/ gal srid/ shar phyogs g.yul sa'i man rigs glas dmag de dag gis bslab byar mi nyan la bka' yang mi brtsi ba'i bya spyod spel rgyu na/ pe lis sa lig gis snga sa nas phor zin btsan rgyal gyi yul dbus su bskrad yod pa red/ tung ki thi'i mi ni rang dbang la dga' bas khyad bsod kyi 'tsho bar bzod bsran byed mi thub/ pe lis sa lig de dang bral nas lo gnyis kyi rjes su de tshos yang bskyar dmag bsdus nas ngo rgol byas pa dang / ming la tho this la(677)zer ba'i dmag dpung zhig gis gzhan shor gyi sa cha mang po zhig slar bsdu byas par ma zad ro ma'i mkhar rdzong la phar rgol byas shing / pe lis sa lig gi rjes 'dzinā snas

kyang 'gog rgol byed pa'i nus pa yongs su thor/ khra hri ten nyi yang bya thabs ci yang med par pe lis sa lig yang bskyar dbyi tha lir mngags kyang khong la dmag mi ma byin/ pe lis sa lig gis dka' ngal brgya phrag la brten nas gzhi nas ro ma'i mkhar rdzong lon pa dang / khra hri ten nyi de'i byas rjes kyis rang nyid kyi rme go gnon par skrag nas mi shugs rgyu shugs kyi rogs skyor rtsa ba nas bcad pa na/ pe lis sa leg la dmag shugs kyis ma 'dang par rgyab rogs kyi re ba gting nas chad de/ tung ki thi'i ba tsho rtsa rdzogs byed ma nas/de'i rjes nas khos skya dmag dang rkang dmag khrid de phyir mtsho rgyud du song nas tung ki thi dang lo lnga'i ring dka' sdug gis 'thab 'khrug brgyab pa dang / de nas rgyal bos kho rang phyir bos te dmag don gyi bkod 'doms yod tshad na zhi hri(smo676)la sprad pa dang / na zhi hri la rgyal bos rogs skyor thob pas ki thi 'thab 'khrug gi rgyal kha'i cho lo thob/mjug mtha'i g.yul thengs gcigape lis sa lig phyir rgyal nang du log rjes/ rang khyim nas ngal gso thob na yang khor sngar nas yod rung ba'i khyim tshang gi rgyu nor 'bor chen thob chog par ma zad/ skabs de'i sgrig srol ltar mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs byas te mi 'bor mang po'i man rigs kyi srung dmag dang lhan du lo zla chu mo bzhur ba ltar/ shar nas nub dang nub nas shar du dmag drangs pas kha char bu yug gis gtses pa'i gdong la rgas gnyer gyi ri mo phab pa'ang nyung nyung min par tshe mjug la slebs/ khong nyid dmag spyir bsdad pa'i lo zla'i nang du gzhan yid cig car 'dren pa'i dpa' rtags ci 'dra'i mang po zhig bstan yod ang /559lor kho'u thi lig ki zhon no ba'i(sgo ma mkhrim)skya dmag man1 zlogs zi la pho(loṣṭhacho)yi mi dang 'grogs te chab rom brgal nas to no

gtsang bor(lkolko ma)slebs/ zhon no'i skya dmag 7000lhag gis sne khrid de chararlung drag tu rgyugs pa ltar ma chis kun dang zig le zi'i ru dpung 'phred du gshags nas pe krin then gyi mkhar ring gi 'dabs su thon/ gcig nas dmag la gyong phog pa dang gnyis nas rang byung gis gnod 'tshe ste sa 'gul gyis mkhar ring 'dir kha sho chen po zhig btod yod cing / zhon do'i skya dmag 'di nas nang du 'dzul te con hri tan ten pa'o yi phyogs su drag shugs kyis thon/ skabs 'dir pe krin then gyi dmag dpung shar byang gnyis kyi mtshams su dbye yod pa dang / rgyal nang ha cang stong ba yin pas dgra bo 'gog srung byed mkhan gyi dmag mi ci yang med par gyur/ myur du rgyal sar brda brgyab pa na/ khra hri ten nyi pho brang nang du skrag nas 'dar sig sig tu gyur te yang bskyar pe lis sa lig gis skyob gnang yod pa'i re ba zhus/ rta rgan bres la btegs gyur kyang / le dbar stong phrag yid la shar zhes pa ltar pe krin then nyen kha'i gnas su bcar yod pa'i skabs su dmag mi bgres po 'dis mtshon cha'i drag chas spros te con hri tan ten pa'o spobs pa cher skyed kyis srung skyob byas/ khos sngon gyi dmag mi bgres po dang cis mu'i(lha )dmangs dmag mi ser sogs chabs gcig tu bsdus te dmag dpung zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / de tshor bzhon rta ma 'dang bas na rgyal bo zig lo tshangagi rta dang grong mi'i rta/ tha na rta rtsed ra ba'i nang gi rta sogs bkol pa dang / de'i 'phror pe lis sa lig gis sa rub pa'i glags dang bstun nas zhon no'i g.yul sa dang nye sa nas dmag sgar phebs pa dang / dmag sgar khrod du me phung 'od snang ha cang gsal yang / rgyang ring nas bltas na mi rta ga tshod yod med ha lam shes dka'/ snyan grags kun tu khyab pa'i pe lis sa lig gis mnga' 'og gi dmag dpung la skul lcag byas pas/ rgyal 'bangs rnams dmag gral du zhugs rgyu'i spro bas brtas thog gcig rjes gnyis1 sdusad

du 'ong re zhus pa dang / pe lis sa lig gis kyang kho tsho'i re ba don thog smin par byed pa las gzhan sngon chad bye thang gi g.yul sa brgyud myong ba'i dmag mi bgres po tsho gtso shugs su 'dzin pa red/nam langs rjes zhon no bas 'jab rgol byed rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa na/ glo bur du mdun phyogs su pha rol ba'i khri rta khri dmag gis gnam gyis sa bkab pa ltar bskyod 'ong ba dang 'dra yang / don dngos su pe lis sa lig gis phyogs so sor dogs slong dmag gi 'char bkod 'then yod pas yin/ zhin no'i dmag dpung sngon du lebs rgyugs byas pa na/ de tsho'i dmag dpung pe lis sa lig gis g.yon phyogs su nye ba'i nags tshal du skung ba'i dmag dpung gi 'gog rgol la 'phrad pas g.yo 'gul chen po bslangs te/ 'thab ru 'khyol bar byas kyang / cha ma chol gyis sngar bzhin sdun la mchongs nas thon/ ming don gnyis dang mtshungs pa'i dpa' bo 'dis glo bur du mthong ma thag ral gri g.yug thengs gcig gis zhon no'i 'go gtso dang dpa' mdzangs che ba'i dmag spyi gnyis mnyam du bsad/ kho'i 'khor srung du bskos pa'i dmag mi bgres po tshos kyang der mthud nas zhon no'i dmag dpung la btsan 'dzul drag tu // no/ sa pe lis sa lig gis pha rol ba'i dmag spyi byas pa go ma thag sdod mi tshugs pa'i dngangs 'dar zhig skyes byung / lam sang 'thab thengs gcig gis skya dmag 400lhag gi gyong reg pa dang / pe krin then gyi dmag gru mgoganyis ma'i ru dpung gis da lta 'gram dar zhu bzhin pa'i to lis gtsang ngogs su kho tsho sgug 'dug pa'ang thos pas/ zhon nos phyir log sa'i bgrod lam gcod par skrag nas myur du mgo bo dud nas rang yul du bros pa na/ pe lis sa lig gis bda' 'ded drag po byas te mkhar ring gi phyi rol du ded/'di1/ 0dpa' bo gang nyid g.yul ngor chas pa'i ches mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha

red/ pe krin then gyi dpa' rgod 'dis rgyal khab nyen kha las bskyabs pa dang /kho rang pho brang du song ste byas pa snyan zhu byed dus rgyal bo khra hri ten nyis bzhugs khri las yar bzhengs te dpung gnyen 'dir dam por 'khyud nas bka' drin che zhus/ zhon no ba phyir ded rjes/ pe lis sa lig gis bskyar du 'gan bskyur dben sdod kyi 'tsho ba bskyar gso byas/pe lis sa lig dben gnas su bsdad yod na yang pe krin then dmangs tshogs kyi sems khongs su khyad du 'phags pa'i snyan grags mnga'/ rgyal bos khong la re dogs byed pa nyin re las nyin re thu ba dang / tung ki thi bas mgo btags pa'i nyin nas bzung re dogs de rgyal bo'i sems khongs nas bor ma myong / de'i rkyen gyis pe lis sa lig gis tshe mjug la dka' ngal mi nyung ba zhig myang dgos pa byung / nyin zhig khra hri ten nyis pe lis sa lig brjid nyams che zhing dpa' stobs ldan pa'i ngang mi tshogs kyis bskor nas grong khyer brgal dus lam 'gro ba tshang mas khong la gus bkur byed pa'i rnam pa de mthong ba na/ sems khongs nas ha cang snang sems skyes/khra hri ten nyis lo na rgas pa dang lus zungs zad pa dang bstun nas phrag dog gi sems pa je lci nas je lci ru gyur ba dang / 562lor rgyal nang du rgyal bor lkog jus 'debs pa'i don rkyen zhig gi gyod gzhi byung zhing / don rkyen de pe lis sa lig dang 'brel yod pa'i bsnyad btags pas/ rgyal bos khong nyid ngan jus mnyam 'god byed mkhan du bltas te/ 'phur bye'u 'phongs/gzhu bzang sbed/ g.yo bong shi/ rgyugs khyi sbyor zhes pa ltar/ pe lis sa lig gis pe krin then gyi 'thab 'khrug khrod lo ngo 40ring la/ mi zad rta zad du btang ste byas rjes ji tsam bskrun yod pa ma shes par lkog jus 'god mkhan gyi nyes ming btags te khyim btson du bcug cing / khyim tshang gi rgyu nor rdordo ma

'phrogalo gcig gi rjes su/ khra hri ten nyis pe lis sa lig la nyes med myi dkar yin par yid ches byung nas khong la lta tshul yag po zhig chags te rang dbang yang bskyar yod par byas/ 565lo'i khra hri ten nyis ma gshegs pa'i zla brgyad kyi yar sngon du pe lis sa lig khong dang bral nas mi yul gyi 'tsho ba rdzogs/ pe lis sa lig gis kyag kyog gi mi tshe'i bzhud lam la phyir mig cig bltas na/ mi rnams kyis ming grags che ba'i dpa' bo 'di'i skyo gar gyi las dbang la dngan pa nar nar 'then dgos byung / kho'i dmag don steng gi shes rgya'i ngos nas brjod na/ skabs der sus kyang 'gran zla bral ba zhig red/kho'idamag don gyi sgyu rtsal sbyangs goms thob pa'i tshad la slebs/ rgyal kha'i mang nyung la lta rgyur dga' la 'thab 'khrug gi gnas tshul lci yang dang myur bul gsal bor dbye thub pa dang / yang na myur du bcom pa'am dal bur rgol ba/dpa' ngar che la khog rgya yangs/ gzab nan che la zhum pa med/ rgyal na nga rgyal med cing pham na sems mi zhum/ snga mo'i ring pe krin then btsan rgyal gyi dmag spyis thog mar gsar du gtod pa'i lcags khrab can gyi dmag dpung gis de'i rjes kyi lo mi①ring la blos dpog dka' ba'i byed nus bton/ pe lis sa lig ni pe krin then lo rgyus steng ches ming du grags pa'i dpa' bo dang dmag don pa yin pa ma zad/ gna' rabs bar ma'i skabs kyi ches phul du byung ba'i dmag don pa'i ya gyal yang red/112

drag rtsal gnam sar khyab pa'i khra yis ta ti/(ṣṭha༅lkolko )/teng zhin yus dpa' rtsal thog mar ngom pa/lo rgyus sbyi la bltas na/stobs shugs che ba'i rgyal khab mang po zhig gi dar rgyas ni de'i dmag don 'thab rtsal dang gtan nas kha phral thabs med pa zhig red/ gna' rabs lo rgyus steng dmag 'thab kyi zil shugs la brten nas gnam 'og dbang du bsdus pa'i dpa' bo'i mtshan byang re re bzhin bgrang dgos tshe/khra lis ta ti/ o gling byang ma'i bkas bkod dmag rgyal khra lis ta ti (spyi lo 742wa 814bar)ni ma gleng thabs med gyi mi zhig ste/ kho'i drag rtsal gyi ba dan dkar po gna' rabs bar ma'i o gling gi yul gru yongs la khyab yod do/de yang ri ar man man rigs kyis ro ma btsan rgyal rtseg med du btang ba'i rjes nas bzung / rang rang gi yul gru so sor bcad bzung byas te phan tshun bar 'khrug zing gi rgyun ma chad par bslangs shing / de nas bzung o gling skam sa'i steng du lo brgya'i ring gi 'khrug rtsod byung bas gtor brla/ pying

de nyid tsha 'ded drag 'ded byas te dbyi tha lir thon/ khos ca zi khan nyis spyi gzhung nas bros byol ba tshur sprod byed dgos tshul dang gal te de ltar mi byed na btsan bzung byed rgyu yin tshul bsgrags pa na/ ca zi khan ya nas ho'u nor thu'u bzung nas khra lis la phul rgyur thag bcad par ma zad/ ca zi khan nyis ya'i sa cha'ang khra lis la phul te hpha lan khi la gtogs par byas/'di ni khra lis kyis thengs dang po dmag dpung khrid nas 'thab 'khrug la zhugs pa dang de las rgyal kha blangs pa'i mngon rtags red/ a cis than 'thab 'khrug ni khra lis la mtshon na ni rang gi 'byung 'gyur gyi lo ngo bcu'i sbyang la /pung dmag kha lo bsgyur nas o gling la rgyang skyod byed pa'i sgo 'phar sa pa 777lo/ ra kha lo man sku gshegs rjes/ khra lis ni hpha lan khi'i dbang bsgyur ba gcig pur gyur/lungapa ti(7༅ṭha)btsan bzung byas pa/ca zi khan nyi'i(15loṣṭhakhu)lho phyogs kyi dbyi tha li'i gling phran ni lung pa ti bas btsan bzung byas yod la/ hpha lan khi'i rgyal khab gyi mtha' mtshams su rgyun par lung pa ti bas 'phrog bcom byed kyin yod par ma zad/ ar pis zi ri bo'i(༅po lo7)kha gtad kyi sa cha de'ang shor nyen che bas phan tshun bar g.yul 'khrug cig gi skyur rta bsnyal zin pa red/spyir na lung pa ti'i rgyal bo tu zhe tug le( pos )dang khra lis gnyis ni gnyen tshan yin yang / khong gnyis kyis ni phan tshun la mngon lkog gang rung nas dgrar 'dzin gyi sbyor ba rtag tu rtsom gyin yod/ tu zhe tug le yis hpha lan khi'i rgyal khab gyi mtha' mtshams la btsan 'dzul zing slong bsdud mar byas par bsten/ khra lis kyis rang gi chung mar gyur ba'i tu zhe tug le31 byā mo

phyirakho mo'i rgyal khab tu bskyal/ tu zhe tug le yis khra lis kyi srid dgra kha lo man(rdo༅4)dang dpung bsdongs nas hpha lan khi dgra ru bzung bas phan tshun gyi 'brel ba sngar las kyang dza drag rno ngar du gyur/gzhan yang / lung pa ti yis ro ma'i chos skyong srid gzhung la btsan 'dzul byas te chos rgyal gyi dbang thang dang bde 'jags la nyen kha bzos/ hpha lan khi rgyal po phe phan dang chos skyong srid gzhung gnyis kyi 'brel ba sngon nas legs stabs/ chos rgyal a ti lis an(slo14ṣṭhasprin6ca)gyis hpha lan khi rgyal bor rogs skyor 'ong rgyu'i re zhu byas pa na/ khra lis ni zol med rnam dag gi chos dad pa zhig yin pas gcig nas chos skyong srid gzhung dka' khag la 'phrad dus ma shes khul byed mi rung ba dang / gnyis nas lung pa ti rgyal khab tshar gcod byed pa'i go skabs 'dzom byung ba na yang / khong gis sngar bzhin khrel med lugs med kyi bgyi ba lhur len mi byed par sngon la pho nya mngags te legs skyes phul nas/ tu zhe tug le la chos rgyal la brtsi bkur dang zhi bde ngang thag gcod byed dgos par bsnyad kyang / des kha ma nyan pas khra lis kyis da gzod dmag drangs dgos pa byung /hpha lan khi dmag dpung khag gnyis su bgos shing / khra lis rang nyid nas dpung chen gcig gi ru sna drangs nas ar pe zi ri bo brgal nas mdun du skyod/ tag tag ri bo'i pha rol nas lung pa nyis dmag dpung dang gdong thug brgyab pas khra lis kyis phar rgol byed zhor mu mthun pha rol du dpung 'jug byas/ lung pa ti'i sa khul du/ phan tshun gyis dza drag che ba'i 'thab ru bshams nas dmar 'dzing gi 'khor lo bskor/ lung pa ti yi dmag dpung gi 'gog rgol ji 'dra btsan yang khra lis hrag dmag gi gdong bsu byed rgyu dka' bar gyur/ skabs der/ hpha lan khi dmag gi dpung khag gzhan pa de yang gzhidi snar slobs byung bas/ tu zhe tug le dmag dpung gis hpha lan khi dmag

gi gdong len ma phod par pha we ye( khri sgro)grong du phyir 'bros byas/skabs der hpha lan khi dmag dpung gis pha we ye grong yongs su bskor nas rgol rdung shugs drag btang mod/ tu zhe tug le yis lung pa tis dmag mi rnams la bkod 'doms byas nas mtha' gcig tu 'gog srung byas stabs/khra lis yis pha rol gyi dmag sgar gtor nas dgra bo shul med du gtong ba'i re ba de re zhig nar 'gyangs su mi gtong ka med byung / de bas khos grong phyi nas dmag sgar brgyab nas yun ring la dmag 'khrug byed pa'i thabs jus lhur len byas/ dgun kha 'das nas dpyid ka slebs na yang lung pa nyis sngar bzhin 'gog srung lhod med byas pas/ khra lis kyis pha we ya grong dang phyi rol gyi 'brel ba gtan gcod byas nas tu zhe tug le yi 'gro 'dug la brtag dpyad byas nas bsdad/ skabs der kho rang ro ma chos skyong srid gzhung gi gdan zhu ltar ro mar yong / de gar chos rgyal a ti lis an gyis kho la phebs bsu rgya che ba byas shing / ye shu'i chos lugs kyi srung skyob mkhan po zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/khra lis ro ma nas phyir dmag sgar du yong dus/ pha we yar gcun pa'i lung pa tis dmag mi rnams stobs zad shugs med du gyur yod stabs/ khra lis yis dpung dmag kha lo bsgyur nas pha we ya grong bde blag tu blangs shing /tu zhe tug le sa mthar smyugs pa dang khos bdag 'dzin byas pa'i chos skyong srid gzhung gi rgyu dngos rnams bdag por phyir sprod byas/ khra lis kyis pha we ya bde blag tu blangs rjes mu mthud du dpung 'jug byas te khu zhe ca gling phran(sapo cha)bar slebs/ spyi lo 774lo'i bar dbyi tha li dbang du bsgyur//o gling nub ma/lo 'ga'i rjes su/ khra lis kyis dmag dpung slar yang khag gnyis su bgos nas pe le nye zi(ltas/rdolo)ri bo brgal te si phen du dpung skyonā shās/

de ni sa la sen ba( ṣṭharsā4)tsho'i dpung shugs rgya bskyed de hpha lan khi la btsan 'dzul byas pas yin/ khra lis kyis rang gi dpung shugs la brten nas sa la sen ba tsho mthar skyod byas rjes/ de gar si phen gyi ma khi(67)mtha' khul btsugs pa dang / hpha lan khi ba tsho gnas spar te rgyal mtshams srung bar byas/ gzhan yang / byang phyogs kyi rgyal mtshams srung skyob byed slad dpung skyod byed skabs pa zi khi ba(2〉〉〉)tshos 'jab rgol thebs te/ dmag dpon lo lan(74)gtsos pa'i dmag mi mang por pham nyes thengs shig byung / khra lis kyis dbang bsgyur byed skabs hpha lan khi'i rgyal khab ni phyogs bzhi'i 'thab 'khrug dang nyen kha'i gnas su yod stabs/ khos rang nyid dngos nas dmag dpung la kha lo bsgyur te dpung skyod byed dgos pa byung /khra lis nas rgyang skyod kyi dmag dpung khag cig nub mtha'i pu le ten ba(lko14sam)tsho dbang du bsdu bar mngags pa dang / de nas to'o no gtsang po'i smad rgyud gyi zhon no ba(4rsāshā)dang a wa ra ba(lo778)la g.yul 'gyed byas/ stobs 'byor ldan pa'i ru ba'i mi rigs 'di dag gis dus rabs mang po zhig la o gling nas 'phrog bcom gyi las kho na gnyer bas/ khra lis kyis dmag dpung la kha lo bsgyur nas phan no nye yar( stsaṭha༅)slebs shing thad gar dgra bo'i dmag sgar du rgol/ khos dngos shugs gang drag bkol nas lo ngo brgyad kyi ring la dmar gsod kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ phan no nye ya zhon no khu tan gyi sgar gnas theg med bzos pas/ rjes su dus yun ring po zhig la yul gru de rang mi med byang thang tu bsgyur/ khra lis kyis zhon no bas 'phrog pa'i rgyu dngos rnams phyir blangs nas hpha lan khi rgyal khab gyi mdzod du bka~X ngo du ma'i dmag 'thab brgyud nas hpha lan khi rgyal khab gzhi nas dus bde1 sdu/sa 'jam du btang ba dang / khra lis kyis rgyal khab mtha' mtshams kyi

sa khe sen dbang du sdud pa'i sta gon bgyis/ sa khe sen pa tsho nam rgyun 'jab rgol las rgyal na gsod 'phrog tshabs chen byed pa dang pham tshe nags tshal tu yib nas sdod pas/ dus thung ngang dbang du bsdu thub dka' bas/ khra lis kyis sa khe sen pa tsho dang 'thab mo rim par bgyis/ phyogs gcig nas phar bskyod byas rjes de gar 'dzing rags bzo ba dang srung dmag skor gcig bzhag rjes mu mthud du dpung chen khrid de gnas gzhan la 'thab mor bskyod de/ sa khe sen pa'i mchod gnas su gyur ba'i lha khang e ge(ṣṭha༅)yongasasu bcad bzung byas/ lha khang de'i nang du de tsho'i dad rten gyi srog shing hi ar man bzhengs yod la/ de ni lha shing chen po zhig gi gzhung rta yin zhing / yan lag dang lo ma sogs ci yang med/ sa khe sen pa rnams kyi bshad rgyun la/ de ni 'jig rten 'degs pa'i ka ba yin par bsnyad/ khra lis kyis dmag dpung la bka' phabs te de tsho'i dad pa'i rten shing rtsa slog byas pa na/ sa khe sen tsho khag khrod du re pham yid chad kyi snang tshul mang po byung song / yin na yang dus yun cung tsam gyi rjes la ngo rgol gyi sbyor ba shugs drag brtsams te/ grong brdal mang po zhig mer bsregs/khra lis kyis sa khe sen pa'i spyi tshogs nang khul brtag dpyad byas te/ de tsho'i nang gi tsho khag so po'i bar du byung ba'i sha 'khon sogs 'gal ba du ma shes rjes/ der 'phrod kyi lag thabs gcig min gnyis min du 'then pas/sa khe sen pa tsho rta rgod sgrog gis bcings pa ltar rim bzhin du khra lis kyi dbang du tshud/ de tsho'i gras kyi ngo rgol mthar chod byed phod pa dag ni ye pe gtsang bo'i sa khe sen ba'i rgyal po we te cin sogs yin la/ de ni tsho khag so so'ikhrod kyi stobs shugs mnga' zhing kun gyis bkur ba zhig red la/ khos drag shugs la brten nas hpha lan khi la phyir rgol bstud mar byas/ 778lor/we rdo 2rdon gyis sa khe sen rgyal sa nas 'tshogs 'du bsdus te khra lis dang kho

tsho'i bar gyi 'cham mthun gan rgya rtsa gtor byed rgyur thag bcad par ma zad/le dbyin gtsang 'gram na yod pa'i hpha lan khi ba'i grong brdal mang po zhig bcoms te/ 'thab 'khrug gsar ba zhig gi 'go yang bskyar bcoms/ khra lis kyi dmag dpung ni tshags dam zhing sbyong brdar la nang byan chud pa'i hrag dmag gi tshogs pa gtso byas nas grub pe zhig yin stabs/ lo ngo gsum gyi 'thab 'khrug brgyud mthar sa khe sen pa tsho gzhi nas pham par bzos la we te cin phyi rgyal du bros byol byas nas de ru yib sdod lo gcig la byas mthar/yang bskyar gtsang bo brgal nas sa khe sen la 'byor te/ khra lis dang dmar 'dzing thengs shig byas kyang / thengs der khra lis kyis we te cin gyi dmag dpungagi 'thab ru tshal ba tshal phyed du btang ba na/ kho rang yang bskyar phyi rgyal du mi 'gro ka med byung / 782lo nas 783lo'i bar gyi lo ngo gcig gi ring la we te cin gyis dmag dpung stobs shugs bsdus nas khra lis la dpung 'jug byas te/ 785lo'i bar du 'thab 'khrug gi rgyun bsrings kyang / khra lis kyi dmag dpung gi do zlar gtan nas ma 'ong ba red/yun ring gi rgyal pham brgyud mthar/ khra lis kyis sa khe sen pa rnams la rgyal pham gyi dbye thag gting gcod byed pa'i sems shugs yongs su mnga' ba rtogs na yang / rgyal kha rang nyid la dbang ba'i bsam 'dun nam yang 'dor ma myong la/ khos phyogs gcig nas rang gi dbang du tshud yod pa'i sa khe sen pa tshor btsan shugs kyi srid jus spyad nas ye shu chos lugs la zhugs su 'jug pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas dmar gsod kyi sbyor ba yongs su spang bar ma zad/ we te cin la thar lam ci yang med pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu/ khra lis kyis mi mngags te kho rang sa khe sen don rkyen gros sol du gdan 'dren zhus/we te cin gyis khas len gtan nas ma byas mod/ khra lis kyis sngar bzhin zhi bas lag thabs bkol te kho la zhu ba byas mthar/ sa khe sen gyi dpa' spyad we

te cin yang khra lis srid gzhung gi tshogs 'dur zhugs shing / rjes phyogs nas khra lis dang dmag mi rgyag pa dang g.yul mi bkye ba'i khas blangs/we te cin phyir slebs nas sa khe sen gyi sa khul mang po zhig zhod 'jags su btang mod/ sa khul kha shas shig tu da dung yang ngo log gi zing cha rgyun par langs bzhin yod pas/ khra lis kyis lo gnyis kyi dus tshod spyad nas sa cha de dag yongs su dbang bsgyur byas/ 'thab 'khrug gi 'go brtsams pa nas mjug bsdu ba'i bar du lo ngo 33'das zin la/ de ni khra lis kyi mi tshe gang ba'i khrod du ches yun ring zhing dka' sdug che ba'i 'thab 'khrug cig red/mtshan snyan gnam 'og tu khyab pa/khra lis kyis dbyin lung kru'u gling phran(rsā 76)dang na we ya gling phran phud pa'i ri ar man yod tshad dbang du bsdus te/ de dag tshang ma khra lis man gyi mnga' khongs su sprad pa dang / phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul zhing / hpha lan khi'i rgyal sa ldab 'gyur gyis cher bskyed byas te ro ma btsan rgyal rjes kyi yo rab gling gi dbang bsgyur rgyal khab ang dang po btsugs par ma zad/ dus zing 'jags rgyu med pa'i rnam pa de legs bsgyur chen po byas/spyi bsdoms byas pa ltar na/ khra li yis dbang bsgyur byas pa'i lo 46nang du gal 'gangs che ba'i 'thab 'khrug53brgyab pa dang / khos sa khe sen la thengs 18dang / sa la sin par(ṭhaṣṭharsāl)thengasami/ zhon no a war dmag la thengs 3bcas 'thab myong la/ mjug mthar yo rob gling byang ma'i mtsho jag la rgol rdung byas/ 'di ltar hob ste bltas na/ khong ni dper mtshon ldan pa'i dbang bsgyur ba zhig yin par ma zad/ khos lag bstar byas pa'i srid jus mtha' dag gis bkas bkod bdag po'i gral rim gyi khe phan mtshon pa rdo12/

yo rab gling byang ma'i mtsho jag la rgol rdung byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod/khra lis kyis gsar gtod byas pa'i 'thab gru yis nus pa mi dman thon song rkyen/ mtsho jag gis khong gi ming thos pa tsam gyis skrag snang gi ba spu gzengs kyin yod pa redo/ thengs shig la/ khra lis nyul zhib la chas pa'i lam bar nas re zhig skor dkyil rgya mtsho'i gru 'gag cig tu sdod pa'i dus/ mtsho thog nas gru yor mang po khad kyis mngon yong ba na/ mi tshang mas de ni tshong skyel 'thab gru'i ru dpung yin par bsnyad mod kyang / khra lis kyis gru dbyibs dang gru'i steng gi mtshon ris/ myur tshad sogs la tshod dpag byas nas de ni mtsho jag yin pa'i kha tshon bcad de/ hpha lan khi'i 'thab gru'i ru dpung gdong bsu ru mngags/ mtsho jag gis khra lis kyi dmag dpung mthong mur phyir bltas tsam yang med par bros byol byas/khra lis ni drag rtsal la mkhas par ma zad/ rig gnas kyi thad la yang ha cang dga'/ khos nam rgyun mi rnams rig gzhung bslab gnyer gyi phyogs la skul slong byas te/ hpha lan khi ni stobs 'byor mnga' thang 'dzoms pa'i rgyal khab cig tu bsgyur/ rang nyid kyis kyang yi ge shes pa las gzhan/ ko'u tug(mcho)skad dang hpha ran si'i skad da dung gi ri si'i skad kyang cung zad shes/khong ni 'bri rtsom gyi phyogs la ha cang dga' bo yod kyang / bslab pa phyi drags pas 'bri rtsom la 'jug rgyu'i las de lag tu bstar rgyu cung khag po byung /gna' bo'i skabs su shes yon pa ni nyin mo'i skar tsam yin phyin/ rig gnas chu tshad 'bring tsam yod pa'i khra lis la mtshon na skabs de'i rin po che ru mi 'gyur ci/ khos pe kun then dang a la po sogs rgyal khab gang mang la 'brel zam btsugs pa dang / khra lis man btsan rgyal gyi srid gzhung gi sgo chen na phyogs 'ong gi pho nya sprin gyi 'du 'god dang mtshungs pa 'di las kyang / khong gi phyi 'brel gyi byas rjes mtshon thub pa ma yin nam/ 123

de ltar rgyal bo khra lis kyis rgyal srid lugs bzhin bskyangs mthar 814sto dgung lo 72steng tshe las 'das/ de nas cung ma 'gor bar khra lis man rgyal khab bkas bkod bran bdag bar gyi 'thab rtsod gyi nyen khar ltung /843lor khong gi tsha bo gsum po so sor gyes te/ phyis su hpha lan khi dang / ti dbyi ṭi/ dbyi tha li gsum gyi gtso bdag tu gyur ro//

rgyaXsprom dmag gi shar 'dul sbyor ba la//dpa' rgod sa la ten(༅ṣṭha1 5873)gyis 'gog rgol byas//teng zhin yus/spyi lo'i dus rabs 12par/ sa la ten gyi dpa' skad nyi lo(77 sa /0)gtsang rgyud du khyab cing / gtsang bo'i brag rgyun dang bsdongs nas ya gling nub tshophopo —tsho ma dang hphe gling byang ma'i yul gru kun tu khyab pa dang / snyan pa'i grags pas o gling 'dzin mar khyab/ khong gi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i dmag 'thab dang srid phyogs kyi byas rjes nam yang nub pa med par lo tsho ni/ ṭā sbyo/sa kyi kyisag zu2gas tu batshe|da spusad la/ :sgo tsho nams kyis khong gi mdzad rjes la bskal ba'i bar du bsngags brjod kyi me tog sa la ten/ gtor gin 'duga.e cib(ṣṭha1 2879 )bdag dbang byed par chibs kha bsgyur/sa la ten zhes pa'i snyan grags che ba'i ming yig 'di'i nang du 'dzam gling gi dar rgyas dang dad pa zhes pa'i go don 'dus pa dang / khong gi rus ni a yig pu ( 77lo)dang / khor tig ( sgopo0 50076)gi mi red/1138lor gna' bo'i dpal yon dar yul dbyi rag(77711ga)byazlo /da

kyi the khu li thu(7746)bya ba'i mkhar grong du skyes/ khong sku bltams pa'i dus rabs ni tag tag ya gling nub ma'i se ar gru'i tho'u ce btsan rgyal( poṣṭhacho lko.a)rtsa 'thor du song ba dang rgyal khab chung chung mang por gyes pa'i dus la 'khel yod la/ khong nyid dgung lo 9steng yab chen zhal khrid ltar ze re ya'i(mas/༅ 57118)'du 'dzi che ba'i grong khyer chen mo ma hri gir(6 sna)bskyal zhing / tsan ci rgyal bo nor ten(0lo1)gyi pho brang du lo gang mang la 'dug tu bcug khong ni sku na phra ba'i dus nas blo rig rgod cing bslab la brtson pa/ snyan ngag rtsom rgyu dang 'jig 'ded rgyur dga' po yod pa'i khar sems rtse gcig gis dbyi si lem chos lugs klog zhib byed pa las gzhan/ da dung drag rtsal sbyong ba dang rgyun par bye thang du song nas rta rtsal mda' 'phen byed pa/ khom long yod dus spang ljongs kyi sil ra dang sdong gseb tu 'cham nyul byed par dga' bo yod skad/ bye thang dang spang ljongs kyis 'byung 'gyur gyi dmag don pa dang chab srid pa 'di nyid skyed bsring byas pa red ces kyang bshad chog pa red/sa la ten ma skyes gong / ro ma'i chos rgyal dang o gling nub ma'i ye shu'i chos lugs rgyal khab kyi rgyal pos se ar kro'u tho'u ce bas(2loṣṭharsāṣṭha)mjal bskor gyi lam bu bkag bcad byas par kha g.yar nas rgya gram dmag 'gul bslangs te gnas mchog ye lo'u sa lem(lkotsho smo3 )073707)bskyar bzung byas pa dang / se ar kro'u btsan rgyal nyams brlag byas shing drag shugs la brten nas pa li zi than(༅777 9703 1 0)gyi sa char ye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal khab dang gzhan ye shu'i chos lugs kyi rgyal khab gsum bcas btsugs/ de'i rjes nas kyang shar 'dul gyi sbyor ba rabs dang rim par rtsom pas dmigs yul nyag gcig ni shar phyogs kyi sa cha dang rgyu nor 'di/ /zung byed rgyu de red la/ sa la ten byis dus nas rgya gram dmag gis

btsan drag gtum spyod kyis shar phyogs pham par bzos pa'i ngang tshul dngos su mthong bas/ nam zhig rgya gram dmag dang khrag dmar gyi 'khor lo bskor te ṭī rda /ra yul du bda' dgos pa'i dam bca' sems pa'i a long dkyus la /ya ci ci rṣa / sdu nga༄ 3choXm1— —— can ris 〉〉 rdorig cing rmug ci pa sa cigacingapya/ji 2ru la ci ru nga ci / tsho (|ji sna kyi shā ci sdus ni / — la / ci4pho sijuge'i —73 4 2 chisas la ten gyis ru dpung la bkod 'doms byed bzhin pa/sa la ten gyi yab dang khu bo gnyis nas sngon chad tsan ci(rsāṣṭha)rgyalabo 127

nor ten la rgya gram dmag gis dpung 'jug byas pa 'gog myong ba dang /khyim mtshes rgyal khab e cib ni hpha tis ma rgyal rabs(ṣṭha lho ma'i 17 7)kyi dbang bsgyur 'og tu gnas pas de'i 'thab jus gnas babs dang rgyu 'byor nom gsum gyis rgya gram dmag rgyal gyi tam sems sred mig ling ling du drangs gyur ba dang / skabs de 'phral du e cib srid khongs su zing long gi 'gyur ba nyos par gyur stabs blon chen hra khur(chu mapo)gyis hpha tis ma'i srid dbang 'phrog ste sku drag mi drag dbar du dza drag che ba'i g.yul 'thab bshams/ rgya gram dmag rgyal gyis glags de dang bstun nas e cib la dpung 'jug byas pa na/ nor ten gyis sa la ten gyi khu bo zhir khos(lkoṣṭhasgo)dmag sna khrid de rgya gram dmag mi gdong gis bsu rgyu dang / sa de ga'i sa bab yongs su 'dzin rgyu'i bka' bgos/ sa la ten 1164lo nas bzung khu bo dang bsdongs nas snga gzhug tu e cib la dmag thengs gsum drangs pa dang kho rang sdun ru'i gdong len pa byas/ 'thab thengs re la rgyal kha ma lon pa gcig kyang med par dpung bu chen por bgrod lam yangs se phyes/ 1167lor sa la ten thengs gnyis par e cib sa thog tu bskyod pa dang khos kha grangs mang rgyu med pa'i dmag mi'i 'go rgod khrid de mi grangs rang dmag las ldab 'gyur gyis mang ba'i dgra dmag la phar rgol byed par bcoms pa na/ kho'i dmag mi tsho zhed cing bkong ba'i sems pa klong klong du gyur/ de'i tshe gdong len dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur ba'i sa la ten gyis chab dmag la ngar skul slong ba dang chabs cig dmag sems lhod la 'bab tu bzhag pa dang / khos sne khrid byas nas pha rol ba'i nyen sar ngar shugs kyis mchong ba na/ dmag mi tshor ngar skul mi dman pa thob par brten dgra dmag cham la phab/e cib cham la phab ma thag sa la ten gyis gces pa'i srog la ma 'dzem pa/ ༵༵ga mi 10)kyopa sne khrid byas te ya li hran ta yi mkhar rdzong brtan srung

byas pa na/ rgya gram dmag gi dpung bu chen pos mtsho skam gnyis kyi lam nas mkhar la rgol rdung byas pa dang / sa la ten gyi dmag shugs dang dngos shugs gang rung nas 'angang po mi 'ong bas 'di lta'i grong khyer chen mo zhig srung dgos pa bshad na sla mo zhig ga la yin/ yin na yang khos nyin 75ring la shi 'dzing ro 'dzing byas mthar dgra dmag phyir slog byas pa dang / rgya gram dmag re zhig phyir bskyod byas te e cib gnas tshul lhod 'jags su btang / rgya gram dmag gi blon po hra wer(mi/ 77)gyis lkog g.yos hpha tis ma'i rgyal rgyud bcad mthar/ zhir kho e cib kyi blon por bskos pa dang sa la ten e cib kyi rgyal don bcos skyong zur bar bskos/cung ma 'gor bar zhir kho tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs pa na/ sa la ten gyis khu bo'i blon tshab kyi las gnas phrag tu bzhes pa dang / dus der kho rang lo sum cur son ma thag yin la rang lo 32steng chab srid pa dang dmag don pa'i 'jon thang gcig lcogs su mngon/ nang khul du hra wer(mi/ 77)gyi tang lhag dang hpha tis ma rgyal rabs kyi ngo log pa'i phu dkrug mda' dkrug byed pa'i sbyor ba rtsom pa dang / phyi na rgya gram dmag mi'i lkog lta dang zing cha slong grabs byed pa'i gnas tshul mnga' bas/ khos nor ten rgyal khab kyi dmag dpon dang hpha tis ma rgyal rabs kyi blon chen gnyis kyi las thob bzung yod pa'i ngos thad nas/ nor ten gyi phrag dog dang hpha tis ma rgyal rabs yid tshim po mi 'ong ba bzlog phyir phan tshun dbar la do mnyam yong rgyu'i blang bya rgyun 'khyongs byas/ cung ma 'gor bar/ blon po tso ter ca(ma poṣṭha)yis gong ma srid gzhung gi ming g.yar nas zing cha bslangs pa na khos gang myur ci myur gyis zing cha zhi 'jags su btang ba dang / der mthud nas mtsho thog nas e cib la rgol ba'i rgya gram dmag gtor pham byas te kho tshos gang byung du har rgyug hol rgyug gi sbyor ngan spel mi thub par bgyis/ e cib zhi bde dang bde la ༵༵ pa

na/ sa la ten gyis gong ma'i srid gzhung gi srung dmag sgrig 'dzugs byas te srid gzhung nang gi dpon ngan rul sungs pa skor zhig gnas dbyung btang /khos dpal 'byor dang dmangs kyi 'tsho ba slar gso 'ong rgyu gtsigs su bzung nas chu bed yur chu'i bzo bkod las pa dang dmangs kyi dpya khral je yang du btang ste zhing las gong du spel zhing / e cib ni gsar du btab pa lta bu'i rnam pa shar bar brten blon po gsar bar e cib mang tshogs kyis bkur bsti bla med thob pa dang go gnas kyang je brtan du song /de nas cung ma 'gor bar/ hpha tis ma'i rgyal bo snyung gzhis mnar bas/sa la ten ni e cib kyi don dngos steng gi dbang bsgyur bar gyur dgos pa byung / kho'i skad grags e cib nas nyin re bzhin rgyas pa 'dis kyang bkra shis sna nag ma dang lhan cig 'grogs zhes pa bzhin khong la rkyen ngan zhig gi ngo so yod pa thag chod yin te/ nor ten gyis sa la ten gyi go sa shin tu che ba mthong nas der dpung 'jug byas te dbang cha 'phrog grabs byas kyang /dpung 'jug byed long ma 'ong bar 1174long grongs pa dang / sa la ten myur du khri la bsdad nas e cib kyi dbang bsgyur bar gyur cing tsan ci rgyal khab kyi bran 'og las thar ba'i gnas tshul dril sgrog byas/ de nas bzung e cib kyis a yig pu'i rgyal rabs 'dzugs thub pa byung /ya gling nub mar dmag drangs pa/sa la ten gyis e cib bdag tu bzung ste rang btsan byed du bcug par ma zad/ da dung ya gling nub ma'i dbyi si lem chos lugs la dad pa'i rgyal khab yod tshad gcig gyur byed rgyu'i spobs sems rgya chen po yod pa red/ 'di ni khos rgya gram dmag gi rogs skyor du bud yod pa'i la ting rgyal khab la phar sgo ni/ pa'i mig rgyang ring ba'i 'thab jus red/ der brten/ gcig gyur

gyi rgyal khab stobs ldan zhig yod tshe da gzod rgya gram dmag gi 'jab rgol ngal yod du bzlog nus pa yin/ sa la ten gyis ya gling nub ma dang hphe gling byang ma'i sa char dmag don bcad bzung byas yod pa'i rnam pa rtsa gtor byed rgyu 'gan du bzung nas/ hphe gling byang ma'i mtsho 'gram brgyud nas dmag drangs te pis lis hri(667/lo 2216157)bdag bzung byas pa dang / de nas mu mthud du dmag brgyab nas tho nyi zi(47mo)shar phyogs kyi ca pe zi(meba'ilo)dang lho phyogs zo tan(79)gyi mnga' khongs bar du dpung 'jug byas shing / de'i rjes nas ya gling nub mar dmag drangs te ta ma hri ga'i(lkob sna)grong khyer bde blag ngang lag tu thob/ der mthud nas nor ten gyi rgyal khab rtsis pa'i ze re ya dang dbyi rag gi rgyal khab kyang sa la ten la gtogs par gyur/ khos lo 12ring ya hphe gnyis kyi 'dres mdor gyur ba'i sa cha chen po de dbang du bsdus te ti ku le zi gtsang bo('a tshololo 11603)nas nyi lo gtsang bo'i nub phyogs kyi sdod 'bangs yod tshad kho'i chab 'og tu bsdus/ spyi lo 1185bar khong ni dbyi si lem pa'i stobs shugs ches che ba'i mi snar gyur/pa ku ta'i(3 2283686)dbyi si lem chos lugs kyi ming don steng gi ches mtho ba'i dbang bsgyur ba ste a pa si rgyal rabs ha las tha(tshomakhri )yis kyang sa la ten la e cib dang ze re ya/ ma ki lis pu(15tsharmespri1tsasgo)sogs kyi mnga' mdzad pa zhes pa'i cho lo bstsal/skabs de nas bzung pa li zi than(༅777 9703 1 0)gyi phra zhing ring ba'i gling phran khor chad de'i steng du la ting rgyal khab bzhi ma gtogs lhag med la/ de dag ni ye lo sa lem rgyal khab dang bcas pa'i an the khu(367jistamu)dang e tig sa(lha'u'agroshā )/ thunas po le(rnyes31lojilko/)bzhi po red/ sa la ten gyis rgya gram rgyal khab de dag yongs su bskor ba'i 'thab jus sngar nas 'grub tshar yod pa red/131

dmag dpon gyi cho lo thob yod pa'i sa la ten ni rgya gram dmag gi dgra ya rnying ba zhig yin mod kyang / de dang 'thab nas rgyal kha len rgyu ni de 'dra'i 'grub sla mo zhig ga la yin/ rgya gram rgyal khab dang ya gling nub ma'i rgyal khab bar rgyun du dmag don gyi 'gal ba byung gin yod la/ de tshor 'byor phyug che ba'i pe krin then gyis rgyab rogs byed kyi yod/ sngon chad sa la ten gyis ze re ya dbang du bsgyur ba'i 'go bcom pa na ye lo'u sa lem rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung gis kho'i mkho dngos skyel lam phu dkrug mda' dkrug byas pas dmag 'dren rgyur dka' khag chen po bzos/ 1177lor/ sa la ten gyis e cib sa mtshams brgal nas ye lo'u sa lem rgyal khab kyi sgo chen a zi kha lung mkhar rdzong(༅lo667)yongs su bskor ba dang / de nas ye lo'u sa lem phyogs su dmag drangs pa na/ lo mo'u la nyi'i( lo77)ri 'gag tu kho'i dmag dpung rgya gram dmag dang 'phrad pas de tshos rgol rdung drag pos kho tsho pham par btang ste nyen kha'i g.yang du bskyur/ de nas sa la ten sogs rgyugs rtsal mnga' ba'i rnga mong skor zhig la bzhon nas bros byol byas shing / nyen kha'i gnas las thar gang thub kyis khe lor(77)'byor/ de'i rjes nas khos e cib kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos shugs dang rgyu shugs spyad nas dmag dpung hrag sgrig byas te/ go skabs yongs su smin pa na rgya gram dmag gis btsan bzung byas yod pa'i sa cha phyir len byed rgyu'i sta gon la zhugs//sa la ten la ya gling nub ma'i 'thab jus steng dge kha thob pas ze re ya'i phyogs kyi myur lam brgyud nas rgya gram dmag sar dpung 'jug byas te ngal chung 'bras chen gyi phan nus thon/ 'thab 'khrug rgyun mthud nas 1180lor thon pa na/ ye lo sa lem gyi phyogs nas 'thab mtshams 'jog rgyu'i bsam tshul bton/ skabs der rgyal pham gyi dbye thag gsal bo ma chod rung khong1 byi2 re bzhin g.yul sar dngos zhugs byed ba'in yod pa red/ yin yang /

khong ni lhan skyes nas zhi bder dga' bas mi shi rta 'gyel gyi las la sun po byung gi yod phyir kho tsho'i bsam tshul la 'thad pa byung zhing 'thab mtshams 'jog rgyu'i chings yig bzhagachings yig rgyab bskyur gyi 'thab 'khrug bslangs pa/sa la ten ni mi gshis drang zhing kha dan don la gnas pa zhig yin pas/khos rgya gram dmag rgyal la bzhag pa'i chings yig gi rtsa don brtsi srung byas te/dus yun thung ngu tsam gyi ring la phan tshun bar la don dag ci yang ma byung bar bsdad kyang / ye lo'u sa lem rgyal khab kyi chos skyong srid gzhung skya dmag gi 'go gtso hra tis rong(mi lko)gi lecin na tig(cho po0)gis bsam bzhin du chings yig rgyab bskyur gyi sbyor ba bcoms shing / ta ma hri ki nas me ca(za10)mjal smor gyi lam bar kho rang nyid bca' sdod byed sa'i khu la khu'i mkhar rdzong(༅7776)brtsigs/ chings yig ltar na/ dbyi se lem chos lugs dang ye shu'i chos lugs kyi sdod 'bangs yongs la lam 'dir zhugs rgyu'i dbang cha yod kyang / chings yig gi snag tsha skam long ma byung bar khos yod tshad la rgyab 'gal byas pa dang / 1180lo'i dbyar kha nas bzung khos me car 'gro mkhan tshong ba'i thog dmag drangs te rgyu nor mang po 'phros bcom btang / sa la ten gyis de don thos 'phral ye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal bor tshong ba'i gyong gud dang gnod 'tshe la 'jal tshab sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton pa na/le cin na tig gis 'jal tshab sprod rgyu khas mi len pa'i khar sngar bzhin rang 'dod rang bsam kho na byed pa red/ sa la ten phyi rol la dmag rgyag par chas pa'i glags dang bstun/ dmag gru'i ru khag bkol te e cib dang rgya gar bar 'gro 'ong byed kyin pa'i tshong dmag ru dpung la 'jab rgol byas nas grong khyer bcad bzung byas pa dang / ha lam me ca dang me tis(zalko)sa sdusanyi

ga 'phrog 'dzin byas nas dbyi si lem sdod 'bangs khrod du 'jigs skul chen po bslangs/sa la ten dmag la ma bskyod gong du dmag dpung khag cig kho'i nu bor sprad pa dang e cib kyi lta rtog spyi ba ma la khu(6ṣṭha༅)bkod 'doms par bskos pa dang / des dmag gru'i ru khag cig la sne khrid byas te le cin na tig gis mngags pa'i mtsho jag dmag gru gcig rtsa med du btang zhing grong khyer kyang tshur blangs/ sa la ten le cin na tig gas 'khrug rkyen bslangs pa la khong khro gting nas langs te rnga gdang rgyug dang dud pa langs rgyug byed mkhan de la khrims chad nan po gcod dgos pa'i mna' bskyal ba dang / le cin na tig gis gtor brlag bzos par rkyen byas te sa la ten dang ye lo'u sa lem bar gyi 'thab mtshams bzhag pa'i rgyun skyong ma thub par 'thab 'khrug bskyar langs mi byed ka med du gyur/ yin yang rgya gram dmag gis shar phyogs la rgyang skyod pa'i go rim khrod du/ pe krin then btsan rgyal la rgyun par god chags snga rjes su byung myong bas/ phyi rol gyi stobs shugs la zhed snang dang sems khur che ba dang de gnyis po bar du rim bzhin 'cham mthun yong gi med pa'i glags btsal nas sa la rten gyis pe krin then la mdza' 'brel legs po btsugs te rang gi nye logs su 'jigs sa med par byas shing / rgya gram dmag gi rgyab rogs gtso bo rbad de bcad/1186lo'i lo smad du/ rgyun du don rkyen slong bar dga' ba'i le cin na tig gis yang bskyar 'jab rgol byas par ma zad khe lo nas ta ma hri kur 'gro 'ong byed pa'i tshong ba 'phrog bcom byas shing / khos sa la ten la 'thab mtshams bzhag pa'i chings yig khas gtan nas mi len pa'i khar mthong chung gi tshig gis lan ldon pa na/ sa la ten khros 'khrug chen po langs te 6 lha 'di/ bye bslangs te bden pa rgyab la sher nas nag phyogs pham par rgyag rgyu

dril bsgrags byas/ 1187lor sa la ten gyis dpung bu chen pos khu la khu'i btsan rdzong la rgol rdung drag tu byas te le cin na tig gis bcad bzung byas pa'i sa cha tshal ba tshal phyed du btang / de'i rjes tag tag la khos yang bskyar dmag dpung mngags nas e cib nas ta ma hra ki la 'gro ba'i tshong skyel ru dpung la srung skyob byed pa'i shugs bsnan te rgya gram dmag gis bgrod lam 'gog mi thub par byas pa dang / rgya gram dmag la 'thab pa'i go rim khrod du sa la ten gyis de'i nang khul gyi khag so so'i 'gal ba'i stobs shugs spyad nas dgra yar rgol rdung btang / skabs der khor 'brel 'dris cung legs pa'i rgya gram dmag gi 'go gtso le min tig(ṣṭha )gi yid 'thad 'thob par brten/ de'i srung yul brgyud nas rngam ston rang bzhin ldan pa'i dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas/ le min tig dang le cin na tig sogs 'go gtso gzhan pa'i dbar la mthun 'cham rtsa ba nas 'ong gi med skad/ khos de'i go skabasaspyad nas rang gi 'char gzhi lag bstar bya thub pa byas pa dang / a la po'i mnyam 'brel skya dmag 1700lhag yod pa des lam bar du cang la gnod 'tshe spu tsam ma btang mod/ ye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal po zhi an ke hri(khro.a cho6)dang rgya gram dmag gi skya dmag 'ga' zhig gis bsam bzhin du btsal nas 'ong ste 'thab 'khrug bslangs te sa la ten pham du bcug par ma zad/rgya gram sman khang gi skya dmag thon gyi thon krang gson bzung byas/ rgya gram dmag dpung gzhan pa dag gis da thengs sa la ten gyis pham kha nyos pa'i spro sems kyis rab tu brtas pa'i ngang du nye 'dabs kyi grong khyer nang g.yul thob dngos rdzas nyar tshags byed kyin 'dug la/ sa la ten gyi skya hrag dmag gis snga mo nas kho tshor sgug bsdad yod pa sems la'ang shar gyi med/ glo bur ba'i drag rgol thengs gcig gis rgya gram dmag mir shi rmas tshabs chen btardo 3/5

blo thag zad chod kyis rgyal kha blangs pa/1187lo'i zla 7par/ ye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal pos sa la ten gyis gzhi rgya che ba'i dmag 'dren rgyu yin pa shes nas/ le cin na tig dang le min tig tshud ba'i rgya gram dmag gi 'go gtso yod tshad bsdus te rgya gram dmag rgyal nang khul du dmag mi sdeb langs byed du bcug pa dang btsan rdzong so so'i nang du so dmag bzhag cing dmag shugs 1200)la slebs/sa la ten gyi dmag gi dpung bu skya dmag gis grub la dmag shugs pha rol las che/ khos chu la rgyab gtad nas g.yul bshams dgos la rgyab phyogs kyi sngo lem lem gyi the pa le mtsho(meng༅sto//glo)kha dmag rtas khengs shing / gri mdung nags ltar 'dzing / gal te rang nyid pham song tshe rang dmag yod tshad chu la 'debs pa las thabs gzhan med la/ de tsho pham par byas kyang mkhar rdzong nang phyi sdur byas chog pas sa bab kyi cha nas sa la ten thabs rdugs kyi gnas su ltung yod mod/ kho'i lag tu dgra bo pham par gtong byed kyi 'gag rtsa gtso bo ste chu'i thon khungs shor yod pas/ sa la ten gyis yun ring 'dang zhig brgyab mthar thabs bkod cig yid la 'khor byung / myur du the pa le'i (8༅sto /)grong khyer phyogs la dpung 'jug byas pa dang / 'di ni pa li zi than gyi 'thab jus grong gtso yin skad/ grong khyer nang da dung rgya gram dmag gtso yod pa dang khos de yongs su bskor nas de tsho chu med sa'i sa skam zhig tu bcug cing de nas phar rgol bya rtsis byas/ rgya gram dmag gi 'go ba dag gis kha gtad du ji ltar langs rgyur mnyam gros byas te kho tsho'i bar la rtsod gleng byung / le min tig nyen mchong rgol rdung byed rgyur yid 'thad pa min la/khos the pa le'i grong khyer brtan srung byas te sa la ten gyi dmag yun ring la mazhi/ sdudabs nas bkag skyil bgyis nas phyi nang gang la'ang 'gro mi thub

pa'i gnas su ltung dgos par bsam yang / kho'i bsam tshul der mi gzhan pas ngo rgol byas pa dang / rgyal po ke hri nas kyang yid 'thad ma byung /rgya gram dmag gis brel brel 'tshub 'tshub kyis tshwa med khron pa rgyab tu bskyur nas/ 1187lo'i zla 7par/ sngon skyod dmag dpung chu thigs tsam yang mthong rgyu med pa'i bye thang zhig la thon/ dus der tag tag tsha ba ha cang che ba'i dbyar gzhung la 'khel yod pas lam bar du bye zegs kyi 'tshub ma lding ba dang / kho tshos bzung yod pa'i btung chu yongs su tshar nas kha skom te ci bya gtol med du gyur/ sa la ten gyis dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul shes ma thag dga' ba 'bum gyis brtas te 'phral ma nyid du dmag dpung khag cig mngags nas rgya gram dmag gi sngon skyod dmag dpung bkag cing de tsho chu med sa'i sa cha nas yongs su bskor ba dang / dmag lhag ma rnams kyis lam bskor nas brgyug ste dgra bo'i gtso dmag la dpung 'jug byas/rgya gram dmag gi sngon skyod dmag dpung gi mdun a la po'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis bkag ste the pa le'i mtsho khar thon ma thub par/dmag mi tshang ma thang chad cing bkres skom gyis mnar ba dang / dmag sna khrid mkhan gyi le min tig gis mi mngags nas rgyal po ke hri la dmag dpung mdun skyod byed pa la shugs snon byed dgos pa'i 'tshub cha bslangs shing /dmag shugs gcig tu bsdus te the pa lis sam yo tan gtsang bo'i(292ma)khar dpung 'jug byas te chu'i thon khungs kyi gnad don thag gcod dgos la/gal srid de ma thub tshe dmag mi yongs rdzogs 'chi ba'i gnas su lhung yod par bshad/ ke hri'i dmag dpung gis tsha gdug gdong gis bsus te mdun du myur skyod byed pa na/ glo bur du kho tsho'i rgyab srung dmag dpung la sa la ten gyi gzhu 'dzin dmag gis gsang stabs kyis mda' mo char du snyil te 'brel zam rtsa ba nas bcad/137

le min tig gi dmag dpung dka' tshegs che ba'i 'thab 'khrug de brgyud mthar yang bskyar dbyin lis kha shas la mdun du/ skyod pa dang /rjes kyi ke hri'i dmag dpung yang bang chad 'u thug gis bskyod de sa bab mtho ba'i g.yang ngos nas dmar sgar brgyab/ gnam mtha'i nub la khyad kyi nyi 'od kyang ches mjug mthar lhag pa'i mkhar steng la phog 'dug la de nas phar bltas na/ rwa co'i dbyibs dang mtshungs pa'i de'u 'bur gnyis ker rer 'greng 'dug cing de'i ming la 6 he ten rwa mtshe mi zhes zer/ ri 'dabs dang mi ring ba'i sar na grong tsho chung chung zhig chags yod la de'i ming la he ten grong tsho zer/ ri'i phyed ngos su rgya gram dmag gi dmag sgar 'tshub mor bstar nas yod/ sa la ten gyi dmag dpung gis gsang stabs kyis dmag sgar de'i nye mthar dpung 'jug byas pa dang / nam phyed la thon tsa na phyi rol nas a la po mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi ki ki bso bso'i skad cor grags 'ong pas/ke hri dang le cin na tig sogs 'go ba tsho gtsos pa'i dmag mi tsho skrag nas ton 'thor bar gyur/ der mthud nas kho tsho'i sgar thog dud smug gis yongs su sgrib cing dud dri'i khrod sdod thabs med par bzos/ de ni ma gzhi nas sa la ten gyi 'jon zhing mdzangs pa'i du ba'i phar rgol byed pa'i 'thab jus yin phyir/ kho tsho mtshan gang bor dud zhag khrod nyam chung ngang mi 'dug rang 'dug tu btang / skabs 'dir sa la ten la mtshon na rgyal kha len thub pa'i gdeng tshod sngar las brtan pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni sngon chad rgya gram dmag dang phan tshun 'thab res byed pa'i nyams myong las shes pa ni de tshos lcags khrab can dang btsan shugs la brten nas nye 'thab kyi dge kha len pa las dgra ya gdong gtugasanas 'thab mi thub pa de red/ de bas mda' mo'i mtheb rtsal spyad nas dmag dpung bgrod yul ci yang med par khegs par bya dgos par brte148/ khos mtshan gang por mtshams chad med par mda' mo char tu snyil ba

dang / mdas mi 'dang ba shes nas rnga mong 70lhag la mda' bkal nas 'ong zhing / he ten ri bo'i(ṭhaṣṭha lo)'i sgo mo yongs su bcad/ ke hri yis khegs pa'i sgo mo brtol bsam ste rkang dmag dkyus la 'then pa dang skya dmag mtha' ru bkod sgrig byas te a la po mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi rta dmag dang gzhu thogs dmag dpung phyogs la phar rgol byas pa na/ sa la ten sku dngos nas dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byas te dgra bo gdong gis bsus/sdun gyi rgya gram skya dmag mdun nas mdun du dpa' ngar gyis mchong gin yod la/ shul gyi gzhug dmag kha skom nas lus shugs kyang 'khos chung bas phyir ldog ste he ten rwa mtshe'i ngos su bros pa dang / de nas rkang dmag gcig gis 6 a la po'i dmag thon thal/ srog skyob rogs ’ ces skad cor brgyab pas/dmag mi yongs kyi sems pa zing zing long long du btang / ke hri rang nyid rgyal po zhig yin pa'i dzig nyams ngoms te dmag mi tsho la na re/ rgya gram dmag mi de dag la kha ya byed mi dgos/ ri las mar bab shog dang 'di nas chu gang 'dod du btung chog zer/ de nas rgyal pos dmag dkyus nas rgya gram chen po zhig bslangs shing rgya gram dmag gis khong tsho'i khyad du 'phags pa'i mtshon rtags mthong byung ba na/ de mur ngar shugs kyis kun nas brtas te rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis rkang dmag dang skya dmag mnyam rub kyis a la po'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung la 'thab ru bshams/lcags khrab gyon yod pa'i rgya gram skya dmag gis dpa' ngar zhum med kyis srog bsdos dmar 'dzing gi 'khor lo bskor te mda' mdung gi drag char brtol te a la po'i dmag dpung skor cig khyur mid du btang ste ngar shugs drag tu ngoms/ skabs der 'thab 'khrug la zur bkod 'then gyin bsdad yod pa'i sa la ten gyis hrag dmag bkol thengs gcig gis de tsho'i gdong mchong ru dpung yongs su bskor nas pham par btang / 139

sa la rten gyis g.yul sa'i gnas tshul la rgyun par mnyam 'jog byed cing / kho'i bu chung ba a hphu'u ta(arke77)rang gi 'khris na yod pa'i sgang der rgya gram dmag gis yang bskyar dpung 'jug byas nas pha rol pham par brgyab pa na/ kho'i bu chung ba dga' thag chod de 6 rgya gram dmag pham par bzos song mi zhes skad cor brgyab pa la sa la ten na re 6 kha rog sdod/ rgya gram dmag gi dmag sgar ma slog bar du nga tshos kho tsho pham par btang song ’ zhes bshad mi rung zer/ a sgo'u ta yis phreng bstar sgrig pa'i dmag sgar khrod du rtse mo dkar po yin pa'i sgar chen zhig phub yod pa rgyang nas mthong ba dang /rgya gram dmag mi srung tshogs rub pa ltar phyir dmag sgar du 'gro bzhin 'dugs la ten gyi a la po mnyam 'brel dmag dpung phyogs de sar rgyugs te skad cig de nyid la/ rgyal po'i dmag sgar dkar bong bong ba de yang ngang gis sa ru sgyel song /ke hri dang le cin na tig sogs dang rgya gram dmag gi lhag 'phro rnams he ten ri bo'i zur zhig tu 'khum nas sdod pa na/ rgya gram dmag gi sdun srung dmag dpung sa la ten gyi dmag dpung gis ded nas thon te rgyal po'i dmag lhag 'phro dang chabs cig a la po'i dmag dpung gi dkyus la lhung / rang gi rmog bor khrab bskyur byas pa'i rgya gram dmag mi tshos mtshon mgo la bkyags shing rgya gram gyi phyogs su 'khor nas shi 'jigs las skyob dgos pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa dang / rgyal po ke hri nas le min tig la ji ltar byas na srog thar 'ong ba'i thabs bkod dris pa na/ le min tig kyang 'thab 'dzing gi stobs shugs yod pa'i sngon srung dmag dpung la brten nas thar lam zhig phyes te rgyal po 'chi ba las skyob par yid 'thad byung / le min tig gis har rgyug hol rgyug gis zur gzhan zhig nas thar lam zhig btod pa na/ de ru dmag dardidī ༵ bkod 'doms byed kyin pa'i sa la ten gyi tsha bo tha zhi ar o ma ar

( skopo 67)gyis 'gog rgol byed dka' bar bsam nas thar lam zhig phyes rjes le min tig gi sngon srung dmag dpung de ru thar song yang /rjes kyi ke hris sne khrid yod pa'i pham dmag skor sngar bzhin thar ma thub/ sa la ten gyis skor dkyil je dam du btang zhing a la po mnyam 'brel dmag dpung phyogs bzhi nas rub 'ong ste mda' mdung gri gsum ral kha'i khrod nas bya spu rlung gis bdas pa bzhin du byas/ rgya gram dmag dpung khag gcig gis thar lam brtol nas bros byol byed thub song yang / a la pos skya dmag ra mdar rgyugs te yongs su bskor ba na/ rgya gram dmag mi mang che ba kha phyir 'khor nas he ten ri ngos su 'jogs nas sa la ten gyi chab dmag bar la bcug pa na/ sa la ten gyis rta rgyab nas skor gzigs shig byas rjes bya 'phur ba ltar ri ngos su brgyugs te/ 'thab mo bar ri'i mtha' bskor nas me gtong dgos pa'i bka' phabs shing / me rgol gyi sbyor ba drag tu bcom pa na rgya gram dmag dpung gis de la rgol lan sprod ma nus par mgo 'dogs byed dgos pa byung / g.yul ra'i ga sa gang du a la po dmag gis gson bzung byas yod pa'i dmag mi mthong rgyu yod pa dang / yang 'thab mo ba kha shas kyis dmag sgar gyi chon thag gcig gis de tsho'i dmag mi 30tsam lhan sbrel byas yod pa mthong rgyu 'dug/ 'thab 'khrug 'di'i khrod du sa la ten gyis dpa' ngar cher skyed kyis rgya gram dmag gi 'go gtso mang po bzung yod la/ de'i nang du ye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal po ke hri dang gyod sna kha mchu la dga' ba'i le cin na tig da dung rgya gram dmag gi dmag dpon gzhan pa dag kyang yod/ tha na rgya gram dmag gi mtshon rtags su byed pa'i gser dang mu tig gi phras brgyan pa'i rtsa che ba'i rgya gram yang sa la ten gyi dgra thob dngos rdzas su gyur/rgya chen blo khog yangs po la// ri rab lhun po yin yang shong //'thab 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ sa la ten gyis phartsa che ba'i 1)sbyong

dmag dag kho'i sgar nang du bos pa na/ ye lo'u sa lim gyi rgyal po ke hri skrag nas lhug lhug tu 'dar bzhin 'dug sa la ten gyis kho tsho 'dzum gyis bsus shing / ke hre rang gi 'khris su sdod du bcug nas sems tshags byed mi dgos pa'i sems gso mdzad pa dang sbrags/ shar phyogs rgyal po'i phyag len ltar zhabs zhu ba mngags te bkres nas shi la nye ba'i rgyal bo ke hrir sil khu grang mo shel phor gang 'dren du bcug ke hris kho'i 'thung 'phro rang gi blos thub le cin na tig la byin pa na/ sa la ten khros 'khrug chen po langs te/ smyo khyod la ngas chog mchan ma thob par ci'i phyir shel phor kho la byin pa yin mizhes skad gseng mthon po'i ngang shel phor ster mtshams bcad/ der mthud nas le cin na tig gis chings yig rgyab skyur dang / 'thab 'khrug ngan slong byas pa'i nag nyes re re bzhin bgrang na yang / le cin na tig ni dpa' bo gzhol med dang glen pa go med ces pa'i dpe bzhin sngar ltar gyong 'dug byas/ sa la ten gyis a la po'i gri gug sked nas bton te jus thabs ngan slong byed mkhan la khrims chad nan mo gcod rgyu yin pa'i gnas bab mthong ba na ke hri skrag nas lus zungs sbrid par gyur/ sa la ten na re 6 rgyal po zhig gis rgyal po gzhan mi gsod// le cin na tig byas nyes thal drags la// khrel med bya ba gcig las gnyis las min// rang srog rang gas chod ces bka' bab bo//mi he ten 'khrug chen rjes kyi nyin gnyis par the pa le grong khyer gyi mi nams kyis sa la ten la mgo btags pa dang / khos grong khyer bdag 'dzin byed mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa bde 'jags ngang der bral du bcug te ten 'thab 'khrug nas bzung rgya gram dmag dpung lo rgyus steng pham 'go brtsams pa red/ de'i rjes nas bzung rgya gram dmag gis sa la ten la 'gog rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs nyag phra bar gyur pa dang / kho tshos brtsigs pa'i brtan srursha sdukar rdzong dag kyang srung dmag med pa'i rdo phung du gyur/ sa la ten

gyis rgyal kha thob pa'i go skabs bzung nas mdun skyod byas te zla 7pa'i nang mtsho kha'i grong khyer gtso bo a khi(lo7)bzung / zla 9par a zi kha long(lo 67)yang kho'i chab 'og tu 'dzul/sa la ten gyi bsam par ye lo'u sa lem yang ye shu'i chos lugs kyi gnas rdzong zhig yin par ma zad/ dbyi se lem chos lugs kyi gnas rdzong zhig kyang yin skad/ khos grong khyer der 'thab 'khrug gi gyong kun thebs tu 'jug ma 'dod par ye lo'u sa lem gyi sdod 'bangs kyis drang mor mgo 'dogs byed srid na rang skyong byed chog ces bton kyang / kho'i re 'dod de dang len ma byas pas zla 9pa'i tshes 20nyin sa la ten gyi dmag ye lo'u sa lem gyi mkhar 'dabs la blugs shing / mkhar rdzong ma skor ba'i yar sngon du kho tshos gson bzung byas yod pa'i rgya gram dmag gi dbyi pa len gyi pa lis an(༅lko)0)gyis sa la ten la re zhu byas te/ kho mkhar rdzong du song nas rang gi chung ma len dgos tshul dang rgyal po dgrar mi 'dzin rgyu'i mna' bskyal ba na sa la ten gyis kyang kho rang grong khyer nang nyin gcig la bsdad chog pa'i chog mchan gnang /bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la pa lis an ye lo sa lem du slebs rjes rgya gram dmag gi skul slong 'og rang gi kha dan dang rgyab 'gal byas te/ mkhar rdzong srung ba'i gtso 'gan phrag tu khur/ de nas sa la ten gyis dmag la bkod 'doms byas te mkhar rgol byas/ ye lo'u sa lem gyis yun thung gi ring mkhar rdzong srung thub byas kyang cung ma 'gor bar ltogs skom gyi 'jigs nyen bzlog ma nus par mtha' mar sa la ten la 'grig mthun 'ong ba'i re ba zhus/skya dmag pa lis an gyi kha dan tshig la ma gnas rung / sa la ten gyis la ting par cha rkyen ha cang yang mo bton pa ste/ gal srid kho tsho mi re re nas gser sgor 1)sprod nus na song chog la/ bud med kyis phyed ka dang byis pas 1re sprad na chog par byas/ gal te dbul bos gser sgor sprod mi nus na ༵ byin

then gyi zangs sgor khri 3re nges par du 'phrod dgos/ de ltar 'ong tshe mi 7000lhag rang dbang gis song chog pa yin/ ye lo'i sa lem gyi la ting bas cha rkyen de mur dang len byas te/ zla 10pa'i tshes 2nyin chings yig bzhag cing sa la ten gyi dpung bu chen po grong khyer du 'gro ru bcug pa dang / dus de nas bzung rgya gram dmag gis lo ngo 88ring bdag tu bzung ba'i gnas rdzong yang bskyar mu'u zi lin gyi lag tu son/1099lor rgya gram dmag gis ye lo'u sa lem blangs rjes sngon chad dbyi si lem gyi chos dad mang tshogs khri bdun dmar gsod byas kyang sa la ten gyis la ting sdod 'bangs la ro skyin ro yis len pa'i dgra sha ma bstsal bar/ de las ldog ste ngan lan bzang 'jal gyi sgam dkyel yangs pa'i rnam 'gyur bzung nas grong khyer phyi nang du tshong ra sgo 'byed byed dgos pa'i bka' phab phyin/ sdod 'bangs kyis dngos po btsong nas sgor mor brje nas mi tshe la rang dbang thob pa red/ 'on kyang sgor mo'i dka' khag yod pa'i dbul khyim ha cang mang po yod cing sa la ten gyi spun mched se hphe ting(671)gis de'i nang nas sdod 'bangs 1000bdams nas/ kho rang la gnang rgyu'i re ba zhus rjes de dag tshang ma glod grol btang bar sa la ten yang yid 'thad byung ba dang / khos yang bskyar rgya srang du mi mngags nas spyi dmangs sgor mo sprod mi thub pa'i rgan pa yod tshad rang dbang gis 'gro chog ces gsal brda btang /gnas tshul 'di thos rjes mi 'di dag la kra lo si sgo chen(7lta'i lo/ci )nas nyi ma shar ba nas sa rub pa'i dbar du da gzod phyin tshar song /lo gnyis par ke hri yis yi lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal sa ring nas bskyur ba'i dam bca' bzhag rjes kho dang bcas pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung gi 'go gtso 'ga' zhig kyang btson grol btang / sa la ten gyi dkyil yangs la byams sedi~Xn pa'i byed stangs 'dir shar nub kyi mi grags dag gis rjes su yi

rangs dang bstod bsngags byed kyin yod/dpa' rgod zung gi dmag 'khrugaye lo'u sa lem gyi rgyal srid shor ba'i gnas tshul gyis o gling nub ma hril por grags 'gul chen po byung la/ ye shu chos lugs kyi gling yongs su 'jigs nyen chen po bzos skad/ o gling nub ma'i rgyal bo rnams kyis thengs gsum pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung shar rgol byed rgyur rtsa 'dzugs byas pa red/ 'jar man gyi rgyal po hphe thu le smra dmar(0lo1lo tsham /)dang chos rgyal hphe le(ṣṭha1tsho/7)/ le khra seng snying(ma ji ༅4)bcas ming du grags pa'i mi sna 'di gsum gtso byas te yang bskyar shar rgol gyi lam du chas pa dang / thog mar shar phyogs su thon pa'i hphe thu le smra dmar gyis 'jom bag med par ga sa gang du dgra btsugs/ lta na sdug pa'i pe ta ljon shing gi skyed tshal du cham cham byed pa'i sa la ten yang bskyar drag chas spras nas g.yul sar chas te dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs kyis ga sa gang nas 'jar man gyi rgya gram dmag dpung la 'gog rgol byas/ khu nyi'i ye'i(774)nye 'gram du kho rang ngo mas hphe thu le smra dmar dang dmag 'khrug drag po zhig brgyab/ 'thab 'khrug la dga' ba'i smra dmar ya zhi ya chung bar bskyod dus chu la byings nas shi song bas 'jar man gyi rgya gram dmag dpung 'go med mjug ldum du gyur nas 'thab 'khrug de rang 'jags su song /skoradakyil rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru chags pa'i gru 'gag gtso bo a khi la rgya gram dmag gi rgol rdung thebs pa dang / seng snying rgyal bo le khra yi dmag gru'i ru khag gis 'thab gru 50dang zur 'degs mtsho gru 10/ skyel 'dren mtsho gru 100bcas su dmag dpung phon chen drud nas mtsho thog nas thon te chos rgyal hphe li sogs kyi mkhar rgol rgya gram dmag dpung du zhugs/ le khra ba~X pa

'dis rgya gram dmag dpung yongs la stobs shugs dang spobs sems bstsal zhing / dbyin ji'i rgyal bo 'di'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yongs su grags pa dang / de ni dpe mtshon ldan pa'i skya rgod pa zhig kyang red/ kho'i sne khrid 'og a khi mkhar rdzong la dpung 'jug gi rba rlabs gcig 'jags gnyis langs su byas/ sa la ten gyis rgyun chad med par dmag mngags nas a khi yo ze(༅༅06)la rogs 'degs byas te yang nas yang du byung ba'i nyen kha'i gnas las bskyabs pa dang / rgol srung 'thab 'khrugs 'di dus yun mi thung ba zhig la brgyab/ srung dmag gi 'bru rigs zad pa'i gnas tshul 'og tu le khras da gzod thabs jus sna tshogs kyis mkhar gyang brtol nas a khi mkhar rdzong len thub pa byung /sa la ten gyis dmag bsdu mtshon sgrig byas nas 'thab 'khrug sta gon la shugs snon pa'i sgang la rgya gram dmag gi nang khul du 'khrug long byung / chos rgyal hphe le yis rtag tu le khrar lkog mtshon 'debs bzhin yod pa dang / le khra yi ming grags nyin re bzhin je cher 'gro bar phrag dog langs pas hpha ran si'i rgya gram dmag tshang ma phyir 'then nas le khra gcig pus sa la ten dang g.yul 'thab tu bcug le khras blo gcig sems gcig gis gnas mchog ye lo'u sa lem len bsam nas rgya gram dmag khri 3khrid nas a khi nas bud de mtsho mtha' brgyud nas dpung 'jug byed pa dang / kho'i dmag gru'i ru khag gis gzhug mkho'i dngos rdzas drud nas mnyam du mdun du skyod/ de'i skabs tag tag la le khra yi logs gnyis dang gzhug phyogs su sa la ten gyi 'thab mo ba 'bor chen gyis nyin mtshan med par 'jab lta byas te/ kho'i dmag dpung la 'jigs snang skul bzhin 'dug de nas nyin 15ring la le khra'i dmag dpung a la po ba'i bar mtshams med pa'i mda' char 'og tu spo skyod byas pa red/yin ༵ yang pha rol ba'i 'thab mo ba 'thab 'khrug gi gdong la mi 'bud par

rang phyogs kyi dmag shugs bsdu sgrig byed kyin 'dug le khra a tso tho'u zi(༅ṣṭha༅lo)la slebs pa na/ sa la ten dmag dpung gis glo bur du dpung rgol gyis le khra dmag dpung dang bcas pa phyogs gsum nas bskor te sa lag mthil lta bu zhig tu bcug rtsis grangs mi lon pa'i mda' mo'i ral kha le khra yi dmag phyogs su drag char bzhin snyil pas/ rgya gram dmag gis mtsho la rgyab gtad nas mda' mo phub kyis 'gog pa las thabs gzhan ma byung / mi mang po zhig thengs 'di'i nyen kha las thar ma thub par gces pa'i tshe srog shor/le khra yis dmag mi rnams la nges par du pha rol ba sdug rus kyis 'gog dgos pa dang a la po dmag gis mda' mo yongs su 'phangs tshar rjes thar lam zhig brtol dgos pa'i bka' brda btang yang / sa la ten gyis de mur dmag dpung khrid nas bya 'phur ba ltar phyir bud song bas/ le khra rjes su rgyugs kyang re ba don stong du gyur/seng snying rgyal pos mu mthud nas ya ten dang hpha ran si'i phyogs su dmag drangs kyang / sa la ten gyis snga mo nas srung dmag phyir 'then byas tshar bas/ der slebs dus kho'i lag tu mkhar stong zhig las ci yang ma thob/der mthun nas le khra yis nye 'dabs kyi ku'e sa lis ya(glo lko/༅)bcad bzung byas pa red/ 1192lo'i dpyid mgor seng snying rgyal po'i dmag ye lo'u sa lem la 'byor/ rgya gram dmag mi yod tshad kyis sngar nas gnas rdzong de 'phrog rgyu'i dam bca' yod/ rgya gram dmag dpung mtsho mtha' brgyud nas zhi po long(lko446)ri 'gag tu slebs dus ye lo'u sa lem gyi mchod rten rtse mo rgyang nas mthong thub mod/ de'i mtha' 'khor du a la po'i mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug le khras tshul 'di mthong dus kho rang sa la ten gyi g.yo 'og tu tshud par dogs nas sngon skyod kyi spobs pa zhum nas de mur tshogs 'du bsdus te dmag mi phyir 'then byed rgyu'i thag bcad ma thag sa la nā/ gyi

dmag dpung gar 'ong 'di 'ong med par glo bur du rgya gram dmag dpung la rgol rdung drag po bgyis/e cib dmag dpon dang seng snying rgyal po gnyis kyis dmag 'khrugs thengs 'gar brgyab pa dang kho gnyis phan tshun dpa' mdzangs la khas len ster ba las rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed ma nus/ kho gnyis kyi 'thab 'khrugs kyi lag thabs la g.yo lhad med de/ thengs shig la le khrar mda' phog ste rta thog nas lhung yang sa la ten gyis de gsod rgyu phar zhog khong la yang bskyar dmag rta zhig byin nas glod grol btang / le khra yis rgyal kha thengs 'gar blangs mod kyang mthar thug ye lo'u sa lem len ma thub/ de mtshungs su dbyin ji'i rgyal khab nang khul nas khor ngo rgol byed mkhan byung bas sa la ten dang nyung mthar yang lo 3dang zla 3la 'thab 'khrug mi byed pa'i chings yig bzhagade nas bzung / ye shu chos lugs pa tsho rang dbang gis mjal bskor la song chog pa'i sgo mo yongs su phyes/thengs 'dir shar rgol byas pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung tshang ma pa li si than nas phyir 'then byas pa dang / sa la ten thengs gsum pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung gtor mkhan gyi dpa' rgod du gyur ba red/ dpa' rgod 'di nyid kyis rgyal kha blangs te phyir e cib tu log rjes khe lo'i nye 'gram gyi ri bo zhig gi steng du mkhar rdzong zhig btab la/ rang ming mkhar rdzong gi ming du btags nas sgor gyi pho brang du byas pa dang / nang gi bkod pa dmag sgar zhig dang 'dra ba ma zad zab tshad la dbyin khri 220yod pa'i dong chu zhig brkos shing de'i ming la yig zo spro'u dong chu(7rsālkolkosko)zhes btags/yid phangs pa zhig la khong nyid yun ring la sdod khom ma byung bar 1193lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes nyin ta ma hri ki nas grongs/ de dus dgung lo35yin/ kho'i dur sa / ༵ hri ki'i ming du grags pa'i e ma ya dbyi si lem lha khang(ṣṭhaṣṭha༅ khorngo
rdo ni nganas zu

dmag dpon byola' the mo'u ar/teng zhin yus/chung dus0 khyams nyul 'tsho ba/dpa' mdzangs kyi mtshan snyan gnam 'og tu khyab pa'i jing gar rgyal bo the mu'u krin(ṣṭharko )gyis mong gol btsan rgyal btsugs nas ha lam lo ngo 100'gor rjes/ ya gling dkyil ma'i sa thog tu 'brog las spyi tshogs khrod jing gar rgyal po lta bu'i 'go khrid dpa' mdzangs can the mu'u ar(ṣṭharkolo)byung /the mu'u ar ni dpa' rgod kyi snyan grags rgyas pa'i mi zhig yin pa ma zad khyad mtshar ldan pa'i mi sna zhig kyang red/dus rabs 13pa dang 14pa'i bsnol mtshams su/ ya gling dkyil ma'i rtswa thang nas nub phyogs kyi mong gol btsan rgyal du tho'u ce ba mang po tha thor tu bsdad yod pa dang / de ru pa tshi zi tho'u ce pa(༅lko/olkoṣṭha)skor cig ljang mdog gis yongs su bklubs pa'i ce hri(76)(se ma ar han(7670)gyi nye 'dabs su yod)zhes pa ru bsdad yod/ spyi lo 1336lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 8nyin tsho dpon zhig gi sbra gur nang du bu chung zhig skyes shing de'i ming la the mu'u ar zhes btags te/ tho'u ce skad dang mong gol skad nang the mo'u ar zhes pa ni sra mo lcags dang 'dra ba'i don yin/ kho rta rgyab nas 'tshar longs byung zhing me mda' dang drag chas sgra ni kho'i gnyid dgug gi rol mo red/ ru ba skyas spo dang 'thab 'khrug don gnyer byed pa 'di ni pa tshi zi tho'u ce pa'i bya 'gul gyi gru /0 chen po zhig tu gyur/ the mu'u ar gyis sgril gzan khrod du ru skyas spo

ba'i dmag 'thab kyi 'tsho ba brgyud myong zhing / kho'i pha dang a khu tshang ma tsho ba'i sku drag yin la ko'u ar kun(lkoṣṭhar)tsho ba'i 'brog khyim khri 1lhag gi tsho dpon yang red/ kho'i a ma ni mong gol gyi khrag rgyud ngo ma yin zhing pha 'ded phugs 'ded byas na jing gar rgyal bo dang cuje zad nye ba yin/ the mu'u ar ni spobs sems bla ru mtho la blo gros brtan zhing khrun thag chod po zhig yod/kho nar son rjes drag rtsal sbyong rgyur dga' po yod pa dang dmag 'khrug dang g.yul bshams par ha cang mkhas/ kho skyes dus gdong khyad mtshar ldan la skyes gzugs ha cang brjid nyams ldan/ khos ga sa gang du khyab pa'i jing gar rgyal po'i mdzad rjes rlabs chen thos pas sngon gshegs dpa' bo gang der rjes su yi rangs byed kyin yod mod/ 'on kyang jing gar rgyal bos( 12slo 1227lo bar rgyal srid bzung) btsugs pa'i mong gol btsan rgyal rgyad pa'i mtha' ru lhung zhing rim bzhin nyams la nye ba dang / mong gol hphan rgyal chen mo bzhi'i ya rgyal du gyur ba'i ya gling dkyil ma dbang sgyur byed mkhan gyi khra hi the btsan rgyal(739)yang nyams pa nas nyams pa'i lam la 'gro bzhin yod la/ tsho dpon mang pos rang rang gi dmag bkol nas rang btsan byas nas phan tshun bar la 'thab 'khrugs brgyab ste gang rgyal de nyid bla ru bkur bzhin yod/ khra hi the btsan rgyal rgyal phran mang po zhig tu tshal ba tshal phyed du gyes/ ya gling gi sa cha 'di khrag dmar gyi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i g.yul sa zhig tu gyur la/ the mu'u ar tag tag 'di 'dra'i 'thab 'dzing dza drag ldan pa'i dus skabs su skyes phyin/ kho'i mi tshe gang bor shugs rkyen zab mo thebs/the mu'u ar byis dus kyi brgyud rim ni ha cang kyag kyog ldan la/ ko'u ar kun(rsālor)tsho khag ni pa tshi zi tho'u ce pa'i nang cung nyam chung gi tsho khag zhig yin pas/ nang dme dang phyis rgol rdung 'og tu stobs shugs che ba'i btsan rgyal pas dbang du bsdus/ the mu'u ar gyi pha shi ba dang a khu bro/ zlos

bsdu rub byas/ ga sa gang du 'khyam pa'i pa tshi zi rigs kyi dmag mis gnas tshul 'di thos rjes phyir yong ba dang / the mu'u ar gyis de dag kyang rang gi dmag dpung du drangs nas mi rta rgya skyed ci thub byas te rang gi gzi brjid bskyar slong byed pa'i sta gon byed bzhin 'duga'atshar longs rim byung /the mu'u ar gyis kho'i dmag dpung ho'o lo hran(770)gyi lho phyogs su 'then pa dang / sngar bzhin nges gtan min pa'i 'khyam nyul gyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin 'dug 1363lor nye 'dabs kyi gis zi than( lo7)du gnas de'i dbang sgyur mkhan la ngo rgol byed pa'i zing 'khrug langs pas/ gis zi than gyi dbang sgyur mkhan gyis the mu'u ar nang 'khrugs zhi 'jags byed rogs la gdan drangs/ zhis zi than mis the mu'u ar slebs kyi yod pa thos nasaphyi thon pa 'dis go skabs 'dir bstun nas gshin sa 'di dang zhis zi than gyi rgyal po'i go sa 'phrog par 'jigs te dbang sgyur mkhan dang 'cham mthun byung / de'i phyir/ the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung gnas 'dir slobs dus gnas tshul glo bur du 'gyur ldog byung ba dang kho tshor zhis zi than gyi dbang sgyur mkhan dang nang 'khrug slong mkhan nyis log byas te dmag 'khrug brgyab/the mu'u ar la gra sgrig gang yang med pa'i skabs su phyogs gnyis nas brgyab 'ong / the mu'u ar gyis dgra dmag mi nyung ba zhig btul yang /'thab 'khrug khrod lkog mda' zhig rlung dang bsdongs nas kho'i rkang bar phog mod/ the mu'u ar gyis dmag sems klong klong du 'gro bar dogs nas bzod thub med pa'i na zug bsran nas ral gri dgung la 'phyar te dgra bo gdong gis bsus pa dang / dgra dmag mi nyung ba zhig ral gris ngar la drangs rdo5/5 the

mu'u ar 'khor dang bcas pa dgra bo'i btsan sa nas thar ro//'thab 'khrug mjug rdzogs rjes/ the mu'u ar gyis rang gi rma khar blta dus dgra mda' des g.yas rkang zha ru bcug cing / 'khrug long khrod g.yas lag kyang rmas/ de nas bzung kho'i g.yas rkang rkyong skum byed mi thub pa dang g.yas lag la 'gyogs rgyu med phyin/ mi tshang mas kho'i ming la gyol bo the mu'u ar zhes 'bod/the mu'u ar chung dus nas ya nga ba'i 'thab 'khrug gi khrod du nar son zhing / dka' khag dang sdug bsngal gyis kho'i dpa' mdzangs rtul phod kyi gshis ka grub pa dang / yun ring gi dmag 'khrug gis kho la dmag don gyi 'jon thang bstsal bas/ kho rang ni ya nga ba'i dka' sdug thog la 'khyir mkhan gyi ming don dang mtshungs pa'i dmag spyi chen mo zhig tu gyur/dmag spyi chen mo 'dis dmag rta sgrig 'dzugs byas nas rim bzhin 'tshar longs byung zhing / khos ye tso po ba dang 'thab nas thu'u ki lo khi'i gnas yul la rgol rgyur thag gcod byas/ nyi se dbyin gyis kyang mi rta mang po tshags sgrig byas nas kho dang mnyam du g.yul sar chas/ kho tshos mnyam 'brel dmag dpung byang phyogs su rgyugs te ho lo'i hran byang ngos kyi rdo zam du slebs/the mu'u ar gyis sa dbyibs la brtag pa na mdun phyogs ri klong shin tu gzar pas 'thab mo ba skor cig ri mgor yib par mngags pa dang / de nas rdo zam gyi gam du g.yul bshams nas/ de gnyis kyi bar la 'thab 'khrug chen po zhig bslangs/skya rengs bkyags pa nas sa rub pa'i bar du dmag 'khrug byas kyang ye tso po ba'i dmag gis the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung phyir skyod gtong ma nus/glo bur du ye tso po ba'i dmag gi rjes phyogs kyi ri rtse ru dpal 'bar khra chil le/sdu/ ba dang / ye tso po ba tsho skrag thag chod nas phyi nud byed pa las the

mu'u ar gyi rgol rdung drag po 'gog ma thub par rgyal kha thob/de nas the mu'u ar gyis ce hri bcad bzung byas nas lo mang po sa mthar 'cham pa'i kho yang bskyar rmi lam gyi zhing khams lta bu'i rang gi pha sar log pa dang / sa 'di'i na gzhon stong phrag mang po rang gi dmag tu bsdus nas dpung shugs rgya bskyed/ nyin re 'ga'i rjes su thu'u ki lo khi sku gshegs song /se ma ar han gyi sdod srung pa ye li ye zi phyir khra hi the'i shar phyogs su song nas rgyal bo'i go gnas bzung / de nas the mu'u ar gyis myur du sa ma ar han la dmag drangs pa dang / mgyogs myur ngang ya gling dkyil ma dbang du sdud thub pa byung 1/365lor ye li ye zi yis sa ma ar han len ched yang bskyar dmag dpung drangs ba na/ e le zhi gtsang 'gram(4 khrom)du the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung dang 'phrad song / drag char zo kha nas byo ba ltar babs pas g.yul 'khrug 'dab rdzab khrod nas rgyag dgos pa byung zhing / the mu'u ar gyi skya dmag rnams 'dam 'bag nang 'gyel log byung bas lo rgyus steng ming du grags pa'i 6 'dam rdzab dmag 'khrug mices zer ba yin la/ thengs der the mu'u ar pham nas bros byol byas pa dang / sa ma ar han ye li ye zi yi dmag gis yongs su bzung / dus skabs tag tag la kho tsho'i dmag dpung khrod nad yams byung nas dmag rta mang po shi bas dmag mi phyir 'then mi byed ka med du gyurade/'i rjes kyi lo 'ga'i ring the mu'u ar gyis ye li ye zi la dmag drangs te 'thab 'khrug bslangs nas 1307lo'i bar tu ye tso po rigs tshang ma mthar bskud pa dang / wo ho gtsang bo(6tshim)(a ma'o gtsang bo)dang zhe ar gtsang bo( pom)bar gyi sa cha yang rang sar blangs/ya gling dkyil ma'i rtswa thang steng gi gnas tshul ni 'jigs su rung ༵༵ blo

yul las 'das pa zhig ste/ the mu'u ar dang hi se dbyin gnyis kyis sdug gi khur bo mnyam khur byas nas rgyal kha blangs rjes slar yang so so'i bar 'gal ba byung ste phan tshun dgra ru 'dzin dgos pa byung / 'thab 'khrug 'di 1365lo nas 'go brtsams te 1370lo bar du byas shing / dang thog hi se dbyin gyi dmag shugs the mu'u ar las che bas khos the mu'u ar gyi pha yul ce hri yi dbyin le 'ga' zin pa'i kha'ar hri(rdo76)bcad bzung byas pa na/ the mu'u ar gyis dmag khrid nas wo ho gtsang bo(677)brgal te rgyang bzhud byed pa las 'thab 'khrug gi sbyor ba rtsom ma nus/'on kyang the mu'u ar gyi nyul ma dus dang rnam pa kun tu sngar gnas su yib nas bsdad yod la/ hi se dbyin gyis rang gis dogs zon ci yang byed mi dgos bsam nas dmag shugs gtor nas phyogs so sor drangs pa the mu'u ar gyis rtogs te phyir dmag drangs pa dang / kha'ar hri'i mkhar gyang gi sgo srung spyi dpon bsad/ dus der dmag brda 'brug sgra ltar grags byung bas mkhar srung dmag mi rnams zhed nas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du bros song ngo / the mu'u ar gyis dmag don gyi thabs shes la brten nas hi se dbyin gyi dmag shugs rim bzhin nyams brlags su btang bas/ mjug mthar nyi se dbyin yongs su pham ste mgo bo mi sgur thabs med byung / the mu'u ar gyis phal cher 1370lor rtswa thang steng gi kho'u lo the tshogs chen(sgo cha(3)bsdus pa dang / rang nyid kyis sa ma ar tan gyi spyi dpon khur/ de dus rang lo 35red/ de'i rjes su khos yang bskyar nub kyi hwa tshi tsi ma'o la dmag drangs /sdu / ṭā hā/ //sa 138'a bar rim bzhin sa 'di blangs nas rang gi rgyal g.ya gling dkyil ma nas dpa' bo'i snyan grags sa pa/15sbyi nyi the rgyal khab kyi gshin sa the mu'u ar gyi lag tu shor ba dang /

'thab 'khrug grangs med brgyab pa las btsugs pa'i the mu'u ar rgyal khab kyi nye 'dabs ni sngar bzhin mong gol btsan rgyal la dbang ba'i rgyal sa yin te/lho nub ni jing gar rgyal po'i bu rabs tsha rgyud kyis po zi sger 'dzin byed par btsugs pa'i gis le wu han(lolko/lo༅)rgyal khab yin pa dang / nub byang gi phyogs ni khobs yangs pa'i u ru su'i sa thog tu btsugs pa'i the khra han(ṣṭhas0)rgyal khab yin la ming gzhan du cin krang han rgyal khab kyang zer/ shar phyogs krung gor 'brel ba'i sa cha khra hi the nas phyi ru gar pa'i mong gol mi rigs kyis bzung yod/ mong gol gyi rgyal khab de dag gi khrod du phyi'i gnya' gnon pa dang mang tshogs bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur yod la/ mong gol sku drag gi dbang sgyur nus pa yang kha thor gyi rnam par gyur zhing / deng thog gi lcags ltar sra ba de rim bzhin je zhan du gyur ba 'dis the mu'u ar la sa cha 'di dag tshur len byed par go skabs byung bas/ khos 'thab 'khrug gi lag thabs la brten nas sa cha gang mang zhig tshur len byas/1381lor dmag spyi 'di nyid dgung lo 46la son dus/ dmag khrid nas ho lo hran la phyin nas gis le wu tan rgyal khab kyi 'thab 'khrug gi 'go bslangs pa red/ khos 'thab 'khrug gi 'gag sgo brtol nas mkhar rdzong mang po bdag gir bzung ba dang / ston rlung gis sdong lo ded pa ji bzhin hi la the(777)la 'byor/ der mthud nas khos nam yang gtor thub med par grags pa'i 'gag sgo kha la the na ti le(rdoṣṭha0774)ru 'jab rgol byas kyang / thengs bcu bzhir rgol nas gtor ma nus pas the mu'u ar gyis dmag khag cig la de ru 'gag sgo bskor du bcug pa dang rang nyid mu mthud nas mdun du skyod/ kha la the na ti le yun ring bo zhig la bskor ba na nad yams gang sar byung bas mgo 'dogs mi byed thabs med byung /the mu'u ar gyis phyogs so sor 'thab 'khrug brgyab ste mkhar rdzoshā snang

po brgyud nas zhi si than la slebs pa na/ khos lo 30yar sngon la gnas 'di ru rurang nyid la mda' phog pa'i rnam pa dran nas khong khro tshad med langs shing /rang gi dmag mi tshang mar bka' bstsal nas zhi si than gyi rgyal sa kra lan ci(lnga'isgolha)la drag char snyil ba lta bu'i rgol rdung drag po byas pa dang cung ma 'gor dror kra lan ci bdag bzung byed thub pa byung / de nas khos srung dmag dang sdod 'bangs dmar gsod byed rgyu'i bka' bstsal te sngar 'di ru rang nyid la mda' gcig phog pa'i dgra sha blangs/ thengs 'dir byung ba'i chag sgo chen po yis kra len ci ni mi med dben gnas lta bu zhig tu gyur/ zhis le wu 'thab 'khrug 1381lo nas 1384lo bar brgyab cing khan ta hwa bar gtugs pa dang /the mu'u ar gyis thengs 'di'i rgyang skyod la lo gsum 'thab 'khrug zhes btagasdu /'gyangs par khos yang bskyar dmag drangs te phor zin gyi byang rgyud dbang du bsdus/ 1386lo'i lo smad la 'thab 'khrug ya me nyi ya(༅steḥ25khru)dang ki lo ci yar(tshe tsā oṃkrokhru)rgyun bsrings shing the mu'u ar gyis sa de gnyis 'phrog rjes/ phyir lho phyogs su dmag drangs te ye si hpha han(khya 46tshesnrog)dang hri la tsi( 77cha)bcas kyi sa cha mang che ba dbang du bsdus/ 1392lo'i yas mas su thengs gsum par dmag drangs nas da gzod gis le wu han btsan rgyal yongs su blangs/dus mtshungs su the mu'u ar gyis thabs jus sna tshogs bkol nas cin krang han rgyal khab(〉〉76〉ta༅)la 'gran btsugs/ dang thog khos cin krang han gyi hphan la gtogs pa'i pe krang han tho tho mus hri(tshe po7/sa(lkolko)dang cin krang han gnyis 'gran rgol byed par rgyab skyor byas/ 1378lor tho tho mus hris lan krang han(lkoṣṭhapo)pham par bzos/ 1380lor u ru su'i rgyadi /)na ce mus the le(rsālkoṣṭha༅)yis ton ho(77)nas cin krang han

pham nyes btang ba'i rjes la/ tho tho mus hris ce mus the le pham brlag btang ste cin krang han rgyal khab bdag bzung byas/ cin krang han gyi rgyal bo gsar ba 'dis the mu'u ar la drin lan mjal rgyu phar zhog phan tshun dgra ru bslangs pas/ the mu'u ar gyis cin krang han khyur mid gtong rgyur go skabs bskrun/ khos dmag drangs te 1394lor yo'u la ar(677)ri 'dabs tu tho tho mus hri dang 'thab 'khrug langs te cin krang han gyi dmag mang po bsad/ lo rjes mar the mu'u ar gyis yang bskyar dmag drangs te g.yul bkye ba dang / nub kyi u ru sur dmag drangs/ tho tho mus hri shar gyi yo'u la ar ri bor bros nas bgrod lam dang zas kyis dbul pa'i lam sked nas tshe las 'das shing / dus yun ring bor ming du grags pa'i the khra han rgyal khab mjug mthar nyams nub tu song / the mu'u ar gyis cin krang han rgyal khab bsnubs pa des rjes phyogs kyi mo si kho bskyar dar byed pa'i bgrod lam yongs su phyes pa dang don dngos thog u ru su rgyal khab gcig gyur yong bar rogs ram byas yod pa red/lo snar lo mthud pa'i 'thab 'khrug brgyud nas sngar mong gol btsan rgyal gyi rgyal khab ni ha lam the mu'u ar gyis bdag bzung byas shing / the mu'u ar ni mong gol btsan rgyal gyi don dngos thog gi dbang sgyur bar gyur/ sngon byon dam pa jing gar rgyal po la yi rangs dang bkur ba'i ched du the mu'u ar gyis rang gi rgyal khab ni mong gol btsan rgyal gyi rjes 'brangs yin par bshad/nges par du gsal bshad byed rgyu zhig la the mu'u ar gyis dbang sgyur 'thab 'khrug khrod sdug rtsub kyi lag thabs bkol nas pha rol ba'i dmag 'bangs mang po dmar gsod byas pa dang / kho rang yid tshim med par thengs gsum la rgya gar du phyin nas 'phrog bcom rang bzhin gyi 'thab 'khrug bslangs te chag sgo dang nyes skyon bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzos/ sa cha kha shas su ༵ di'i
