keng rus brtsigs te zor dbyibs mchod rten bzhengs tu bcug pa 'di ni ji 'dra'i sdug rtsub che ba zhig red ang / 'di ni the mu'u ar gyi rang gshes dang sdug rtsub che ba'i ngos zhig lags so/dmag thabs la byang cha ldan zhing byas rjes 'jog thub pa'i rgyal po zhigadamag don thad the mu'u ar la khong rang nyid kyi sgrub stangs khyad par ba zhig yod de/ khong sog po'i dmag dpung gi 'thab rtsal la byang cha ldan zhing de yang 'gyur ba med par lad zlos byas pa tsam min par 'thab rtsal 'di sngar las lhag par gong 'phel btang yod/ the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung la rkang dmag dang skya dmag bzo skrun dmag bcas rigs gsum yod/ the mu'u ar gyis dmag 'thab rgyag skabs rgyun par bkol pa'i 'thab rtsal zhig ni thog mar rkang dmag gis khyab che ba'i gdong mchong byas te thog sgra myur bas rna ba 'gebs long med pa lta bur bzo la/ skya dmag gi stobs shugs da dung sor nyar byas yod/ g.yul sa zing long du gyur ba'i glags dang bstun nas skya dmag g.yul sar gtong la/ bzo skrun dmag ni mkhar grong la 'thab rgol byed pa dang dmag don bzo skrun las sgrub byed dus bkol pa yin/dmag spyi chen mo 'dis dmag dpung yod tshad bkol nas 'thab 'khrug byed pa las gzhan/ skabs bstun gyi 'gyur ba dang lkog jus 'then rgyur yang ha cang mkhas/ rgya gar gyi tig lis so tan rgyal khab la dmag drangs dus/pha rol bas rgya gar gyi glang bo che'i dmag bkol pa na/ the mu'u ar gyi dmag mi rnams thabs la mkhas pa dang stobs chen 'gran bral gyi glang chen dag la ha cang 'jigs snang skyes/ the mu'u ar gyis rnam pa 'di mthong nas bzo skrun da// /pung la g.yul sa'i mdun phyogs su grog rong chen po zhig bsko ru

bcug pa dang / chu glang gsum re lcags thag gis sbrel nas sum tshugs kyis gral du bsgrigs shing / sra brtan gyi phur bar btegs te bkag rdo ru byas/glang bo che'i dmag dpung gis nus rgu yod tshad bton nas grog rong brtol yang chu glang la thog nas khegs par gyur/ dus 'dir the mu'u ar gyis thol byung dmag dpung bkol te rgyab phyogs nas tig lis so tan dmag gi g.yon ru brtol ba dang / rang gis dmag khrid nas mdun phyogs nas rgol rdung byas te g.yas ru brtol nas rgyal kha blangs/ khos thabs jus phran tsam bkol ba la brten nas skya dmag khri 1dang rkang dmag khri 4gzhan glang bo che'i dmag gis grub pa'i rgya gar gyi dmag dpung chen mo de skad cig de nyid la pham par btang the/ mu'u ar dmag 'thab la byang cha yod pas dmag rgyag dus snga gzhug dang g.yas g.yon la ha cang gzab gzab byed pa dang / phyogs gang nas kyang zhan cha phyir mi mngon zhing dgra bos tshur rgol byed pa'i go skabs med par gtong / des kho'i dmag 'thab steng gi sems chung dang hol rgyugs mi byed pa'ingos de mtshon yod/ nam rgyun khos rgyal khab gang zhig la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i yar sngon du nyul ma tshong bar brdzus te mngags nas/ de'i gnas bab dang dmag don gyi rnam pa/ yul srol goms gshes la sogs par brtag zhib byed pa yin/ khos nyul ma'i gsang 'phrin la ha cang mthong chen byed de phyogs so sor nyul ma mang po btang ba dang / de tshos gnas tshul mkho 'don byas pa la brten nas pha rol ba'i dmag don gyi gnas bab la tshod dpag byas nas jus thag gcod pa red/thelu'u ar gyis lo mang por phyogs las rgyal ba'i dpung chen la kha lo bsgyur nas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad btul pa dang / kho'i khyim mi rnams kyis kyang dus rgyun dmag sgar du 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod par ma zad/16/'i

srid gzhung yang dmag dang mnyam du gnas spor byed bzhin yod/ khom long cung tsam byung dus khos rgyun du dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba dang bstun nas ru ba'i dmag dpung rtswa chu 'dzoms sar sgar btabs te/ gtan 'jags min pa'i ru ba'i goms srol de nam yang 'dor gyin med la/ khra ma ar han gyi sa cha nas pho brang dang dgon pa mang po btabs te sa cha so so'i rin po che'i rigs tshang ma gnas der drangs pa dang / khra ma ar han ni ya gling dkyil ma'i mdzes sdug brjid nyams ldan pa'i grong khyer zhig tu bskrun no// 'on kyang the mu'u ar gong ma nam rgyun mkhar rdzong 'dir nyin 'ga' ma togs mi sdod par phyir mkhar phyi'i dmag sgar du 'gro ba red/the mu'u ar btsan rgyal la stobs shugs 'dzoms pa'i skabs nub skor dkyil rgya mtsho dang shar tshung lin( ྅)dang chu bo gang ga(khrim)/ lho phor zin 'gag byang u ru su'i bar du mnga' khongs rgya bskyed pas/ skabs de'i dpa' bo'i rgyal rabs shig tu grags/ the mu'u ar gyis sog po'i btsan rgyal gyi dbang bsgyur byed thabs la brtsi srung byas nas rang gi khyim mi dang nye ring /nang blon la mnga' khongs 'dzin du bcug ste mi rabs nas mi rabs su brgyud sprod byed chog ze mu'u ar rgyal bo zhig gi ngos nas blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis rang gi mnga' khongs te ya gling dkyil ma'i sa khul gyi srid gzhung do dam mdzad/the mu'u ar ha cang dar ba'i tshe na ya gling dkyil ma'i sa khul gyi gnam gshes ni char chu ha cang mang ba'i dus shig yin pas/ rtswa thang du rtswa rtsi shing skyes pa bzang ba dang / bye thang gi spang leb kyi rgya bskyed pa 'dis the mu'u ar btsan rgyal gyi stobs 'byor longs spyod dar bar shugs rkyen thebs yod/ gong ma the mu'u ar la yon tshad de 'dra chen po mi 'dug na'ang / khos gam du rgyun du shes yon can 'ga' khrid nas yig cha sna tshogs dang bstan bcos grags chen klo/ shādon byed du 'jug gi yod/ kho lo rgyus skor gyi gsung rtsom la lhag par

dga' snang che ba dang thos pa rgya cher bsags/ mi la bka' bstsal nas rang gi 'thab 'khrug brgyud rim zin thor bkod de 〈g.yul rgyal zin tho 〉zhes pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpe cha zhig sgrig rtsom byas pa dang / de brgyud nas kho'i stobs shugs dang mnga' thang ngoms pa red/ khos rtag tu shes yon pa dang mnyam du lo rgyus kyi gnad don dang chos lugs kyi dgongs pa'i gnad don/ gzhan rgyun spyod rig tshan skor gyi gnad don la rtsa bdar byed kyin 'dugathe mu'u ar gyi dgra 'dul bya bzhag gis ya gling dkyil ma dang sa phyogs so po'i tshong lam khegs med shar gyis phye nas tshong las kyi dar spel la skul 'ded chen po thebs/ skabs der khra ma ar han mkhar nang du pa ki ta nas slebs pa'i shes yon can dang ta ma hri ki nas yong ba'i las rigs sna tshogs kyi bzo ba/ da dung rgya gar gyi rin po che'i rgyan cha/ si phen gyi sa gdan 'thag ma/ pe krin then btsan rgyal gyi hpho lo len gser sgor/ e cib kyi gser bzos yo chas sogs las the mu'u ar dus skabs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon gyi gnas bab mthong thub pa yin/the mu'u ar ni chab srid pa zhig kyang yin te srid byus la mkhas shing /blon ngan gyi kha la mi rgyugs pa dang / bya ba bden drang gis thag gcod byed mkhan zhig yin par ma zad/ rgyal khab mang po zhig la phyi phyogs kyi 'brel ba bzung yod la rgyal khab so so'i pho nya mang po the mu'u ar gyi srid gzhung du lta skor dang las 'tshol du yong gi yod pa red/dmag spyi chen mos thog lhar 'thab pa/dus rabs 14pa'i mjug tu/ shar ro ma btsan rgyal pe krin then gyi pho nya the mu'u ar mjal du 'ong / rgyal khab de'i mkhar grong o zi man thur khe so tan pa ya zho( spokro pho777༅lko )skye phreng dang pos rgol ཿstu ཿsa

nas snum zad kyi mar me lta bur gyur yod pas/ stobs shugs ldan pa'i the mu'u ar la rgyab dpung mi zhu ka med byung / the mu'u ar btsan rgyal dang pe krin then btsan rgyal gnyis kyi bar o zi man btsan rgyal gyis chod yod/ spyir the mu'u ar dang pa ya zho gnyis mi 'cham pa dang / skabs 'dir pa ya zho ni o gling phyogs su rgyal kha mang po thob cing dbang cha dang dmag shugs kyi rtse mor son yod pas/ the mu'u ar mig nang du 'jog gi med/ the mu'u ar gyi phyi 'brel srid jus ni rgyang 'brel nye rgol yin gshes/ khos pe krin then gyi re ba khas len gyis 1400lor dmag dpung drangs nas pa ya zho so tan la phar rgol byas/ the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung khri 80yod par grags pa de thur khe'i ya gling nub ma'i 'gag sgo ste zhis wa zi'i(07mo)mkhar 'gram la slebs te dza drag che ba'i g.yul 'gyed thengs shig bshams/ gis wa zi'i btsan rdzong mang po 'gog srung dam zhing / srung dmag gi dpon po ni pa ya zho'i bu che ba ste dgra 'thab la mkhas pa'i er tho gu lar pha zhwa(ṣṭhaṣṭhaṣṭha ṣṭhasgo khri )yin/ phan tshun yun tsam 'thab pa'i rjes su the mu'u yar sa 'og gi bgrod lam brgyud nas mkhar nang rgol rdung byas te thur khe'i dmag dpung la pham nyes chen po bzos —pa dang er tho gu lar gson bzung byas/ 1401lor pa ya zhos brel 'tshub ngang o gling nas dmag dpung bsdus nas phyir slobs te 'gog rgol byed pa la/'gro 'dug rlung las skyen pa'i the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung ya gling nub ma'i yul kun tu spor zin pas khos lag stong mchan la btsur nas mi 'dug ka med byung / 1402lo'i zla gnyis bar dmag dpung khag gnyis po an ki la'i(ṣṭha 7)mya ngam thang du slebs shing / pa ya zho yis dmag khri tsho 30bsdus nas the mus sdu/ gyi tshur rgol la sgug pa dang / dmag dpung 'di o gling du 'gran zla

med par grags la/ lhag par du so tan gyi cin we dmag dpung(lo14)gi brtul phod che ba'i snyan grags yongs su rgyas shing / dmag spyi pa ya zhi'i mtshan snyan gyis o gling gi rgyal khab kun la 'jigs nyen skur gyin yod pas mtshan la thog lha zhes thogs/ phyogs gnyis gas nus rgu yod tshad bton nas dmar 'dzing gi 'khor lo bskor nas khrag dmar gyi rgya mtsho skyil/ the mu'u ar ni ma gzhi nas dmag bkol thabs jus la mkhas mdzangs ldan na yang / pa ya zho yang don dngos stong kho'i 'thab yar yong gi 'dug o ze man gyi 6 thog lha'i cin we dmag dpung gis mgo rkang med par lcags khrab gyon nas glog dmar 'khyug pa ltar mchongs yong ste/ kho tshos 'gran med kyi dpa' ngar dang stobs shugs che ba'i 'thab 'khrug gi nus pa yongs su mngon yang / gong ma the mu'u ar dmag shugs kyi thad nas pa ya zho las brgal yod pas/ kho'i gral dpung chen po'i dmag shugs kyis dgra bo yongs su bskor/ pa ya zho 'chug nor chen po zhig byung ba ni re 'thab re rgyal gyi nga rgyal gyis khengs te dgra bor mthong chung byas nas the mu'u ar gyi 'thab tshul dgu 'gyur snang med du bzhag stabs/ g.yul sa'i 'thab 'khrug gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur te thur khe'i dmag gi chu lam the mu'u ar gyis glo bur du bcad/ skad cig de nyid du dmag sems klong klong du gyur ba dang / dus cung 'gor ba na 'ga' zhig kha skom nas shi ba dang kha shas bros byol byas shing / yang kha shas shig gis mgo btags/ dus der cin we dmag dpung sogs dmag dpung khag cig ma gtogs 'thab 'khrug sngar bzhin rgyun skyong mkhan med par gyur/ the mu'u ar gyis thur khe'i dmag dpung kha 'thor du 'gro ba mthong nas/ya gling dkyil ma'i skya dmag la bka' btang nas cham la phab par chas pa dang / rang nyid dmag dpung dang lhan du gdong mchong gi las la zhugs/de nas pa ya zho yongs su pham zhing dpa' ngar gyi mtshan snyan rgyas pa'i ༵ stan

gson bzung byas nas btson du bcug lo rjes mar pa ya zho so tan nad kyis mnar nas tshe las 'das/ an ki la dmag 'khrug ni ham sems che ba'i the mu'usar btsan rgyal dang o zi man thur khe btsan rgyal bar gyi 'thab 'khrag yin la/ dbyin rgyal hin lis(jos/)skyes rabs bzhi bas the mu'u ar la 'phrin lan bskur dus/ kho o gling gi dgra bo thur khe ba las rgyal bar smon 'dunabyas pa yin/ the mu'u ar gyis kyang e cib dang ya gling nub ma'i sa gzhan dag kyang dbang du bsdus/ kha la pa ho nas ngal gso byas te dgun bskyal rjes 1404lo'i dbyar khar phyir khra ma ar han du slobs nas dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i mdzad sgo'i dga' ston byas/dpa' rgod grongs pa/an ki la dmag 'khrug mjug rdzogs ma thag the mu'u ar gyis krung gor rgol rgyu thag bcad cing / thog mar khos dmag dpung khag gcig so chin wu zhu'o ho gtsang bo'i shar rgyud gyi lam du mngags te dmag dpung gi lte gnas btsugs pa dang / dmag rgyag sa dang zur 'degs kyi lam bu myul zhib byed du btang / phyir khra ma ar han la slobs pa na the mu'u ar la dmag rgyag sa'i lam byang gi sa khra zhig dang chis si gtsang bo(stsalo7)nas lcags ri ring bo'i bar gyi krung go'i gnas tshul snyan zhu zhig lag tu 'byor/ skabs der the mu'u ar gyis ming rgyal rabs kyis yon rgyal rabs rtsa slog dang jing gir rgyal bo'i mong gol rjes rabs pa mthar bskyod gtong ba la kha g.yar nas krung gor btsan 'dzul byed rgyu'i bka' btang la/ de ni sngar gyi mong gol btsan rgyal chen mo'i mnga' khongs slar gso byed par dmigs pa yin/ de ma thag hrag dmag khri 20bsdus nas rngam rngam brjid brjid kyis shar krung go'i phyogs su rgya spyangs bskyed pa'i 'dod blos yongs su gzir/

thengs 'di'i rgyang skyod dmag don gyi phyogs su gra sgrig byas pa ha cang legs po yod la/ the mu'u ar gyi dmag dpung chen mo chab rob kyis khebs pa'i zhis ar gtsang bo brgal ba na/ mdun phyogs ni mu mtha' med pa'i skyod lam ring mo de yin yang / glo bur ba'i tsha drod rgyas thengs gcig gis 'thab 'khrug la bar chad byung zhing / rgyang skyod kyi gom mtshams mi 'jog ka med du gyur te chin pin the( lha )nye 'gram du sgar btab nas bsdad pa dang /1405lo'i zla dang por the mu'u ar dmag sgar du grongs pas/ kho'i shar 'dul gyi sbyor ba yang rang shugs su yal song ba red/the mu'u ar zhes pa'i mi sna 'di yang lo rgyus steng gi ru ba'i dbang sgyur mkhan tshang ma dang 'dra bar/ khos zhing las spyi tshogs la dbang bsgyur byed pa'i 'thab 'khrug khrod dmu rgod dang sdug rtsub kyi ngos de mngon yong la/ sa cha mang po zhig tu kho ni bdud rgan zhig tu mthong ba'ang yod mod/ 'on kyang khong ni mi rang ga ba zhig ma yin par phyogs mi nyung ba zhig nas byas rjes chen po bzhag yod pa 'di jing gir rgyal bo dang kun nas mtshungs so/ gzhan gyis ji ltar smras kyang rung / kho ni khyad du 'phags pa'i dmag don pa zhig red ces na/ sus kyang khas mi len pa med do//169

ce khe877)mi'ags kyi dpa'aca ce hri kha/teng zhin yus/g.yul sar yun ring brgyud pa'i dmag dpon zhigadus rabs dkyil ma'i nang ce khu ru mtshan snyan yongs su grags pa'i dmag don spyi dpon yung ce hri kha zhes pa zhig byung la/ kho'i snyan grags thos pa tsam gyis g.yul sa'i dgra bo spa bkong bar byed pa dang / khos gsar gtod byas pa'i mchog gyur 'thab rtsal des 'thab 'khrug gi lo rgyus steng du go gnas chen po bzung yod/ces zhes pa der gna' dus su po zhi mis ya(ṣṭhaskoskosgro ga'i rku18)zhes 'bod cing / mtha' bzhi ri yis bskor la nags tshal stug por bkra ba dang / hphur tha ba gtsang bo(ṣṭha poX7 ma)gnas 'di brgyud nas lhung lhung du 'bab bzhin yod/ ha lam 1360lo'i snga gzhug tu ce hre kha po zhi mis ya'i lho rgyud kyi tho lo tshi no rlu(67choXlko)zhes pa'i grong tsho'i sku drag chung chung zhig gi khyim du skyes shing / kho chung dus nas mig gcig zhar bas ce hri kha zhes pa'i ming de btags pa yin la/ ce khu'i skad du zu 'brug mig gcig ma mi zhes pa'i don yin no/ce hri kha nar son rjes dmag la zhugs nas po zhi mis ya rgyal khab kyi rgyal bo wa tshi la rmu'i(7chos )pho brang du las ka byas/ de dus po zhi mis ya ni ro ma btsan rgyal gyi cha shas tsam yin la/ 'jar man rgyal khab kyi bkas ba/kā zlo'i brnyas bcos myong gin yod/ 'jar man pas po zhi mis ya las

gzhan o gling dkyil ma'i sa cha gzhan dag tu'ang dpa' ngom dpung ston byed pa yin/ 'jar man tho'u tung(lko smo)skya dmag thon gyis dmag khri 10bsdus te shar phyogs su btsan 'dzul byas nas/ po lo(77)mtsho 'gram gyi sa char rgol dus po lan(ṣṭha༅)dang lis tha'o wan(2 7)lhan du khyur mid byed pa'i bzo lta yod pa dang / ce hri kha wa tshi la rmu yi bka' bkod ltar khyim mtshes rgyalakhab la rogs skyor byed du song nas/ po lan rgyal bo la tis zi lo zi'i(7777lo)mi grangs khri 10lhag longs pa'i mnyam 'brel rtsa 'dzugs su zhugs/ 1410lor phyogs gnyis gas ki long war tig(77777)sa cha nas 'thab 'khrug chen mo zhig bslangs/ ce hri kha rngam brjid ldan pa'i lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'thab 'khrug 'dir dngos su zhugs pa dang / 'di ni khos thog dang po rgya gram dmag gi skya dmag dang 'thab res byas pa yin la/ khos dpa' mdzangs gnyis ldan gyis shar phyogs rgyal khab 'gar mnyam 'brel byas nas skya dmag tshogs pa pham brlag chen po btang zhing / thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed khrod byas rjes chen po bzhaga.o zi man thur khe'i dpung chen gyis o gling la rgol pa'i tshe/ ce hri khas yang bskyar po zhi mis ya'i dmag dang zhon ya lis dmag khrid de thur khe'i tshur rgol la ya lan sprad nas to no gtsang bo'i pha rol du bdas/ ce hri khas ga sa gang du g.yul bkye nas kho'i mi tshe'i phyed ka 'thab ra nas 'das shing /dmag dpon 6 'brug mig gcig ma mi de'i snyan grags kyang o gling du rgyas/1415lo'i dbyin tha'i lo brgya'i dmag 'khrug drag po'i khrod kho dbyin ji'i glas dmag tu zhugs nas a cen ko'ur(tsho bopo)g.yul sa ru mngags/phyi nas thon pa'i ce hri kha ni mi sna gtso bo zhig tu gyur te g.yul 'thab gal chen tshang mar zhugs pa dang / dmag 'khrug byed thabs dang dmag don thabs jus kyi phyogs la mthong rgya che ba dang nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yonā pyas/

rgyal bo wa tshi la rmu nas kyang gtsigs chen byed kyi yod/ho zi dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa/phyir rgyal nang du log rjes ce hri khas po zhi mis ya'i rgyal gces sngon skyod pa yung ho zi(cha lo7)nas 'go khrid byas pa'i chos lugs bcos bsgyur bya 'gul la rgyab skyor zhus/ thengs 'di'i bcos bsgyur la ce khi mi rigs yongs kyi 'gebs srung thob pas/ che lo'i(mos)chos skyong srid gzhung dang ro ma btsan rgyal gyi rgyal bo zhis ci zi mun tig(mtshim cho)gis ngan 'brel byas te ho zi la bar chad btang zhing / khang zi than tshi(jomomacho)chos tshogs steng mgo g.yog nas khrid 'ong ste gson sreg byas/ ho zi mer sreg pa'i gtam ngan gang sar khyab pas po zhi mis ya'i mi rnams khong khro rab tu 'bar ba dang /ho zi la rgyab skyor byed pa'i mi tshang mas 'os langs byed par gra sgrig byas/skabs der/ mi'i mig nang gi tsher mar gyur ba'i zhis ci zi mun tig gshegs zin pa'i wa tshi la rmu'i rgyal tshab tu bzhugs pas gnas tshul sngar las dza drag tu gyur ba na/ mi rnams kyis 'bangs dang sku drag gi dbye ba med par 'os langs byed pa'i gros mol gsang stabs kyis bsdu bzhin yod/ce hri kha ni ho zi'i ring lugs brtan por 'dzin mkhan zhig yin pa dang /kho blo gcig sems gcig gis bya bzhag 'dir zhugs nas ho zi gson dus kyi phugs bsam mngon 'gyur dang rgyal khab kyi bcings 'grol gyi ched du 'bungs pa yin la/ ce hri kha mi bzang bo drug cu lo yis thub nas mgo skra phyid nas skya ther du gyur kyang / kho'i lhan skyes kyi glag gi mchu dang mtshungs pa'i sna bo dang gdong la sngar bzhin 'jigs nyams ldan la/ dmag 'khrug mang po brgyud myong ba'i dmag dpon de da thengs yang 'os langs dmag gi dmag spyin )blos/

snorsha naXdzad ——mong pho ( 6 ngaX5 7 ldesku/sgyusnyosgye rde|/yone(shā ༷༷ṣṭha/snaX/〈sngu ngaX rtswa stuX/ je(78 / skyi//rtarsha rta5༷༷thowaka )༷ 4po tsongaX497༄༷༷rshaX dzrapyar zlo1 rshardo — —— de tsho hāshāshā/33 〉 spu sgyurshaX4༷ tsho)byuṣṭha༄༄'i /meX sku /sto

zhing ba dang mkhar grong gi 'bangs mi bsdoms pas khri 4 2ri 'gor 'dus shing / brjid nyams ldan pa'i ri rtse'i mkhar rdzong 'di 'os langs dmag gi sra mkhregs ldan pa'i 'dzoms sa zhig tu gyur ba dang / tha por ri bo'i snyan grags kyang gnam 'og tu khyab pa red/ ce hri kha dang kho'i rogs pas sne khrid byas pa'i dmag dpung gi ming la yang ri bo 'di'i ming du thogs te/ tha por ring lugs zhes grags/ tha por dmag gi ming la 6 dkon mchog gi 'thab mo ba ’ zhes thogs pa dang / kho tsho'i dam tshig ni rno ngar ral gri shubs las bton te/ gnam gyi tshab tu bden lugs spel rgyu dang ho zi'i srog gcod dgra bo mtha' dag tshar gcod byed rgyu de red/ tha por ri bor 'tshogs pa'i nyin de nas bzung / ho zi yi ming g.yar nas spel ba'i bkas bkod la ngo rgol dang mi rigs bcings 'grol byed pa'i zhing ba'i dmag 'khrug (1419nas 1434lor )cig o gling gi lo rgyus kyi gar stegs steng tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis 'khyab 'go btsams//rgya gram dmag dang thogasar 'thab nas rgyal ba/chos skyong srid gzhung gi skul 'ded 'og zhis ci zi mun tig gis dmag grangs khri 10lhag yod pa'i dpung chen zhig bsdus te ho zi ring lugs la rgol pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung thog ma grub pa yin/ 1420lo'i zla bar po gis mis yar btsan 'dzul byed pa'i lam bar du gsod gtub ci rigs kyis khag bsgos te pu la kir dmag drangs shing / ches che ba'i mkhar grong de len rgyu'i ham sems bcangs/ rgyal sa srung skyob byed pa'i chen ce hri kha yis dmag dpung zla8ba'i tshes 20nyin pu la gir drangs/ gis ci zi mun tig gis rgyal sa'i phyi skor gyi lcags ri dang de'i steng gi btsan rdzong bzung ba dang / zla 6pa nadi /sdu langs dmag dang dza drag che ba'i dmag 'thab gcig mjug gnyis

mthud du langs/ rgya gram dmag dpung rgyun chad med par gshar 'ong ba dang /gong mas dmag mjug sgril bar sgug rjes dmag shugs bkol te po gis mis ya cha rkyen ci yang med par mgo 'dogs byed du 'jug rtsis yod/ ltos 'jog gis bshad na ce hri kha yi dmag shugs ha cang nyung mod/ 'on kyang kho rang gis 'jigs snang spu tsam byed kyi med/ pu la ki'i mkhar gyi shar phyogs su we thu khi hphu'u ( 67 lko)zhes pa'i ri bo zhig yod/ ce hri khas g.yul sa'i sa babade mthong nas de mur sa de blangs te dmag dpung ri mgor tshags sgrig byas/ gis ci zi mun tig rjes su lus kyang kho rang gi dmag shugs la yid tshim po yod stabs 'jigs snang ci yang ma byung / ce hri kha'i dmag dpung gis tshabs che ba'i rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 'og tu nges par du 'thab ra brtsigs bzo'i bya ba yongs 'grub byed dgos kyang / shing chas ma 'dang bas kho tshos nye 'gram gyi lha khang zhig gi nang gi rkub stegs tshang ma khyer nas bzo skrun rgyu cha'i kha gsab byas/ zla 7pa'i tshes 14nyin ni gong ma'i dpung chen gyis phar rgolakhyed pa'i nyi ma yin/ we thu khi hphu ri bo'i mtha' 'khor gyi 'thab 'khrug shin tu dza drag che ba dang / ce hri kha'i 'thab mo bas dus tshod kha shas shig gi nang du rang las ldab 'gas mang ba'i dgra dmag phyir 'ded byas/ ri bo de ni lcags 'dzer zhig dang 'dra bar pu la ki'i shar phyogs kyi sgo chen du krong sbyar langs yod pas/ rgya gram dmag sa mtshams nas gom gang yang mdun du ma nus gra/ ma dmag gis pu la ki'i mtha' bskor ba de pham nyes bzos pas/gis ce zi mun tig mkhar grong la gol ba'i 'char gzhi chu kha'i wu ba bzhin du gyur te dmag mi phyir 'then byed 'go btsams/ ce hri khas phyir rgol byas nas gzhi rgya ches che ba'i rgya gram dmag dpung tshal ba tshal phyed du btang / dmag dpung chen mo 'dis pu la ki srung skyob byas nas rgyal kha thob pa'i dran nātā gyi

ched du mi rnams kyis ce hri kha'i ming ri bo we thu khi hphu la btags pa dang / ri bo mthon po 'di'i ming la da bar du ri bo ce hri kha rmu zhes 'bod kyi yod/ ce hri khas rang nyid la sman pa'i g.yul sa 'dems par mkhas pas rang las dmag stobs che ba'i dgra dmag las rnam par rgyal ba red/ lo 'di'i dpyid kur ce hri khas lho phyogs su 'gul skyod byas te mu mthud du rang gi mnga' khongs dang lo ma btsan rgyal gyis gong mar ngan 'brel byas pa'i bkas bkod kyi stobs shugs gtsang phyags byas/ zla 10pa'i zla stod du tha por dmag dpungagis gong mar rgyab skyor byed pa'i sku drag gi mnga' khongs te song len mkhar rdzong du(756)rgol rdung byas te dbang du bsdus/ gong ma'i dmag dpung gis mkhar rdzong phyir 'phrog byed pa'i sbyor ba rtsom pa na/ ce hri khas nye 'gram gyi ri chung zhig tu sgar gzhi btabs te dgra bo'i g.yul ngor bud pa dang / zla 10pa'i tshes 12zhin rgyal kha yongs su blangs/ der mthud nas lho phyogs kyi tshong las lte gnas chen po phu'u la ha ti tshi(07྅lkolko)mkhar grongablangs/ 1420lo'i lo mjug nas 1421lo'i lo stod du/ ce hri kha dang kho'i tha por dmag dpung nub phyogs su dpung skyod byas te dgra bo'i btsan rdzong rdul bzhin brlags so/gong ma zhis ci zi mun tig gis po zhi mis ya dbang bsner byed rgyu'i re ba stong zad du gtong mi 'dod par dmag shugs bsdus te ce hri kha la 'jab rgol byas pa na/ 'os langs dmag gi g.yul srung ru khag cig gis rgol lan drag tu sprod bzhin pa'i gnas tshul de ce hri khas thos ma thag bya 'phur ba ltar 'ong ste/ zhis ci zi mun tig po zhi mis ya'i byang rgyud du ded/lo'adi'i zla 3par ce hri khas pe lung(12)mkhar du dmag drangs/mkhar 'di ni lo ta'o rmu pe khras(khamacho ma /bkod 'doms byas yod pardo )/ tha li btsan rgyal gyi glas dmag gis ham bzung byas yod/ ce hri

khas pe lung yongs su bskor ba'i skabs der/ gis ci zi mun tig gi chab dmag gis go kun btsan rdzong(lha 6)du tha por gyi bzung dmag 7tsālhag dmar gsod dang gson sreg byas pa'i gnas tshul go rjes/ ce hri kha zhe sdang me ru 'bar nas rta kha de sar dkyus shing yud tsam ma 'gor bar go tun mkhar rdzong yongs su gtor ba dang / ce hri kha'i khyad 'phags kyi dmag don sdekhrid dang 'os langs dmag gi ngar shugs la brten nas rgyal yongs kyi sa khul phal che ba ho zi ring lugs kyi mnga' khongs su bsdus/dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs la shugs snon byas pa/'os langs dmag gi spyi dpon ce hri khas dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs la mthong chen gyis rang gi mnga' 'og gi mi mang che ba zhing ba yin pa dang 'thab 'khrug gi nyams myong zhan pas kho tshor 'thab 'khrug byed stangs khrid pa dang / 'thab mo ba rnams la dmag sbyong byed du bcug nas rnyog 'dzing gi sa dbyibs dang gral dbyibs kyi 'gyur ldog la byang chub par byas pa ma zad/ kho tshor mdung dang sta re/ shang lang dang glo gri/ spyang so dbyug pa la sogs pa'i dmag chas spyod tshul bslabs la/ dmag chas ma 'dang tshe gnas skabs su sbyab ༵nga zor ba/ sta re la sogs pa'i zhing ba'i yo byad dmag chas su bkol na py-i hri/ khas dmag dpung gi sgrig lam la do snang chen po byed kyi yod de/khos dmag don khrims srol zhig bsgrigs shing / khrims 'gal gyi bya spyod sna tshogs la chad gcod nan mo'i srol yig dper mtshon sgos phyes te/ dmag mi phan tshun gyis 'khon 'dzing dang 'phrog bcom/ sdod dmangs dang lhan du chang 'thung ba/ tshig ngan 'debs pa/ rgyan 'dzugs pa/ log g.yem byed pa sogs la nyes chad nan mor gcod rgyu khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / nge/ ltar

du dmag khrims ltar chad pa 'khur dgos/ dmag dpon 'di ni spyir 'thab mo bar gzab nan byed pa zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang khos bden pa bden drang gis bya ba sgrub nas rang dpe gzhan ston byed pas/ dmag mi rnams kyis brtsi mthong bla med byed kyi yod/ kho'i mnga' 'og gi mi tshang ma rang gi dmag dponadang nye bas/ dungs zhen gyi dbang gis kho'i ming la ce hri kha spun zla zhes 'bod kyin yod/ce hri khas rang gi tha por dmag dpung sgrig lam dam cing 'thab 'khrug gi nus pa rtser son pa'i dmag dpung zhig tu sbyong brdar byas yod/ kho tshor chos lugs dad mos kyi spro sems rab tu 'khol ba ma zad/ gzhan rigs kyis bran bsgyur byed par ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyal gces snying stobs kyang ldan/ ce hri kha'i dmag dpung gis sdod 'bangs la gnod 'tshe ci yang ma bskyal bas/ sa de'i mang tshogs kyis dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul sba gsang med par yar zhu byed pa bcas la ci nus kyis rogs ram byed kyi yod/ce hri kha ni 'jon nus ldan pa'i dmag don 'go khrid pa zhig yin pa ston du med la/ kho 'thab rtsal gsar bsgyur la mkhas pas shing rta'i dmag thabs sheg gsar gtod byas te/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i brgyud rim khrod nus pa chen po 'don thub pa red/ de ni dmag khrod kyi nyer mkho'i shing rta'am yang na zhing ba phal ba'i khyim tshang gi shing rta'i phyogs bzhi lcags khrab kyis shan nas phan tshun lcags thag gis sbrel te/ zlum dbyibs kyi 'thab ra zhig tu grub yod la/ de ni 'gul skyod byed thub pa'i lcags mkhar sgo med zhig dang 'dra/'thab 'khrug rgyag dus dgra bos shing rta'i mkhar rdzong 'di nyid brtol thabs med mod/ ce hri kha'i rkang dmag shing rta'i mkhar rdzong gi rgyab phyogs nas phyir thon te dmag 'khrug byed chog pa yin/ shing rta'i mkhar rdzong gi nang du rmas da/lha snang 'gebs byed thub pa dang / dgos gal la thug tshe gon pa dang

skyes ma/ byis pa sogs de ru skung chog dus rgyun du ce hri kha'i skya dmag gis shing rta'i g.yul sa'i mdun du dgra bo'i gdong bsus shing / gal te dgra dmag la stobs shugs ldan tshe phyir shing rta'i mkhar rdzong du phyir 'then byed pa yin/ 'jar man gyi rgya gram dmag gi skya dmag gis sra mkhregs ldan pa'i shing rta'i mkhar rdzong 'di ha lam brtol myong med la/ dgra dmag gis yun ring bor 'thab kyang pham nyes chen po nyos nas phyi bshol byed dus/ ce hri khas mkhar rdzong gi dkyil du thar lam zhig phye ru bcug pa na/ skya dmag gi dpung khag yod tshad dgra dmag gi gzhug tu rgyugs/ ce hri khas rgyun du ri chung gi rtse'am yang na phyogs gnyis su grog rong chen po dang chu bos 'gebs srung byas yod pa'i sa bab tu dmag 'thab 'khor lo'i 'gog srung gi bzo bkod 'then pa dang / gal te dus tshod kyis 'dang na shing rta'i g.yul sa'i mtha' 'khor rngo 'obs rong chen po zhig bskos te rang gi stobs shugs la srung skyob byed pa na/ shing rta'i 'thab 'khor ni gna' snga mo nas yod mod/ 'on kyang ce hri kha yis 'dir nang don gsar ba bstsal ba dang / 'khor skyod thub pa'i phyogs mdel dang me mdel de dag kyang shing rta'i nang bzhag ste 'khor skyod phyogs 'khor du byas yod pa red/ shing rta 'khor lo re re'i nang phyogs mdel dang grangs tshad nges can longs pa'i mdel rdzas bzhag nas rta gnyis la 'drud du bcug pa na mgyogs myur ngang gnas spo byed thub la/ de ni 'gul skyod thub pa'i phyogs stegs shig dang 'dra/ 'di ni 'thab rtsal bsam blo'i steng gi gsar brje thengs shig yin pa sus kyang bston du med do/'thab 'khor shar mar bskyod pa'i tshe na/ rta ba zhig gis rta thog nas dmag rtar kha lo byed cing / 'thab mo ba gzhan zhig gis me mdel tshod 'dzin byed pa dang / 'os langs dmag gi 'thab mo ba shing rta'i nang ༵༵ te

ha cang khrigs cha dod pa'i ngang dgra bor rdung rdog gtong ba red/ kho chos kyang ce hri khas thog mar gsar gtod byas pa'i lcags sbrel 'khor lo 'di spyad nas pha rol ba'i khrab rmog gtor byed du byed pa dang / 'di lta'i khyad mtshar ldan pa'i dmag chas de dpa' mdzangs che ba'i 'thab mo ba'i lag tu shor ba na/ha cang 'jigs skrag skye dgos pa'i drag chas ya med zhig tu gyur 'gro ba dang /skya dmag gi khrab rmog gis de'i dza drag che ba'i rgol rdung 'gog srung byed ma thub/ ce hri kha yi 'thab 'khor gyis rgya gram dmag gi skya dmag la ya lan sprod par phan nus chen po thon yod de/ skya dmag rnams kyis 'thab 'khor gyi ldir sgra thos pa dang bros byol byed pa red/ ce hri kha yi skya dmag la yang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshon cha yod pa dang / rkang dmag ru khag khrod du dbyug ring mgo na lcags kyu yod pa zhig bsnabs pa de ched du rgya gram dmag gi skya dmag gi kha gtad du bslangs pa dang / de kho tsho'i gyon pa dang khrab rmog tu rgyus te rta thog nas drud de sa ru sgyel ba red/ skya dmag dang rkang dmag gis kyang sbyogs dmag dang mnyam 'brel byed pa yin la/ ce hri kha ni rkang dmag dang skya dmag phyogs dmag mnyam 'brel byas nas 'thab 'khrug byed pa'i mi sna dang po yin/ dpung skyod khrod kyi 'thab 'khor gnas tshul tshabs chen la thug dus shing rta'i btsan rdzong zhig tu sgrub chog 'gog srung 'thab 'khrug khrod ce hri khas dgra bor lcags mkhar sgo med kyi btsan rdzong 'dir rgol rdung byed du bcug nas/ dgra dmag thal ba'i rdul du brlags/ ho zi dmag gi dmag spyi de dgra bo'i zhan cha 'tshol rgyur goms lobs su gyur yod pa dang / rang gi phyogs dmag sgrig 'dzugs legs po byas nas sa bab dang dus tshod bzang po'i cha rkyen 'og dgra dmag gi gdong bsu ba red/ gal srid dgra drag rang zhan gyi gnas tshul byung tshe rdzu pham byas nas go skabs gang 'grig la sgug nas phyin hāsdu byed pa yin/ kho thol rgol byed par dga' po yod pa dang rgyun du

rgol sa'i gnas gtso bor dpung 'jug byed dus dmag mi'i stobs shugs bsdus nas dgra dmag gi dmag shugs gtso bo'i nus pa shor du bcug srid pa red/ gal te dgra dmag gis brtan srung byas pa legs pa'i btsan rdzong la la zhig ma lon rung / ce hri kha yis der nus pa yod rgu bton nas len e thub la mi blta bar mu mthud du mdun du skyod nas dmag don gyi dmigs sa gtso bo len thub byed pa red la/ 'gyur skyen che ba'i dmag thabs de ni kho'i drag 'dul rgyal lon gyi man ngag kyang red/thengs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i la gram dmag gi dpung rgol gtor pham btang ba/'thab 'khrug gis shi rmas skyel 'ong ba gzhol thub med/ 1421lo'i zla 7par ce hri khas lā pis mkhar rdzong(7776)la bskor rgol byed dus dka' ngal chen po zhig 'phrad pa ste/ pha rol ba'i mda' mo zhig kho'i mig yas la phog nas dmag spyi 5'brug mig gcig ma de ha lam dmus long du btang / thengs gnyis pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung gis zla 8par po zhi mis ya'i nub mtshams brgal te 'os langs dmag gi phyogs su dpung 'jug byas nas thon pa dang / gong ma gis ci zi mun tig gis bsdu rub byas pa'i 'jar man gyi skya dmag las gzhan chos skyong srid gzhung la sri zhu byed par 'ong ba'i dbyin jidang si phen gyi a la gung gi skya dmag kyang yod/ tha por gyi 'thab mo bas rang srung brtan po byas yod pa dang ce hri kha'i mig mi bzang na'ang khos dmag dpung khrid nas ri a thi tshi'i(bramasacho)dmag rogs su 'ong nas mkhar bskor yod pa'i rgya gram dmag la rgol rdung drag po byas te mthar bskyod btang /thengs gnyis pa'i rgya gram dmag gi stobs shugs gtso bo ni zhis ci zi mun tig gi dmag dpung yin la/ khos mgyogs myur ngang pu la ki dasturdo du

bsdu rgyu'i bsam pa 'chang yang / ce hri kha dang gis ci zi mun tig gi dmag dpung gnyis dus thog gcig tu rgyal sa pu la ki'i mkhar rdzong ko tun la thon pas/ sa cha'i gnas bab la cha rgyus yod pa'i ce hri kha sdun du shor ba dang /ce hri khas grong khyer gyi mtha'i gnas mtho sa zhig g.yul sar bdams shing /de'i phyogs gsum ris chod pa dang / phyogs gcig nas dgra bo'i gdong bsus pa na/ zhis ci zi mun tig gis ce hri kha yi shing rta'i mkhar rdzong gtor ma thub pas mdun skyod byed ma thub/ 1421lo'i zla 12par mkhar nang du zing cha langs pas glags dang bstun nas ce hri khas ko tun mkhar rdzong gi dgra bo'i skor dkyil gtor nas rang sar mgyogs myur ngang phyin pa na/ zhis ci zi sbyan tig gis ce hri kha gzhi nas bros bshol byas song bar bsam gyin yod pa cad/ tha por dmag dpung gi dmag spyis lam bar du dmag rta bsdu rub byas nas dmag dpung rgya bskyed de 1422lo'i dpyid mgor yang bskyar ko tun mkhar rdzong du slebs/ zhis ci zi mun tig gis rgya gram dmag gi dpung shugs gcig sdud byed ma thub pas/ de yi ngo ya ma yong bar mjug mthar mkhar rdzong me la bsreg rjes bros byol mi byed ka med du gyur/rgya gram dmag gis g.yul thob dngos rdzas dang / tha na drag chas kyang brjed bskyud du lus shing / gis ci zi mun tig bros nas hran yang rab khar slebs pa dang / de nas ja yun tsam la yang mi sdod par ce hri kha'i ra mda'i grags skad ci yang mi go ba'i gnas su bros/ ce hri khar rgyu nor shing rta brgya phrag du ma thob pa dang / de'i nang du rtsa chen gyi dpe cha shing rta gsum yod/thos langs dmag gis spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas rgyal kha'i dga' ston bshams te/ hran yang rab kha'i mang tshogs kyis ce hri kha la ches mtho'i gzengs skyes phul/182

thengs 'di'i 'thab 'khrug brgyud nas dgra phyogs kyis ce hri kha ni phyi bltas zhar bar snang yang 'thab mdzangs kyi las la blo gros rgyas pa'i dpa' rgod stag dang 'dra ba zhig yin pa gzhi nas shes te/ tshang mas mgrin gcig sbyi dmag spyi zhar ba de ni mthong chung byed rung ba zhig gtan nas ma yin no ra/ 1422lo'i dbyar khar ce hri khas sngang bzhin dmag don gyi bya ba sgrub bzhin yod la/ kho rang gi dmag dpung la rgya che ba'i zhing ba rnams kyis rgyab skyor dang sems khur byed gin 'dug kho tshos tha por dmag dpung la lam stonapa dang dgra dmag gi gnas tshul sngog 'don byas pa sogs ci nus gang thub kyis rogs skyor byed kyi yod/ zhis ci zi mun tig gis po zhis mis ya'i sna log lta'i nad yams mched par skrag nas thengs gsum pa'i rgya gram dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs byas/ci hri khas glo bur du dmag shugs gcig sdud byed ma thub la/ dgra dmag gis rgol sa gtso bo yang gang yin ma nges pas/ khos mang tshogs skul slong byas te/ dzimi re re nas drag chas dang dbyug pa/ rdo ba zungs sheg mices smras pa dang / yang chos spel ba rnams la 6 ye shes kyi dgra bo 7dang po zhis mis ya'i sa khongs kyi gtor bsheg pa ste/ gong ma dang de'i phyogs gtogs pa rnams la ngo rgol drag po byed dgos zhes 'bod skul btang /rgya gram dmag dus rtag tu dza drag che ba'i 'gog rgol la 'phrad pas thengs 'di'i rgyang skyod 'thab 'khrug la yid gting nas chad pa dang / ma 'gyangs par ce hri kha 'thab rar slebs yod pa thos pa na/ dmag sems la g.yo skyom chen po byung bar ma zad/ mgyogs myur ngang phyi nur byas pas thengs gsum pa'i rgya gram dmag yang pham mo/ 1420lo nas mgo bzung pa'i lo gsum gyi nang rgya gram dmag gis thengs gsum la ce hri kha yi lag tu sdu/ kha

༷stos/nang 'khrug zhi 'jags su btang ba/ce hri kha'i dmag dpung gis yang nas yang du blangs pa'i rgyal kha'i khrod/dus yun ring bo zhig la 'os langs dmag gi nang khul du sbas pa'i kha thor gyi rnam pa phyi ru mngon yong / pu la ki gtso byas pa'i sku drag dang 'byor 'bring gral rim gyis chos skyong srid gzhung dang gong mar 'cham mthun yong bar 'dod phyogs 'dzin pa dang / de'i ming la 6 hrin pa'i lugs zer zhing /dmag chas spyad nas tha por lugs la 'thab 'khrug byed pa yin/ ce hri kha tha por lugs kyi phyogs su ker rer langs pa dang stobs shugs yod tshad bton nas ho zi dmag sgar nang khul gyi kha thor gyi rnam pa sel ci thub byas/ lha hrin pa'e lugs ’ kyis tha por dmag la rgol ba de 'gog ched khos gyod sna 'dren mkhan kha shas shig la chad pa mi gcod ka med byung ba dang / rang gi dmag dpung 6 hrin pa'i lugs kyi mi stobs shugs che ba'i per zin du drangs/6 hrin pa'i lugs ’ kyis dmag shugs chen po bsdu rub byas nas ce hri kha'i dmag phyi snar byas shing / la pa gtsang bo'i(ṣṭha༅7)'gram gyi khu si tig lis kri(thomo ma/4)ru yongs su bskor te dga' spro'i g.yul las rgyal bar rten 'brel zhus pa yin/ ce hri khas mtshan mo lkog nas dmag khrid de la pa gtsang bo brgal nas ma le hro tshur(67/lkolko)slobs pa dang / de ru sgar btabs te 6 hrin pa'i lugs kyi mi dmag dpung yong bar sgug6 hrin pa'i lugs ’ kyis kyang rjes snyeg ste ce hri khas ma le hro hphu ru bshams pa'i g.yul sar thon/ ce hri kha'i dmag dpung ri mgo ru bsdad nas phyogs mdel gyi kha dgra phyogs su gtad/ 6 hrin pa'o lugs kyi dmag dpung gu //zhe pa'i grog rong ring mo zhig brgyud nas gtsang bo brgal na da gzod

dmigs sar slebs nges kyang / sa bab btsan sa gzhan lag tu shor yod pas mjug mthar cis kyang ce hri kha'i dmag dpung gi phyogs mdel 'og tu lhung dgos pa yin/ gu dog pa'i grog rong gi zhabs nas ri rtse la rgol na dmag shugs bskyed mi thub pas/ dmag grangs mang ba'i dge mtshan yongs su shor/6 hrin pa'e lugs ’ kyi dmag dpung gis dka' sdug thod la khyer nas ri'i rtse mor 'dzeg pa na/ ce hri kha'i skya dmag gis logs gnyis nas rgol rdung drag po byas nas ngal ba 'bras med du btang /6 hrin pa'e lugs ’ kyi rkang dmag dang skya dmag ri sked du 'dus nas yang bskyar ri rtser rgol rgyu'i sta gon byas pa na/ ri rtse nas ldir sgra dang lhan du nang du rdo gang ba'i shing rta bcu phrag kha shas rbab tu 'dril nas thon te/ mi rta mang po gcir zhing / 6 hrin pa'e lugs ’ kyi dmag rnams ag skad dang bcas te ri ngos nas 'grol pa dang / srog thar byung ba re 'ga' yod kyang rkang chag lag chag tu ma song ba gcig kyang med/ 'di ni ce hri khas yang bskyar 'thab 'khor bkol nas dmag 'khrug legs po zhig brgyab pa ste/ ma le hro spru'i g.yul sa'i steng 6 hrin pa'e lugs kyi dmag dpung gi ro yis bkang la/ pu la ki'i sku drag gi bem ro 1400lhag de ru thang mar brdal yod/thengs 'di'i 'thab 'khrug khrod tha por dmag dpung la shi rmas byung ba ha cang nyung la/ pha rol ba'i skyogs chen dang bcas pa'i g.yul thob dngos rdzas mang po lag son byung /ce hri kha'i mtshan snyan phyogs bzhir rgyas shing / mu hrin pa'e lugs migatogs pa'i grong khyer mang po zhig gi sgo glegs kho'i phyogs la yongs su phyes yod/ 1424lor khos dmag khrid nas rgyal sa pu la ki la slobs dus/ hrin pa'i ba kha shas shig gis kho tshor gu yangs gtong dgos pa'i zhu ba yang yang byas shing / kho tsho yahrin pa'i lugs ’ 'os langs dmag dpon la skrag ༵༵ tha

por dgra ru bzung ba las rjes phyogs ngan sbyor ci yang mi bgyi bar smras/'di dag las kyang khong ni ming don mtshungs pa'i dmag don pa zhig dang chab srid pa chen mo zhig yin pa'i gdeng rnyed thub pa ma yin nam/shi yang gson yang dpa' nyams ldan/gong ma'i rkang dmag rnams ce hri kha'i do zlar ma yong pas ho zi lugs dang mnyam 'brel gyis ce hri kha lkog gsod byed mi zhig mngags/ lkog jus 'di tha por spun mched tshogs pa'i tshogs mi zhig gis shes nas myur du ce hri khar brda brgyab pas/ thengs 'di'i lkog gsod kyi las la sngon 'gog byas/dgra bos lkog gsod byed ma thub pa mthong nas yang bskyar dmag 'khrug bslangs mod/ 'gran zla med pa'i ce hri khas ya lo hri man gyi nye 'dabs nas dgra dmag la rgol rdung dza drag che ba zhig byas nas mkhar rdzong kha shas shig bstud mar dbang la bsdus/ma 'gyangs par khyim mtshes kyi mo la we ya( khri ༅)nas ho zi lugs la gnod 'tshe gtong ba'i don rkyen byung bas/ lo na rgan pa'i ce hri khas dka' tshegs la ma 'dzem par mo la we yar sdod pa'i ho zi lugs kyi spun zlar dmag rogs byed tu chas/ zla 10ba'i mgor ce hri kha'i dmag gis mo la we ya'i rgyal mtshams kyi 'gag sgo ste phu lis pis zi la blu(rsātsho mo'ilko)mkhar rdzong yongs su bskor/ mkhar rdzong la bskor rgol byas nas nyin mang po zhig phyin pa dang / tha por dmag dpung khrod du nad yams shig glo bur du byung zhing / de lo na bgres pa'i dmag spyi ce hri kha la 'gos nas 1424lo'i zla 10pa'i tshes 11nyin tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs/ hi la tig khu khu la lo we(blo'i ma khriX )ru 'das mchod bsgrubs/ de nas tha por dmag dpung gis phu di16 pis zi la tru(rsā༅7lo74)la rgol rgyu bskyur nas kho'i bang so yang

bskyar cha zi la tru( 〉〉rsālko)la bsdur/ce hri kha 'di ltar 'das kyang / khong gi gson dus kyi snyan grags kyis dgra bo'i bla rtsa 'dar zhing bkong bar byed la/ ce hri kha dang 'brel ba'i bshad rgyun de mur sa phyogs so sor khyab pa ste/ tha por gyi dmag dpung gis kho tsho'i dmag spyi'i skyi pags kyis rnga chen zhig bzos te rgyun du 'thab 'khrug byed dus rnga chen de rdung gin 'dug la/ ce hri kha'i rnam shes kyis sngar bzhin tt+waṃ /bye dro/shā /doms dang skyabs su bzung yod pa dang kun nas mtshungs ce hri kha 'das rjes lha ba phu lo khi phis(:rdzormarnya/sto )'os langs dmag gi dmag don gyi las 'gan phrag tu blangs pa dang / kho dang phu lo khi phi chung ba gnyis kyis dus yun ring bo zhig tu dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byas nas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du 'ong ba'i rgya gram dmag dpung la sngon 'gog byas pa dang / dus mtshungs su phar rgol byas nas dmag 'khrug 'jar man gyi sa thog tu spar/ 'on kyang / rgyal kha 'di dag ce hri kha gson dus kyi 'thab 'khrug gi byas rjes dang bsdur thabs med la/ ce hri kha tshe las 'das pa ni 'os langs dmag gi gyong gud tshabs che ba zhig red la/ 6 hrin pa'e lugs dang 66tha por lugs ’ gnyis kyang 'dum thabs med par phyogs gnyis su gyes song / hrin pa'e lugs dang dgra bo gnyis 'cham mthun byung nas phyir tha por phyogs la dpung 'jug dza drag byas pa dang / phyogs gnyis ka 1434lor li phang du 'thab pa na/ tha por dmag gi rgyal kha rtag len gyi dmag dpon sngar na~X bzhud zin pas/ stobs shugs che ba'i dgra bo'i do yar ma yong bar cigam kha ci ṭwāṃ /kha 'das rjes/ o gling gi dmag khul du kho'i gsar gtod byas pa'i 'thab 'khor byed thabs snang med du bzhag nas lo 200lhag phyin/18/de

ni bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin ring lugs spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas kyi gom rim dal ba dang o gling la stobs shugs ldan pa'i krung dbyang srid gzhung zhig med pas/ 'di lta'i sngon thon gyi dmag don lag rtsal nang 'dren dang bkol spyod byed ma nus/ dus rabs gnyis kyi rjes su res tan(lkolko)gyi rgyal bo ko'u zi tha hphu sku phreng gnyis pas(lhamo lko tsho)ce hri kha'i dmag thabs spyad 'go bcoms nas spor skyod byed rung gi phyogs chen dmag dpung sgrig pa dang /'thab 'khrug khrod nus pa chen po thon nas dmag don lag rtsal gyi gsar brje zhig bslangs pa red/ ho zi dmag 'khrug gi dmag don pa 'di'i 'thab rtsal gyi bsam blo yang kun la cha rgyus yod par gyur la/ o gling gi dmag don bsam blo'i 'byor phyug gi cha shas shig tu kun gyis khas len mdzad/ rjes rabs pa chos ce hri kha yi 'thab rtsal dang lhag par du kho'i 'thab 'khor byed thabs la zhib 'jug byas nas legs bcos su btang / kho'i spor skyod 'thab 'khor gyis rjes rabs pa la blo skyed mi dman pa bstsal zhing / lo 500lhag gi yar sngon du lcags khrab kyis shan pa'i spor skyod 'thab 'khor ni don dngos thog deng rabs can gyi 'thab 'khrug khrod kyi me skyogs rang gzur dang / khyab ldan 'khor lo/ than khe sogs dang 'dra bas/ ce hri kha la 'thab 'khor gyi pha rgan zhes bshad chog chog red/yung ce hri khas ho zi dmag 'khrug khrod byas rjes bla med blangs pas lo rgyus kyi steng du snyan grags phyogs su khyab pa dang / ce hri kha'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo zhes bla ru bkur gyin yod/ da lta po zhis mis ya'i ga sa kun tu dpa' bo 'dis bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes mthong thub ste/ ce hri kha'i g.yul chas tāzlo // tse/ da dung mon cha ra sogs da lta'i mi rnams la dran gso'i rten du 188

rgya mtsho'i steng du dragayor 'jigasanyen skur mkhan gyi dmag dpon zhiga'o zhan gyi rgyal gces dmag dpon lis hron khren/teng zhin yus/dus dbyibs dmag gru bzos nas ljar pan dgra dmag la thog mar 'thab pa/1592lor ya gling shar ma'i mkha' dbyings su 'thab rdul lang long du 'khrigs shing / ham thob kyis sems rgyud kun nas brlams pa'i nyi hong gi dbang bsgyur ba hphin khrin gi'u ci(ro zaṣṭha)yis rgyal khab gcig gyur byas rjes/ blo khengs yid tshim gyi ngang nas yang bskyar ya gling gi skam sa dbang du sdud rtsis byed pa dang / thog mar khra'o zhan khyur mid du gtong ba dang / de nas krung gor dpung 'jug byas nas krung go btsan bzung byas rjes kho tsho'i rgyal sa pe cing du spar te/ kho rang nyid nying po ru 'dug pa'i 'char gzhi 'then zhing / dmag mu mthud du mngags te rgya gar dbang du bsdus nas rgyal sa'ang de ru spor 'dod/ der brten hphin khrin zhi'u ci yis dmag gru 2000bzos pa dang dmag khri 20sto yongs grags la khri 30yod pa nyi hong gi dmag dpon zha'o zhis zhin krang(7)rimabiṣṭha)dang ca thin chin krin(meb 1)/ to cing dbyi hong(rma 57)sogs kyis sne khrid de khra'o zhan btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug bslangs/khra'o zhan ni gna' nas bzung 6 dben sa ba'i rgyal khab tu ga~X la/

dus yun ring mo zhig la zhi bde khor yug khrod gnas pas drag chas yod tshad zhig rid du song yod pa red/ lis rgyal rabs rgyal bo zhon tso lis yan(tshimalto7/)gyis hur brtson rgyal skyong mi byed par srid gzhung du dza drag che je'i tang srid kyi rtsod gzhi ru tshud 'dug dus 'dir nyi hong dmag dpung 'os ma mtsho rgyud(snamatho ṣṭha)brgal te hphu hran(༅7)nas skam sar bud pa dang /dus rgyun du 'thab 'khrug gi sta gon zhan pa'i khra'o zhan gyi dmag dpung la glo bur du hi lan dang phu'u tho ya'i phyogs mdel dang rdzas mdel gyi drag chas spras pa'i dgra dmag dang 'phrad pas pham kha 'phro rim 'phror nyos/ zhon tso lis yan gyis wang cin(12)bskyur nas byang phyogs krung go'i mtha' mtshams kyi yu krig(575)tu bros/ de nas khos rgyal yongs kyis dgra bor rgol rgyu'i 'bod skul byas pa dang / dmag dpung gis gtso dmag zho zhis dang ca thon gyi sne khrid 'og mu mthud du byang phyogs su rgol nas phen rāng(cha )tshur bcad pa dang / chon lo'u to(༅77)dang phen rāng gi nub byang las gzhan pa'i sa khul yongs rdzogs bcad bzung byas/ zho zhis nas khong la mgo 'dogs skul yig cig bris te khra'o zhan gyi rgyal bo la bskur pa dang / de ru ljar pan gyi mtsho dmag hri khag khri 10shar phyogs nas yong ste skam dmag dang spyan du yu krig la rgol rgyu yin pas/ myur du mgo 'dogs dgos tshul bkod da/ khra'o zhan lho nub kyi chon lo to mtsho dmag gi ce tu'u hri lis hron khren gyis rgya mtsho brtan por srung nas nyin mtshan med par rgyal khab kyi las dbang la thugs khur byed kyin yod/ kho rang ni 1545lor wang cin gyi khyim tshang dbul bo zhig tu skyes shing / spyod pa bzang zhing gshis rgyud drang la/ lo na chung dus nas drag rtsal sbyangs pas lo 32stong wu co'u(7lto)yi thob thang bladi/0/ khos dmag don skor gyi dpe cha mang du bklags pa dang / 'thab

jus la mkhas par ma zad snyan ngag la'ang mkhas/ yin na yang srid jus mi legs pas kho lta bu'i blo sems dkar ba'i mi la mthong chen ma byas/ de'i rjesanas nang blon le'u khrun lung(7)lo7)gi rtsis mthong thob par brten/'thanga'akhrug ma langs pa'i yar sngon du mtsho dmag hri khag gi las gnas gtso bor bskos pa yin/ lis hron khyen dpon sar bsdad rjes myur du drag chas bzos shing / 'bru rigs gsog 'jog byed pa dang nam rgyun du mtsho dmag hri gyi khag la dag ther dang dka' spyad sdug rus kyis dmag sbyong byed du bcug pa red/mtsho thog srung ba la shugs snon byed ched/lis hron khren gyis dka' spyad sdug rus kyis rus sbal dbyibasakyi dmag gru/ mtsho dmag gi go cha dang 'thab rtsal la zhib 'jug byed pa yin/ khra'o zhan gyi gru bzo'i las rigs ha cang dar zhing sngon chad nas rus dbyibs dmag gru zer ba'i 'thab gru zhig bzo srol yod de/ gru gzings kyi gcal du sra zhing mkhregs pa'i lcags kyi phyi skogs btang yod pa dang / dbyibs ni rus sbal gyi rgyab dang 'dra bas ha cang sra mkhregs ldan/lis hron khren gyis yang nas yang du rus dbyibs dmag gru des 'thab 'khrug gi nas shugs je cher gtong ba la byed nus 'don thub par bsam blo btang ste/khos de'i ring tshad dang zheng tshad bsgyur ba dang / de'i nang du btung chu dang zas rigs cung mang po blug chog la dus yun ring bor spyod thub/ gru'i mgo yi 'brug mgo ru phyogs mig gnyis brtol nas skyogs chen btsugs pa dang /phyogs bzhi ru dra mig mang po bsnan yod pa dang phyogs bzhir phyogs mda' gang dgar 'phang chog pa yin/ logs gnyis su gru khem 10ra sprad yod la/bsgyur las byas rjes kyi rus dbyibs gru gzings de ni chu ngos su bya 'phur ba ltar bgrod chog gzhan gru steng du snyung gris bkang yod pa des 'thab1 rnyisag

khrod dgra dmag gru thog tu 'gro ba la 'gog srung byed thub/ lis hron khren gyis bsgyur las byas rjes rus dbyibs dmag gru'i nus shugs sngar las ldab 'gyur gyis che ru phyin yod/ 'di lta'i 'thab 'khor mang po gsar bzo byed pa la khong sku dngos nas lta skul byas pa dang / rus dbyibs gru gzings 'di dag gis rjes phyogs kyi 'thab 'khrug khrod du nus pa bla na med pa bton no//lis hron khyen gyis hphu hran shor ba shes pa na/ nyi hong gi dmag dpung gis saḥ kho'i btsan srung byas yod pa'i sa khul du la 〉 btsan 'dzul byed par bsam nas/ myur 4 du dmag dpon bsdus nas dgra 'gog 'thab jus la gros mol byas/ hphu hran gyi nye 'dabs su sdod pa'i chin hrang to'i(ṣṭha lo11) g.yas kyi mtsho dmag hri khag ri 'jigs nas gru gzings 100lhag bskyur / nas bros/ yon con gyis srid gzhung gi khrims chad phog par skrag thag chod de chon lo to ru mi mngags nas lis hron rsharwa nghru tsho khren la skyob dmag bslangs/ lis rgyal stod 4 3po tsho rabs kyis khag so so'i mtsho dmag la sa tre 3cho〉 (79 7)shā gciXmatshams bgar nas 'gog srung byed rgyu 64 mo— ci cho ci mo dang / bka' ma yong bar du rang 'gul ponyan sna pa0 4 44 gyis sa mtshams brgal mi chog pa'i thag dmag dpon chen mo lis hron khrin/ bcad byas/ lis hron khren gyis gnas 192

tshul ha cang tshabs chen yin pa mthong nas nges par du dgra bo'i ngar sems bcog dgos par bsam ste/ 'thab gru 85chin hrang to ru btang / 'di ni kho thengs dang po dgra dmag dang 'thab pa yin la yon con yang 'thab gru zhig la bsdad nas kho dang mnyam du g.yul la zhugs/lis hron khyen gyis thog mar rus dbyibs dmag gru khag cig sdun gyi so bar btang ste dgra dmag gi gnas tshul nyul zhib byas/ dgra phyogs kyi gnas tshul snyan zhu 'byor rjes myur du 'thab gru'i ru dpung khrid nas ce ci gling phran(༅lkotsho)gyi ye phu'i(cha )nye 'dabs su phyin/ de nas phar bltas na mtsho mtha' ru sdod pa'i tshon mdog sna tshogs kyis rgyan pa'i nyi hong gi 'thab gru 50mthong thub pa dang / gru steng du dkar dmar can gyi dar cha chung chung re bslangs yod pa yang mthong thub/ lis hron khren gyis 'thab gru so so 'thab 'khrug gi gral bstar sgrig nas mnyam du dgra bo'i 'thab gru'i phyogs su dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i bka' bstsal/ mtsho mtha'i grong sde'i rgyu nor 'phrog bcom byed kyin pa'i nyi hong gi dmag kha shas kyis khra'o zhan gyi mtsho dmag hri khag 'jab rgol byas 'ong ba mthong nas brel 'tshub ngang phyir gru'i nang du bros te 'thab 'khrug gi gdong bsu ba la brel/khra'o zhan 'thab grus phyogs mdel dang mda' mo nyi hong gi steng du 'phangs pa na/ phyir lcags log dang sgro mda' 'phangs nas ya lan sprad/dmag dpon lis hron khren gyis dka' ba spyad nas dmag sbyong byas pa'i mtsho dmag hri khag gis dgra bo'i 'thab gru gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bsnubs pa dang / khro dmag gi me mda' phog pa'i 'thab gru mer 'tshig nyi hong gi 'thab gru 26bsnubs pa dang mer bsregs la dmag dpung pham nas ce ci gling phran du bros so/ lis hron khren gyis spyir gling phran du dgra dmag gi rjes snyeg par bsam mod/ 'on kyang gling phran steng gi sa bab btsog pa dang ༵ /ba

ran pa mthong nas/ g.yul sa gtsang dag byas nas dmag bsdus te yung teng phu'u(lkoṣṭha )nas bsdad/ zhag gcig 'gor rjes lis hron khren gyi mtsho dmag hri khag gis sngar bzhin ye phu'i(cha )sa cha'i so'u chin nye 'dabs su yod pa'i nyi hong gi 'thab gru 40lhag bsnubs pa dang / nyi hong dmag gi 'bru rigs dang gyon chas/ drag chas sogs mdzod khang 50gang ba'i g.yul thob dngos rdzas mang po lag tu thob la/ thengs 'di'i 'thab 'khrug nas 'go bcoms te mtsho thog tu chu 'brug lo'i rgyal srung dmag 'khrug gi sgo mo phyes/lis hron khren gyi dpa' ngar ldan pa'i hri khag 'dis yag thog yag brtsegs kyis mtsho mtha' brgyud nas dgra dmag gi 'thab gru bsnubs te 'thab 'bras rgya bskyed pa dang / rgyal kha gang mang blangs nas mtshan snyan phyogs su rgyas/zhan hran gling phan nas rgyal kha chen po blangs te dmag dbung gi gzi nyams mngon pa/khra'o zhan dang krung go ni mdza' 'brel che ba'i mna' 'brel yin stabs/krung go'i ming rgyal rabs la skyabs zhu'i 'phrin yig 'byor ba na/ zhon tso lis yan la ya lis gtsang bo brgal nas de ga'i btsan rdzong du bsdad chog pa'i chog mchan thob par ma zad/ dmag rogs mngags te rang spun zla'i rgyal khab nyi hong btsan 'dzul las thar bar rogs ram byas/ khra'o zhan gyi dmag dpung gis skam sa nas 'gog srung byed pa de phyir rgol byed par bsgyur ba dang / zho zhis zhin krang gis mtsho dmag gi dpung rogs la brten nas skam dmag pham zlo) rgyag rgyu'i mig zung ji ltar bgrad kyang / mtsho dmag gtan nas mthong ma 19/na khrin gi'u cis mtsho dmag dang skam dmag dpung bsdongs pa'i

'char gzhi mngon 'gyur byed ched/ dmag gru mang po khra'o zhan gyi rgya mtsho btsan bzung byed par mngags pa na/ lis zhon khren gyi mtsho dmag hri khag gi stobs shugs che ba'i rgol rdung la 'phrad/ dgra bo'i dmag gru stong khom ma byung dus tag tag la/ lis zhon khyen gyis mtsho dmag gi ce tu'u hri lis yu che dang lhan du dmag gru btang nas gling phran gyi dgra tshang la slebs/ lis hron khren gyi dmag gru thang phu'u ru slebs pa na/ gnas de'i mang tshogs kyis kho rang dgra bo gsod du slobs pa la dga' bsu zhus pa dang / nyi hong dmag gru 'dus yod pa'i zhan hran gling phran gyi gnas tshul gsal bor bshad/ dmag dpon lis kyis mtsho dmag hri khag khrid nas mu mthud du zhan hran gling(776)phran du skyod pa dang / ma 'gyangs par de'i nye 'gram gyi can nee lhang gi 'gag(༅lotsho gre)tu slobs pa yin la/ 'gag nang du nyi hong gi dmag gru'i ru khag gtso bo zhig yod pa ste/ dmag gru che chung 60lhag gis gnas de'i sa bab legs shos bzung zhing / hphin khrin zhi'u ci yis gsar du mngags pa'i dmag dpon hphu'u than zhi'u ca yis mtsho dmag la bkod 'doms byed kyi yod pa dang / khos nyi hong sngon chad kyang gnas 'di nas pham myong ba'i gnas tshul shes pas/ cung rang rlom dang bcas mthong chung gi skad cha ci dgar /chad pa zad/ khra'o zhan gyi mtho ngogs 'phred gcod byed rgyu'i kha pho'ang sgrog na 'ahā/ zhon khren gyis 'gag phreng gu dog pa dang sa bab mi legs pa mthong nas dgra bo'i dmag gru bskor rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'then pa red/ kho nyi hong gi dmag dpung pham tshe skam sar bud nas bros 'gro bar dogs nas de tsho 'gag phyi la phud de rgyag dgos bsam ste/ sngun la dmag gru drug tsam btang nas rgol khul byas pa na nyi hong gi dmag dpung gis chu sgar gyi bde 'jags srung ched/ dmag gru yod tshad kyi stobs shugs bkol nas khra'o zhan gyi dam/mi ༈ de

tsho gtor pham btang ste zhan hran gling phran du mngon/ lis zhon khren gyis rang gi dmag gru zhan hran gling phran gyi rgyab phyogs su skung nas bzhag pa dang / go skabs 'grig pa'i glags dang bstun nas pha rol ba'i phyogs la glo bur du leb spragakā ddhis pa na nyi hong gi dmag dpung ha las hon thor du gyur te pham kha dzen khyazlo zha/ na dmag dpung gis lis zhon khren gyi bkod 'doms 'og tu skad cig de nyid la dmag gi gral bstar ( dbyibs dang mtshungs pa'i gral chen gnyis su sgrig cing / g.yas ru g.yon ru gnyis nas nyi hong gi dmag gru'i phyogs su bskor bcom byas nas rgyugs te mda' mdung char zhod 'bab 'bab byas pa dang de'i sngon skyod dmag gru gnyis gsum zhig thal ba'i rdul du brlags/ nyi hong gi gzhug dmag sngar bzhin sbrul dbyibs ltar shar mar sgrig la/ mda' mdung 'phen gsum gyi ral khar brten nas gdong la mchongs 'ong ste tag tag lis zhon khren gyi 'thab ra'i skor dkyil khrod du lhung /gral bstar gseg mar sgrig pa'i khra'o zhan dmag dpung gnyis bsnol mar 'ong ste rgol rdung drag tu byas/khra'o jamag gi rus dbyibs dmag gru sngon du bud nas phyogs mig las gsang stabs kyis skyogs mdel 'phangs/ phyogs mdol 'phen mkhan de dag lcags khrab kyi nang du skung nas dmigs sa'i phyogs la rtog zhib gsal bo byed thub pa yin la mda' mo phog tshad ha cang mtho/ nyi hong dmag dpung gis rus dbyibs dmag gru'i nang tshul gtan nas ma mthong bar da dung de la rgol ci thub kho na byed pa las/ phyogs mdel ji 'dra 'phangs kyang de la sen shul tsam yang phab thub kyi med pa ga la shes/ rus dbyibs dmag gru mang po zhig rlabs rgyun dang bsdongs nas mdun du mchongs pa na nyi hong gi dmag mi mang po sdo/6 gru yis bsnubs pa dang / dpa' rtul che ba 'ga' shas shig chu ru

byings kyang rus dbyibs dmag gru'i steng 'dzegs nas yang bskyar 'thab par 'dod na yang / gom pa re 'ga' las spo long med par rus dbyibs dmag gru'i steng gi snyung gri'i 'og shi ba dang / rus dbyibs dmag grus nyi hong gi sbrul dbyibs ru bstar cha kha ya sdeb tu btang ste/ dgra bo'i dkyil la slebs pa dang / dza drag che ba'i me rgol gyis dgra dmag pham par btang zhing rgyal kha'i zil shugs ngoms/mtsho 'thab mjug sgril rjes/ nyi hong gi dmag gru chen po gcig dang chung 'bring 10da dung dmag mi 4rtsilhag bros byol byas pa las/ mang che shos sheg 'dzin bzung byas/ der mthud nas lis zhon khren gyis rang gi rgyal kha'i snyan grags an ko'u phu'u(a tsho)ru khyab ched/ de ru nyi hong gi dmag gru 40lhag bzhag pa dang / de'i nang gi thog so can gyi gru chen 3yod pa dang /an ko'u phu'u yi chu srab cing sa dog pas/ lis zhon khyen gyis yang bskyur dgra bo 'gag sgo la 'bud par sgug kyang / sngar gyi nyams myong gis dgra bo kho'i g.yo 'og tu ma tshud/ de nas khos dmag gru chung 'bring gis ru chung zhig bsgrigs pa dang rus dbyibs dmag gru sngon la phud de phu'u kho'u la rgol rdung byas/ rus dbyibs dmag grus g.yas rdung g.yon rdung ci rigs byas mthar dmag gru che 'bring chung gsum rdul du brlags par ma zad/ tha na dmag gru chen po de dag kyang bcom chag tu btang / dmag 'khrug chen po zhig brgyud mthar an ko'u phu'u nang gi nyi hong gi dmag gru yod tshad bcom chag skya nyil du btang ba dang shi rmas chen po thebs/ shul du lus pa dag kyang mtsho 'gram du bros byol byas/ lis zhon khyen gyis shul du lus pa'i dgra dmag gis gling phran steng gi mang tshogs la gnod 'tshe mi skyel ba'i ched du dmag gru yod tshad rtsa rdzogs ma byas par gru chung kha shas bzhag pa dang / de nas mtsho dmag phyir 'then byas nas zhag gcig la bsdad pa na/ nyi hong gi shul lus dmag1 /snang

de ma thag tu dmag grur 'dug rgyu'ang bskyur nas zhag ma gcig gi ring la rmu hran la bros byol byas/ thengs 'di'i mtsho 'khrug steng nyi nyong gi dmag gru 42gtor pham btang ba dang / de nas khos dmag dpung khrid nas zhan hran gling phran gyi 'gag sgo so sor nyul zhib byang kyang dgra bo'i rjes tsam yang mthong rgyu mi 'dug mtsho phyi'i tung le me yon the(lkolkoṣṭha73)ru dmag gru'i gral bstar sgrig ste rgyal kha'i gzi shugs ngoms/zhan hran gling phran dang yan ko'u phu'u mtsho 'thab gnyis kyi ming bsdoms na 6 zhan hran gling phran gyi rgyal kha chen mo mi zhes zer/ thengs 'di'i rgyal kha chen mo yis nyi hong mtsho dmag gi rno dbal gzhom par byas te byang phyogs nas dmag rogs bsnon pa'i sgo mo yongs su bcad/ mu'u lu'u to khu(a zam)zer ba'i o gling gi dmag don pa zhig gis zhan hran gling phran gyi rgyal kha chen mor gdeng 'jog byed dus de'i dpe ru gna' bo'i ke ri se'i mtsho dmag gis phor zin pham par btang ba'i sa la mu'i 'thab 'khrug(97skololo)bkod yod pa red/ khra'o zhan dmag dpung gis rgyun chad med par mtsho thog tu nyi hong gi dmag dpung la 'jigs dngangs chen po skul gyin 'dugaspyir na hphin khrin zhi'u cis rgya mtsho brgal nas khra'o zhan la gzigs zhib tu 'gro rgyu'i sta gon yod kyang / rgya mtsho'i ched dbang yod tshad lis zhon khren gyi lag tu yod pas rang gi 'char gzhi de rdo thog chu blug tu gyur bar ma zad/ khra'o zhan btsan 'dzul gyi dmag 'khrug slong mkhan gyi dmag dpon 'di mi tshe gang bor khra'o zhan gyi sa thog tu gom pa gang tsam yang spo ma nus/gzab nan sgos dmag la bkod 'doms byas pa/lis hron khren gyis mtsho dmag la dbang bsgyur byas pa nas bzung rim bsdi/ ḍi mtsho'i 'gram brgyud kyi chon lo'u dang khron chin/ chin hrang bcas sa

khul gsum gyi mtsho dmag dbang du bsgyur ba dang / kho tsho'i dmag sgar sa bab dang 'thab jus ches bzang sa'i zhan hran gling phran la spos pa ma zad/gling phran steng kho dang kho'i mnga' 'og gi dmag mi rnams dang mnyam du dmag don la gros bsdur byed sa'i tshogs khang zhig kyang bskrun/ skabs der chin hrang na bkag nyar byas yod pa'i dgra dmag gis ston lo'u sa khul la tshur rgol byed rgyu'i go skabs btsal bzhin yod/ li'u hron khren gyis mcho srung sra brtan du btang bar ma zad gal te ljar dmag gis skam lam brgyud nas mtsho dmag gi rjes chod na de ni ha cang nyen kha che ba'i gnas shig yin par gzhigs te sa cha so so'i dgon pa'i btsun pa rnams bsdus nas dmag sbyong byas pa dang /de tsho sa cha so sor mngags te ljar dmag gi 'gul skyon la so lta byed du bcug nas gal te rgyun ldan min pa'i gnas tshul 'dra yod tshe 'phrin btang nas dgra bo'i myul zhib la sngon 'gog byed par bcug de ltar byas na dmag sgar gyi bde 'jags brtan srung byed thub la/ 'thab 'khrug byung tshe btsun pa rnams kyang skam sa'i dmag 'khrug gam rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gang rung la zhugs te dmag mir rogs ram byas te mnyam du dgra bor 'gog rgol byas/li'u hron khyen gyi sems la dgra bo'i gnas tshul rgyus lon byed rgyu ni ha cangagal che bar 'dod de rgya mtsho dang skam sa'i thog tu gsang 'phrin gtong len byed sa zhig kyang btsugs/ btson du bcug yod pa'i dgra bo'i kha nas pha rol ba'i chab srid dang dmag don bkod sgrig thad kyi gnas tshul rgyus lon byas te ljar dmag khra'o zhan gyi dmag rgya mtsho'i mnga' khongs las pha rol du bskyod dgos na nges par du mtsho dmag gi stobs shugs je cher gtong dgos pas gru gzings bzo ba'i 'char 'god chen po zhig 'then nas gru gzings sna tshogs bzos shing / khos ljar dmag gis zil shugs cung che ba'i rdzas mda'(67)zhig bkol spyod byed bzhin pa mthong ste/ khra'o zhan gyi ma/mi/ ba

rnams la rang rgyal gyi rdzas mda'i spus ka je legs su gtong du bcug pa ma zad de las kyang lhag pa'i lcags grub rdzas mda' sna tshogs bzo dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ de yang lcags grub me mda' mang po zhig bskrun dgos na nges par du rgyu cha mang po zhig mkho bas/ khos lcags kyi gter kha mang po zhig sngog 'don byas pa dang / btsun pa rnams la bsod snyoms slong du 'jug pa'i thabs la brten nas rgya che'i mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi lag nas lcags rdzas rgya ma khri brgyad tsam 'tshol bsdu byas/ zla gsum re'i nang dgra bo'i lag nas yan zho'o(ṣṭhalo)rgya ma 1000re btso sbyangs byas te me rdzas mang po mkho sprod byas/spyir skabs der me skyogs yod na yang me mda' sngar bzhin kho tsho'i dmag 'khrugagi mtshon cha gtso bo yin pas/ lis dmag spyis dmag mir rgya mtsho'i 'gram brgyud du smyug sdong mang bo 'debs 'dzugs byed du bcug nas mda' bzos pa dang / mtshams rer dmag spyi khong dngos su song nas mda' bzo rogs byed pa red/ khos ljar dmag la 'brel 'dris byas pa brgyud ljar dmagagis spyod bzhin pa'i ring la rno ba'i gri des mi gsod dus stabs bde zhingaspyod mkho che ba mthong ste sngon chad kyi dmag 'khrug khrod khri'o zhan dmag pham pa'i rgyu rkyen shes te 'dzin bzung byas yod pa'i ljar dmag khrod mgar ba kha shas bdams te gri brdungs su bcug pa dang / de yang khra'o zhan gyi dmag la sprad nas gri g.yug srol sbyangs su bcug de yang gna' snga mo'i dus su dmag 'khrug las dgra dpon bzung ba'am bsad rjes de'i 'go bo'am yang na rna ba gcod pa dang / 'go bo dang rna ba'i mang nyung de byas rjes ji 'dra bzhag pa'i tshad la bzung ste bya dga' gnang ba'i srol yod pa yin mod/ li'u hā/ bye/ /rdzu /lha de rgyun bskyangs na gdug rtsub che drags par snyam nas rgyun 2lu/'o zhan dang krung go'i mnyam 'brel dmag gis lho phyogs kyi skam sa'i

thog tu rim bzhin gom gang mdun spos kyis phen reng(ga )tshur blangs ba ma zad/ wang cin(10)yang blangs pa red/ li'u hron khren gyis skam sa'i thog gi 'gog rgol la ram 'degs byas te lho nub rgya mtsho'i mnga' khongs bdag bzung byas/ dmag 'khrug 'di ltar dza drag che na yang chon lo'u(༅7)sogs 'gag gsum dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram brgyud gling phran gyi mang tshogs rnamasakyis sngar bzhin lto gos la sems khral byed mi dgos pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod la/ rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis nam yang li'u dmag spyi'i bkod 'doms la dga' gus yi rangs byed bzhin yod pa red/khos dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms byas pa nas bzung chon lo'u(༅7)sa cha'i mi dmangs kyis ljar dmag gi drag gnon dang mnar gcod myangs ma myong la/ sa cha 'di ni sngon chad nas khra'o zhan gyi 'bru mdzod yin pas sa khul gang yin yang dmag mi rnams kyi bza' chas gnas 'dir mi brten ka med yin/ 'bru rigs thon skyed la shugs snon byed ched li'u dmag spyis mtsho dmag mngags nas sa spyod du bzhag yod pa'i zhing sar 'bru btab/ 'di ltar phyogs gcig nas dmag 'khrug brgyab pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas sa zhing rmos pa/ yang zhor du dka' khag yod pa'i mang tshogs rnams bsdus nas dmag du len pa'am ngal rtsol byed du bcug ste lto gos kyi gnad don thag gcod byas/ khos gling phran steng rta gsos te skam sa'i dmag la mkho sprod byas pa dang / nya ba tshor nya ra rgya bskyed du bcug nas nya mang bo gso skyong dang rgya mtsho'i nang gi rtswa rigs mang bo bsdu nyar byas nas bza' chas bskrun pa ma zad/mtsho dmag mngags nas nya gso skyong dang / mtsho chu bskol nas tshwa 'don sprod byas/ thabs shes 'di dag tshang ma ni yun ring rgyun bsrings byas pa'i chu 'brug(1lo)'thab 'khrug la sta gon byas pa red/lngar dmag la 'thab ra'i khrod rdung deg drag po phog rjes/ gling shāsnyi gyi

shar lho'i mtshams su phyir bsdur byas te khra'o zhan dang 'grig mthun yong rgyu'i gros gzhi bton/ gros mol gyi khrod du ljar phyogs kyis gnas lugs med pa'i cha rkyen gang mang bton par khra'o zhan dang krung go gnyis kyis dang len ma byas pas/ gros sol de de ltar lo gsum la phyi bshol mi byed ka med du gyur/dmag spyi lis hron khyen khong khro chen po langs te ljar dmag tos ma mtsho 'gag la bskyod rgyu'i 'char gzhi 'then/nyes med khag 'gel byas pa/1597lor gros mol 'cham mthun ma byung bas/ hphin khrin gi'u cis 'thab dmag dang 'thab 'khor mang po kha snon byas te khra'o zhan la mngags nas thog mar de'i mtsho dmag rtsa med gtong rgyu'i bka' btang ba dang /dmag dpon ca thin dang zho zhis gnyis nas lo ngo drug gi yar sngon du lis zhon khren gyi lag tu pham kha nyos pa sems la wa ler shar bzhin yod la/ de'i ming go ba na mgo nang la tsag shad rgyug gi 'dug 'thab 'khrug 'go ma bcoms pa'i yar sngon du de gsod rgyu'i 'char bkod cig 'then pa ste/ zho zhis yis khra'o skad shes pa'i dmag mi yo hri lo chin hrang to ru gsang stabs kyis mngags pa dang cin ying ton srid gzhung du lis zhon khren gyis rkang btsugs nas nyi tong gi dmag dpon ca thin btang zin pa sogs kyi dkrog /tam ci rigs lab pa na/ dkrog gtam de de mur gang sar khyab par gyur dmag 'khrug gi gnas tshul zhi 'jags su song rjes/ khra'o zhan gyi rim pa so so'i dbang bsgyur ba'i nang khul du tang khag 'then 'khyer yang bskyar langs shing / zhi drag gi dpon po sdod gnas kyi sa khul ltar shar ba'i tang da~X /cho ma'i tang du dgar ba dang / shar ba'i tang yang lho ba'i tang dang

byang ba'i tang du gyes/ blon chen li'u khrun lung gis lho ba'i tang gi 'go ba khur ba dang / tang khag 'di'i stobs shugs tang khag gzhan las che bas/nub byang gnyis kyi tang khag mnyam 'brel byas nas lho ba'i tang la ngo rgol byas/lo rgyus steng du 'di la 6 tshon bzhi'i tang 'khrug mi ces zer/ lis zhon khren tang khag gang la'ang ma zhugs mod/ 'on kyang khong ni li'u khrun lung gis 'os sbyor byas pa yin pas nub byang tang khag gnyis kyi mig nang gi tsher ma lta bur gyur yod/ kho tshos yo hri lo yi dkrog gtam la nyan nas rgyal bo'i mdun nas lis hron khren la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen bskyal ba dang / g.yul las pham kha bsdud mur nyo mkhan gyi yon con lis zhon khren gyi skad grags che ba'i mdzad rjes la phrag dog gting nas skye ba dang de'i go gnas 'phrog par 'dod nas/nub byang tang khag gnyis dang ngan 'brel gyis lis hron khren la ngan rigs ci nus lab pa de rgyal bos bden par sems te/ kho'i byas rjes yod tshad chu kha'i wu ba ltar dor nas btson du bcug pa dang / yon con mtsho dmag gi dmag spyir bskos/lis hron khren gzhan gyi ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis rgyal khrims la brdzangs pa de lam bar gyi mi ser gyis thos rjes kho'i ched du sdug lus kyi skad cor mi rgyag pa gcig kyang med la/ dmangs khrod du'ang lis zhon khren la dkar 'don byed dgos pa'i skad cor nyin re bzhin je drag tu song / gzhung drang ba'i blon chen nyung shas shig kyang kho'i phyogs su langs nas dkar nag gi dbye ba bcod de ming du grags pa'i dpa' rgod de nyid gsod khrims la sbyor mi rung ba'i dag 'bud zhus pa dang / de dang sbrags rgyal khab kyang 'thab 'khrug bskyar du langs par thug yod pas/ lis zhon khren gsod khrims la sbyor ma dgos par 6 byas nyes thod gtugs ’ kyi khrims la sbyar te dmag gral du phud nas rgyang bskyur btang ba na/ dmag dpon lis yu chis skyo gdung dra/ zlos

khong la 'phrin yig 'di ltar bris yod/ dmag dpon song shul du mtsho dmag nges par pham 'gro ba yin la/ ngas kyang rang gi bem ro sa gang zhig tu sbas dgos pa shes kyi med zer/hphin khrin zhi'u ci'i sems su snying gi tsher mar gyur ba'i lis zhon khren med par btang ste dmag 'khrug gi 'go slong bar 'dod/ dmag mi khri 15tshags sgrig byas nas 1597lor yang bskyar dpung 'jug gi las la zhugs/nyi hong mtsho dmag gis dmag gru 58lhag gi nang du mtsho dmag khri 5drud nas 'ong ste/ khra'o zhan gyi mtsho dmag dang g.yul 'thab pa'i bzo lta spel ba na/yon con gyis dmag grabs ci yang 'then med pas nyi hong dmag phyogs kyi g.yo 'og tu pham kha chen po nyos/ dmag spyis kho la dbyug pa 50bzhus pa dang sgar nang du bkag nyar byed dgos pa'i bka' btang bas 'gro ma thub par chang 'thung nas nyin mtshan skyel dgos byung / de'i rjes nas nyi hong dmag dpung gis glo bur du 'jab rgol byas te dmag mi yod tshad bsnubs pa dang /rgyun par pham kha nyo mkhan gyi dmag dpon yon con kho yang 'gro lam nas bzung ste bsad/ rgyal gces dmag dpon lis yu chi mtsho mo brgal nas bros shul du/ zhan hran gling phran dgra lag tu shor ba dang / mtsho dmag gi sgar chen yang me la shor te lis zhon khrin gyis lo ngo mang po'i ring la zungs khrag spyad nas bdag gnyer byas pa'i mtsho dmag skad cig de nyid du pham gtor byung ba na/ tshang mas mgrin gcig tu yon con la le bda' dang lis zhon khren bskyar bsko byed dgos pa'i re ba bton/gong ma'i srid gzhung la nyi hong dmag dpung gis skam sa dang rgya mtsho phyogs gnyis nas rgol bar brtsams pa na/ gong ma'i srid gzhung skrag thag chod nas lis zhon khren bskyar bsko byas te mtsho dmag la bkod 'doms byed pa'i dbang cha yongs su sprad/2slo

men gling mcho 'gag dmag 'khrugalis zhon khren gyis yon con gyi shul du lus yod pa'i dmag gru bcu lhag tsam de blangs pa dang / gong mas mtsho dmag gi gnas tshul nyam thag pa de shes nas mtsho rgyud dmag 'khrug gi mtshams bzhag ste/ skam dmag la dpung rogs byas nas skam sa srung dgos pa'i bka' phab kyang / lis zhon khren gyis gong ma'i bka' gyen ldog byas/ khos 'dod par khra'o zhan dmag dpung la mtshon na chu'i gnas tshul dang sa khams/ rgya mtsho'i 'phel 'grib sogs la rgyus mnga' yod pas 'dir brten nas mtsho 'thab byas chog par snyam nas/mtsho thog nas nyi hong gi dmag dpung sngon 'gog byed dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin dang rgyal kha las pham kha med pa'i snyan zhu gong mar phul te dam bcas/ khos snyan zhu'i yi ger zhu don/ sna blon chung nga ma shi bar du/ dgra dmag gis rang phyogs la btsan 'dzul gtan nas byed du mi 'jug mi ces bkod yod/ mi gzhan pas bltas na de ni bya sgong brag la brdabs pa ltar dang nam mkha'i skar ma 'dzin pa las kyang khag pa zhig red/lis zhon khren gyis dmag dpung tshags sgrig byas ma tshar gong nas nyi hong dmag dpung gi 'thab gru 500dang dmag khri gnyis lhag gis chon lo'u to ru dpung 'jug byas/ lis zhon khren gyis rang gi dmag mi rnams la thabs jus bton nas rgyal kha len dgos pa'i skul ma btang zhing / khos dmangs gru kha shas dmag grur brdzus pa dang rang nyid nas dmag gru skor zhig la sne khrid de sdun du gral bstar gcig tu sgrig de'i rjes su dzig nyams ston rogs su dmag gru brdzus ma de dag bshar du bcug pa dang / ma 'gyangs par nyi hong dmag dpung gi nye bar bcar ba ste kho rang sngon ma byas nas dgra bo'i g.yul sar mda' mo char du snyil ba dang 'thab 'khor lhag ma rnams kyis kyaḥ byes

chod na/ /sdom/ga la sne khrid byas yod pa'i 'thab 'khor brgya lhag gis skad cig de nyid la bskor nas thon tshe/ kho'i dmag dpung gis gnas tshul de mthong mur skrag nas spa bkong bar mi gyur thabs med byung yang / dmag dpon gyis skad gseng mthon por bsgrags nas rang dmag la sne khrid de dgra dmag la sngon 'gog byas/dgra dmag khrod du tshon mdog sna lnga'i dar cha dgung la skyod gyin pa'i thog rtseg can gyi gru chen zhig mngon yong la/ de ni 'thab gru gtso bo yin pa rjen par shes thub/ gru gcal du gos chen gyi dug log gyon yod pa'i dmag dpon zhig bsdad yod la/ de ni an ko'u phu'u 'thab 'khrug steng pham kha nyo mkhan gyi dmag dpon le to yin zhing kho pham kha'i snying nad rtsod du 'ong ba red/ 'thab gru gcig la dgra bo'i 'jigs skul thebs pa na/ lis zhon khren brel 'tshub ngang rang dmag la ngar skul bslangs te sngon ma'i dmag rogs la rgyugs pa dang / mda' mo 'phen thengs 'ga' yis dgra dmag mang po bsad cing / dmag dpon le to la yang mda' phog nas chu nang du lhung ste shi song /'thab nas cung tsam 'gor ba na/ lis zhon khren gyis sne khrid nas dmag gru phyir 'then byas/ dmag gru so sos lis zhon khren gyis gsar gtod byas pa'i zhon tsi lcags ril rang rang sa nas 'phang ba na/ dud rdul lang long gis dgra bo'i dmag gru sgrib cing 'gebs srung ru khag yod tshad phyir 'then byas kyang / nyi hong gi dmag grus khra'o zhan mtsho dmag rtsa med du gtong ched rjes 'ded byas/ dud smug dwangs rjes lis hron khyen gyis dmag gru 'ga' khrid de gdong len byas pa dang / dmag gru bde 'jags ngang skyod thub pa phal cher yid tshod yod phyir/ yang bskyar 'thab 'dzing thengs shig byas/ nyi hong gi dpasdu sa'i stobs shugs kyis khra'o zhan dmag gru slar yang phyi snar thengs shig

byas te ja yun tsam la 'khruga'adi ltar phar skyod phyir 'then gyis khra'o zhan dmag grus phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas dgra bo'i gdong bsus pa dang / nyi hong dmag gru bsdoms pas 30lhag rtsa med btang / dmag 'khrug khrod lis hron khren gyi dmag gru men ling mtsho 'gag tu phyi snar byas nas song / hin rdu rgya mtsho chen mo nas thon pa'i mtsho rlabs 'di ru thengs bzhi la 'phel 'grib 'byung gi yod pa dang / mtsho rlabs rgyas pa'i dus su rlabs phreng mkha' la 'phyo zhing stag gi ngar skad lta bu'i sgra zhig mched kyi yod stabs men ling zhes btags pa yin la/ming gzhan la men yung zhes 'bod srol yang yod/ lis hron khren gyis rba rlabs 'grib pa'i dus dang bstun nas men ling la 'byor ba dang / mtsho dmag gis dkyogs shig bskor nas g.yu yi rlabs phreng 'byur ba'i nang du 'dzul nas gar song cha med du gyur/ nyi hong dmag grus de tsho 'tshol ba'i sgang der glo bur du rlabs phreng 'phyur bas kho tsho brel 'tshub ngang phyi snar byas kyang / rlabs 'jags dus dmag gru mang che ba chu 'og tu sbas pa'i lcags thag dang shing gtun bar gyi chu srab sar lhung bas 'gul skyod tsam yang byed mi nus/ da dung chu 'brug lo'i 'thab 'khrug gi 'go langs dus/ lis hron khren gyis sngon chad nas nyi hong dmag gru'i btsan 'dzul pa 'gog ched men ling mtsho 'gag tu lcags thag mang pos dra rgya bzos yod pa dang / phyis su de'i khar lcags thag dang shing gtun mang po bsnan/ skabs der khos bsam bzhin du nyi hong dmag gru sa der khrid nas lcags thag dang shing gtun gyi dra bar 'phangs nas shor mi thub par byas shing / dgra dmag zang zing lang long du bzos te rdza khog nang gi rus sbal bzhin bros sa thar sa med par gyur/dmag gru 300lhag dang mi stong kha shas med par btang bas/ 'di ni lha/rlom

gling rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi lo rgyus steng pham kha las rgyal kha mang pa'i phul byung dper mtshon zhig go/men ling rgyal kha chen mo ni khra'o zhan mtsho dmag bskyar 'dzugs la rgyal kha thob pa'i dus skabs shig ste/ lis hron khren gyi dmag dpung hrag bsdus dang yon con dmag dpung kha 'thor du song ba'i dmag mi phyogs 'dir /sdus te/ mi 'gyangs par dmag mi stong brgyad lhag la rgya bskyed bzhin yod rgyal kha'i dpa' glu len pa/1598lo'i zla 7par/ khren lin(ṣṭha )dang ten tsi lung(༅12)gnyis nas sne khrid mdzad pa'i krung go'i mtsho dmag stong lnga lhag khra'o zhan gyi dmag rogs la 'ong ste lis hron khren gyi mtsho dmag dang zla 'dril byas/ de'i rjesanas khra'o krung gi mtsho dmag mnyam 'brel gyis mtsho thog gi dgra bo pham nyes btang ba dang / rgyal kha'i gtam snyan yang nas yang du grags/hphin khrin zhi'u ci khra'o zhan 'thab 'khrug khrod bstud mar pham pas/sems khur lci mos mnon te ma 'gyangs par tshe las 'das/'thab 'khrug la pham nyes bzos pa'i grib chen de dgra bo'i dmag sgar steng phog pa na/ nyi hong dmag dpung gis 'thab rgyu'i sta gon tsam yang mi byed par ca thin gyis khra'o dmag la gra sgrig med pa'i glags dang bstun nas/shul du lus pa'i dmag dpung khrid de kha rog ger bros song la/ dmag dpon zho zhis kyi dmag mi khra'o krung gi nyen kha'i skor dkyil khrod lhung yod/ khos mtsho lam ded nas song na mnyam 'brel mtsho dmag gi rgol rdung thebs tshul shes nas/ pho nyar dngos po rtsa chen bskur nas lis hron khren la mjal du ma~X te/ khos dmag dpung yod tshad khra'o zhan nas phyir 'then byed rgyu

yin tshul dang der bgrod lam zhig ster dgos pa'i re ba zhus pa na/ lis hron khren gyis gtam nan nyams dzig dang bcas na re mu chu 'brug lo nas bzung / nga'i dmag dpung gis dgra dmag bsad pa bgrangs las 'das shing / dgra lag nas thob pa'i mda' mdung ri bo'i gtos dang 'dra/ khyed tshor thar lam ster rgyu skyid thag chod pa red ’ ces bshad/ zho zhis kyis rang dmag skor dkyil las thar ched/ to cin yis hong(lo kroṣṭha)gi phyogs la mi mngags te rogs skyor yong ba'i re ba zhus/zla 11tshes 17gyi dgong mo/ zho zhis gnas sa hrun then dang bar thag chu bo gcig chod pa'i lho mtsho'i mtsho khul du me 'od skar mda' bzhin 'tshub/ de ni to cin nas dmag rogs slebs zin pa'i dmag brda'o/ tshes 18nyin gyi dgong mo'i skar ma shar ba na/ to cin gyis dmag gru 58khrid de rkang 'jab lag 'jab ngang nye 'dabs kyi lo ling mtsho ngos su dpung 'dzul byas/ lis hron khren gyis dgra bo'i gnas tshul de gzhi nas shes yod la/ khong dang khren linaganyis kyi mtsho dmag gis mtsho ngos nas hrun then la nges par du 'bud dgos pa'i lam mdo snga mo nas srung yod la/ gzhogs gnyis nas dpung 'jug byas te me phyogs dang me mda' mnyam 'phen bgyis shing / nyi hong dmag dpung rgol rdung drag po'i klong du tshud pa dang / thog mar dmag gru re 'ga' me la 'bar te dmag gral 'chol/ lis hron khren gyis me rgol thabs jus gtan 'khel byas te/ mnyam 'brel dmag gru'i steng 'bar rdzas dang rtswa/me rdzas sogs 'bar sla ba'i dngos po mang po zhig drud de/ dgra bo'i dmag gru'i nye bar bcar nas me sbar ba'i rtswa bsdams log bsdams log byas te pha rol ba'i gru thog la 'phangs pa dang / de tshos me rdzas sna tshogs kyi zil shugs 'gog ma nus pas/ mtsho ngos su skar 'od 'tsher ba lta bu'i me lce lam lem du 'bar ba dang / ja yun tsam gyi ring nyi hong gi dmag gru 50lhag /sdu du

brlagalta /cin gyis brel 'tshub ngang nyi hong dmag dpung phyogs gcig tu bsdus te kon yin phu'u ru 'bro bar brtsams pa dang / de'i 'gag phreng mthong ma thag thar lam med pa shes/ rjes phyogs na lis hron khren gyis dmag gru khrid nas mgyogs myur ngang thon gyin 'dug la/ lis hron khren gyi dmag gru mgyogs pas kun gyi sdun la slebs/ to cin gyis dmag gru mang po khrid nas 'bro bar bcoms kyang / khra'o krung dmag dpung gi ngar shugs stag dang 'dra bas ci bya lam la ma song bar nam langs rag bar du shi 'dzing drag tu byed dgos pa byung la/ khra'o krung dmag gis dgra dmag dmar gsod kyi 'khor lo bstud mar bskor/nyi hong gi dmag gru skor zhig nyen tshabs che ba'i g.yul las thar ched/lis hron khren gyi dmag gru ngar shugs kyis bskor nas rgol rdung drag po byas/gnas tshul de khren lin gyis mthong 'phral de myur rgyugs nas skor dkyil sil bur gtor ba na/ drag dmag gis phyir gol byas te kho'i dmag gru bskor ba dang / de nas yang lis hron khren sngon la rgyugs te khong dang dpung bsdongs nas dgra bo'i gdong la bud cing / lis hron khren gyis dgra dmag stong du mda' mo shugs kyis 'phangs pa na/ dgra dmag ag skad dang bcas sa ru sgyel ba dang 'tshub cha chen po bslangs/ dus der bstun nas dmag spyi gnyis skor dkyil las phyir thar te sngar bzhin dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed thub pa zlo dngha nga/ dmag dpung la gyong gud chen po brgyab yod na yang / dmag gru mang po sngar bzhin mchongs 'ong bas g.yul sbyor kyang je drag tu gyur/ teng tsi lung gi dmag grus nyi hong gi 'thab gru mang po'i gdong gcig rjes gnyis maḥ/ / bsus nas dgra dmag mang po cham la phab/ de nas dmag gru'i steng
