mas pā khu lad dang pā ku la chi āng(3(777)sus kyang las 'gan 'di mi nus par 'dod yod pa shes tshor byung / dmangs kyi re 'dod bzlog dka' bas hra lhung gis lo na rgan pa'i kho'u tho'u tso spru la 'phrin yig mi springs thu med du gyur/ khong gis 'phrin yig las 2 khyed kyi dmag dpung khrod kyi bla med mtshan snyan dang khyed kyis mes rgyal la bcangs ba'i dga' zhen/ da dung khyed kyis bsdud mar ngo mtshar byas rjes bzhag pa'i nyams myong sogs kyi dbang gis/ khyed la las 'gan 'di sgrub pa'i yid rton thob pa ni 'os pa zhig yin ’ zhes bkod yod/yang bskyar dmag spyi'i las 'gan khur rjes/ kho'u tho'u tso hphu'i gnas bab ni ha cang dka' tshegs ldan pa zhig ste/ khong gis dmag dpung phyi bsdur byed pa'i lam nas las 'gan blangs pa yin pas/ mu mthud phyi bsdur byed zhor dmag 'khrug la gra sgrig byas/ go skabs bzang bo zhig dang sa gnas legs po zhig tu dgra dang 'thab te dgra bo'i dmag shugs je gnyom du gtong dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod dmag mi'i sems shugs slong thub la dmangs kyi re ltos bskang thub pa yin/ mtha' mjug mo si kho dang spyi le 120tsam yod pa'i pa'o lo te no ru khong gis 'thab ru bsgrigs te dgra dpung bkag phyogs gnyis kyi dmag shugs phal cher 'dra ste/ khri 12tsam yod pa'i u ru su'i dmag dpung gis de las tsung tsam mang ba'i dgra dpung la kha gtad gcog dgos pa yin/pa'o.o te no'i g.yul 'khrug ni mi rnams kyis zu rdzas mdel gsar du byung ba nas da bar gyi ches ya nga ba'i dmar 'dzing thengs shig yin mi zhes bshad pa'i g.yul 'khrug de yin/ me skyogs 1000lhag gi ldir sgra de 'chi bdagagi 'bod brda ji bzhin mtshams med par grags la/ chu tshod 10lhag gi )sdur 'dzing khrod phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi khri 10lhag shi rmas su song ba

red/ god chag chen po byung ba'i hpha ran se'i dmag dpung gis sa rub dus su da gzod u ru su'i 'thab ra bzung yang u ru su'i dmag dpung rtsa gtor gtong ma nus/ kho'u tho'u tso rmus shi rmas kyi tshad de dang mtshungs ba'i dmag dpung gi lhag ma khrid nas phyir 'then byas shing / da dung mjug mtha'i shi 'dzing byed pa'i dus su slebs med pa tshor te dmag stobs gsog 'jog gis mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha len par gra sgrig byas/ u ru su'i dmag dpung rgyal sa mo si kho la phyir 'then bya dus/ mi rnams kyis da ni ches mjug mtha'i rgyal pham thag gcod pa'i mo si kho srung skyob g.yul 'khrug cig rgyag nges pa rtogs shing / dmag mi tshos kyang 6 mo si kho dgra bor sprod pa las rang nyid 'thab 'khrug la shi 'dod ’ pa'i snying stobs kyis khengs/ 'on kyang / kho'u tho'u tso rmus g.yul ma sprad par mo si kho bskyur te phyir 'then bya rgyu'i blo thag bcad/'di'i don du khong gis dmag dpung dang rgyal yongs mi dmangs/ hra lhung bcas kyi mdun du mjug 'bras yod tshad 'khur dgos la/ de'i dbang gis kho la skyon btsugs te dmag dpung la sa phyir 'phud pa'am dmag mi'i sems shugs nyams te zing long gi gnas tshul tshabs chen 'byung yang srid/ yin na'ang / kho'u tho'u tso sprus rang gi bde sdug yal bar dor nas mi dmangs dang dmag mi'i sems shugs la yid rton gyis rang gi thag gcod de 'gyur ba med par srung 'dzin byas/ khong gis mi dmangs la'ang gsal bshad ci yang mi byed par blo thag chod pos tsa ngas mo si kho bskyur don ni nā pho lun theg med du 'gro ba'i ched du yin mi ngas mes rgyal skyob pa'i don du rang nyid kyi yod tshad blos gtong bar gra sgrig byed kyin yod ’ ces bshad cing / ljid tig tig gis 6 da ni phyir 'then byos mizhes dmag dpung la bka' phab/dmag yongs skyo sdang zung 'brel gyi sems khams dang bcas mo si kho nas phyir 'then byas/ kho'u tho'u tso kyus dmag dpung mo si kho'i shastu sna'i

mtshams su bsnur du bcug na yang / nyin gsum gyi rjes su/ glo bur dmag dpung khrid nas gsang stabs kyis nub phyogs su bskyod cing mjug srung dmag mu mthun shar lho'i mtshams su 'gro ru bcug nas dgra bor mgo bskor/khong gis dgra bo'i blor mi shong ba'i dmag jus shig bshams pa ste/ nā pho lun gyi dmag chas mkho sprod byed sa'i bgrod lam bcad/ sngar yod kyi gzan rgyags la chag skyon bzos/ dgra bor dmag chas med par mo si kho stong bar srung nas sdod mi thub pas nam zhig rang 'gul gyis phyir 'gro nges pa de'o//nā pho lun dngos gnas mo si kho nas sdod ma tshugs pa red/ kho'u tho'u tso rmu'i dmag jus la rgyal kha thob song / kho yid 'gul thebs pa/'i ngang cadakon mchog ya/ da nas bzung u ru su nyen kha las thar song ’ zhes gsungs/ zla 10ba'i tshes 19nyin/ nā pho lun gyis dmag dpung lho phyogs kyi smyo 'thab 'khrug gi god chag ma byung pa'i zhing chen mibargyud nas phyir 'then bya rgyu'i sta gon byas/ yin na'ang / kho'u tho'u tso spus sne drangs pa'i dmag mi khri 10yod pa'i dpung chen gyis bgrod lam bkag ste chu tshod 18la g.yul bkyes/mjug mthar/ nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung gis kha phyogs bsgyur te 'thab 'khrug gi chag skyon byung zin pa'i lam rnying las phyir mi 'gro thu med byung / hpha ran se'i dmag dpung gi phyi 'then de brol byol du gyur cing u ru su'i dpung chen gyis tsha 'ded rdung deg byas/ tā si ma'o lin si khu(77sgoṣṭhamo )ru slebs dus/ hpha ran se'i dmag mi khri 10bo las khri 4las lhag med la/ u ru su'i mnga' khongs las phyi 'bud dus dmag mi khri 2las med pa red/nā pho lun gyis u ru su la dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag dpung de phal cher rtsa med du song zhing / kho'u tho'u tso spus 'khrid pa'i u ru su'i dmag dpung 1813lo'i zla 1por rgyal mtshams brgal te yo rab nub mar slebs/hra /zlo ya le hran ta sku phreng dang pos 6 rang gi 'dod blo las ldog ste mi kho'u tho'u

tso rmu la u ru su'i dmag gi ches mtho ba'i bya dga' ste/ rim pa dang po'i cha'o kri rgya gram rtags ma (gemolkotsho/17rsā)gnang / yin na'ang / kho'u tho'u tso rmus rga ba'i khur gyis non dus da gzod kho'i mi tshe gcig gi bya gzhag mjug sgril ba red/ 1813lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 28nyin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod midang skar ma 35steng / kho rang zhi le zhi ya'i (otshopo༅)pun tshi lo'u(lhachoṭha)zhes pa'i grong khyer chung chung de ru nad kyis 'das/ yul de'i mi ser gyis khong la mtho zhing brjid pa'i rjes dran rdo ring zhig bslangs ba'i steng du/6 kho'u tho'u tso rmus sne drangs ba'i 'thab na mi rgyal ba med pa'i u ru su'i dmag dpung yul 'dir slobs cing / gnas 'di ru 'chi bdag gis khong gi rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag mtshams 'jog tu bcug khong gis rang gi mes rgyal nyen kha las bskyabs shing yo rab gling bcings 'grol byed pa'i bshul lam btod//sdogi dpa' bo'i mtshan snyan gtan du mi nub par shog ces bris yod pa 265

dus rabs kyi dmag don pa chen mo nā phyo lun/cina'agong nan/6 gsar brje'i dmag dpon mi1785lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 11nyin/ hrin khu lo'u na gzigs bsher gnang bzhin pa'i hpha ran se'i rgyal bo lo'u ye bcu drug pas (lkoṣṭha/ra)do snang ci yang med par yig cha zhig la ming rtags bkod/ de ni nā pho lun la hro we(kā/〉 skodzesgo )go rtags ster ba'i yig cha zhig ༷yin/ lo'u ye bcu drug pas phal cher nā pho lun de nas bzung srid pho gzhung gi dmag khag la zhugs shing / na lunami tshe gcig gi dmag mi'i 'tsho ba 'go brtsams te dmag mi dkyus ma zhig nas 'dzam gling la grags 'gul slong ba'i mi sna grags chen zhig tu 'gyur nges ba yid la'ang dran med las che/nā pho lun po nā pa (1769— 1821)ni skor dkyil rgya mtsho steng gi khu zhi cwa gling phran(rnya/po lo)nas skyes/ mes po ni dbyi tha li'i sku drag yin la/gling phran de hpha ran se'i khongs su bzhag rjes hpha ran se'i rgyal bos khong gi yadī /6 ran se'i sku drag yin par khas len byas/ 1779lor kho rang yab dang

lhan du pa li ru 'byor zhing sku drag gi thob thang gis dmag don slob grwa 'grim thub pa byung / rjes su pa li dmag dpon slob grwar zhugs na'ang mi ring bar slob byol byas te dmag la zhugs/ skabs de'i rgyun ldan gyi go sa 'phar ba'i go rim ltar na/ hro we(yi/ sa)go thob las med pa'i na gzhon zhig mi lo 8kyi rjes su cang cun (74)gyi go sar slebs mi srid na'ang / gsar brje'i las 'gul gyis kho rang la go skabs bzang bo de sprad pa red/1789lo'i hpha ran se'i 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje chen po langs te/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi po'o hāng (ṣṭha༅)rgyal rabs mgo rting slog cing rgyal bo lo'u ye bcu drug pa( skya/lo)ske gcod stegs bur 'khrid pa dang / rgyal sras sku drag mang po btson mar gyur/ 1793lor gsar brje'i las 'gul 'phel ba'i rtse mor slobs te yā ko pun phyogs khag gis srid dbang bzung na'ang / gnas bab ha cang nyen tshabs che ba ste/ rgyal yongs kyi zhing chen 83las 60tsam gyis 6 zing cha'i dar cha bsgrengs mishing / thu'u lun(47)ni zing cha'i lte bar gyur/ zla brgyad par/ pa'o wang tang (rgyal srung tang cho12)gis dbyin ji dang si phen(po lko)gyi dmag gru'i ru dpung gdan drangs te thu'u lun gru khar slebs pa ma zad/ lo'u ye bcu drug pa'i sku sras (lo ཿla pon yod)pho ran se'i rgyal bo yin pa khyab bsgrags byas/ don dag 'dis hpha ran se'i rgyal khongs la grags 'gul chen po bslangs/ hpha ran se'i rabs dang po'i spyi mthun rgyab khab kyis dmag btang nas thu'u lun bskor ba dang / ched mngag sku tshab mngags te dmag 'khrug la 'go 'dzin byas/ zla 9ba'i tshes 16nyin/ ched mngag sku tshab kyi re 'dun ltar lo na gzhon pa'i nā pho lun phyogs dmag gi bkod 'doms dmag dpung la bskos/yin na'ang / mi rnams kyis kho la sprad pa ni 6 me phyogs bed spyod byed mi shes pa'i miskyogs dmag khag cig yin la/ der ma zad rdzas mdel da16 /ga

gso'i lag cha ci yang med pa red/ de lta na'ang / nā pho lun gyis nyin 'ga'i nang du me smyogs bcu lhag dang der dgos nges kyi rdzas mdel yang gra sgrig byas pa dang / 6 phar rgol byed thub la 'thab 'dzing nus shugs yod pa'i skyogs dmag gi ru dpung zhig ’ sbyong brdar gyis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa red/ bshad pa ltar na/ 6 kho rang nam yang me phyogs dang kha mi 'bral la ngal gso dgos dus su'ang sa ru nyal nas gnyid pa red/ de las kyang nā pho lun gyi phul du byung ba'i dmag don gyi 'jon nus mthong thub ba ni khong gis dmag don tshogs 'di'i steng bton pa'i 6 phyogs dmag gis rgol gtor byed pa dang / rkang dmag skor skyod byed pa/ mtsho thog dang skam sa nas dus mnyam por thu'u lun la phar rgol byed pa'i yang dag gi dmag jus de yin/ dmag jus der dmag spyi 'thad byung zhing /thu'u lun la phar rgol byed pa'i g.yul 'khrug khrod nā pho lun gyis bkod 'doms byas te lag tu bstar ba red/ kho rang dmag mi'i sngon du gdong mchong byas te me sgrogs kyi zil shugs dang phyir mi ldog pa'i phar rgol gyis dgra dmag smyo yongs rdzogs mtsho nang la ded de/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis smyo thu'u lun phyir len pa'i re ba ha cang chung ba'i gnas tshul 'og thu'u lun phyir len thub pa byung / de'i dbang gis/ spyi khyab dmag spyis srid gzhung la phul ba'i snyan zhu'i khrod du lha khyod tshos na gzhon 'di la bya dga' gnang zhing go gnas spar bar mdzod/ rgyu mtshan ni kho la bka' drin ma zhus kyang khong gis rang la brten nas mtho sar 'jog nges red mices bris yod/ zla 12ba'i tshes 22nyin/ rgyal dmangs tshogs pa'i ched mngag sku tshab kyis nā pho lun la krun cang ( stsa)gi go sa byin nas dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung gi phyogs dmag bkod 'doms dmag dpon du bskos/ nā pho lun gyis thog mar rang gi 'ardokā /sa ngom pas mi rnams kyis kho la tsa gsar brje'i dmag dpon zhes

'bod pa red/ na gzhon dmag dpon 'dis thengs gnyis par 'jon nus ngom dus ni lo gnyis kyi rjes yin te/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa pa li'i sa khul phal che ba zing 'khrug dmag gis bzung ba dang / kho tshos tshes 13nyin rgyal dmangs tshogs par tsa mjug mtha'i thag gcod mi bya rgyu'i blo bkod 'then bzhin yod/ nyen 'gag gi skabs su nā pho lun gyis bka' dang len byas shing / rang las ldab bdun brgyad tsam gyis mang ba'i zing 'khrug dmag zas) spro tsā / ༷ /ci/sna byehāskoṅka4༄ —— pa byo mitsho /rdokhrishes/ 4 rtsoX )ri nya7spra/ rshatshoraji 'di thu nga lta—7 chi ri ga/lasa'i nā pho lun /dpung la kha gtad de khong gis pa li'i srang bar nas me skyogs btsugs nas/6 sgrogs mdel gyis hrin o le no gzhung lam steng gi zing slong ba dag mthar skyod byas/mi chu tshod gcig lhag gi 'thab 'khrug brgyud nas rgyal kha chen po blangs pa dang / nyin gnyis par zing 'khrug dmag gi spyi khyab khang gis mgo 'dogs byas/ nā pho lun gyi rgyal khas dmag khongs dang srid phyogs nas rang la snyan grags chen po blangs/ rgyal dmangs tshogs bas kho la bla med // snas

'dud zhus shing kho'i gzhan las 'phags pa'i 'jon nus kyis spyi mthun rgyal khab bskyabs par khas len byas/ nā pho lun la hro cang gi mtshan rtags byin la hpha ran se'i nang srung dmag gi dmag spyi gzhon pa dang dmag spyi'i go gnas snga rjes su bstsal/ yin na'ang / cang cun dang dmag spyi'i go thob kyis da dung nā pho lun gyi 'jon nus yongs su 'don spel bya mi thub pas/ kho rang gi phugs 'dun ni spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dang rgyal bo byed pa de yin/ches mtho ba'i khrid dbang thob pa/ches mtho ba'i srid dbang gi phyogs su skyod pa'i lam du/ nā pho lun gyis dbyi tha li'i g.yul 'khrug dang e ceb (ṣṭha7)la dpung 'jug byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gnyis kyis rang la them skas rim pa gnyis brtsigs pa red/1793lo'i dpyid kur/ hpha ran se'i gsar brje la 'khon du 'dzin pa'i yo rob gling gi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi rgyal khab khag gis hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa btsugs nas dpung 'jug byas/1796lor/ hpha ran ses dmag dpung khag gsum la bgos nas rang 'gul gyis phar rgol byas/ zla3par pho lo 27la son pa'i nā pho lun gnyen sgrig nas nyin gnyis kyi rjes su/ dbyi tha li'i phyogs kyi spyi khyab dmag spyi'i tshul gyis dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ de ni khong gis rang skya 'pher bar dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed pa yin/ 'jar man 'thab ra nas hpha ran se'i dmag dpung khag gnyis la pham nyes tshabs chen byung na'ang / dbyi tha li'i 'thab ra nas nā pho lun la rgyal kha bsdud mar thob/ lo gcig dang phyed ga'i ring /g.yul 'gyed chen mo 14dang dmag 'khrug thengs 70brgyud nas/ o si khru ri ya'i hrag bsdus dmag dpung khag lnga cham la phab cing / dgra dmag khri 151shān bzung byas pa dang me phyogs 1150/ dmag dar 170/ dmag gru che

chung 51bcas 'phrog nas rgyal kha chen po blangs/ 1797lor/ kho rang gis dmag dpung o si khru ri ya'i rgyal sa wi en nā'i nye sar 'byor ba na/ o si khru ri ya'i phyogs nas 'grig mthun byed pa'i re 'dun zhu/ thengs dang po'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa rtsa gtor byas shing / hpha ran ses da dung dbyi tha li'i byang phyogs sa khul bzung / zla 12ba'i tshes5nyin/ nā pho lun dmag dpung dang bcas pa phyir mes rgyal la log par srid gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis/ gna' bo'i ro ma rgyal khab kyis rgyal kha blangs nas log pa'i dmag dpon la bsu ba byed pa'i rnam pa ltar mdzad sgo gzab rgyas bshams nas kho rang la bsu ba byas/ nā pho lun gyi mtshan snyan hpha ran se yongs dang yo rob gling hril bor khyab pa byung /yin na'ang / kho rang de tsam gyis yid mi tshims par tsa ha cang chung ba'i yo rob gling gis nga la yod nges pa'i snyan grags ster mi thub pas/ nga cis kyang shar phyogs su song nas 'tshol rgyu yin/ mi nub pa'i mtshan grags yod tshad shar phyogs nas byung ba red mices bshad/ 1798lor/ nā pho lun gyis bka' ltar e cib la dpung 'jug byas/ ro skam (897)dang nya chen migs pa'i (74)dbang gis 'dzam gling la grags pa'i rgyal khab 'di la dpung skyod byed don ni dbyin ji la rdung deg byed pa'i ched du yin/ zla 5ba'i tshes 18nyin gyi mtshan mor/ skor dkyil rgya mtsho'i steng gi thor rlung gis thu'u lun gru khar nyen zon byed pa'i dbyin ji'i dmag gru thag ring la ded pa'i skabs dang bstun nas/ nā pho lun gyi dmag gru dpung 'jug byed 'go brtsam//ga tag nā pho lun yo rob gling dang rgyang thag ring bor bskyod de/ hpha ran se'i tshon mdog gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyal dar de dbyi si lan gyi chos khang gi yang rtser 'dzugs par gzhol dus/ yo rob gling gi gnas tshul ༵ sapho

'gyur chen po 'byung gin pa ste/ 1798lo'i lo mjug tu/ thengs gnyis pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs kyis phyogs bzhi nas dus mtshungs su hpha ran se la tshur rgol byas/ 1799lor hpha ran se'i lag nas dbyi tha li'i byang phyogs shor zhing le dbyin sa khul du bstud mar dmag pham pas/ hpha ran se kha thor dgu thor du gyur nas gang sar mi bde ba'i 'khrug zing byung ba red/ gnas bab 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/ mi rnams kyis 'das zin pa'i rgyal kha dang thag ring gi nā pho lun dran zhing / khong gis e /ba(70)nas rgyal kha blangs tshul thos rjes kho rang myur du phyir phebs par sgug ༵ sdu/ba'i tshes 9nyin/ nā pho lun gsang stabs kyis dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gi bkag sdom las g.yol te rmu lo cu si(lkoḥṭhalo)nas skam sar bud/nying 'jags kyi grong brdal chung chung de dga' spros myos shing nā pho lun bskor nas 'tshab 'tshub kyis 6 dmag dpon/ khyed kyis myur bar dgra dpung phyir skyod rogs/ gal te khyed rang mos mthun byung na/ nga chos khyed rang rgyal bor bkur nges yin ’ zhes bshad/ srid gzhung gis nā pho lun phyir phebs zin pa bsgrag dus/ gros tshogs kyi tshogs mi (77)yongs rdzogs yar langs nas yun ring bor thel mo deb pa dang gzhung lam steng la phyin nas dga' bsu byas/ tshes 16nyin/ nā pho lun pa li la 'byor dus bsu ba rgya chen po byas pa/ pa li'i tshags par steng du tsa nga tsho mi re res khong la dga' bsu bya/rgyu mtshan ni khong gis nga tsho la re ba gsar ba khyer yong ba'i phyir ’ zhes dang 6 nā pho lun dang 'grogs te 'ong ba ni gzi brjid dang zhi bde/ bde skyid 'ba' zhig yin ’ zhes bkod yod/kha dbugs 'di lta bu'i khrod du/ pa li'i 'byor ldan gral rim dang daswākta ཿpung gis rgyab skyor 'og nā pho lun gyis khrag ma bzhur ba'i srid 'gyur

thengs shig bslangs pa ste/ srid dbang 'dzin pa'i srid gzhung (77khya)gis sngar gyi lta skul byed pa'i srid gzhung ( mkhya)gi tshab byas pa dang / nā pho lun gyis srid skyong dang po'i 'gan 'khur te hpha ran se'i ches mtho ba'i dbang cha bzung / 1804lo'i zla 5bar/ yon la'o yon gyis thag bcad cing dmangs kyis 'dem shog 'phangs te/ tsa hpha ran se'i spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid dbang yod tshad rgyal bo zhig la gtod pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni hpha ran se'i mi yi rgyal bo zhes 'dogs rgyur ’ gros chod byung / zla 12bar/ nā pho lun rgyal bo'i khri la 'dzegs shing rang gis rang nyid ni 6 gla ran se btsan rgyal gyi dmag spyi chen mo thog ma mi yin par bsgrags/ de nas bzung / 6 hpha ran se'i glag rgod ’ de/ hpha ran se'i dmag dpung gis rang gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa'i sne khrid 'og yo rob gling gi nam mkha' hril bo gshog pas gzhal/yo rab gling gi sa gzhi'i steng du bang rtsal ngom pa/lo rgyus smra ba dag gis 6 nā pho lun ni dmag rtar bcibs pa'i rgyal bo ’ yin par bshad la/ khong gis mi rnams la bzhag pa'i ches gsal ba'i snang brnyan ni/ dbu la rmog zur gsum ma gyon zhing de'i 'og gi gzab nan gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i ngo gdong dang grung sha dod cing gting dpog dka' ba'i mig mdangs kyis mi la brjed dka' ba'i tshor snang ster ba dang / tshon mdog rnam par bkra ba'i dmag spyi lu ba'i steng la mdog skya bo can gyi phyu ba dkyus ma zhig gyon te gzugs bongs che ba'i dmag rta dkar por bcibs pa na/ khong gi lus gzugs ha cang thung ba'i zhan cha de'ang sbed par byed pa'o// hpha ran se'i dmag dpung ni khong gi bkod 'doms 'og yo rob gling gi rgyal khab hril bo nas 'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha bstud mar blangs pa red/nā pho lun gyis srid dbang 'dzin dus/ hpha ran se ni tag tag 2〉zlos

gnyis pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pas skor dkyil byed pa'i khrod du lhung yod/ lhag par/ o si khru ri yas nā pho lun gyi nang srid bde la babs med pa dang dmag shugs kyang gnyom par dmigs nas/ o dmag khri 8'khrid nas dbyi tha li ru sdod pa'i hpha dmag khri 3la phar rgol gyis hpha ran se'i mnga' khongs la btsan 'dzul byas/ dbyin ji ba'ang hpha ran se'i nubaphyogs mtsho ngogs nas skam sar bud de hpha ran se'i lho phyogs dang nub phyogs kyi zing 'khrug mi sna dag grogs su bkugs/ dus mtshungs su/ le dbyin la khul gyi o dmag khri 12kyis su'e tser phyogs nas hpha ran se la tshur gol byas te nā pho lun gyi srid dbang la nyen kha chen po bzos/ yin na'ang /nā pho lun gyis shi rgyur sgug nas mi sdod par o dmag gi dmag jus la kha gtad de/ 'thab 'khrug lo rgyus steng gi skad grags che ba'i dmag jus te/6 mā lun ko skor skyod chen po zhes pa lag tu bstar/ 180)mo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 14nyin/ nā pho lun gyis dngos su dmag dpung 'khrid de ā ar phe si ri bo'i btsan 'gag dang po hrin ti po nā ti brgal te glo bur dbyi tha li ru mngon zhing / yang skor dkyil thebs pa'i hpha dmag la rogs byed du mi 'gro bar dgra bo'i gzhug phyogs su skyod de dgra bo'i ldog lam bcad de dmag jus steng nas dgra bo skor dkyil byas/ zla 6ba'i ches 14nyin/ phyogs gnyis kyi gtso shugs dmag dpung gis mā lun ko nas g.yul sprad de o dmag pham nas 'grig mthun byed pa'i re 'dun zhus/ zla 1tsam gyi ring la/ nā pho lun gyis lo gcig ring hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel rgyal khab khag gis dbyi tha li ru blangs ba'i rgyal kha yod tshad shul med bzos nas dbyi tha li phyir blangs shing / thengs gnyis pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs ba theg med du bcom/27byengs gnyis pa'i dbyi tha li'i g.yul 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ dbyin

hpha dmag 'khrug yang bskyar langs/ 1803lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 18nyin/dbyin jis hpha ran se la g.yul 'khrug slong ba'i dmag brda btang / nā pho lun khong khro me ltar 'bar nas hpha ran se'i nub phyogs mtsho ngogs kyi pu'u lun gru kha nas gzhi rgya che ba'i dmag sgar btsugs shing / dbyin ji le mtsho 'gag (rsālhas/77)brgal nas dbyin ji ba dang bzang ngan rting thag chod pa zhig bya rgyu'i grabs shom byas/ khong gis 66rgyu nor dang 'khon sems kyis hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i tshogs pa 'dzugs mkhan gyi gte bor mi gyur ba'i dbyin ji ba rtsa ba nas pham par rgyag 'dod pa red/ yin na'ang / nā pho lun pi le ten(posto/sa)gling phran la ma 'byor gong du/ dbyin jis thengs gsum pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/1805lor o si khru ri ya'i dmag mi khri 20yis gtso shugs byas pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pas dbyi tha li la phar rgol drag po bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byed la/ de nas u ru su'i dmag mi khri 10dang 'dzoms thog hpha ran se'i mnga' khongs su dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i dmag jus 'phen/ tshul der dmigs nas nā pho lun gyis dmag dpung lho phyogs su skyod de u ru su'i dmag dpungadang o dmag ma 'dzoms pa'i yar sngon du o dmag cham la phab rgyu'i dmag jus bkod pa red/ khong gis rang gi 'char gzhi mngon 'gyur byas pa ste/ zla 8par/ dmag mi 176000yod pa'i dpung chen po de sa thag spyi le 600lhagagi pha rol na yod pa'i mtsho ngogs nas nyin 2khril myur skyod kyis le dbyin gtsang 'gram la 'byor zhing / myur stabs kyis u ru su dang o dmag kha bkar te yo'u ar mo'u(677)nas o dmag skor dkyil gyis rtsa med du btang ba red/ der mthud nas khong gis dpung chen drangs te thad kur wi en nā blangs pa red/ o si khru ri ya'i rgyal bo mo'u ar we ya ( po sgro)ru bros byol gyis u ru su'i rgyal bo ya le hran ta sku phreng dang po dang mjal 2)snad

byas/ zla 12ba'i tshes 2nyin ni nā pho lun gyis rgyal srid bzung nas lo gcig 'khor ba'i nyin mo yin/ rgyal bo rnam gsum gyis bkod 'doms byed pa'i dmag dpung o si thu le tshi nas rgyal pham thag gcod pa'i g.yul sprad/ thengs 'di'i zu rgyal bo gsum gyi g.yul 'khrug mi ni nā pho lun gyi dmag 'khrug lo rgyus steng gi ches phul du byung ba'i dmag 'khrug thengs shig yin/ de ni nā pho lun gyis dmag 'khrug gi phyi nyin dmag mi rnams la 6dmag mi tsho/ khyod tshos glag rgod phab pa'i rgyal dar steng du yang bskyar mi nub pa'i gzi brjid gsar ba bsnan byung / chu tshod 4tsam yang ma 'gor bar/ u ru su'i rgyal bo dang o si khru ri ya'i rgyal bos sne drangs ba'i dmag mi khri 10bor rdung deg gis dmag dpung du grub mi thub pa'i tshad du bskyal yod mi ces gsung ba ltar red/ zla 12ba'i tshes 3nyin o si khru ri yas 'grig mthun byed pa'i re 'dun zhus shing /u ru su'i dmag dpung phyir log ste thengs gsum pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa thor ba red/'od stong 'bar ba'i rgyal kha des hpha ran se la zhi bde ster ma thub/1806lo'i zla 9bar/ nā pho lun gyis thengs bzhi ba'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs par gdong gtod dgos byung ba red/ thengs 'dir snyan grags can gyi phu lu'u hri'i (rsā tsho)dmag dpung gis gdong mchong ba'i tshul byas/ nā pho lun gyis phu dmag dang g.yul sprod pa ni o dmag las ldab 'gyur gyis dka' tshegs che nges par dmigs nas/ dmag shugs legs gras bsdu rub byas/ zla 10ba'i zla 'gor/ nā pho lun gyis g.yul sa'i sbyong brdar thob myong pa'i dmag mi khri 20tsa 'dzugs kyis 'jar man gyi mnga' khongs su bsdus/ phu dmag la dmag mi khri 13man las med pa red/ tshes 14nyin/ hpha dmag gis ye nā dang o ar hri tha'e the gnyis nas duswā ltosangs su dmag 'khrug gnyis las rgyal kha blangs shing / dpung chen po

shwa 'od rgyugs pa nang bzhin 'jar man gyi rgyal sa per len (tshesgornyekhri)la slebs/phu lu'u hri'i g.yul 'khrug de zla gcig gi nang la yongs su mjug sgril/ rgyal kha thob pa'i hpha dmag gis der mthun nas u ru su'i dmag mi khri 15yi gdong blangs te/ 1807lo'i pho lan g.yul 'gyed kyi mgo brtsams/ thengs 'di'i g.yul 'gyed ni zla 2ba'i e lo'u(47)dmar 'dzing dang zla 6ba'i rmu le ti le'i(lkotsho tsho/khyod shi nga gson gyi dmag 'khrug gis rting thag bcad pa red/ nā pho lun la rgyal kha bla na med pa thob par bsams na/ rgyal kha'i lha mos (cholko147)nam yang rgyal kha'i mtshan snyan nā pho lun la sprod gnang ba 'dra/ da bar du/ nā pho lun gyi dpung chen des thug tshad ma bcom pa med la 'thab tshad las ma rgyal ba med pas/ mi la las smyo lag na me lce 'phyo zhing mig nas 'od zer 'gyed/ mi rnams kyis 'gran med dpa' bos ral gri shubs nas phyung ba'i sgra thos shing / dpung chen shwa 'od bzhin rgyugs pa dang phyogs dmag rngam zil gyis bshar/ thor rlung khrod ri thang yod tshad skya dmag gi mig pas brdzis/ dus der/ gser khri yod tshad yam yom g.yo la/ rgyal bo yod tshad kyi mtha' mtshams ni sa khra'i steng nas shig shig 'dar byung mi zhes nā pho lun ni dmag 'khrug gi lha zhig gi tshul du bsngags pa red/ nā pho lun gyis yo rob gling gi chab srid kyi sa khra bskyar du bgos la/ pi li hri (dzes/ga )dang phus min thi/(ṣṭha06) ri nā ya (776༅)'dus pa'i hpha ran se btsan rgyal btsugs pa ma zad/ da dung zur du dbyi tha li'i rgyal bo dang / le dbyin rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyi srung skyob pa/ su'e tser gyi 'dum gcod pa bcas byas la/ kho'i spun mched rnams so sor nā pi le si (smosapo mo)dang ho lan/we si thi hpha le ya (7777 tsho༅)bcas kyi rgyal bo mdzad/ phu lu'u hri ni kho'i dpung gis bzung ba'i rgyal khab dang / o si khru ri ya ni dmag phashā sna'i

rgyal khab/ u ru su ni kho'i mna' 'brel grogs po/ dbyin ji ba yo rob gling nas mthar skyod byas pa sogs nā pho lun gyi zil shugs dar pa'i rtse mor slebs/de lta na'ang / dbang shugs ni bsngags chog pa zhig yin yang / dar ba'i rtse mor son dus zhar du 'chi ba'i rmang gzhi'ang mi mngon par btings zin pa yin/u ru su'i thang chen nas dmag pham pa/nā pho lun gyi btsan rgyal chen pos mi rigs mang po dbang du bsdus shing rgyalakhab dang sa khul mang po'i las dbang kha lo bsgyur bzhin yod/ dpal 'byor gyi steng nas dbyin ji pham par bya ched/ kho rang gis yo rob gling hril bor btsan shed kyis skam sa'i bkag sdom ma lag 'dzugs su bcug bya las 'di dag gi dbang gis/ kho rang yo rob gling gi mi'i mig nang gi tsher ma lta bu'i dbang sgyur par gyur ba red/ 1808lor si phen mi dmangs kyis 'os langs byas la/ 1809lor dbyin ji dang o si khru ri yas thengs lnga ba'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ nā pho lun gyis yang bskyar mna' 'brel tshogs pa de cham la phab cing / o si khru ri yas mi lo 18la son ma thag pa'i sras mo lo'u ye tra(rmi 77)kho rang gi bag mar brdzangs dgos pa bzos na'ang / chab srid kyi gnyen 'brel des nges don gyi grogs po sgrig mi thub pa yin/ 1811lor/ sger phan gyis blo mig sgrib pa'i nā pho lun gyis nan tan gyis u ru su la dmag 'khrug byed par gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang / dmag 'khrug des kho rang theg med du 'gro ba'i lam du 'khrid pa red/1812lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 24nyin/ nā pho lun gyis dmag mi khri 60yod paX )sbyang chen la kha lo bsgyur te u ru su'i thang chen la dpung 'jug byas/

kho rang gi dmag dpung gi grangs 'bor ni phal cher u ru su'i dmag dpung gi ldab gsum gyis mang bas/ nā pho lun gyi dmag jus 'char gzhi ni myur 'thab myur rgyal te/ thengs gcig gnyis kyis rgyal pham rting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug brgyud nas u ru su la mgo 'dogs su 'jug pa de'o// de bas/dmag mis nyin bzhi la 'dang ba'i lam rgyags las bzung med la shing rtas nyin 20la 'dang ba'i gro phye las drud med pa yin/ kho rang gis gza' 'khor gsum gyi nang tshud du dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rgyu'i sngon dpog byas/sngar med stobs ldan gyi dgra bo'i dpung chen la kha gtad de/ hra lhung dang kho'i dmag dpon rnams kyi bsam 'char gcig mthun ma byung / lang tshos dregs pa'i hra rwang gis dgra bo rgyal mtshams nas 'gog par 'dod kyang nus pa med par gyur la/ dmag dpon mang pos rang gi stobs shugs gnyom pa tshor nas bsdud mar pham rjes dpa' zhum ste/ dgra bor thad kur g.yul mi sprod par phyir bsdur gyis stobs shugs gsog 'jog byas te go skabs btsal nas phar rgol bya rgyu'i 'dod blo bcangs/ mjug mthar hra lhung gis g.yul sa brtan srung gis thad kur dgra bor g.yul sprod pa'i dmag jus bkod kyang /dngos don gyi dmag 'khrug steng u ru su'i dmag dpung phyir 'then tshad med bya dgos byung / tshul des de las ldog ste nā pho lun gyi 'char gzhi gtor zhing hpha dam/ gi stobs shugs ni dgra bo tsha 'ded byed pa'i khrod du gyong gud du gyur ba zla /pa/'i tshes 26nyin/ nā pho lun gyi dpung chen we ar nyig si( po7lo)la myur skyod byas te u ru su'i gtso shugs dmag dpung kha bkar nas skor dkyil gyis cham la phab rtsis byas kyang / u dmag sngar nas ti le sā( ༅ṭha)'thab rar phyir 'then byas zin la/ dmag khag gzhan pa dang mnyam 'dzomasakhyed du song pa red/ zla 7pa'i ches 3nyin/ nā pho lun gyis 2)sbyang

chen btang nas we the pi si khi( lkolkolkom)ru bskyod cing u dmag ma 'dzoms gong du sdun 'gog rtsis byas/ 'on kyang / u ru su'i dmag khag gnyis sngar nas mnyam 'dzoms byung zin pa red/ zla 8pa'i tshes 16nas tshes 18bar du/ hpha u dmag dpung gnyis si mo lin si khi'i(loṣṭhaṣṭhaspom)mkhar 'dabs su g.yul sprad kyang nā pho lun gyis dgra bor bskor rdung byed ma thub/ tshes 18nyin gyi mtshan mor/ u dmag yang bskyar phyir 'then byas/de bas/ u ru su'i mtha' med pa'i thang stong du nā pho lun gyis phyi 'then byed kyi/ pa'i u dmag gi rjes 'ded btang nas mo si kho'i lcags ri'i 'dabs su 'a ra/'thab ra ring drags pa dang dmag mi kha thor tu gyur ba/ dmag rgyags zad pa'i dbang gis/ dmag mi je nyung du phyin nas khri 13 5las lhag med pa red/ dmag mi'i gnas bab ha cang ya nga ba'i gnas su gyar ba ste/ lus po skam rin du gyur ba'i dmag mi rnams 'chi gson gyi mtha' mtshams nas 'phag 'tshag byed cing / dmag rgyags dkon pas sgrig lam 'dzin dka' la bros byol byed pa'i dmag mi je mang du gyur/ yin na'ang / kho tshos yid ches nyagagacig la rgyab rten bcol yod de/ mo si kho tshur blangs tshe hra 'ong gis 'grig thabs bya nges pas yod tshad je bzang la 'gro nges ba de'o// nā pho lun gyis kyang mo si kho thob rjes yod tshad mjug rdzogs nges par sems/ zla 9ba'i tshes 7nyin/ nā pho lun gyis yun ring snyeg pa'i 'thab 'khrug de mo si kho dang spyi le 120las med pa'i pa'o lo te no (777glo)nas brgyab pa red/phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi khri 26dang me phyogs 1200tsam g.yul 'khrug la zhugs/ ston ku'i nyi zer sa gzhir phog dus/ nā pho lun dga' spro'i ngang 66de ring gi nyi ma yang o si thu le tshi'i( lo tshoṣṭha)nyi ma zhig yin nges mi zhes ba/tā0/ zhogs pa'i chu tshod drug gi steng du phyogs gnyis kyi me phyogs kha grags

byung / skya dmag rnams kyis nga ro sgrog bzhin yang yang gdong mchong gis 'thab ra 'phrog res byed/ g.yul 'khrug mjug sgril dus/ phyogs gnyis la shi rmas tshabs chen byung 'dug pa ste/ u dmag gi dmag dpon 22dang dmag mi khri 5gron pa dang / hpha dmag gi dmag dpon 47dang dmag mi khri 3lhag gron pa red/ sa rub dus/ u dmag me skyogs kyi 'geb srung khrod dal bur phyir 'then byas/ mi rnams kyis 6 dus rabs 19ba'i ches ya nga ba'i dmar 'dzing ’ du bshad pa'i 'thab 'khrug mjug rdzogs byung / nā pho lun gyis shi rmas tshabs chen gyis rgyal kha thob pa byas na'ang u dmag gi gtso shugs rtsa gtor bya rgyu'i dmigs yul ma 'grub pa red/ der mthud nas/ kho'i dmag dpung gis nyi zer lus la gyon zhing sa rdul rdog pas mnan te re ba chen pos mo si kho'i phyogs su dpung skyod byas/zla 9ba'i tshes 14nyin/ nā pho lun gyis mo si kho tshur blangs/ yin yang kho'i re ba'ang de dang mnyam du wu ba bzhin yal ba ste/ u ru su'i mi yis kho la bzhag pa ni phal cher grong khyer stong ba zhig yin/ tshes 15yi mtshan mor/ mo si kho'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas me dpung 'bar zhing mo si kho ni me yi rgya mtsho lta bur gyur/ me dpung de nyin lnga drug gi rjes su da gzod bcil pa red/ mo si kho grong khyer ni ming tsam du zad la u ru sus kho la mgo 'bul ye nas ma byas/ de las ldog ste mkhar stong zhig srung nas sdod pa'i nā pho lun gyis thengs du mar rang 'gul gyis u ru su'i phyogs la 6 ches rgya che zhing ches sgam dkyel che ba/ ches gzi brjid ldan pa/ ches dgra bos mi tshugs pa'i mthun 'brel zhig 'jog 'dod tshul bshad kyang / hra rwang gis kha ya tsam yang ma byas pa red/ zla 9ba'i mi sems bzi bar byed cing bkrag mdangs 'tsher ba'i nyi 'od phar 'das zin/ zla 10ba'i tshes 13nyin/ kha ba thengs dang po babs te mi rnams la 'khyag grang gi dgun kha slobs nye ba'i sngonā /rda

brgyab/ nā pho lun gyi dmag dpung ni dbyar lu las med pa dang dmag rgyags zad pa'i dbang gis mo si kho nas sdod ma tshugs par zla 10ba'i tshes 19nyin phyir 'then bya dgos byung / nā pho lun gyis yid la'ang ma dran pa zhig ni/phyir 'then thengs de ni god chag chen po zhig yin pa de red/zla 11pa'i zla stod du/ snying rtse med pa'i dgun kha'i bu yug gis ru dpung 'di'i srog la rgol zhing mtha' med pa'i gangs klong du dmag sgrig thor te dmag sgar re re bzhin shul med du gyur/ dmag mi rnams mi du ma shog sgrig gis 'bud shing bza' bca' 'phrog bcom byed pa'i las la zhugs/ kho tsho'i mig mdun gyi las bya gtso bo ni rang byung khams dang 'thab rtsod khrod tshe srog rgyun bsrings rgyu de yin/ u dmag gis kha thor dgu thor du gyur pa'i dmag dpung 'di la tsha 'ded deg rdung byas/ zla 12ba'i zla dkyil du dmag /pung u ru su'i thang chen nas 'bud dus dmag mi khri 2 7las lhag med pa da/ da ni sngar yo rab gling hril bor khong 'dar slong pa'i dmag dpung chen po de shul med du gyur la/ der bkod 'doms byed mkhan gyi dmag spyi'i tshe srog kyang dus ga tsam la rgyun bsrings thub bam/dmag don pa chen mo'i skyo gar/u ru su'i thang chen nas dmag pham pa'i god chag rang bzhin gyi mjug 'bras de ma thag phyir mngon pa red/ de ni 6 nub phyogs pas yongs khyab kyis 'os langs byas te hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i brda 'phrin milta bur gyur/1813lor/ thengs drug pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa grub/ nā pho lun gyis dmag mi gsar ba bsdu len byas te 'tshab 'a/sdu 2kyis dmag mi khri 30tsa 'dzugs byas/ zla 10bar/ hpha dmag khri

15dang mnyam 'brel dmag dpung khri 23le pe zhi (lkoms)nas g.yul sprad/nyin dang por hpha dmag khri 3shi rmas su song ba dang mnyam 'brel dmag dpung khri 4shi rmas su song / hpha dmag 15000kha snon byas la mnyam 'brel dmag dpung khri 11kha snon byas/ nyin gnyis par hpha dmag gis rang las ldab 3tsam gyis mang ba'i dgra bo'i kha gtad ma chog par phyi bsnur bya dgos byung la/ phyi bsnar de yang bskyar god chag cig tu gyur/ 1814lor/ 'thab 'khrug hpha ran se'i mnga' khongs su brgyab/ nā pho lun seng ge zhig dang 'dra bar dgra dang 'thab na'ang pham ste phyir 'then byas/ mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis nā pho lun tsha 'ded ma byas par thad gar rgyal sa pa li la dpung drangs pa red/zla 3pa'i tshes 30nyin/ hpha dmag 12000gis dgra bo 'gog ma thub par mgo btags pa dang / zla 4ba'i tshes 3nyin/ hpha ran se'i gros tshogs gnyis nas mnyam 'brel gyis nā pho lun srid khri las phab zin pa khyab bsgrag byas/ tshes 6nyin nā pho lun gyis kyang de la yid 'thad bya dgos byung / 'grig mthun chings yig ltar na/ nā pho lun dang kho rang gi khyim rgyud kyis tsa hpha ran se btsan rgyal dang dbyi tha li sogs rgyal khab kyi dbang sgyur blos gtong dgos mi la/ kho rang gis rgyal po'i mtshan bzung chog kyang nges par skor dkyil rgya mtsho'i steng gi u ar pā gling phran du gta sdod bya dgos pa yin/ don ngo mar/kho rang la rgyal po'i mtshan btags yod kyang btson ma yin pa red/1815lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 1nyin/ nā pho lun gyis ches mjug mtha'i ngo mtshar ba'i lag rjes bzhag pa ste/ mtshon cha med pa'i rjes 'brang nyung ngu 'khrid nas gling phran las bros byol gyis hpha ran se'i lho phyogs nas skam sar bud/ mtsho ngogs dang nye dus/ kho rang gis ha cang yid tshod yod pa'i sgo nas sna ngas me mda' gcig kyang ma brgyab par pa li la 'byor thub ces bshad myong / dngos gnas nyin 20yi rjes su khong gis mtshon cha ci sturdo ma

bkol bar pa li la 'byor zhing / yang bskyar hpha ran se'i rgyal khrir bsdad/yin na'ang / ngo mtshar pa'i lag rjes 'di ni khong gi skyo gar khrod kyi 'od zer ldog 'phro byas pa'i 'khrab tshan ches rjes ma yin/ nā pho lun pa li la 'byor ba dang dus mtshungs su/ thengs bdun pa'i hpha ran se la ngo rgol byed pa'i mna' 'brel tshogs pa rtsa 'dzugs byas/ phal cher dmag mi khri 80yod pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis hpha ran se'i mtha' mtshams mnan/ nā pho lun gyis dmag mi khri 12bsdu rub byas te rang 'gul gyis dgra bo'i gdong bsus/ zla 6pa'i tshes 18nyin gyi hwa the lo'u g.yul 'khrug ni nā pho lun gyi las dbang thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug cig yin/ de yang bye brag gi 'char gzhi dang dmag jus steng nas bshad na phyogs gnyis kur mi 'dang sa yod kyang / nā pho lun gyi pham nyes ni 6 'char gzhi rang steng ngam de lag len khrod kyi zhan cha'i rkyen min par chab srid dang thabs jus kyi dbang gis yin/ de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dmag stobs che thag chod yin pa dang / cig shos ni dus rabs kyi 174gi nang du dmag 'khrug gis stobs shugs zad pa'i rgyal khab cig yin zhing / des sngar nas rang skya thub par mtshon cha thogs pa'i 'dzam gling hril bo'i tshur rgol 'gog dka' ba yin/’ zla6pa'i tshes 22nyin/ nā pho lun thengs gnyis bar srid khri las 'bab dgos byung /dmag don pa chen mo 'di'i chab srid gyi tshe srog dang dmag 'khrug gi 'tsho ba'i lo rgyus 'di nas mjug rdzogs pa red/1815lo'i zla7pa'i tshes 15nyin/ nā pho lun mnyam 'brel dmag gi bzung dmag gi tshul gyis dbyin ji'i 5po los le blun (4khri spyo0)zhes pa'i dmagagrur bsdad nas yo rob gling dang kha gyes te/ spyi le stong phrag du mas chod pa'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i kher rkyang gi gling phran zhig gi steng du ma~X /gas byas/ mi lo drug gi rjes kyi zla8ba'i nyin zhig la/ 6 rgya mtsho'i

'thor rlung gling phran du g.yug cing shing sdong chen po dag kyang rtsa ba nas 'gog dus/mi yun ring nad kyis mnar ba'i nā pho lun gyi 6 blo rig rim gyis bzi sbrid kyi rnam par gyur zhing de ltar chu tshod 'gar bsdad pa dang / 'thor rlung 'jags te 'od snang 'bar ba'i nyi 'od gling phran chung chung der 'phros shing dal bur rgya mtshor nub rjes/ rlabs chen gyi mi sna 'di 'jig rten dang gtan bral byas pa red/mi ma gshegs pa'i sngon du/ khong gis skyo shas chen pos 6 ngas rang gi bu la ba'i ming yig tsam las ci yang 'jog ma thub ’ ces gsung myong yang /khong ni dus rabs kyi dmag don pa chen mo yin pa'i cha nas/ mi rabs phyi mar shul dngos phun sum tshogs pa bzhag yod pa yin/ mi tshe hril por khong gis g.yul 'khrug thengs 60la bkod 'doms byas myong / gshib bsdur byas tshe/ lo rgyus steng gi snyan grags 'bar ba'i dmag spyi ya li hran ta dang tan nyi po(tshokhuṣṭha)/ khe sā(mo )bcas kyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i dmag 'khrug gi sdom grangs las kyang mang ba red/ dus rabs kyi 174gi nang yo rob gling gi rgya che ba'i 'khrab stegs steng du/ khong gis gson nyams ldan zhing rngam brjid 'bar ba'i zlos gar mang por 'khrab khrid byas/ nā pho lun gyis dngos don gyi 'thab 'khrug brgyud nas dmag 'thab dang dmag don tshan rig gya nom par btang la/ dmag don dang dmag 'thab lo rgyus steng du khyad par ba'i go sa bzung yod pa'i /nā pho lun gyi dus rabs mi gsar gtod byas/khong gis gsar brje chen po'i dus skabs kyi dmag jus rgyud 'dzin byas te/'gul skyod dmag 'khrug rgyag mkhas pa ma zad/ da dung 'thab dus myur zhing brtan la dmag dpung hrag bsdus kyis gzhi rgya che ba'i g.yul sprad de dgra bo'i stobs shugs med med du gtong mkhas pa yin/nā pho lun gyi dmag don gyi grub 'bras ni mi rnams ha las ba'i shātā du

slebs pa dang / tha na rlabs chen gyi mi sna zhig gis tsa rta phor bcibs pa'i 'dzam gling gi bla srog :ces bsngags na'ang / kho rang gis rgyun ma chad par dpung 'jug byas te 'dzam gling dbang du bsdu rtsis byed dus/ 'dzam gling hril bos brtse ba med par kho rang rta'i gong nas phab pa red/ 'di ni dus rabs kyi dmag don pa chen mo'i skyo gar gyis mi rabs phyi mar bzhag pa'i nyen brda yin yang srid/

dbyi tha'a'i dpa'aca ngo mtshar can cwale'o te/(102 ṣṭha7)rinarkanganan/dbyi tha li ni 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rig gnas yod pa'i rgyal khab cig yin/ dbyi tha li'i lo rgyus kyi bzhur rgyun ring mo'i khrod du snyan grags 'dzam gling la khyab pa'i rlabs chen mi sna dang rshaXrsha ༵ snang po byung myong zhing / kru'u sa'e phe nā le po te ni de'i gras kyi thog mar char rlung brgyud pa/1807lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 4nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod 6gi steng du/ rgya mtsho'irlabs sgra dang 'grogs nas khye'u zhig gi ngu skad thog ma 'jig rten du grags/ tsā le po te dbyi tha li'i nyi si grong( cas/777)gi kha rgya mtshor 'khor ba'i khang mig cig tu skyes/ kho'i yab ni rgyal spyi'i mtsho ngogs kyi dngos zong brje res byed pa'i gru gzings shig gi gru dpon yin yang / kho rang rgya mtsho'i steng gi 'grul skyod kyi 'tsho bar yid tshims kyi med/ kho rang gis rang gi gces su 'os pa'i bu chung cwa le po te yis rjes su khrims lugs kyi bya las gnyer ba'am sman pa zhig byed par re ltos byed bzhin yod pa dang / yang minan chos las bya rgyu de red/ de'i dbang gis cwa le po te yi blo 'byed dge rgan gnyis ku'ang ye shu'i chos 'chad mkhan yin/ de lta na'ang / tsā le po te la mtshon na dpe deb las rgya mtshor bslu brid ldan che ba ste/ khos bsha༄ gyur/

6 nga ni phal cher lhan skyes kyi skam chu gnyis 'tsho sku ri zhig yin pa 'dra/ nga'i rkyal rtsal ni phul du byung ba zhig yin/ tshul 'di nga shes pa'i mi yod do cog gis shes pa yin mi zer/ der ma zad mi yod tshad kyis 6 nam yang grabs shom gyis chur mchong ste mi skyob par byed pa'i kho lta bu'i byis pa zhig btsal rgyu ni las sla bo zhig min mi par 'dod pa red/mo sgyu 3 tsā nga tsho 4sa/ ji stobarngo/ tsho ca〉 rte sde rangagyiṭa — /cwa le po te/gru dpon bgres pos gzhi nas lam gzur dgos byung ste/ bu chung yang /)tre༈ //lnga/ ///lha /rdorje/ 1ཿ///rdo tho rwa/(( ba na ma 'grul bya gzhag la ga la du bcug 16la na dus/ cwa le po te la mi lo gsum gyi mtsho 'grul gyi myong brgyud yod pa red/ kho rang skor dkyil rgya mtsho dang mtsho nag(tsho )gi lang long 'phyo ba'i rlabs rtse nas bskyod par spro la/ mtsho 'grul 'tsho ba'i dka' tshegs dang nyen kha/ tha na mtsho jag dang 'thab pa'i go rim khrod du kho la sbyong brdar thob/ kho'i bag yangs ba'i gshis ka dang bden pa'i rgyab rtsar langs te gzhan la rogs byed 288

pa'i ngar shugs/ chag sgo'i mdun du gzab cing brling ba/ nam yang yid ches kyis khengs pa/ dngangs 'jigs med pa'i spobs pa sogs yod tshad mtsho 'grul 'tsho ba las thob pa red/ gsar bu 'dis rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i lam bu rnyed zin pa 'dra/pho lo 26la son pa'i lo der/ cwa le po te sngar nas rim pa gnyis pa'i gru dpon gyi go sar slebs yod/ dus der/ kho'i 'tsho ba'i lam bu la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ba ste/ 1833lo'i zla3ba'i nyin zhig la/ kho'i gru gzings steng du hpha ran se'i mā se gru kha(zarngo )nas mthar sprugs byas pa'i hrin zhi min rang lugs pa(cham/ka11)skor zhig bud pa red/ mtsho skyod kyi brgyud rim hril bo'i khrod du cwa le po te dang kho tsho'i 'go gtso gnyis lab gleng byed misnyi/ bzhin bskyod/ 'go gtso des kho la 6 mi'i cho rigs kyi gnad don chen po ribashad pas kho sku ci rang ya mtshan par gyur/ khong gis rim bzhin 'jig rten 'di'i bya las la la zhig she dngos gzhan mtsho 'grul las kyang gal che trī 〉tshul la shes rtogs byung / tag tag lo der/ — khong gis u ru su'i thā kun lo ku (sgomi//39 tshe )gru kha nas 6 na gzhon dbyi tha li tang ’/(stongaminatsho(15lko132)gi tshogs mi zhig gis zi ga ci gtam bshad la nyan zhing / des bshad 'irwa tshon /pa'i ra dbyi tha li phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul pa'i 1833lor ca le po tes ma se dang mā kri nye lag nas bskyabs te gcig gyur dang rang gnyis la zlog 'phrad thog mar gnang ba/ dbang / rang btsan gyi dbyi tha li spyi mthun 289

rgyalakhab 'dzugs dgos mizhes pa'i skad cha des kho la yid 'gul chen po thebs te/ gtam bshad spel mkhan gyi mi cha med der 'tham pa red/ zhin de nas bzung / kho rang gsang ba'i sgo nas 6 na gzhon dbyi tha li tang minang du zhugs shing lus sems yod tshad mes rgyal skyob pa'i bya gzhag la phul ba red/yin na'ang / khong gis 66gdung sems che ba'i pham kha brgyud 'thab 'dzing mi tshe 'go brtsams pa yin/’ lo de'i zla 12bar/ 66na gzhon dbyi tha li'i migasar gtod mkhan mā kri nye(zaṣṭha༅)yi 'char gzhi ltar cwa le po te dang lag rogs tsho rgyal khab kyi mtsho dmag khrod du lkog 'dzul byas te/ 'os langs thengs shig la rtsa 'dzugs byed par gra sgrig byas/ kho tshos 6 rtul phod kyi bya 'gul 'di'i me stag gis yā phing nying gling phran phyed ma(༅sga'icha42lo)hril bo'i gsar brje'i me dpung sbar ’ bar 'dod pa red/ yin yang / kho tshos gnas bab la nor 'khrul gyi tshod dpag byas pas/ cung dgod bro ba'i 'dod 'dun de de ma thag lha lhad med byis blo dang myul mas lkog btsong mi gi dbang gis pham pa red/ cwa le po te stabs legs nas bros shor na'ang kho'i ming yig 6 thengs dang por tshags par la bkod micing / kho rang srog chad bcad pa'i 6 zingare 'khrug la zhugs mkhan gte bo'i mi tshul du 'dzin bzung brda yig bkram zlo ra/ /yo rob gling gi skam sa nas sdod ma tshugs par 1834lo'i zla8par/ ming brje nas chu ba byas te pa zhi (༅po)la bskyod pa'i gru gzings shig la bud/ rgya mtsho chen po brgyud nas kho rang gnam sa gsar ba zhig la 'byor zhing de ru mu mthud du 'thab 'dzing gi rgyun bsrings/me gling lho mar 'thab 'dzing la zhugs pa/2ma/ le po te me gling lho mar 'khyam skyod kyis slebs dus/ pa zhi btsan

rgyal gyi ches lho sne yi nan le yo ku la'ang ti khul(tshe477777)du 'os langs byung ste spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs ched 'thab 'khrug rgyag pa'i sgang yin/ mi lo gcig gi dza drag dang kyag kyog gi dmag 'khrug brgyud rjes spyi mthun tang mi pham zhing 'os langs dmag gi 'go gtso rnams 'dzin bzung byas/ yin yang 'os langs byed mkhan dag gis mgo ma btags pa ma zad/da dung 1836lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin le o ku lan ti(tshom ༅7)spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags byas/ nyam chung gi spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dis dbyi tha li'i btsan byol ba dag gi sems su re ba'i me son bstsal/mā kri nyi yi smyo gnam 'og gcig 'dra'i mi rtsa don ltar/ rgyal khab gzhan gyi mis rgyal bo gdug rtsub can la ngo rgol byed par rogs ram byed pa ni rang gi rlabs chen gyi bya gzhag gnyer ba dang khyad med pas/ cwa le po te bya gzhag der zhugs pa red/dus der/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis skam sa nas dgra bo'i 'thab ya mi 'ongs bas dmag 'khrug mtsho thog la rgya skyed pa red/ cwa le po tes bka' ltarasbyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag gru'i ru dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas te/ mtsho thog nas pa zhi btsan rgyal dang dmag 'khrug brgyab/ khong gis dngos don gyi 'thab 'khrug khrod nas dmag 'khrug gi nyams myong bslab 'go brtsams/ mi lo gsum gyi dka' tshegs kyi dmag 'thab khrod du/ khong gis dmyal khams nas thar ba lta bu'i gnas bab ya nga ba brgyud myong la/ rgyal kha bla na med pa'ang blangs myong / 1839lo'i zla 7ba'i tshes 22nyin/ dmag dpung dang mnyam 'brel sgos grong khyer la phar rgol byed pa'i ched du/ cwa le po tes spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag gru gcig po ste tsa sa'e wa ar rtags can la bkod 'doms kyis dgra bo'i dmag gru drug la kha gtad bcag pa red/ dgra bos me phyogs kyis 6 sa'i wa ar mi rtags can la rgol dus/ khong gis spyi mthu// /la

khab kyi mtsho dmag drangs te dgra bo'i gdong du mchongs nas me phyogs gcig pus dgra bo 'tshab 'tshub tu btang / dgra bos gnas tshul gsal bor shes te dmag gru gnyis tsa sa'i wa ar rtags can la gzas nas rub yong dus/kho'i dmag gru myur du ha cang dog pa'i mis bzos gtsang por phyin pa red/gtsang bo'i ngogs kyi nags klong du rgya che ba'i gab dmag yod pas/ dgra bo'i dmag gru gnyis rjes 'ded kyis gtsang gzhung la 'byor dus phyogs gnyis nas me mda' drag po 'phangs te/ dgra bos gru bskyur nas rang mgo gang thon du 'bro dgos byung / dus der/ 6 sa'i wa ar ’ rtags can bskor skyod kyis dgra bo'i dmag gru gzhan la rgol du phyin/ gsar du tshur blangs ba'i dmag gru gnyis kyi 'gebs srung 'og cwa le po tes yang bskyar dgra bo'i dmag gru gnyis la 'go 'dogs su bcug de ltar chu tshod 'ga'i nang du/ pa zhi'i dmag gru'i ru khag phal cher theg med du btang / dgra bo'i dmag gru gcig kho na bros nas shor ba red/yid phangs pa zhig la/ le o ku lan ti spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag stobs zhan drags pa'i dbang gis cwa le po te'i dmag don gyi 'jon nus yongs su ngom skal ma byung ba red/ 1843lor/ kho rang wu ra ku'i(67cho)yi shar ngogs kyi spyi mthun rgyal khab srung skyob byed pa'i 'thab 'dzing la zhugs/dus der/ wu ra ku'e yi shar ngogs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa min ti we ti yu( cho ༅༅)ni a ken thin(ma lo)gyi dmag dpung gis bskor te bya byi'u yin yang 'phur dka' ba'i tshad du 'dug grong khyer nang du sdod mi khri 4lhag yod la de'i nang gi 374ni gtan sdod phyi mi yin/ spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa srung skyob byed pa'i ched du/ rgyal khab re re'i gtan sdod phyi mis rang rang gi dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ cwa le po te yis spyi mthun rgyal kha~X stalha mtsho dmag gi hrang zho yi las 'gan 'khur te dmag gru'i ru dpung sgrig

btsugs byas pa ma zad/ zhor du dbyi tha li'i mtsho dmag khag gi bkod 'doms dmag dpon byas/ dmag khag 'di'i ru dar gyi kha dog nag po yin la steng du we so we me ri 'phyur ba'i snang brnyan gtsag drub byas yod/ lha des 'thab mo ba rnams kyi mes rgyal gyi chag 'jig la bcangs ba'i gdung sems dang dpa' bo'i sems khong gi rang dbang gi ched du 'bar ba'i me lce mtshon pa yin/’ dmag mis lus la dmag lu dmar po gyon yod pa dang / cwa le po te yang dmag mi rnams dang 'dra bar stod lwa dmar po bsnabs shing ske la bkrag mdangs bkra ba'i ske dkris brgyab/ ko ba'i skag bcing du ral gri btags la bya sgro btsugs pa'i phying zhwa mgo la gyon yod/ dbyi tha li'i dmag khag ni khong gi bkod 'doms 'og min ti we ti yā srung skyob byed pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod du gzhan las 'phags pa'i byas rjes bzhag lhag par/ 1845lo'i zla8par/cwa le po tes dmag gru'i ru dpung dang dmag dpung yongs rdzogs 'khrid cing dbyin ji dang hpha ran se'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dang bsdongs nas rgyang ring la dpung 'jug thengs shig byas/ rgyang skyod dmag dpung gis lā phu lā tha satsang bo(khri khri ma)brgyud de btsan rdzong mang po gtor zhing mthar wu ra ku'egatsang bo'i steng gi sā ar tho btsan rdzong blangs/ de ru cwa le po te la a ken thin gyi dmag mi 3000lhag gis me skyogs kyis nyin gsum la bskor brgol byas kyang dgra bo'i btsan rdzong len pa'i dmigs yul ma 'grub pa ma zad/ da dung cwa le po tes phar rgol gyis pham ste phyir 'then byed dgos byung /rgyang skyod dmag 'khrug thengs des cwa le po te la snyan grags cung che tsam byung la/ de las kyang dza drag che ba'i hrin an tung nye o(zaṣṭhapokhu )dmag 'khrug gis kho'i snyan grags kun la khyab par byas/ de ni 1846lo'i zla2pa'i nyin zhig yin/ cwa le po tes sku dngos su dmag mi 186dang skya dmag 100khrid nas dgra bo'i gdong blangs/ gsang kha ma dam pa'i dbang gi19 kto tsho

bzo grwa rnying ba zhig gi shul du dgra bo'i skor dkyil la tshud/ dgra bo'i skya dmag 1000tsam dang rkang dmag 300lhag gis thad gar tshur rgol byas/ cwa le po te la dngangs 'tshub ci yang med par dmag mi rnams la 6 gra sgrig gyis/dgra bo gam du ma bcar bar du me mda' rgyag mi chog mices bka' bsgos/ phyi dro hril bor khong gis 'thab ra brtan srung dang myur stabs kyis gdong mchong /ral gri'i dmar 'dzing sogs dmag thabs spyad de dgra bo'i rkang skya dmag thengs mang po'i rgol ba phyir bzlog sa rub rjes/ dgra bo thang chad pa'i glags dang bstun nas dbyi tha li'i dmag khag gsang stabs kyis 'thab ra las bud de nags gseb tu song zhing / nags gseb tu dgra bo'i rjes 'ded dmag la yib sgug gis rdung deg byas te dmag dpung bde blag gis phyir log thub pa byung / thengs der dbyi tha li'i dmag khag gi dmag mi 33shi ba dang dmag mi 55mas/ dgra phyogs kyi shi rmas ni ya nga ba zhig yin/ hrin an tung nye o dmag 'khrug ni spyi mthun rgyal khab kyis 'od 'phro ba'i rgyal kha thengs shig tu lta ba red/ spyi mthun rgyal khab srid gzhung gis dmag 'khrug thengs der zhugs pa'i dmag mi yongs la bya dga' bstsal zhing go 'phar byas/ cwa le po te la ta zho(lkoṣṭha)yi go thob gnang / dmag khag gi ru dar steng du gser skud kyis tsa cwa le po tes sne khrid pa'i dbyi tha li'i ru dpung gis 1846lo'i zla 2ba'i tshes 8nyin ha las pa'i rgyal kha blangs mizhes pa'i yi ge chen po dag gtsag /dro /sna /gi me gling nas ca le po te yis spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi ched du 'thab 'khrug byas pa'i mdzad rjethe dag rim gyis dbyi tha li'i mnga' khongs su khyab par gyur/ mi rnams kyis khong gis ji ltar dmag nyung ngus dgra mang gi kha gtad bcag pa dang / ji ltar brtan zhing brlir bar bkod 'doms byas te ༵༵༵ tshad las rgyal song tshul sogs khong gi mdzad rjes rnams gtam rgyud

khrod kyi dpa' bo ngo mtshar can gyi rnam par byas nas sgrog la/ kho'i snyan grags kyang je che je cher gyur ba red/ro ma spyi mthun rgyal khab la srung skyob byed pa/me gling lho ma'i mi dmangs kyi rang dbang gi ched du 'thab dus kyang /cwa le po te rgyal gces pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas nam yang sems khong la rang gi mes rgyal bzung yod pa yin/ 1848lor/ yo rob gling hril bo bsregs myong ba'i gsar brje'i me lce de thog mar dbyi tha li'i pā le ma'o(3 sgo)grong khyer nas sbar ba red/ gsar brje'i thengs 'di'i khrod du dbyi tha li'i phyogs kyi dmigs yul ni/ phyi'i btsan bzung ba mtha' skyod btang ste kha thor dgu thor gyi dbyi tha li gcig gyur bya ba de yin/ de ni lo 10yi sngon la cwa le po te sogs kyis mthong 'dod pa'i gsar brje'i rnam pa yin pas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 21nyin/kho dang dbyi tha li'i dmag khag gi 'thab grogs 60yun ring bral ba'i mes rgyal gyi phang bar slar logazla7pa nas bzung / cwa le po te cang cun (74)gyi tshul du mi grangs stong gcig nye ba'i dang blangs dmag khag la bkod 'doms byas te/ o si khru ri ya'i btsan bzung dmag dpung la g.yul 'khrug byas/ khong gis dmag mi rnams la gsal bsgrag bya don/ 6 da nas bzung nga tsho rang gi pha sa'i phyogs gang sar skyod nges la/ zhabs 'dren bla 'tshong byed mkhan dag yan por 'jog mi srid pa dang phyi rgyal ba'i btsan 'phrog gi bya spyod la bzod pa'ang sgom misrid/ nga tsho g.yul ral can gyi seng ge ltar ma shi bar du dbyi tha li'i rang btsan gyi rlabs chen bya gzhag gi ched du 'thab 'dzing bya dgos mizhes bshad/skabasader/ cwa le po te sngar gyi dmag dpon dkyus ma de min par kho'i phyi rgyal du byung ba'i lha sgrung lta bu'i mdzad rjes kyi dbang gis/ dbyi tha ༵༵ mi

dmangs kyis re ba yod tshad khor gtad cing dgra bos kyang kho rang dmigs 'ben gtso bor bzhag yod pa red/ 1849lo'i zla 4bar/ khong gis dmag dpung 'khrid de ro ma grong khyer la bskyod cing mā kri nye gtso byas pa'i ro ma spyi mthun rgyal khab la srung skyob byas/ zla pa'i tshes 30nyin/ hpha ran se dmag mi 5000yis thog mar ro ma grong khyer la tshur rgol byas/ khong gis dmag mi 2500yi sne drangs nas 'gog rgol byas te nyin hril gcig gi dmag 'khrug brgyud nas hpha dmag 500tshar bcad/ dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung la'ang shi rmas nyung tsam byung / ches thog ma'i rgyal kha des mi rnams dga' ste sa lding gnam lding byas/ cwa le po tes dgra bo pham pa'i skabs dang bstun nas tsha 'ded byas te theg med gtong ba'i gros 'go bton yang / mā kri nye yis mos mthun ma byas par kho rang tsa nā pu le si'i(smo6lo77)mi skyod ’ du mngags/cwa le po tes sems la rgyal kha blangs pa'i skabs dang bstun nas rjes 'ded btang ste nā pu le si'i rgyal khongs la phyin nas sa de'i mi dmangs la 'os langs byed pa'i me son ster dgos snyam nas/ las 'gan de dang len byas pa red/ zla 5ba'i tshes 27nyin/ khong gis dpung drangs nas lho phyogs su bskyod dus myur du phyir log dgos pa'i bka' 'byor/ rgyu mtshan ni hpha dmag khri 3gyis me skyogs sogs dmag chas mang po 'khyer nas bshar 'ong ba dang /6 dmag rgyag thengs gcig la ro ma spyi mthun rgyal khab rmeg med gtong ’ 'dod pas red/ cwa le po tes smyo thengs 'di'i lho bskyod kyi grub 'bras yod tshad brlag nges 7pa rtogs na'ang khong gis bka' tshig de dang len byas/ khong gis dmag dpung bskor skyod byas te dgra bo'i gzhug dang gzhogs nas phar rgol gyis ro ma dgra bo'i skor dkyil las skyob pa'i dmag jus bkod na'ang /kho'i dmag jus der yar bskyar mos mthun ma byas par dmag dpung thad dkā ༵ 6ma mkhar du log dgos pa'i bka' 'byor/ cwa le po tes 6 dmag

dpung yongs rdzogs ro ma ru log dgos pa'i bka' brda de spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung yongs rdzogs hpha ran se'i rgyal bo gdug rtsub can de'i mche bar la brdzangs pa dang khyad med ’ pa sngon dpog gis tshor na'ang / khong gis sngar bzhin 6 am gtsigs bsdams te bka' de dang len byas/mi ro ma la srung skyob byed pa'i rgyal pham thag gcod kyi dmag 'khrug ni nor 'khrul gyi dmag jus 'di lta bus bzos pa'i gnas bab mi legs pa las 'go btsams/ zla6pa'i tshes 3nyin gyi mtshan gzhung la/ hpha dmag gis glo bur 'jab rgol byas/ nyi ma shar dus 6 ro ma'i lde mig ’ tu 'bod pa'i si gleng(khrata/)gzhis ka hpha dmag gis bzung ba red/ nyin de hril bo si hpheng gzhis ka 'phrog rtsod kyis 'das/ tsā le pho tes thengs gnyis la tshur 'phrog kyang mjug mthar yang bskyar phyir 'then bya dgos byung / dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung la shi rmas chen po byung yang nyen kha sngar bzhin bzlog ma thub/ spyi mthun rgyal khab hril bor dmag mi khri 1 7las med la de las dmag mi phyed ka tsam ma gtogs 'thab 'khrug la zhugs mi thub pa yin/ hpha dmag gis ro ma'i dmag chas mkho sprod kyi rgyun bcad pa dang / mtshon cha'i mdzod khang / dmag chas bzo grwa sogs gtor ba red/ cwa le po tes yang bskyar mig rgyang ring ba'i gros 'go bton pa ste/ 6 'gog srung bya dka' ba'i dus 'dir/ rgyal dka' ba'i dgra bo dang 'thab ra brtan srursha gis g.yul 'gyed byed pa las bskor skyod kyis dgra bor rdung deg bya ba legs ’ zhes khong gis skya dmag 200'khrid de mkhar phyi la 'bud rtsis byas kyang / 6 spyi mthun rgyal khab skyob pa'i mtha' mjugagi go skabs mi 'di yang mā kri nyi yis brlags pa red/ zla6pa'i tshes 30nyin/ hpha dmag gis spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srog la rgol pa'i mjug mtha'i tshur rgol byas/ cwa le po tes tshogs 'du'i steng du 6 mgo 'dogs pa dang srang lam nas dmag 'khrug rgyag pa gang yin yang go mi chod/ yang dag pa~X snam

bu nyag gcig ni mkhar grong gi phyi ru bud de mu mthud 'thab 'dzing bya ba de yin/ nga tsho gang du bskyod kyang de ru ro ma yod chog mices 'bod skul btang yang / yid thag chad pa'i tshogs mi rnams kyis rnar ma song bar 66dkon mchog dang mi dmangs kyi ming thog nas 'gog srung bskyur nas mgo 'dogs byas pa khyab bsgrags byas/mi spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi tshe srog de ltar mjug sgril yang / cwa le po tes 66rang gi mi gzhi la nag nog bsgo ma 'dod la/ mtshon cha bskyur nas po nā pa(ṣṭha 3)dmag mi'i rkang 'og la mgo bo 'jog 'dod gtan nas med par zla7pa'i tshes2nyin gyi phyi dror/ khong gis rkang dmag 3900dang skya dmag 800'khrid de mkhar grong las phyir bud/ skabs 'dir spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi phugs re ni ro ma mkhar nas bros byol byas pa'i mi 'di dag gi sems khong kho nar gnas pa red/da ni cwa le po te btsan gyis mkhar grong du 'jog mkhan med la 'go ba dag gi tshod 'dzin yang ye nas med/ khong gis rang 'dod kyis dmag dpung sdeb sgrig gis 'khrug pa brgyab chog pa yin pas/ kho'i dmag don gyi 'jon nas yongs su ngom thub pa byung / kho rang gis yul dus dang bstun pa'i nges med rgol rdung gi dgra 'thab lag len byas/ skabs 'gar dgra bo rang gi rjes su bskyur la skabs 'gar dgra bo'i mgo bskor nas ldog phyogs la rjes 'ded gtong du bcug yang skabs rer dgra bo dang spyi le 'gas chod pa'i sa nas mnyam du bskyod cing skabs rer ri lam kyag kyog bskyur nas gzhung lam du mngon sum du dpung skyod byed/ tshul 'dis dgra bo'i dmag dpon dag la khong khro chen po bslangs te 6 cwa le po te'i dmag jus ni dmag don slob grwa gang gi dmag rtsal sbyong yig gang la'ang mi mthun pa yin ’ zhes rgyal khab 'di dang cwa ༵ ༵ te dpung dang bcas par dmod mo drag po byas/

rgyalakhab kyis o si khru ri ya la g.yul sprod par sta gon byed pa'i bya las la zhugs/ 1859lor/ khong gis dmag mi 3000yod pa'i 6 ār phe si rngon pa'i ru dpung zhes par bkod 'doms byas nas yang bskyar lun pā te'i nye khul du dmag 'khrug byas/ dang blangs dmag mis grub pa'i ru dpung 'dis bstud mar rgyal kha blangs te stobs je cher phyin te/ mjug mthar sā ting gi tshad ldan dmag dpung dang mnyam du o dmag lun pā te nas bskrad de we nye si la phyir 'then bya dgos pa bzos/o si khru ri yar ngo rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gi rgyal khas dbyi tha li'i sa khul so so'i gsar brje'i las 'gul la skul 'ded chen po byas/1860lo'i zla bar/ zhi zhi le gling phran gyi pa le mo(37sgo)ru 'os langs byung zhing / cwa le po tes rgyal bo cwa rmu ar la zhi zhi le'i mi dmangs la rogs dmag gtong ba'i re 'dun zhus kyang yid 'thad ma byung / zla8ba'i tshes 6nyin/ cwa le po te rang nyid kyis dang blangs dmag mi 1)botsam bsdu rub byas te/ dmag gru gnyis la bsdad de ri nā ya gru kha( smosasgro )nas dpung skyod byas/ cwa rmu ar gyis 6 smyon pa'i bya las zhes 'bod pa'i dpung skyod de de ltar 'go btsams pa red/ cwa le po te dang kho'i dmag mi stong gcig gi ru dpung gis sa rgya che zhing stobs 'byor ldan pa'i ling zhi zhi le rgyal khab la 'gran bslangs pa ste/ rgyal khab 'dir mtshon cha bzang zhing sgrig lam legs pa'i dmag mi hrag bsdus khri 10yod na'ang cwa le po tes ngo mtshar ba'i lag rjes bskrun pa red/stod lwa dmar po gyon pa'i dmag mi stong gcig gi ru dpung de zhi zhi le gling phran(mamatsho )du bde bar 'byor la/ gnas tshul de gcig kha gcig brgyud kyis kun la khyab par gyur/ des srid gzhung la dngangs 'jigs byin pa kāṭā mi dmangs la re ba bstsal/ zhi zhi le mi dmangs mdza' sems chen

pos dmag mi stong gcig gi ru dpung du zhugs pa red/ zla8ba'i tshes 26nyin/tsā le po te'i ru dpung zhi zhi le'i rgyal sa pa le mo yi mkhar 'dabs su 'byor/mkhar grong nang du dgra dmag khri 2 1tsam yod la/ kho'i lag 'og na dmag mi 900tsam las med/ yin na'ang / cwa le po te la mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor yod pa ma zad/ mkhar nang gi sdod dmangs kyis kyang mtshon cha gra sgrig byas te dmag mi stong gcig gi ru dpung bsu ba byed rgyur sgug yod/ dgra bos 'gog srung brtan por kha gtad de khong gis rang gi dmag don gyi 'jon nus ngom pa ste/ khong gis thog mar mkhar gyi lho nub phyogs nas phar rgol gyis dgra bo'i gtso shugs dmag dpung mkhar phyi la drangs/ 'thab zhor 'bro zhor byed pa ni kho'i ru dpung nyung shas tsam yin yang dgra bo g.yo 'og tu tshud de tsha 'ded btang / skabs der/ khong gis gtso shugs dmag dpung 'khrid de ri lam gya gyu brgyud nas mkhar gyi shar lho phyogs nas phar rgol drag po byas/ kho rang dmag mi'i sngon du gdong mchong gis mkhar nang la bshar ba na/ sdod dmangs rnams kyis sung lam yongs nas bsu ba dang rogs ram rgya cher byas/nyin zhag /nyis srang lam gyi dmag 'khrug brgyud de dgra dmag rtsa med du btang ༵ le tā/ tshur blangs pa'i gnas tshul skad cig la yo rob gling hril bor khyab cing rgyal khab mtha' dag ha las par gyur/ rgyal kha thengs 'di ni ling zhi zhi le rgyal khams la mtshon na nyi 'od khrod kyi glog zhags dang 'dra bar sa phyogs so so nas gsar brje'i me dpung 'phyur te rgyal rabs 'jig pa'i lam du zhugs/ cang ma 'gor bar zhi zhi le gling phran cwa le po ti'i lag 'og tu tshud/zla8par/ cwa le po tes rang gi dmag dpung yongs rdzogs khrid de mtsho 'gag brgal nas rgyal khab hril bo dbang du bsdu bar sta gon byas/ tshes 18nyin gyi mtshan mor/ dmag dpung bde blag gis mtsho 'gag brgal cing /30rdos

21nyin le tso(74)bzung / tshes 23nyin kha la pu le ya(chakhri lo༅༅)tshur blangs/ cwa le po tes dgra dpung la/ tshang ma dbyi tha li'i mi yin pa'i cha nas/kho tsho las kho dang 'grogs 'dod pa dag la dga' bsu bya nges la 'grogs mi 'dod pa dang gang dgar rang yul la phyin chog pa'i srid jus bsgrags pas/dgradapung rtsa ba nas 'thor 'go brtsams pa dang btsan rdzong re re bzhin sgo phyes te srung dmag dag gis me mda' gcig kyang ma brgyab par phyir 'then byas pa red/ nyin 12tsam yang ma 'gor ba'i ring la/ khong gis khrag thigs gcig kyang ma bzhur bar rgyal khongs kyi yul khams phal cher tshur blangs pa red/ zla)ba'i zla stod du/ khong gis rgyal sa nā pu le si la nyin mtshan ltos med kyis dpung 'jug byas/ lam bar du dgra bos 'gog srung yod na'ang dgra dmag gi sems shugs nyams yod pas re re bzhin cham la phab tshes 5nyin/ rgyal bo dang btsun mos rang 'gul gyis rgyal sa bskyur nas gzhan du song ba red/ tshes 6nyin/ cwa le po tes rgyal sa nā pu le si blangs/ zla gcig gi rjes su/ khong gis 6 ling zhi zhi le rgyal khab rtsa gtor byas zin/ dbyi tha li'i rus rgyud kyi mi dmangs gso skyong byas myong ba'i yul khams 'dir/ nga rang rang dbang gis 'dem shog 'phangs te dbang sgyur bar bskos pa red/da lta ngas bsgrag rgyu zhig ni/ yul khams 'di sā ting ni rgyal bo khrims mthun gyi rgyal bo yin pa'i dbyi tha li'i kha 'bral thabs med pa'i cha shas shig yin pa de'o mizhes khyab bsgrags byas/cwa le po te'i phul du byung ba'i dmag don 'jon nus dang khyad du 'phags pa'i byas rjes kyis dbyi tha li'i bcings 'grol bya gzhag la nus pa bla med 'thon na'ang / kho la chab srid steng nas mig rgyang ring bo med la chab srid kyi rtsa 'dzin gsal bo med pa dang / 'byor ldan gral rim gyi gsar brje brdi sdusam chung gi cha de phyir mngon nas gcig gyur gyi bya gzhag de sā ting

rgyal bor yongs su gtad pa red/ 1861lo'i zla3par/ dbyi tha li rgyal khab tu'u lin nas dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags byas shing / sā ting gi rgyal pos dbyi tha li'i rgyal bo byas/ cwa le po tes khrab rmog phud nas phyir pha yul la log nas nya las dang zhing las gnyer/ 'on kyang / yul dbus kyi ro ma chos bdag rgyal khab de dbyi tha li las logs su rang btsan byas yod pa dang / we nye si sa khul sngar bzhin o si khru ri yas btsan bzung byas yod pa red/6 mjug mtha'i lcags sgrog gtor ba'i mi ched du/cwa le po te pha yul du log na'ang / kho rang gis mi tshe gcig la hur thag byed pa'i bya gzhag yal bar dor ba gtan nas min par dbyi tha li'i mjug mtha'i lcags sgrog gtor rgyur sgug bsdad pa red/’ kho rang gis rmi lam du'ang rmis bzhin pa ni ro ma la dpung 'jug gis chos lugs srung skyob kyi dar cha bsgreng ba'i hpha dmag mtha' skrod gtong rgyu de yin/ kho rang yang bskyar mi dmangs khrod du 'gul skyod byas shing ra rgyal yongs me mda' rgyag pa'i spro skyid khang ’ gi 'go gtso gzhon pa 'khur/ kho rang gis na gzhon khrod nas dpa' bo'i ngang gshis yod cing 'gran bsdur khrod gzhan las 'phags pa'i mi la stod lwa dmar po bya dga'i tshul du sprad/ phyis su kho rang slar yang zhi zhi le gling phran du phyin nas dang blangs dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 6 yang na ro ma skyob pa dang yang na gces srog gtong mizhes pa'i 'thab 'khrug 'bod skul kun la bsgrags/ 1862lo'i zla8par/ kho rang gis dmag mi3000'khrid de gling phran 'phred kyis bcad de khā tha nye ya gru kha(chaXṭha༅6)nas mtsho 'gag brgal nas rgyal sa nā pu le si la dpung bskyod byas/ kho rang gi re 'dun ni rgyal yongs mthun sgril gyis tshad ldan dmag dpung dang dang blangs dmag mnyam 'brel byas te ro ma la dpung 'jug byed pa de yin yang /30/la

bos kho rang gi bya spyod de 6 khrims 'gal rang yan dang rgyal khab kyi bde 'jags la gnod par rtsis te/ tshad ldan dmag dpung la 6 tsā le po te la rjes 'ded rdung deg gis mgo ma btags na theg med gtong dgos mi pa'i bka' phab/ zla8pa'i tshes29nyin/ kho rang gi dmag dpung spru le si tha le mtho sa nas skor dkyil thebs/ gal te tsā le po tes brda btang nas 'thab 'khrug brgyab tshe/ 6 yang bskyar rgyal kha chen po zhig blangs chog ’ kyang / spun zla nang dme med pa'i ched du me mda' rgyag mi chog pa'i brda btang / de ni cwa le po tes spun zla nang 'khrug mi 'byung ched du 'thab ra nas mtshon cha thang la bzhag pa thengs dang po yin/ srid gzhung dmag gis de ni rang gi rgyal khar brtsi ba red/ kho tshos cwa le po te 'dzin bzung gis btson la bcug kyang /rgyal yongs su gleng brjod chen po byung la dbyi tha li hril bor khong khro bslangs pa ma zad/ tha na yo rab gling gi rgyal khab gzhan dag gi mi dmangs la'ang khong khro chen po bslangs par brten/ srid gzhung gis tsā le po te dpung dang bcas pa dmigs bsal gyi btsol grol gtong dgos byung /1866lor/ phu lu'u hri dang o si khru ri ya gnyis g.yul skyod pa'i glags dang bstun nas dbyi tha lis kyang o si khru ri yar dmag 'khrug brda yig btang / zla 5bar/ srid gzhung gis bka' phab nas dang blangs dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas shing / cwa le po te dmag spyi la bskos te dang blangs dmag 3800)la sne drangs te g.yul sar bskyod/ zla 'ga'i dmag 'khrug brgyud de tshad ldan dmag rtsa ba nas pham ste phyir 'then byed pa'i tshad la slebs kyang / cwa le po tes sne drangs ba'i dang blangs dmag gis phar rgol mtha' gcig tu byas te we nye si tshur len par byas rjes chen po bzhag dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ dang blangs dmag dpung gtor cing cwa le po te yang bskyar radi sdus la 'gro ru bcug 'on kyang / kho rang gi ro ma tshur len pa dang ro ma

bcings 'grol bya ba'i re 'dun la 'gyur ba gtan nas byung med/1867lor/ kho rang gis slar yang 'char gzhi gsar ba zhig 'then pa ste/ ro ma chos bdag rgyal khab kyi nye 'khor du nges med rgol rdung dmag 'khrug brgyab ste/ dus la babs tshe ro ma mkhar nang gi 'os langs rtsa 'dzugs byed pa de'o//zla)bar/ kho rang gis rang gi 'char gzhi lag len byed 'go rtsom dus srid gzhung gis yang bskyar kho rang btson du bcug thengs 'dir/ rgyal yongs rang bzhin gyi khrom bskor byas te srid gzhung gis cwa le po te glod grol btang ste khā phu le la gling phran(rdorsā776)du skyel cing de dang kha 'bral mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ zla 10ba'i nyin zhig la/ cwa le po te bkag sdom las thar te dmag mi 14000'khrid nas ro ma chos bdag rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs su 'dzul na'ang / sngon na chos bdag rgyal khab kyi dmag dpung dang hpha dmag yod la/ gzhug na dus nam yang kho rang la rgol rdung bya nges pa'i srid gzhung gi dmag dpung yod pas/ gnas bab ha cang mi legs pa red/ cwa le po tesadamag dpung 'khrid de ro ma dang spyi le 'ga' las med pa'i sar 'byor na'ang / mkhar nang nas kho rang gis re ltos byed bzhin pa'i 'os langs ye nas ma byung pa red/ skyabs med dpung med kyi gnas bab 'og nas dang blangs dmag dpung pham pa red/ thengs de ni cwa le po tes dbyi tha li'i gcig gyur gyi don du brgyab pa'i ches mtha' ma'i dmag 'khrug yin/1870lor phu hpha dmag 'khrug brgyab bas/ nā pho lun sku phreng gsum pas ro ma chos bdag rgyal khab tu bca' sdod byed pa'i hpha dmag phyir 'then byas shing dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung gis shul du ro ma bzung / phyi lor ro ma dbyi tha li'i rgyal sa byas te gcig gyur gyi bya gzhag chen po de mjug sgril ba red/ cwa le po tes sku dngos su mes rgyal gcig gyur gyi bya gzhag de yongs 'grub bya ma thub kyang / mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur dang mi rigs kyi rang 3sdusan

gyi ched du nam yang mi nub pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod pa yin/ mjug mthar/kho rang gis khā phu le la gling phran gyi steng nas tshe mjug gi 'tsho ba bskyal/ dbyi tha li'i mi dmangs kyis cwa le po te brjed kyin med de/ kho chos dbyi tha li'i grong khyer che chung tshang ma'i nang du/ cwa le po tes 'khor gsum lus la bskor te rtas gong nas dgra 'thab la zhugs pa'i 'bag sku bzhengs yod/ 'di ni mi dmangs kyis dpa' bo ngo mtshar can 'di'i phul byung gi dmag don 'jon nus dang dmag bkod sgyu rtsal la gdeng 'jog byas pa yin la/ kho rang gi mi nub pa'i mdzad rjes la khas len byas pa'ang yin no//306

dus rabs 19ba'i mu lu'u hri'i dmag don gzhung lugs ba khu 'o sa'e we3tse/cinarkang nan/kha ar hphan khu lo sa'e we tshi (1780 — 1831lo )ni dus rabs 19ba'i phu lu'u hri rgyal khab kyi dmag don gzhung lugs pa zhig yin/ kho ni dmag don pa grags can gzhan dag dang 'dra bar 'thab 'bras mngon gsal yod pa zhig min par/ kho'i dmag don gyi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim ni ha cang rgyun ldan zhig yin yang / dmag don gyi mtshan ldan brtsams chos 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉zhes pas kho rang 'dzam gling gi dmag don pa grags can gyi gral nas ngo gnong mi dgos par gyur la/ le nyin gyis kyang kho ni 6 snyan grags 'bar ba'i dmag don mtshan nyid dang dmag 'khrug lo rgyus kyi rtsom pa po zhig yin ’ zhes gsungs/las dbang gi bkod sgrigakhu lo sa'e we tshi ni dmag mi'i khyim rgyud nas skyes pa min par kho'i mes po'i skabs kyi mi 16ni ye shu'i chos lugs gsar ma'i chos pa dang lha rig pa ba yin/ kho'i mes po ni hwa le grong du snyan grags 'bar ba'i lha rig pa'i slob dpon chen mo dang mkhas pa zhig yin/ yin na'ang / 1763lor/ lha rig pa'i slob dpon chen mo 'di'i yugs sar lus pa'i chung ma gzugs byad legs pa de phu lu'u hri'i hro zho dmag dpon hphan hong thi(/9 tshis)yi bza' zla byas/ de bas khu lo sa'i we tshi yi khyim rgyud phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpon ñtsha /ma

sbyin par byas la/ 6 dkon mchog ya/ mig lam gyi brnyan ris 'di dag yal bar mdzod ang zhes dbang med shor/ de lta na'ang / pho lo 13la son pa'i byis pa 'dis dmag mi rgan pa rnams dang 'dra bar mdel char dang ral gri'i tshang tshing brgyud nas slebs byung / zla7pa'i tshes 20nyin/ khu lo sa'e we tshi dmag dpon ru sde yi tshad ldan gyi dmag dpon zhig tu gyur/mang po'i khrod nas mgo 'phang brtags pa/1795lo'i zla bar/ dmag dpung 'thab ra nas phyir 'then byas/ pho lo 15la son pa'i khu lo sa'i we tshi yang phyir dmag sgar la log glo bur g.yul sa dang kha bral te/ snying 'jags kyi zhing grong gi 'tsho ba ngo ma zhig rol 'go brtsams/’ de ltar ro gcig mdog gcig gi srung dmag gi 'tsho ba mi lo 6la bskyal ba red/ phu lu'u hri dmag dpung gi 'gyur ba dang rkyong skum med pa'i dmag sgrig gis ma 'ongs pa'i dmag shen gzhung lugs pa 'di'i 'jon nus brlags kyang srid pa yin/ kho'i khor yug gi nus med rtsub spyod can gyi 'dug grogs dag gis 'chal spyod kyi 'tsho ba ngom res byed na'ang / khu lo sa'i we tshi bsam blo dang kun spyod kyi cha nas nam yang ngan rul du ma songab red/ khong gis 66skom pa chu 'dod lta bu'i dpe klog gi re 'dun ’ gyis khom gseng gi dus tshod yod tshad spyad de/ dmag don gsung rtsom dang / phyogs yongs nas dmag don thabs jus gleng ba'i dpe cha yin na'ang 'dra/ bye brag gi dmag 'khrug gang rung la brtag dpyad byed pa'i rtsom yig yin na'ang 'dra/yang yang lta klog dang yang yang zhib 'jug byas/ rgyun chags lhod med kyi rang sbyongagis kho'i bsam blo gsar ba nas gsar ba'i phyogs su 'phel la blo khog kyang rgya je che je cher gyur ba red/ skabs de'i na gzhon dmag dpon dag gi tshad gzhis gzhal tshe kho ni 6 slob 'bras kun las 'phags pa yin zhes 3sdu/da

chog chog yin/ mi rnams kyis kho ni 66ngang rgyud bzang zhing shes bya sna tshogs 'bad pas sbyong ba'i dmag dpon phul byung can zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin byed/ 1801lor/ kho rang per lin(75)dmag dpon slob grwar slob gnyer byed du mngags/ de ni kho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi dkyogs lam zhig yin/mi lo gnyis kyi dmag don slob grwa'i 'tsho bas khong gis dmag don slob gso cha tshang ba zhig myangs thub pa byung ba ma zad/ da dung tsa bsam blo'i steng spyi yab chen zhig dang mjal nas 'od stong 'bar ba'i ma 'ongs ba'i lam sne da/ slob grogs rnams kyis rgyal sa nas rgyas spros kyi 'tsho bar rol dus/ khu lo sa'e we tshis 'bad 'bungs lhod med kyis dmag don bslab bya khag la slob sbyong byed pa'i zhor la/ gtan tshigs rig pa dang rtsis rig sa rgyus/ lo rgyus/ 'jar man rtsom rig sogs la sbyang brtson byas/ gnyid bcag zas brjed kyis slob sbyong byed pa'i na gzhon 'dir mi sna phul byung can zhig gis do snang byung / khong ni phyis su phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung gi khyad du 'phags pa'i 4blo mdzod dang gtso 'dzin/mi dmag srid blon chen du gyur ba'i zhang ho si thi krung cang yin/ skabs der/ khong dmag don slob grwa'i slob gtso yin la/kho rang gis khu lo sa'e we tshi yi lhan skyes kyi shes rab dang brtson 'grus mthong nas kho la yab lta bu'i byams brtses mdzub ston byas te/ 'gro 'os pa'i mi tshe'i lam sne bstan pa red/ khu lo sa'i we tshi dang kho'i yab lta bu'i grogs po 'di gnyis tshe gcig lus gcig gi mdza' grogs su gyur cing / da dung khu lo sa'i we tshis dran tshor gyi bsam pas khong ni 6 nga'i bsam blo'i steng gi yab chen miyin zhes bshad pa red/1803lor/ pho lo 23la son pa'i khu lo sa'e we tshi khyad du 'phags pa'i sbyaXdi zlobras kyis dmag don slob grwa nas mthar phyin/ slob gas kho la gnang

ba'i dpyad gtam ni 6 nus pa dang brdar sha gcod pa'i rnam dpyod/ brtson 'grus/ shes yon sogs phyogs gang nas bltas kyang kho ni gzhan las gzengs su thon pa zhig red ces pa'o// slob gtso zhang ho si thi yis mtshams sbyor brgyud nas rgyal bos kho rang rgyal sa per lin srung mkhan mdel 'phen sgrogs dmag gi 'go gtso dang o ko si thi rgyal sras kyi sku bcar dmag dpon du bskos/ dus de ni me tog lham mer bzhad pa'i dpyid ka yin la/ khu lo sa'e we tshi spro snang chen pos pe le we ti le pho brang du bskyod pa red/ kho la mtshon na/ da ni dka' tshegs kyi las res dang dmag sbyong / dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba rnams 'das zin phyir de dag mi ldog par gyur ba dang / nus med spobs med kyi mi rabs 'di las mgo 'phang mthon por btegs te 'khrug cha che la bde zhing skyid pa'i pho brang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod du zhugs pa red/ rgyal sras kyi sku bcar dmag dpon yin pa'i cha nas kho rang pho brang nang gi bro tshogs dang dgong tshogs sna tshogs la zhugs dgos la/ chab srid las rigs dang dmag don las rigs kyi 'go gtso rnams dang 'brel 'dris byed pa/ rgyal bo dang blon chen/ dmag dpon chen mo dag gi lab gleng dang bya spyod la rgyus lon bya thub pa byung / lo gsum gyi pho brang nang gi 'tsho bas kho'i mig rgya dang blo khog rgya cher bskyed na'ang / dmag don gzhung lugs pa zhig byed dgos na da dung dka' tshegs kyi sbyong brdar mang po zhig brgyud dgos pa yin/dka' sdug khrod nas nar son pa/skyesachen zhig gis 6 mtshan nyid rig pa ba zhig nar son pa'i brgyud rim ni bde blag cig min par rmas skyon gyis thag gcod pa yin zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ khu lo sa'i we tshi'i mi tshe ni ha cang ngos mi snyoms pa zhig yin/ dka' sdug khri phrag brgyud de da gzod kho rang rlabs chen gyi mi sdu /ga

tu gyur 1kā ༵༵/'i ston kur/ yo rob gling gi mkha' dbyings nas yun ring bsags pa'i dmag 'khrug gi sprin nag de char zhod thengs shig tu gyur nas phu lu'u hri'i sa gzhir babs pa red/ nā pho lun gyi dpung chen po de bzlog dka' ba'i zil shugs kyis phu lu'u hri la gshar yong / zla 10ba'i tshes 14nyin/phu hpha gnyis kyis ye na(lko )dang o ar hri thi( po 6)gnyis nas dus mtshungs su g.yul sprad/ g.yul sa gnyis po nas phu dmag la pham nyes tshabs chen byung / yun ring bor snyan grags kyis khyab pa'i phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung ni hpha dmag gi me sgrogs dang / rlung ltar myur ba'i skya dmag gi gdong mchong mdun du kha thor dgu thor du pham/ bros shor ba'i pham dmag rnams btsan rdzong khag la bros te skyabs 'tshol bar byed/ yin na'ang / nus med kyi dmag dpon rnams ngo tsha dang bral te mgo btags pa red/ btsan rdzong mang po zhig me mda' gcig kyang ma brgyab par dmag mi nyis brgya sum brgya las med pa'i hpha ran se'i gdong mchong dmag la sprad/ phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung dang rgyal khab ni shog bus bzos pa'i khang ba dang 'dra bar rgol ba phran tsam yang spra theg par gyur/ nyin 11gi nang du hpha dmag thad kur rgyal sa per lin la 'a bye lo/ sa'i we tshi dang kho'i ru dpung gis 6 rang gi stobs shugs yod tshad bton nas 'thab 'dzing nus shugs yongs su zad pa'i bar du 'gog rgol byas na'ang / mjug mthar lha rgyal khab kyi las dbang dang bstun mi dgos byung / rgyal sras ni 'dzin bzung gis per lin la bskyal zhing kho yang mnyam du 'khrid pa red/ de snga'i pho brang ni nā pho lun gyi bzhugs sar gyur ba dang /pham nyes byung ba'i phu dmag gis rnying zhing rul ba'i dmag lu gyon zhing zhwa mo phu) /lha nā pho lun gyi bka' sgug 'dug 'di lta'i brnyas dmod kyi khrod du/

khu lo sa'i we tshi'i sems khong du zhe sdang dang 'khon sems non mi thub pa zhig byung na'ang dgra bo'i bka' brtsi ba las bya thabs ma rnyed/ zla 12ba'i mjug tu/ kho rang rgyal sras dang mnyam du hpha ran se la 'khrid nas bkag skyil byas/rgyal khongs mi gcig pa'i sa mtha' nas kho'i mi rigs kyi la rgya la rma kha chen po byung ste bshad don 66yod tshad la 'gyur ldog ji 'dra zhig byung song / re ba dang rgyu nor ji tsam theg med du song zin/ rgyal khab med pa'i dwa phrug dag gang sar 'khyams shing kho tshos zhabs 'degs sgrub sa'i mes rgyal gyi gzi brjid yongs su yal tshar / 'bangs mi'i khe dbang mtha' dag la da lta rin thang ci yang med ’ ces bshad/ bkag skyil byas pa'i lo zla'i khom gseng du/ kho rang gis bsam gzhig byed bzhin rtsom yig bris/ kho rang gis phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung dang rgyal khab kyi ngo gnong tshad med kyi don dag 'di la mno bsam zhib mo btang ba ste/ 6 mtho rim dmag dpon rnams 'jon nus dang bral la/ dmag dpon mtho dman bar gsum ni rgan pa nus zad yin/tha na dmag mi skor zhig lo tshad mthon por slebs yod/ dmag mi'i mkho chas dang lu ba sogs ches dma' ba'i tshad la'ang mi slebs pa dang mtshon cha rnams dus rabs dang bsdur tshe rnying nas 'dor 'os pa'i tshad du 'dug dmag mi'i ngar shugs ha cang dma' la sbyong brdar cha tshang min pa dang / lhag par phu lu'u hri'i srol rgyun gyi 'du shes te gzhan gyi dmag don don rkyen dang 'phel rgyas la do snang mi byed par gna' srol mkhregs 'dzin kho na byed pa red/ de las gzhan da dung ha las pa'i rang rlom chen pos lhan skyes su yod pa'i sems khral dang zhed snang gi bsam pa'i tshor shes yongs su sbrid du bcug 'dug mi ces so// 'di ni phu lu'u hri dmag pham pa'i rgyu rkyen la snag thog khab gtsag byas pa zhig yin te/ dmag dpon bgres po dag gis grub pa'i bkod 'doms sde khag gi nus med spobs med dang rjes lus kyi spyi tshogs sgri/ /zhi
