rmang gzhi byas pa'i rul sung gi dmag don sgrig gzhi'i skyon 'tshang rjen por bstan pa red/1807lo'i zla 11par/ phu lu'u hri'i rgyal sras 'khor dang bcas pa gzhi nas mes rgyal la log skabs der/ phu lu'u hri'i rgyal khongs kyi 172gi sa cha khag bgos byas yod pa dang / hpha dmag gis rgyal sa per lin dang phyogs so so'i btsan rdzong khag bzung yod/ ches khu lo sa'e we tshi'i snying na ba zhig ni/hpha ran se'i dmag dpung gis phu dmag 420)skyoras yod mi chog pa'i bkas bcad yod pa de yin/ phu lu'u hri ni phal cher nyen srung med pa'i rgyal khab cig tu gyur yod/ nyen 'gag skabs der zhang ho si thi ni dmag dpung gi re ba 'cha' sa gcig pur gyur/ dmag 'khrug skabs su/ kho'i 'jon nus gzhan las 'phags pa'i dbang gis/ kho rang cang cun la 'phar ba dang 6 dmag don bsgyur sgrig u yon lhan khang mi gi kru'u zhi'i 'gan bzhes/ kho rang gis bka' ltar bkas tshad bkag byas pa'i nang tshud nas dmag dpung zhig sgrig 'dzugs byas/ 6 nam zhig phyi'i gnon shugs je yang du song ba dang bstun nas/ gsar skyes myu gu ji bzhin myur bar sa brtol nas 'tshar skyed 'byung ’ rgyu'i re 'dun bcangs/ zhang ho si thi yis dmag dpung bsgyur sgrig byed pa'i bya gzhag khrod du rang gi slob ma skor zhig yod la/ khu lo sa'e we tshi ni kho'i lag g.yas pa'i tshul du tsha dmag don bsgyur sgrig u yon lhan khang mig gzhung las khang gi kru'u ren gyi 'gan bzhes/ kho tshos rkang dmag gi sgrig srol rtsa 'dzin gsar du bsgrigs shing lam srol rnying ba mang bo snying stobs chen pos bsgyur bcos byas/ sgrig srol gsar mas sngar gyi glas dmag lam srol de phyogs yongs nas dmag mi bsdu ba'i lam srol du bsgyur ba dang / sku drag gis dmag khongs nas khe dbang khyad par ba bzung ba'i lam srol med par byadi rdo dmag 'khrug khrod nus pa med pa'i dmag dpon mang po go phab byas pa

red/ kho tshos da dung myur 'grub dmag mi'i lam srol btod pa ste/ gza' 'khor 'ga' 'am zla 'ga'i rjes su dmag mi skor zhig dmag khongs nas phyir 'bud pa dang dus mtshungs su dmag mi gsar ba skor zhig bsdu len gyis dmag don sbyong brdar byas/ dus la bab tshe grangs 'bor mang ba'i dmag dpung zhig myur du sgrig chog pa red/ 'on kyang / hpha dmag gi the gtogs dang pho brang nang khul gyi tang khag re 'gas ngo rgol byas pas/ zhang ho si this rang gi bya gzhag mjug skyong ma thub par 1810lor las gnas las 'bud dgos pa byung / khu lo sa'e we tshi'ang phu dmag gi lte ba las phyir bud/ lo gsum gyi bsgyur bcos kyi grub 'bras shul med rjes med du gyur/de ni da dung ches yid phangs pa'i mjug 'bras min te/ 1811lor/nā pho lun gyi yo rob gling gi dbang shugs dar ba'i rtse mor son te khong gis dbang shugs kyis mnan pa'i rgyal khab dag la btsan skul gyis rang btsan gyi rgyal khab gcig pu ste u ru su la dpung 'jug byed du bcug nus med kyi phu lu'u hri'i rgyal bos nā pho lun la mgo sgur te hpha ran se la mna' 'brel byas/de ni phu lu'u hri mi rigs kyi ngo tsha chen po zhig yin pas/ khu lo sa'e we tshi dang kho'i grogs po tshor zhe sdang chen po bslangs/ kho tshos da ni rang gi mi rigs kyi khe dbang dang ldog pa'i dmag dpung zhig nas bya las sgrub ma 'dod par re re bzhin dmag khongs nas phyir bud/ khu lo sa'i we tshis u ru su'i dmag dpung la zhugs nas hpha dmag dang 'thab pa'i sems thag bcad/ khong gis rgyal 'tshong mkhan gyi nyes ming 'khur nas mes rgyal gyi 'thab yar gyur ba'i dgra phyogs su zhugs nas dmag 'khrug brgyab/ skyo gar 'dis kho'i sems khong la bsub thabs med pa'i rma kha bzos pa red/u ru su yi 'thab 'khrug ni khu lo sa'e we tshi brgyud pa'i dngos don gyi dmag 'khrug thengs gsum pa yin/ thengs 'di'i dmag 'khrug gis rdzutā kho

la yod 'os pa'i bgo skal ma bstsal ba red/ dmag 'khrug khrod du kho'i zhum med dpa' bo'i rang gshes dang gtong phod kyi spobs par u ru su'i mi yi gong bkur thob pa dang / byas rjes gzhan las 'phags pas hrang zho go sar 'phar na'ang / phu lu'u hri'i rgyal bos khong gis smyo rgyab gtod byas par nam yang 'khon sems bcangs yod pa red/ 1813lo'i lo stod du/ phu lu'u hri'i rgyal bo rang nyid kyis kyang hpha ran se la dmag 'khrug brda yig btang yang khu lo sa'e we tshi phyir log nas dmag 'gan 'khur bar mos mthun ma byas/ khu lo sa'i we tshis rgyal bos 'di ltar byed don ni lha kho'i rang bkur gyi 'du shes la mtshon 'debs pa yin ’ tshul gsal bor rtogs na'ang / kho rang gis lha mes rgyal la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ni nga'i gzi brjid yin la/ brnyas dmod kyi gnas bab 'og tu de la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ni de las ldab 'gyur gyi gzi brjid ldan mi pa'i yid ches brtan po bcangs/ phyi lo'i zla bar da gzod kho rang mes rgyal gyi dmag khongs su slar zhugs pa red/ de'i rjes su'ang rgyal bos sngar bzhin 6 phyogs gang thad nas kho la kha ya ma byas/mi 1818lo'i zla5bar/ rgyal pos kho'ang dmag don slob grwa dkyus ma'i slob gtsor bskos te dmagadapung gi dngos don bya las kyi phyi ru ded/ zla)ba'i tshes 9nyin/ kho rang hro cang la go 'phar byas kyang slob grwa'i sgrig lam las gzhan pa'i 5rig gzhung 'go 'dzin dang slob khrid kyi bya bar the gtogs bya mi chog ’ pa'i bka' bskos/ che mi la sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i las gnas ’ 'di'i steng nas khong gis mi lo 12la bya ba sgrub ste/ dmag mi gang rung gis skom pa chu 'dod ltar re ba pyid pa'i dmag 'khrug las byas rjes 'jog rgyu'i go skabs yongs su shor ba da/ de lta na'ang / gnas bab ngan pa 'di'i khrod du/ dmag don gzhung lu/sdu ༵ 'dis rang nyid nar son pa'i mjug mtha'i skas rim brgyud pa ste/

dmag 'khrug mang po'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug dang rang nyid dngos su brgyud pa'i dmag 'khrug la phyir rtog byas te/ dmag 'khrug tshan rig gi rgyal khams ༵ rno/ kā sdi/sa lta bu'i gsung rtsom chen mo ste 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉zhes pa lo rgyus kyi rdo ringage〈dmag 'khrug gleng bsnya1830lo'i zla8par/ khu lo sa'i we tshi gzhi nas gnas pa ngan pa de las thar te pu le si lo'i phyogs dmag dpung khag gnyis pa'i spyi lta skul ba'i las gnas su bskyod dus/ kho rang gis phal cher 'chi bdag glo bur slebs srid pa sngon dpag gis tshor ba 'dra ste/ las gnas la ma song ba'i yar sngon du rang gi mi lo du ma'i rngul khrag gis bris pa'i ma phyi dag la 6 dag sgrig zhib mo zhig byas shing re re la yang rtags bkod de nyar tshags byas rjes/ 'bral mi thub pa'i ngang rang nyid dga' ba'i bya las dang bral mib red/ ma phyi de dag ni 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba'i 〉ma phyi yin/dngos gnas/ 1831lo'i zla6par pho lan dang phu lu'u hri'i mtha' mtshams nas skyug bshal gyi nad 'gos shing / zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin glo bur nad 'phar te tshe las 'das/ dur sbas gzab rgyas ma byas la mya ngan yang chen po med par g.yul sa nas sla bcos stabs bde yis dur 'jug byas shing /ri mo phab med pa'i rdo ka ma ru'i dur byang steng du 66'di ru kha ar tpan khu lo sa'e we tshi dur sbas byas yod/ hro cang dang phyogs dmag gi lta skul dmag dpon yin/ 1780lo'i zla6pa'i tshes 1nyin skyes shing 1831lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 6nyin 'das zhes brkos yod/ tshul 'dir bsam na/ mi rnams kyis rgyal bo'i thugs brtse thob ma myong ba'i 'das po 'di myur du brjed du 'jug 'dod pa dang 'dra/ 'on kyang / mi rnams kyis dus gtan du kho rang 3sdushād

ma thub/ rgyu mtshan ni 1832lor kho'i mi nub pa'i shul bzhag gsung rtsom (dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉zhes pa dpar du bskrun pa red/ gsung rtsom 'dis kho rang la gtan du mi 'jig pa'i lo rgyus kyi rdo ring zhig bslangs/〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmag don tshan rig gi tshab mtshon bcoms chos yin la/ khyon sdom pod gsum dang yig 'bru khri 60lha sa yod/ gsung rtsom nang dmag don tshan rig gi khyab khongs gtso bo phal che ba gleng yod pa ste/ dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo dang gzhung lugs/ dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs/ dag 'thab sgyu tsal gyi lam srol/ dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi dang bsam pa'i rgyu rkyen sogs kyi gzhung lugs dang lag len la gting zab pa'i lta ba mang po bkod yod/khu lo sa'i we tshis gsung rtsom gyi nang du rang gi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi 6 ches mtho ba'i rtsa don bstan pa ste/ 6 chab srid ni dmag 'khrug sbrum pa'i ma lus lta bu yin la/ chab srid kyis dmag 'khrug bed spyad de rang gi dmigs yul 'grub thabs byed pa yin mizhes dang / 6 dmag 'khrug ni chab srid kyis lag thabs gzhan zhig spyad pa'i rgyun mthud tsam red ces so//kho'i lta ba 'di la le nyin gyis dmag 'khrug gnad don skor gyi legs bshad rma med pa yin par gdeng 'jog byed pa yin la/ zu mar khe si ring lugs kyis dmag 'khrug re re'i dgos phan la rtog zhib byed pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi'ang yin/mi don dngos su/ khu lo sa'e we tshis kyang lta ba 'di rang gis dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo dang dmag don rig gzhung la zhib 'jug byed pa'i rkang rten dang log mal byed pa yin no//kho rang gis dmag 'khrug ni g.yul sa'i 'thab 'dzing tsam min par 'dod la/ dmag 'khrug rgyag na nges par phyogs gnyis kyi chab srid dang dpa/ /pung / mtshon cha'i khyad par/ phyogs gnyis kyi thon khungs/ rgyal

khab gnyis kyi dmag don dang sa rgyus/ dmag don bsdoms rtsis dang 'byung nges pa'i dka' ngal sogs la rgyus lon bya dgos par 'dod/dngos su 'thab pa dang dmag 'khrug rang steng gi gzhi rtsa'i rtsa don thad du/ khu lo sa'e we tshis thengs dang por dmag 'khrug gi ches mtho ba'i dmigs 'ben ni dgra dpung rtsa gtor bya ba de yin pa bstan la/ ci nus kyis ches che ba'i dmag stobs bsdu rub kyis glo bur dang myur stabs/ phyir mi ldog pa'i spobs sems kyis rgol ba'i rtsa don yang bstan/ da dung phar rgol dang 'gog srung gi rtsa don rgyas bshad byas pa dang dmag thabs 'di gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba dang phan tshun la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen sogs bshad yod/ mang tshogs kyi 'thab 'dzing gleng dus/ kho rang gis mang tshogs kyi 'thab 'dzing ni me dpung zhig dang 'dra bar dgra bo'i gnas gzhi bsregs te de'i srog la rgol bar nus zhes bstan/ gzhan yang / sems khams kyis rgyal kha thob par nus pa ci 'dra 'don tshul dang / dmag spyi'i 'jon nus dang dmag dpung gi ngang rgyud/mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i stobs shugs sogs la zhib 'jug zab mo byas yod/khu lo sa'i we tshis bstan pa'i gong gi rtsa don 'di dag la/ mi'i rigs kyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po dang gnyis pa sogs dmag 'khrug che 'bring chung gsum brgyud rjes kyi de ring yang da dung gnas lugs dang ldan pa kun gyis khas len byed/ 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉da bar du thengs 20tsam la bskyar du dpar ba dang 'dzam gling gi yig rigs sna tshogs su bsgyur nas khyab brdal du song zhing 'gro bzhin mchis/ dus rabs 'di'i lo rabs 80bar a ris dpar skrun byas pa'i 〈pu le ten shes bya kun btus chen mo'i dmag 'khrug mdzub ston 〉zhes par/ 6 khu lo sa'e we tshi'i mi nub pa'i gsung rtsom 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉zhes pa phyogs yongs nas dmag don rig gzhung la zhib 'jug byed pa'i ches legs pa'i bcoms chos yin par ngo ga~X mi

dgos pa zhig ste/ tshad nges can zhig gi stong nas bshad na/ khong gi gsung rtsom ni 'thab jus rig pa'i gsung rab yin ’ zhes bkod yod/ de'i dbang gis/ kun gyis kho rang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi ches mtho ba'i dmag don gyi dbang grags mi snar brtsi la/ 6 ches thog ma'i 'thab jus rig pa ba dang deng rabs 'thab jus rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi shing rta'i srol 'byed yin par brtsi ba red/ kho rang gi 〈dmag 'khrug gleng ba 〉yang 'byor ldan gral rim gyi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi tshad ldan btsams chos gtso bor bzhaga'ong 'phyi ba'i mtshan snyan 'di dag thob par kho rang ngo gnong mi dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang / kho rang gis dmag don gzhung lugs kyi 'phel rgyas ni dus dang bstun dgos te/ dus rabs 'gyur tshe nges par de dang mthun pa'i dmag don gzhung lugs gsar ba 'byung 'os zhes bshad pa ltar/ dmag 'khrug steng gi spyi 'gros dang rtsa don dag gtan nas mi 'gyur ba zhig ye nas med cing / dus rabs re rer rang gi dmag 'khrug yod la rang gi dmag 'khrugagazhung lugs kyang 'byung nges pa yin pas/ khu lo sa'i we tshi'i dmag don gzhung lugs la yod 'os pa'i lo rgyus kyi go gnas yod na'ang gtan du mi 'jig pa'i bden lugs yin mi srid/ kho rang gi lta tshul re 'ga' ni nor 'khrul gyi lta tshul yin te/ dper na/ kho rang gis dmag 'khrug ni phyi'i srid jus kyi rgyun mthud tsam yin par 'dod pa las/ dmag 'khrug dang nang srid bar gyi 'brel ba ngos ma zin pa ma zad/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ chab srid dang spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi/ chab srid dang gral rim 'thab rtsod sogs so sor bkar ba red/ kho rang gis dmag 'khrug gi spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo dang spyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin gsed 'grol ma byas pa'i dbang gis/ bye brag gi dmag 'khrug gleng dus/ dmag 'khrug gi btsan 'dzul rang bzhin nam bden don radi ༵༵na sogs gsal bor brjod thabs med par gyur ba red/

hri le thin dang lha hri le thin 'char gzhi/ ’phu'ukṣa chon/'jar man gyi 'byor ldan gral rim dmag don gzhung lugs pa ā ar spru le te hphan hri le hphin gyis 6 hri le hphin 'char gzhi gtan 'beb byas pa'i dbang gis 'dzam gling la snyan grags khyab pa red/ 'jar man tho 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang spro po'i steng nas pham nyes byung ste 'char ste hrileḥn gzhi 'di rtsa ba nas thor zhig tu song na'ang / kho rang gi lta tshul gyis thengs gnyis pa'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen sngon gyu bye/ra man dmag dpung gi dmag don bsam blo la shugs rkyen chen po ma'o chirgan pa'i dad ldan gyi rjes 'brang ba/hri le hphin ni 1833lor phu lu'u hri'i zhing bdag cig gi khyim du skyes/yabani phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung gi hro cang zhig yin/ hri le hphin gyis por lin slob chen(7sgom༈)nas slob gnyer byed skabs phu lu'u hri'i dmag dpung la zhugs/ 1856lor srung dmag gi hro we 'khur zhing / lo gnyis kyi rjes su rkang dmag slob chen 'grims/ kho rang gis slob sbyong la bzlo/ pa

bskyed de dmag 'khrug lo rgyus dang 'thab jus dmag rtsal la zhib 'jug byed dus/ ma'o chi'i(charsha)〈mtshon cha legs bcos kyis dmag rtsal la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen skor gleng ba 〉zhes pas yid sems yongs su bkug ste de'i dad ldan gyi rjes 'brang bar 'gyur 'go brtsams/ma'o chi'i ming hril bor ho ar ma'o thi khu ar po in hwa ti ma'o chi (1800— 1891)zer zhing / kho rang gi tsha bo ho ar ma'o thi lo han lu'u ti we chi ma'o chi dang dbye ba 'byed phyir kho rang gi ming la mi rnams kyis ma'o chi rgan pa zhes 'bod pa yin/ mtho chi rgan pa ni skabs de'i 'jar man dmag dpung gi drag jus dmag dpon yin la/ kho rang gi lta ba ni dgra bo'i sngon du myur stabs kyis phar rgol bya ba de yin pa dang / 'gog srung 'thab jus la mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byed pa red/ hri le hphin gyis ma'o chi la mi phyed pa'i dad pa byed pa yin/ de ni kho rang gis ma'o chi'i rtsom yig re gnyis bklags pa'i rkyen kho na tsam min par kho rang gi 'thab jus dang dmag rtsal la sems gting nas dga' mos byed pa'i dbang gis red/1866lo'i zla6bar/ phu lu'u hri dang o si khru ri ya gnyis kyis 'jar man gyi rgyal khongs 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i dmag 'khrug brgyab/ hri le hphin ni 'jar man dmag dpung gi skya dmag dmag khag dang po'i drag jus pa'i tshul du g.yul la zhugs/ kho rang ma'o chi gon pas bkod 'doms byas pa'i rgyal pham rting thag gcod pa'i khu nye ku le tshi'i dmag 'khrug(mtha lkocholo7)la dngos su zhugs shing / thengs de'i dmag 'khrug khrod du ma'o chi rgan pas myur 'thab myur rgyal gyi dmag jus bkol nas/ dmag mi hrag bsdus khri 29yis dgra dmag khri 23meg med bzos pa red/ 6 dmag 'khrug thengs de las rgyal ba tsam ma zad/ dmag 'khrug hril bor rgyal kha thob tu bcug pa'i ’ dpa/ /thab kyi dpe mtshon des hri le hphin la bag chags zab mo bzhag la/

kho rang gi rjes phyogs kyi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi zhib 'jug dang 'thab jus 'char gzhi gtan 'beb byed par phan nus chen po byung /1870lor/ hri le hphin rkang dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gi drag jus dmag dpon gyi tshul du ming grags che ba'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ phu dmag gi don ngo ma'i dbang cha tshang yod pa'i bkod 'doms pa ni zu rgyal bo'i bkod 'doms khang gi dmag yongs kyi dmag spyi chen mo ma'o chi rgan pa yin/ kho rang gis phu dmag 384000de khag gsum du bgos shing /phan tshun zung 'brel dang kha bkar nas bskor rdung byed pa'i thabs kyis hpha dmag pham par byas te si tang(4zo)bar du phyir 'then byas/ zlamiba'i tshes 2nyin/ nā pho lun sku phreng gsum pas sne drangs pa'i hpha dmag khri 10yis si tang nas mgo btags/ der mthud nas phu dmag thad kur dpung skyod kyis rgyal sa pa li bskor/ hri le hphin gyis dmag 'khrug thengs 'di'i khrod nas ma'o chi rgan pa sogs kyi dmag mi hrag bsdus kyis myur rgol byed pa'i 'thab jus de lag len dang slob sbyong byed thub pa byung / kho rang la dmag 'khrug khrod du byas rjes yod pas rim pa dang po'i lcags kyi rgya gram gyi rtags ma bstsal zhing hro zho la go 'phar byas/phu hpha dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ hri le hphin gyis dmag khag gi drag jus pa'i 'gan 'khur te ma'o chi rgan pa'i blor bab pas/ 1876lor skya dmag thon dang po'i thon krang dang krung zho'i go thob sprad/ lo 7gyi rjes su/kho rang spyi khyab drag jus khang la phyir blangs te khru'u krang gi 'gan sprad/ des kho rang la ma'o chi rgan pa'i dmag don bsam blor slob sbyong byed pa'i go skabs bzang bo thob/ 1888lor hri le hphin spyi'i dmag chas lta skul dmag dpon du go 'phar byas/ kho rang gi chab srid dang dmag don gyi lta tshul mtho chi gan pa'i shul du spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon gyi 'gan blangs pa'i dmag 3)sbyan

wa ti zhi (khrosam)yis do snang byas pa dang / cang ma 'gor bar wa ti zhi yi lag rogs pa gtso bor gyur/myur 'thab myur rgyal smra ba/1891lor pho lo 58la son pa'i hri le hphin gyis wa ti zhi'i go sa rgyud 'dzin gyis 'jar man dmag dpung gi spyi khyab drag jus pa'i las 'gan 'khur/ dus der 'jar man ni ma rtsa ring lugs nas btsan rgyal ring lugs la bskyod pa'i sgang yin pas phyi phyogs las rgya bskyed par gra sgrig byed/ 'jar man gyi rgyal bo we len sku phreng gnyis pas(tsho sgo7)'dzam gling la rgya bskyed pa'i 6 'dzam gling srid jus ’ bton la/ gung blon pe lo chus dzinyi 'od 'og gi sa khul la re ba 'don zhes pa bsgrags/ spobs sems kyis khengs pa'i hri le hphin gyis spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon 'khur nas lo ngo 16'das pa'i ring rme/ ma'o chi rgan pa ltar dngos su dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms byas ma myong na'ang / kho rang gis 'jar man btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i phyi'i srid jus kyi dgos mkho ltar/ dmag dpung sgrig 'dzugs dang dmag don gzhung lugs la zhib 'jug byas/hri le hphin gyis thog mar 'jar man dmag dpung gi spyi khyab drag jus khang la dag ther dang bskyar sgrig byas/ kho rang gis spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon gyi 'os 'gan gtso bo ni g.yul 'gyed kyi thog ma'i 'char gzhi gtan 'bebs bya ba de yin pa gtan la phab/ 'os 'gan de'i dgos mkho ltar sngar gyi kho'o 11de kho'o 16du 'phar zhing / dmag dpon 50nas 162la 'phar bsgon byas/ spyi khyab drag jus khang gi mi sna yongs la sbyong brdar nan mo byas te dmag 'khrug dngos kyi dgos mkho dang bstun ci thub byas/320jar man dmag gi dmag 'khrug gi nus pa mthor 'degs bya ched/

hri le hphin gyis dmag mkho'i yo chas rgya bskyed pa'i 'dod tshul bcangs/ kho rangagis rgyal yongs kyi lcags lam gyi dra ba dang gzhung lam gyi dra ba/ bzo las/ tha na 'jar man mi dmangs kyi bsam blo sogs yod tshad dmag 'khrug gi dgos mkho dang 'tshams dgos tshul bsgrags/ 1893lor/ kho rang dang dmag khongs kyi mi sna gtso bo 'ga'i skul 'ded 'og 'jar man rgyal tshogs kyis dmag dpung rgya bskyed pa'i srol yig cig la chog mchan bkod/ srol yig ltar du/ dmag dpung gi grangs 'bor nam rgyun gyi 58900steng du 1899lor dmag mi 3lugatsam kha bsgon byas/ dus mtshungs su/ hri le hphin gyis dmag dpon gyi bkod 'doms sgyu rtsal la sbyong brdar byed par shugs bsnan zhing skabs de'i sngon thon gyi lag rtsal gyis dmag yongs la drag chas spro bar 'dod/ 1896lor/ 'jar man gyis thog mar myur 'pher me skyogs dpe gsar zhig rkang dmag la sgrig sbyor byas pa red/hri le hphin gyis spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon gyi las 'gan 'khur dus/mi ring ba'i 'byung 'gyur la 'jar man gyis yo rob gling la g.yul sprod skabs 'thab jus dang dmag tsal ci 'dra bkol rgyu'i skor la zhib 'jug byas/ phu hpha dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ 'jar man gyi dmag don gzhung lugs pa rnams kyis ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug khrod 'jar man gyis phyogs gnyis la ji ltar g.yul sprod par bgro gleng byed bzhin yod/ phyogs gnyis ni nub phyogs dbyin ji dang hpha ran se dang shar phyogs u ru su gnyis la dus mnyam por g.yul sprod pa de'o// skabs thog de'i dmag don gzhung lugs kyi rtsod gzhi gtso bo ni gnyis te/ gcig ni ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'thab de myur 'thab dmag 'khrug dang rgyun ring po'i dmag 'khrug gnyis las gang yin dgos pa dang / gnyis ni 'jar man gyis 'thab ra gnyis nas ci ltar dmag 'khrug byed pa de'o// hri le hphin gyis rtsod gzhi 'di gnyis rmang gzhi byas (2 /ba

'jug gis rim gyis rang gi dmag don gzhung lugs chags pa red/myur 'thab myur rgyal ni hri le hphin gyi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi rmang gzhi yin/ kho rang gis blo thag chod pos ma 'ongs pa'i dmag 'khrug de rgyun ring bo'i dmag 'khrug min par nges par myur 'thab myur rgyal gyi dmag 'khrug yin zhes bshad/ kho rang gis dpal 'byor gyi ngos nas bsam blo btang ste sdom tshig 'di rnyed pa yin te/ ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug stong du khri dmag brgya tsho 'ga' bkol na 'gro song sgor dung phyur bcu phrag 'ga' gtong dgos pas/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og nas rgyun ring bo'i dmag 'khrug rgyag pa ni dpe mi srid par 'dod la/ dmag 'khrug gi rgyun ring na dpal 'byor rtsa thor dang bkres ltogs byung nas dmag mi'i ngar shugs nyams pa sogs kyi gnas tshul 'byung nges pa red/ hri le hphin gyi myur 'thab dmag 'khrug gi bsam blo 'di ni khu lo sa'e we tshi dang ma'o chi rgan pa'i 'thab jus kyi rtsa don 'phel rgyas byas pa'i 'bras bu yin/ dus rabs 19ba'i lo rabs 30bar/ khu lo sa'e we tshis spyi'i rgyal pham rting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug ni 6 dmag 'khrug hril bo'i gtso gnad yin mi pa dang / myur 'thab myur rgyal ni dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob pa'i 'gag rtsa yin par 'dod la/dus tshod kun las gtso che ba las mkhar rdzong dang sa cha 'phrog pa ni phal ba yin par snyam/ khu lo sa'e we tshi'i 'thab jus bsam blo 'di dang rang nyid dngos su zhugs pa'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug dang phu o dmag 'khrug sogs ma'o chi rgan pas bkod 'doms byas pa'i dmag 'khrug gi nyams myong zung 'brel byas pa brgyud nas/ kho rang gis bshad don 'thab jus kyi ngo bo ni dgra bo pham bar bya ba tsam min par/ dgra bo rtseg med bzo ba de yin la/ 'thab jus kyi ches mtho ba'i grub 'bras ni 6 rgyal pham rting thag gcod pa'i dmag 'ardi/ /da nas dgra bo'i drag chas ru dpung rtsa med bzos te dmag 'khrug

hril bor rgyal kha thob pa'i dmigs yul 'grub dgos /zhes bshad pa red/'on kyang / hri le hphin gyi myur 'thab myur rgyal gyi bsam blo ni gdong thad nas phar rgol bya ba de min par/ mi lo stong phrag gnyis lhag gi sngon du hwan nye po yis ro ma dmag dpung la bkol ba'i 'thab jus de gzhogs zur gnyis nas rgol rdung byed pa de yin/ kho rang gi sems la/ dmag 'khrug chen po'i khrod du myur 'thab myur rgyal bya ched/ dmag don gyi dgos mkho ltar lag thabs yod tshad spyod dgos la/ tha na tshul min gdug rtsub kyi bya thabs kyang bkol dgos par 'dod/ hri le hphin gyi myur 'thab dmag 'khrug gi bsam blo ni 'jar man gyi phyogs gnyis la g.yul sprod dgos byung ba'i gnas bab 'og gi bshol med kyi gdam ga zhig yin zhing / 'jar man btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul rang bzhin dang nyen mchong rang bzhin rjen par mtshon pa yin/ hri le hphin gyis drang bo drang bzhag gis 6 'jar man gyis bltas bltas rig rig la dgra sha len 'dod pa'i dgra bor go skabs thob tu 'jug mi rung /mi 66'jar man nges par rang dbang gis 'tsho gnas bya dgos la/ dgos mkhor thug tshe lag thabs 'di bkol dgos pa yin/ go skabs dam por bzung na da gzod phan 'bras 'byung thub ’ ces bshad/'jar man gyis ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug khrod ji ltar phyogs gnyis lagayul sprod pa'i gnad don skor la/ hri le hphin gyi lta tshul ni 'jar man gyis shar phyogs 'thab ra nas rgyal kha chen po len mi thub pas nges par nub phyogs nas 'jar man gyi las dbang thag gcod dgos par 'dod/ da dung 'jar man dmag dpung phyogs gnyis la g.yul sprod pa las byol dgos la thog ma'i rting thag chod pa'i phar rgol de nub phyogs 'thab ra nas byed dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bton pa red/ hri le hphin gyis skabs de'i 'jar hpha mtha' mtshams dang 'jar u mtha' mtshams kyi stobs shugs skor la dbye zhi~X shās

te thob pa'i sdom tshig ni/ 'jar u mtha' mtshams su u ru sus sngar nas sra brtan gyi 'thab ra bskrun yod la/ lcags lam 'grim 'grul nus pa mthor 'degs byas yod pas u ru su'i dmag mi brje spor nus pa legs pa ma zad/sa rgya ha cang che bas myur 'thab dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob rgyu khag po yin/de ltar byas na hpha ran ses kyang gza' 'khor gnyis kyi nang du 'jar man la tshur rgol byed thub pas 'jar man gyis dus gcig gi nang du phyogs gnyis la g.yul sprod dgos par 'gyur/ gal te/ thog mar hpha ran se la phar rgol byas na/ u ru sus gza' 'khor drug gi rjes su ma gtogs 'jar man la dpung 'jug byed mi thub pas/ de'i ring la 'jar man gyis hpha ran se cham la phab ste phyir 'khor nas u ru su la phar rgol gyis re re bzhin rtsa gtor byed pa'i dmigs yul mngon 'gyur bya thub pa de'o// 1892lo'i zla8pa'i bar du/hri le hphin gyis ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug khrod du thog mar hpha ran se la phar rgol byed pa'i 'thab jus gtan 'beb byas zin pa red/hri le hphin gyis spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon gyi dbang cha spyad nas thabs brgya jus stong gis rang gi dmag don gyi gzhung lugs dang dmag don bsam blo de 'jar man gyi dmag dpon dang dmag mi yongs kyi rgyud la bzhagade'i ched du kho rang gis sgrig srol mang po bzos la gzhi rgya che ba'i dmag don dngos sbyong bstud mar byas/ hri le hphin gyis 'thab jus dang dmag rtsal la zhib 'jug byed don ni 'jar man dmag dpung la cha tshang zhing zhib phra ldan pa'i dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi zhig gtan 'beb byed pa'i ched du yin/ mi lo 10lhag gi gra sgrig brgyud de 1905lo'i zla 12pa nas 1906lo'i zla 1pa'i bar du gzhi nas 6 hri le hphin 'char gzhi mi dngos su chags pa red/1906lor/ hri le hphin spyi khyab drag jus pa'i go sa nas phab kyang kho rang gi /sdus don lta tshul gyis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i sngon gyi

'jar man dmag gi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi khrod du dbang sgyur gyi go gnasabazung yod/ 2 hri le hphin 'char gzhi mi yang 'jar man spyi khyab drag jus khang gis 'jar man dmag dpung gis 'thab 'khrug byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i tshad gzhir 'dzin pa red/6 hri le zin 'char gzhi dang de thor zhig tu song tshul/smyo hri le hphin 'char gzhi yi nang don gtso bo ni ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug khrod du 'jar man gyis hpha ran se la ji ltar rdung rdeg byed pa de yin pas/ de'i ming dngos la (gla ran se la g.yul sprod pa'i brjed tho 〉zer/6 hri le hphin 'char gzhi'i :snying bo ni/ dmag dpung hrag bsdus kyis nub phyogs 'thab ra nas pi li hri(77)lo)dngalu tsem pog(906)ho lan bcas brgyud nas gzhogs zur nas hpha ran se bskor te rmeg med g.yul 'khrug dang myur stabs g.yul 'khrug gi 'thab jus lag bstar byas te hpha ran se cham la phab pa dang / der mthud nas dmag dpung shar phyogs su bskyod de u ru su la rgol rdung bya rgyu de yin/ 'char gzhi 'dis shar nub gnyis la dmag dpung bkod sgrig byed tshul ni/ shar phyogs 'thab ras 1710gi dmag stobs te phal cher hri 9tsam las las bkol med la o dmag dang hang ga ri'i(7skyas/)dmag dpung dang mnyam 'brel gyis u dmag 'gog pa dang / nub phyogs su hri 78bsdus shing dmag khag g.yas g.yon gnyis su bgos yod/ de gnyis las kyang hri 70yi dmag mi g.yas ru la bsdus yod/dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams ma thag tu g.yon rus hpha dmag gi gtso shugs la phar rgol byed pa dang / g.yas ru gsang stabs kyis pi li hri dang lu tsem pogaho lan bcas brgyud de 'gog srung med pa'i hpha ran se'i byang phyogs mtha' mtshams brgal zhing zhin wa tshi gtsang rgyud(777777)bskor na~X 2sbya li

la dpung 'jug byed cing / de nas dmag dpung shar lhor dpung skyod kyis hpha dmag gi gtso shugs shar phyogs su 'ded 'dod pa red/ hri le hphin gyi 'dod tshul ni gal te dmag 'khrug gi gnas tshul bde blag yin na g.yas ru g.yon ru gnyis kyis mnyam du dgra bor bskor rdung byas chog par lems la/ gza' 'khor 6nas 8kyi nang du nub phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug yongs su mjug sgril chog par 'dod pa red/ hri le hphin gyis spro snang gis sngon dpag bya don/ dmag stobs zhan pa'i g.yon ru la pham nyes byung nas hpha dmag 'jar man gyi mnga' khongs su slebs na'ang / 'jar man la sngar bzhin rgyal kha thob thub par bsams te/ rgyu mtshan ni 'jar man dmag dpung gis hpha ran se dang pi li hri'i mtsho ngogs bzung yod pas/ hpha dmag gi mna' 'brel dmag dpung dbyin ji ba'i rgyab rogs thob mi thub phyin/ hpha dmag rtseg med du btang chog par 'dod pa red/yin na'ang / hri le hphin gyi 'thab jus kyi 'char gzhi 'di 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i thog ma'i zla ba'i nang du rtsa ba nas thor zhig tu gyur ba red/ dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus rim nang du/ hpha dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis 'jar man gyi dmag dpung gis pi li hri dang hpha ran se'i mtha' mtshams nas glo bur rgol 'ong snyam pa yid la'ang ma shar bar/gtso shugs dmag dpung 'jar man gyi mtha' mtshams pe ar tru(777)nas ye ar sung(777)gi 'thab ra'i steng du bkod sgrig byas pa red/mjug mthar 'jar man gyi dmag dpung gis hpha ran se'i rgyal mtshams brtol te thad kur mā en gtsang bo'i ngogs su 'byor te/ pa li ha cang nyen 'gag gnas su gyar/ yin yang hpha dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi bskyar du sgrig ste/ 'jar man gyi g.yas ru'i da~X pya 'gog rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs la kha snon byas shing / dmag

dpung hrag bsdus kyis pa li srung skyob byas/ 1914lo'i zla)ba'i tshes 5nyin nas zla)pa'i tshes 10nyin bar du/ 'jar man dang hpha ran se gnyis kyis mā en gtsang rgyud gyi ring tshad spyi le 2①yod pa'i 'thab ra'i steng du g.yul 'gyed byas/ phyogs gnyis kyi dmag mi khri 150lhag dang me skyogs stong drug bdun tsam g.yul la zhugs shing / mjug mthar/ 'jar dmag phyir 'then byas te dmag 'khrug mjug sgril/ 'jar man dmag gi myur 'thab dmag 'khrug de'i dbang gis thor zhig tu song ba red/ra hri le hphin 'char gzhi ’ la 'jar man dmag don lo rgyus steng du bsub thabs med pa'i go sa yod de/ dper na/ des gtan 'beb byas pa'i dmag stobs gcig bsdus kyis dgra bo'i blo yul las 'das par 'jab rgol byed pa sogs kyis dmag 'khrug gi thog ma'i dus rim nang du rgyal kha chen po blangs pa lta bu red/ yin na'ang / spyi'i cha nas bltas na/ 'char gzhi 'dir thog ma nyid nas cis kyang thor zhig tu 'gro nges pa'i rgyu rkyen lhan skyes su yod pa yin te/ gcig ni hri le hphin gyis phyi'i gnas tshul gyi 'gyur ldog la do snang ma byas par dmag 'khrug ma langs ba'i yar sngon du 'jar man dmag la cha tshang ba'i dmag 'khrug gi 'char gzhi gtan 'beb byas pa red/ ‘ hri le hphin 'char gzhi mi gtan 'beb byed pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa ni 1905lo'i skabs kyi 'jar man gyi rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang gi gnas tshul yin la/ 1914lor 'jar man gyi mig mdun byung ba'i gnas bab la 'gyur ldog chen po byung 'dug pa ste/ u ru su'i dmag stobs je cher phyin cing hpha ran ses kyang dmag shugs dang dmag chas rgya bskyed de 'jar man dang khyod shi nga gson gyis 'thab par gra sgrig byed pa red/ gnas bab 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/ 'jar man gyis da dung yang myur 'thab kyis rgyal kha len 'dod pa ni pham pa'i rgyu yin pa smos ci dgos/dmag don gzhung lugs pa re 'gas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dazlo zlo'i

nang du 'jar man pham don ni ma'o chi gzhon pas hri le hphin 'char gzhi ji bzhin lag bstar ma byas pas lan pa red zer ba ni gzur gnas kyi gtam du ma mthong ste/ hpha ran se la phar rgol byed dus/ 'jar man dmag gi spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon yin pa'i ma'o chi gzhon pas g.yas ru'i hri 70yi dmag stobs de hri 59du 'phri 'then byas pa ni gnas tshul gyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun pa zhig red/ gnyis pa ni hri le hphin gyis 'jar man rang gi stobs shugs la tshod dpog byas pa thal che ba dang / hpha ran se dang dbyin ji/ u ru su'i stobs shugs la tshod dpog byas pa dma' song bas red/ kho rang gi sems la/'jar man gyi dmag don dang dpal 'byor gyi stobs shugs kyis kho rang gi 'charagazhi 'grub par khag theg bya thub la/ hpha ran ses 'jar man dpung chen gyi rgol ba 'gog mi thub pa dang / u ru su ni 1905lo'i gsar brje'i gnod skyon thebs pa'i dbang gis myur du dmag dpung rtsa 'dzugs byed mi nus pa/ pi li hris ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu bya mi srid par 'dod pa dang /dbyin ji la do snang cher ma byas/ don ngo mar/ skabs thog de'i stobs shugs la gshib bsdur byas na/ 'jar man dmag dpung la hpha dmag theg med bzo ba'i stobs shugs med pa dang / 'jar man gyi dpal 'byor yang hpha ran se dang dbyin ji/ u ru su las rgyal ba'i tshad la slebs med pa red/ de bas/ dbyin dang hpha/ pi li hri'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis 'jar man gyis tshur rgol la kha gtad bcag pa dang u dmag gis shar phyogs nas dpung 'jug byas te/ 'jar man ni phyogs gnyis la g.yul sprod dgos pa'i gnas su byar ba red/ gsum pa ni hri le hphin gyis 'char gzhi 'di 'jar man btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul ham sems kyi dgos mkhor bstun nasagatan 'beb byas pa zhig yin pas/ rgyal spyi'i steng du grogs med kher hrerdo/ riganas su gyar nges par bsam blo ma btang ba red/ kho rang gis smyo

ham chen pos hpha ran se la g.yul sprod dus 6 khu nye ku le tshi'i g.yul 'gyed mi dam 6 khu nye ku le tshi'i g.yul 'gyed las lhag pa'i ’ dmag 'khrug cig rgyag rgyu yin tshul bsgrags/ rgyal kha thob pa'i ched du bar sdod rgyal khab pi li hri sogs kyi khe dbang la gnod par ma ltos pas/ rgyal khab gzhan dag khong khro langs srid pa smos med red/hri le hphin 1906lor go gnas las babs rjes/ sngar bzhin dmag don gzhung lugs dang ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi la zhib 'jug dang 'bri rtsom byas te/ 'jar man drag jus khang la mu mthud du shugs rkyen bzos/ kho rang gis snga gzhug tu (khen nye'i dmag 'khrug 〉dang (deng rabs dmag 'khrug〉 (spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa〉 〈khu nye ku le tshi g.yul 'gyed 〉sogs brtsams nas dmag don lo rgyus steng gi dpe gson pos rang gi 'thab jus rtsa don dang dmag don bsam blo rgyas bshad byas/ 1911lor/ kho rang la rkang dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo'i mtshan thob gnang / 1912lor khong gis yang bskyar hpha ran se dang u ru su la g.yul sprod pa'i brjed tho bcoms shing phyogs yongs nas dpung 'jug byed pa'i gzhung lugs bstan/ 1912lo'i zla 12bar/ hri le hphin nad yams kyi dbang gis mal sar lhung / bshad pa ltar na/ kho rang sku gshegs khar yang nad khri'i steng nas shab shub tu 6 dmag 'khrug de cis kyang 'byung srid/ nges par g.yas ru la shugs snon dgos ’ zhes bshad/ 1913lo'i zla 1ba'i tshes 4nyin/ hri le hphin per lin du gshegs/ gshegs dus dgung lo 8zhal pon yod/333

'dzom gling 'khrug chen dang po'isalas kyi hpha dmag gi spyi khyababakod 'doms lazhwa the/wu'uta chon/dmag 'khrug lo rgyus steng du nam rgyun 'di 'dra'i snang tshul yod de/dmag spyi re 'ga' zhig dus rgyun du 'jon nus dkyus ma'i tshad du gnas na'ang / gnad 'gag gi skabs su khyad du 'phags pa'i 'jon nus ngom ste dmag 'khrug thengs shig gam tha na g.yul 'gyed thengs shig gi rgyal kha len srid pa red/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs kyi hpha dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa zhwa the(1852 — 1931lo)ni de lta bu'i dmag don pa zhig yin zhing / hpha ran se'i dmag don lo rgyus steng du snyan grags chen po yod/lag rtsal dmag dpon nas spyi khyab bkod 'doms dmag dpon du 'phar ba/yo sig chu lnga khu sa'e tse ar zhu hphe ni hpha ran se'i zo ba bzo mkhan zhig gi khyim du skyes/ kho rang gi mes po hpha ran se la btsan byol du yong pa'i si phen gyi sku drag yin la skabs der khyim tshang dbul zhing phongs/ zhwa hphe la ming sring 11yod cing kho rang bu che ba yin/ pho lo 16la son pa'i lo der/ zhwa hphe bzo rtsal sna 'dzoms ched gnyer slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod de ar las dang dmag don bzo skrun gyi phyogs la slob gnyer byas/ 187)lor/ phu hpha dmag 'khrug langs pas kho rang gis slob gnyer bskyur te pa li la srung skyob byed pa'i dmag do/ nādzugs bskrun la zhugs/ 1872lor/ kho rang dmag la zhugs shing

dmag mi'i 'tsho ba 'go bcoms/ krung we go thob bstsal la lo bzhi'i rjes su hrang we la 'phar/ 1883lor/ zhwa hphe ni hpha ran ses krung go la btsan 'dzul byed pa'i krung hpha dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ dmag khag dang lhan du tha'e wan du bca' sdod byas/ 1886lor/ kho rang spyi khyab bzo bkod pa'i go thang 'khyer nas an nan bzo skrun dmag don slob gling du las 'gan 'khur/zhwa hphe 1888lor pa li ru 'byor zhing hpha dmag gi spyi khyab dmag don bzo skrun cus su phyin/ phyis su hpha dmag gi dngos sbyong slob grwa'i slob dpon chen mo byas/ 1892lor/ bka' ltar hphe gling la song nas mi ser spel ba'i dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ se ne gal(2850lo)du dmag don gyi bzo skrun khag 'dzugs bskrun byas pas thengs dang por bya dga'i rtags ma thob/ lo 'ga'i rjes su ma ta ka si khar(6775lo10)du gnas spor/ 1899lor hrang zho'i go sar 'phar ba dang 1905lor hro cang la 'phar/ skabs de dag du khong gis lu'e krang dang hri krang / cun krang sogs dmag 'gan 'khur/zhwa hphe ni bzo skrun dmag mi'i tshul du dmag la zhugs pa yin la/ skabs de'i hpha ran se ru dmag khag 'di nas dmag spyi chen mo mi 'byung bar 'dod pa red/ 'on kyang / yun ring gi dmag mi'i 'tsho ba brgyud pa dang lhag par bzo skrun lag rtsal gyi ched las kyi dbang gis zhwa hphe yis gzab brling dang dngangs 'tshab med pa/ las 'gan 'grub thabs byed pa'i gshes ka goms par byas pas kun gyi yid rton thob/ 1910lor/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen je nyer 'gyur bzhin pa'i sgang la zhwa hphe hpha ran se'i ches mtho ba'i dmag don bkod 'doms las khungs te/ ches mtho ba'i dmag don u yon lhan khang gi u yon dang hpha dmag gi rgyab phyogs zhabs 'degs kyi spyi'i lta skul bar bskos pa red/ 1911lor/ zhwa hphe hpha ran se'i ches mtho ba'i dmag don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dang spyi khyab bkod 'doms dmag dpon 3)/ga

lcogs byas/ 1914lor 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po langs rjes/hpha ran se'i dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi la bskos/ dus der zhwa hphe yis bshad don 6 ngas dmag dpung la bkod 'doms kyis rgyal kha len nges yin/ bya ba ci zhig sgrub kyang ngas byas rjes 'jog par 'bad pa bya nges yin mi zhes bshad/thengs dang po'i 'dzam gling 'khrug chen khrod du/ zhwa hphe ni 'thab na mi rgyal ba med pa'i dmag dpon zhig min yang / kho rang gis bkod 'doms byas pa'i mā en gtsang bo'i g.yul 'khrug dang hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug sogs gnad 'gag gi g.yul 'gyed tshang mar rgyal kha thob pa red/1916lor kho rang la dmag spyi'i go thob gnang /mā en gtsang bo'i g.yul 'khrugamāsan gtsang bo'i g.yul 'khrug ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po 'go brtsams ma thag dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung dang 'jar man dmag dpung gnyis hpha ran se'i mā en gtsang po'i rgyud du gnad 'gag gi g.yul 'khrug thengs shig brgyab pa de la zer/g.yul 'khrug thengs de ni 'jar dmag gi myur rgol gyis hpha dmag bstud mar pham pa'i gnas bab 'og brgyab pa yin/ hpha ran se'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis 1872lo nas bzung 'jar man la ji ltar g.yul sprod pa'i dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi 16tsam bzos na'ang tshang ma dmag 'khrug dngos kyi re 'dun dang mi 'tshams pas/ zhwa hphe yis spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa'i las 'gan 'khur rjes/ 〈'char gzhi ang 17pa 〉bzo 'go btsams shing 1913lo'i zla par gtan 'beb byas/ 'on kyang / kho rang gi 'char gzhi 'di la'ang dngos yod dang mi mthun pa'i rmongs tshod kyi rang bzhin tsharshaswā ༵ ba ste/ dang po ni zhwa hphe yi sems la 'jar man dmag dpung gi

dpung 'jug lam thig de sngon dpag byed mi nus pa zhig yin par 'dod pa'i dbang gis/ rtsa don gyi steng nas hpha ran se'i shog sgrig dmag dpung re res phyogs gang rung nas rgol nges pa'i dgra bor kha gtad ji ltar gcog tshul gtan la phab pa tsam yin/ gnyis pa'i 'char gzhi de ltar na/ 'jar man dmag dpung gis u ru su'i dmag dpung gis phar rgol 'gog srung byed dgos pas/ nub phyogs 'thab rar hri 68kyi dmag stobs las yong mi srid pa dang de yang 'jar hpha mtha' mtshams su bsdu rub byed nges par 'dod/ de ltar zhwa hphe yis hri 79yi dmag dpung dang skya dmag hri 10yi dmag stobs de 'jar man dang hpha ran se'i mtha' mtshams su bkod sgrig byas/ don ngo mar/'jar dmag gi dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi de phal cher hri le hphin gyis 1905 1906lo'i bar gtan phab byas pa'i 'char gzhi de ma gzhir byas pa red/'char gzhi des yo rob gling gi 'thab ra de shar nub gnyis su phyes shing /dmag stobs gtso bo nub phyogs 'thab ra'i g.yas ru'i phyogs su bsdus yod la/ hri 70yi dmag dpung gsang stabs kyi pi le hri dang ho lan brgyud nas 'gog srung med pa'i hpha ran se'i byang phyogs mtha' mtshams brtol te myur 'thab kyis hpha ran se cham la phab rjes/ kha phyir 'khor nas shar phyogs kyi u ru su la 'thab rgyu de red/ 1914lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 1nyin/ 'jar dmag gis 'char gzhi ltar nub phyogs 'thab rar dpung 'jug byas/ cung mi 'dra sa ni 'jar dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa ma'o chi gzhon pas 'char gzhi lag tu bltar dus/ dmag mi hri 70de hri 59la 'phri 'then byas pa tsam red/1914lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 2nyin/ 'jar dmag gis lu tsem pog bzung ba dang / zla 8pa'i tshes 3nyin pi li hri'i rgyal mtshams brtol zhing tshes 20nyin rgyal sa pu ru ser(lko tshipo)blangs/ zhwa hphe yis nus shugs yod rgu bton nas dmag dpung sgrig sbyor byas te dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag dpuzlo /sa

mtha' mtshams srung ba'i dmag 'khrug brgyab kyang 'gog ma thub par yang yang phyi bsdur bya dgos byung / zla8pa'i tshes 20nyin/ 'jar dmag gis hpha ran se'i byang phyogs rgyal mtshams brtol te thad kur mā en gtsang 'gram du 'byor zhing pa li nyen kha'i gnas su gyar/ zla 9ba'i tshes 3nyin/ hpha ran se'i srid gzhung pa li nas po ar to(777)la spor dgos byung /de ltar 〈'char gzhi yang 17pa 〉rtsa ba nas thor zhig tu song nas hpha ran se la chag 'jig chen po 'ong nges pa'i gnas bab 'og zhwa hphe yis rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i brtan brling gi gshes rgyud spyad de/ pham kha rgyal khar bsgyur ched dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi gsar du bsgrigs shing gtan la phab/kho rang gis phyogs gcig nas hpha dmag la cis kyang dgra bo 'gog dgos pa'i bka' bsgos shing phyogs gzhan zhig nas dmag dpung sdeb sgrig gis dgra bo'i g.yas ru 'gog par shugs bsnon byas/ da dung pa li'i shar byang sa khul du dmag mi 'bor chen bzhag ste dgra bo'i gzhogs zur dang rgyab phyogs nas rgol rdung gis dgra bo rtsa med bzo rgyur sta gon byas/ 'jar dmag gi spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon mtho chi gzhon pa ni dmag dpung dang rgyang thag ring bos chod pa dang re zhig gi rgyal khas bzi yod pas/ hpha dmag gis gsar du dmag dpung sdeb sgrig byas pa ma tshor ba red/ skabs der/ shar phyogs 'thab ra nas u ru su'i dmag dpung gis phu lu'u hri shar ma bzung bas ma'o chi gzhon pas nub phyogs kyi dmag mi 'bor chen shar du 'dren dgos byung /zhwa gles go skabs de bzung nas zla 9ba'i tshes 4nyin gyi mtshan mor brda phab pa dang zla 9ba'i tshes 6gi mtshan mor phar rgol byas/zla)ba'i tshes 6nas zla 9ba'i tshes 10nyin bar/ snyan grags can gyi mā yen gtsang po'i g.yul 'khrug chen mo de gtsang ngogs kyi ring tshad spyi le 2༷sdud pa'i 'thab ra nas brgyab pa red/ g.yul 'khrug 'dir phyogs

gnyis kyi dmag mi khri 150lhag dang me skyogs stong drug bdun tsam g.yul la zhugs/ zla 9ba'i tshes 6nyin gyi zhogs par/ hpha dmag gis dpung 'jug byed 'go bcoms shing dmag mi'i ngar shugs slong ched zhwa hphe yis bshad don/6 mes rgyal gyi 'chi gson dmag 'khrug thengs 'dis thag gcod pa'i phyir nges par tshang mar gsal 'debs bya rgyu zhig ni tsham tshom gtan nas byed mi rung ba de yin/ nges par stobs shugs yod rgyas dgra bo phar skyod pa dang / gal te mdun skyod byed mi thub na'ang tshur blangs zin pa'i g.yul sa ni 'chi ba srog la bab kyang brtan srung byed dgos/ gnas bab 'di 'dra'i 'og tu/ dpa' med sdar ma'i ngang tshul mtha' dag la bzod sgom ye nas bya mi 'os pa yin ’ zhes bshad pa na/ mu mthud du phyi bsdur byed pa'i hpha dmag gi ngar shugs ldab 'gyur gyis 'phel ba red/ hpha dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag drug pa shar phyogs su dpung 'jug gis 'jar dmag gi gzhogs zur gyi shog sgrig dmag khag dang por 'thab pa dang / shog sgrig dmag khag lnga bas kyang kha phyir 'khor nas phyir 'then te phar rgol tu bsgyur nas 'jar dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag dang po dang gnyis par 'thab/ dbyin dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag gis kyang 'jar dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag dang po dang gnyis pa'i b.ragaseng du phar rgol byas/ hpha ran se'i shog sgrig dmag khag gsum pas 'jar man gyi shog sgrig dmag dpung gnyis pa'i g.yon zur dang dmag khag gsum par phar rgol byas te/ dgra bo'i shog sgrig dmag khag dang po dang gnyis pa grogs med kher hreng gi gnas su bskyal/ phyogs gnyis rgyal pham thag mi chod pa'i skabs su/ hpha dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis me 'khor tsam ma zad/ da dung rlangs 'khor gyis dmag dpung skyel 'dren byas/skabs der/ pa li nas gla gtong rlangs 'khor 1200tsam gyis rkang dmag lu'i gcig spyi le 50yi pha rol gyi g.yul sar bskyal/ des dmag 'a~X lo

rgyus steng du rlangs 'khor gyis dmag dpung skyel 'dren byed pa'i dpe gsar ba btod pa red/ zla 9ba'i tshes 9nyin/ ma'o chi gzhon pas hpha dmag gi bsam tshul shes te 'jar dmag gi g.yas ru phyir 'then byas shing g.yon ru la'ang dpung 'jug mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab/ zla)ba'i tshes /0nyin/ mā en gtsang bo'i g.yul 'khrug hpha dmag rgyal te mjug sgril ba da/ mā en gtsang bo'i g.yul 'khrug brgyud nas 'jar dmag gi myur 'thab myur rgyal gyi dmag jus thor zhig tu song zhing / ma'o chi gzhon pas rgyal bo we len sku phreng gnyis par zhu don/ smyo rgyal bo rin po che/ nga tsho dmag 'khrug las pham song zhes bshad/ zla)ba'i tshes 14nyin/ ma'o chi gzhon pa go gnas las phab/ zhwa hphe la ni nub phyogs dpyad gtam pa rnams kyis 6 hpha ran se skyob mkhan mi zhes bsngags pa red/than ar ting gi 'dzad gron dmag 'thab/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa langs nas lo gnyis par slobs rjes/'jar man gyi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis dmag 'thab kyi 'char gzhi bsgyur bcos byas te/ dmag 'khrug gi gtso gnad shar phyogs 'thab rar bzhag cing thog mar u ru su cham la phab rtsis byas/ de bas/ nub phyogs kyi 'thab ra bcas nas 'gog srung gi 'thab jus lag bstar byas pa red/skabs der/ zhwa hphe yis mnyam 'brel rgyal khab khag gis mnyam gcig tu dmag 'thab byed pa'i 'dod tshul bton zhing / phyogs gcig la dgra byung na tshang mas rgyab rogs byed rgyu'i re 'dun ltar shar phyogs 'thab ra'i u ru su la rgyab rogs byas/ khong gis rgol thabs sna tshogs rtsa 'dzugs byas kyang shi rmas tsharshakā che zhing 'bras bu ha cang chung ba red/

1916lor/ zhwa hphe yi bsam 'char ltar/ mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis shar phyogs dang nub phyogs/ dbyi tha li'i 'thab ra bcas nas gzhi rgya che ba'i phar rgol bya rtsis byas kyang / 'jar man gyis u ru su la dbyin hpha yi rgyab rogs mi thob pa'i ched du/ 'thab jus kyi gtso gnad yang bskyar nub phyogs 'thab rar bsnur ba dang / dmag dpung hrag bsdus kyis dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung rtsa gtong btang rjes u ru su cham la phab rtsis byas/'jar man gyi spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis hpha ran se'i hphan ar ting btsan rdzong 'thab ra bya rgyu gtan khel byas pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni sa khul 'di nub phyogs 'thab ra'i mnyam 'brel dmag gi sa gnas gtso bo yin la 'jar dmag la 'jigs nyen chen po yod pas yin/ der ma zad da dung hphan ar ting ni pa li la bskyod pa'i 'gag sgo lta bu yin/ 'jar man pas gnas 'di mi ring bar 6 hpha dmag phye mar 'thag sa'i rang 'thag tu 'gyur nges par yid ches chen po bcangs/ dmag dpung sdeb sgrig gi dus rim mjug sgril rjes/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i gzhi rgya ches che zhing dus yun ches ring ba'i g.yul 'khrug gzhi nas 'go brtsams pa red/1916lo'i zla7ba'i tshes 21nyin gyi zhogs par/ 'jar dmag gis hpha dmag gi 'thab rar me skyogs drag po 'phangs te hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug gi 'go bslangs/ 'jar man gyi rgyal sras kyis sku dngos su dmag mi hrag bsdus kyi dpung khag ste shog sgrig dmag dpung lnga ba'i sne drangs te phar rgol byas/ dmag khag 'dir dmag mi hri 17dang me sbyogs 1000lhag gnam gru 160bcas yod/ 'char gzhi ltar/ spyi le 15tsam gyi sa khul du myur rgol byas pa dang rgol yul gtso bo'i phyogs su dmag mi hri drug dang phyed ka tsam dang me skyogs 900lhag bkol ba red/ rkang dmag yin na'ang 'dra/ phyogs dmag yin na'ang 'dra tshang ma hpha dmag las ldab 'gas mang / 'jar dmapyo gis

dus tshod re la smyogs mdel khri 10'phangs shing nyin hril por hphan ang ting nye 'dabs kyi 'thab rar stogs mdel dang 'bar mdel khri 100lhag 'phangs te/ hpha dmag gi 'thab rar chag skyon chen po bzos la nye 'khor gyi nags tshal dang ri sgang yod tshad rmig med bzos/hpha ran se'i las dbang hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug la rag las pa'i gnad 'gag gi skabs der/ zhwa hphe yis yang bskyar brtag brling gi gshes ka dang yul dus bstun mkhas pa'i nus rtsal ngom pa red/ dus der/ zhwa hphe ni hphan ar ting btsan rdzong gi nye 'khor gyi spyi le 100lhag gi sa khul gyi drang thad du bsdad yod la/ bkod 'doms bya yul ni hpha dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag gsum pa yin/ ru dpung 'dir dmag mi hri 11tsam dang me phyogs 600lhag yod pa dang 'gog srung 'thab rags rim pa bzhi yod pa yin/ zhwa hphe yi dmag jus ni 6 rang 'thag rang 'thag la gtug pa ’ zhes pa yin te/ dmag dpung la 'thab ra brtan srung byed dgos pa'i bka' phab ste/ dgra bo'i gtso shugs gron du bcug nas dgra bo cham la phab pa de'o// dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams ma thag 'jar dmag gis phar rgol drag po byas pa'i dbang gis/nyin dang por hpha dmag gi 'gog srung 'thab rags dang po brtol ba red/dus der/ zhwa hphe yis yod tshad blos btang ste dgra bo 'gog dgos pa'i bka' btsan po phab pas/ hpha dmag phyi nur ma byas par dgra bo dang dmar 'dzing byas nas 'jar dmag dpung bskyod pa'i myur tshad je dal du btang / dus mtshungs su/ zhwa hphe yis shog sgrig dmag khag gnyis pa'i dmag spyi pe tang(yezo)phon ar ting sa khul gyi dmag spyir bskos/ pe tang hphan ar ting la 'byor ma thag g.yul sa nas dmag 'khrug la lta skul byed pa'i sa rtags brgyab ste/ dmag mir dgra bo shi 'thab kyis 'gog pa las sa rtags de'i tshur roX 12 phyi bsnur byas mi chog pa'i bka' phab/ da dung gzhung lam bskyar bzo

byed pa'i zhor la mi 90①yod pa'i skyel 'dren ru khag cig rtsa 'dzugs byas pa dang / rlangs 'khor 3900tsam la gza' 'khor gcig gi nang du rogs dmag khri 19dang rdzas mdel kun25000skyel 'dren byed du bcug tshes 28nyin bar du/ 'jar dmag gi thengs dang po'i dpung 'jug gi mtho rlabs mnan zhing / 'jar dmag spyi le 5nas 8tsam la ma gtogs dpung skyod byed thub med pa red/hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug ni hpha dmag la mtshon na 'chi gson thag gcod pa'i dmag 'khrug thengs shig yin pas/ skabs de'i hpha dmag gi kha g.yang ni lha shi yang 'jar dmag hphan ar ting nas mi gtong mi zhes pa de yin la/ 'jar dmag gis kyang hphan ar ting cis kyang tshur len rgyu'i sems thag bcad yod/ de bas/ phyogs gnyis kyi yang nas yang du phan tshun la phar rgol byas/ zla 4bar/ rogs dmag 'byor ba'i hpha dmag gi grangs 'bor 'jar dmag dang mnyam pas/ 'jar dmag gi thengs gnyis pa'i dpung 'jug gis hpha dmag gis bzung ba'i mtho sa gnyis las len ma thub/ zla 5bar/ phyogs gnyis ka 'dzad gron dmag 'thab kyi dus rim du zhugs/ zla6pa'i tshes 7nyin/ 'jar dmag gis dpung 'jug thengs gsum pa byas/ zhwa hphe yis bka' phab nas hpha dmag gi bkod 'doms dmag dpon gyis dmag dpung phyir 'then byed rtsis byed pa bkag cing / zla7pa'i tshes 1nyin/ zhwa hphe yis hpha dbyin mnyam 'brel dmag dpung la kha lo bsgyur nas su'o mu'u gtsang bo'i khul nas 'jar dmag la phar rgol drag po byas pas/ 'jar dmag gis hphan ar ting gi dmag stobs 'phri 'then gyis su'o mu'u gtsang rgyud dang shar phyogs 'thab rar spor dgos byung / de ltar zla7pa'i tshes 11nyin/ 'jar dmag gis dpung 'jug byed mtshams mi 'jog rang 'jog tu gyur/ hpha dmag theg med gtong rgyu'i 'dod blo ma 'grub pa lta zhog de las ldog spya /nga

la bskang thabs med pa'i pham nyes byung ba red/ skabs der/ g.yul 'khrug gi rang dbang gi nus pa hpha dmag gi lag tu shor/ de'i dbang gis/ 'jar dmag gi spyi khyab drag jus dmag dpon hpha ar khun he an(ṣṭhapo loṣṭha)go phab byas te tshab tu zhin tin po(༅22)bskos/ zla 10ba'i tshes 24nyin/hpha dmag gis phar rgol byed 'go bcoms shing shor zin pa'i g.yul sa mang po /shā tārdolda/ zla 10ba'i tshes 28nyin/ hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug mjug hphan ar ting g.yul 'khrug gi gdug rtsub dang ya nga ba'i tshad ni mi rnams kyis zu hphan an ting sha 'thag 'phrul 'khor zhes 'bod pa red/g.yul 'khrug de'i nang du/ 'jar dmag khri 60lhag dang hpha dmag khri 34lhag 'das pa red/ g.yul 'khrug 'di 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i dkyogs mtshams shig tu gyur te/ mnyam 'brel rgyal khab dag mna' 'brel rgyal khab dag las rgyal bar rmang gzhi btings ba red/zhwa hphe hpha dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi yin pa'i cha nas/ brtan zhing brling ba'i bkod 'doms kyis dmag 'khrug thengs der rgyal kha blangs pa ma zad/da dung dmag don gyi rig gzhung thad la'ang byas rjes bzhag yod de/ dper na/ kho rang gis g.yul sa'i gnas tshul gyi 'gyur ba dang bstun nas dmag 'thab kyi go rim dang dmag dpung gi sdeb sgrig la 'gyur ldog byas pa dang /rang las stobs che ba'i dgra bo'i me skyogs la byol zhing rang gi stabs bde'i me mda'i nus stobs ci nus kyis ngom pa red/ 'gog srung thad du/ thang rgod dmag 'khrug gi 'thab ra dang yun gnas 'thab ra gnyis zung 'brel byed pa'i nyams myong 'don sprod byas/ 'di dag gis hpha ran se'i dmag don lo rgyus steng du shog ngos gtso bo zhig bsnan pa red/34san kyang / hphan ar ting dmag 'khrug 'jags nas yun ring ma

'gor bar/ kho rang gi mnga' 'og gi mis ngo rgol byas pa brgyud 1916lo'i zla 12bar kho rang go phab byas te/ dmag spyi'i go thob bstsal ba dang hpha ran se'i srid gzhung gi dmag don lag rtsal gyi blo 'don par bskos/ phyis su/ kho rang a ri dang 'jar pan la dmag rogs skul du phebs/ don dngos su/dus der zhwa hphe yis hpha ran se'i dmag don dang chab srid kyi thad du nus pa ci yang 'don thub kyin med pa red/

su'u we a'e srid dbang gi srung skyob mkhan dang dmag don gzhung lugs pang myo lungakhri/zhug yun/smi ha ye arawa zhi le ye we chi hphu lung kri(1885—1925lo)ni su'u len dmag dpung gi ming du grags pa'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa dang dmag don gzhung lugs pa yin/ kho rang zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la zhugs myong zhing rgyal nang dmag 'khrug gi skabs su dmar dmag gi dmag dpon dang shog sgrig dmag gi dmag spyi/ g.yul sa'i dmag spyi sogs kyi 'gan 'khur myong /1925lo nas bzung / su'u len gsar brje dmag don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi dang skam mtsho dmag gi mi dmangs u yon gyi las 'gan khur/ kho rang gis su'u we a'i(smo ṣṭha)srid dbang sra brtan du gtong ched dang dmar dmag sgrig 'dzugs byed pa'i thad du byas rjes chen po bzhag dmag don gzhung lugs pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas kho rang gis mar khe si ring lugs kyi brtag thabs de dmag don gzhung lugs kyi khyab khongs so sor 'go khrid pa'i brtag thabs su 'gyur rgyu'i 'dod blo bcangs shing / bcoms chos 'bor chen bris nas su'u len gyi dmag don tshan rig gi 'phel rgyas la gzhung lugs kyi rmang btings pa red/nyen 'gag gi skabs su las 'gan 'khur ba/zla bcu ba'i gsar brje la rgyal kha thob rjes/ yun ring bor pu ar hri we trī shāng khag gi gsang ba'i las don bsgrubs pa'i rmu lung kri yis ye wan no

wodapewo tshi nye zhan si khe zhing chen gyi zhing chen u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci'i 'gan khur ba red/ skabs thog de ni su'u we a'e srid gzhung sra brtan du gtong ba'i 'thab 'dzing dka' tshegs che ba'i dus yin te/ su'u we a'e mi dmangs kyis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis drag chas the gtogs dang rgyal nang gi ngo log zing cha la ngo rgol byed pa'i gnad 'gag gi dus skabs la 'khel yod/ 1918lo'i zla7pa'i zla stod du/ rmu lung kri mo si kho ru tshogs pa'i skabs lnga ba'i su'u we a'e 'thus mi tshogs chen la zhugs/ tshogs 'du 'tshogs skabs/ mo si kho nas g.yon phyogs spyi tshogs gsar brje tang mis bslangs pa'i zing cha la ngas pa dang / ya lo si la tru(7774lko)nas yang bskyar srung dmag dkar po dang spyi tshogs gsar brje tang mis rtsa 'dzugs byas pa'i gzhi rgya che ba'i drag chas zing 'khrug langs/ zla7par/ spru lung kri yis krung dbyang lag bstar u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi si we ar ti lo rgyu'i(lo lo lkolko)bsam 'char ltar zing 'khrug zhi 'jags byed pa'i ru dpung rtsa 'dzugs byas/ zla7pa'i tshes 9nyin/ kho rang gis tang yon gyi tshogs 'du bsdus nas tang yon yongs kyis myur du drag chas spras dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / dmar dmag yongs rdzogs ya lo si la hphu la zing 'khrug zhi 'jags su gtong du 'gro rgyur gtan 'khel byas/ nyin de'i mtshan mor/ gung khran tang yon bzhi brgya lhag gis grub pa'i drag chas ru dpung zing 'khrug langs sar bskyod pa dang / nyin 'ga'i rjes su yang bskyar gung khran tang yon dang bzo bas grub pa'i ru dpung 'ga' mngags gtong byas/ zla8pa'i tshes 1nyin/rmu lung kris zhing chen lag bstar u yon lhan khang dang grong khyer su'u we a'e/zhing chen dang grong khyer gyi khel 'thag bzo tshogs sogs la brel myur gyi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te/ gsar brje ngo log pas 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang la nyen 'jigs chen po bzo bzhin yod tshul dang / tang gi sgrig bsdu/ sra

brtan du gtong dgos pa/ 'byor med gral rim gyi drag chas stobs shugs la shugs snon byed dgos tshul sogs bshad/ zla8pa'i tshes 11nyin/ ye wan no wowa wo tshi nye zhan si khe zhing chen du tshogs pa'i khul tang gi tshogs chen steng du/kho rang gis spyi mthun rgyal khab dka' nyen gyi gnas su lhung ba'i skabs 'dir gung khrang tang mi re res nges par du cha rkyen ci yang med par tang gi bkod sgrig la nyan dgos la/ tang gi sgrig lam brtsi srung byas te tang nang la g.yo 'dzul byas pa'i mi ngan dag phyir phud dgos tshul bstan/ tshogs 'dus 'jon nus gzhan las 'phags pa'i spru lung kri zhing chen brgyad la bdag gnyer byed pa'i ya lo si la hphu'i dmag khul gyi dmag don u yon gyi las 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i re 'dun zhus/ hphu lung kri yis las 'gan de phrag tu blangs shing nus shugs yod rgyas bya ba bsgrubs/thog mar/ kho rang gis blo rtse gcig sgrim gyis las byed pa'i sde la dag ther byas/ yun ring bor dka' tshegs kyi tshod bgam brgyud myong pa'i las byed pa dag dmag don gyi 'go khrid par bskos shing / tru ar man no spu(tshiposgyu lko)lta bu'i gung khran tang yon phul byung can dag la dmag khul gyi chab srid bya ba sgrub tu bcug kho rang gis dmag don ched mkhas dag gis dmar dmag gi dmag 'thab nus shugs dar spel gtong bar byed nus gal chen 'don thub pa rtogs pas/ nam yang kho tsho dang 'brel lam bzang bo yod par byas/ de bas/ dmag don ched mkhas mang pos kho rang gi 'go khrid 'og nas bya ba sgrub par spro ba yin/ dper na/ no we tshi ci ni sngar hra hong gi dmag dpon chen mo zhig yin yang dus der dmag khul gyi dmag don slob ston pa yin pa lta bu'o// spru lung kris dmag don u yon gyi las 'gan lci mo de legs grub yong ched/ dmag don gzhung lugs la slob sbyong byed pa dang dus maḥdīpya su no we tshi ci(rmi ṣṭhazlo)dge rgan du bsten/ yun ring gi bya ba'i

khrod du/ kho gnyis kyi bar la mdza' brtse zab mo chags pa red/ spru lung kris mnga' 'og gi dmag dpon bsko 'jog byed pa'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen ni/ nges par don ngo ma'i gsar brje'i langs phyogs kyis bya las sgrub pa dang / 'das zin pa'i dmag 'khrug las nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa blangs yod pa/ bkod 'doms slob gso'i sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa gang rung 'grims myong ba bcas so//gal te cha rkyen de dag ma ldan na go sar ye nas mi 'then pa red/rmu lung kris mnga' 'og gi mi'i bya las la re ba nan mo 'don pa ste/ bya ba sgrub dus rnam g.yeng che zhing 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes med pa'i mi la dran skul byed pa dang / bya ba'i khrod du nor 'khrul byung tshe kha ngo ci yang med par chad pa nan mo gcod pa red/ dmag khul gyi sa phyogs so sor lta zhib byed dus/srung dmag ru dpung la sgrig lam 'gal ba'i bya spyod yod pa mthong nas de ma thag bshad don/ su'u we a'e srid dbang gis skyug bro ba'i snang tshul dag la gu yangs ster mi srid la/ gal te/ nor 'khrul mtho na su yin yang chad pa nan mo gcod dgos zhes bshad/rmu lung kris da dung dmar dmag gi stobs shugs rgya bskyed par do snang chen po byed pa ste/ ye wan no lo yo tshi nye zhan si khe zhing chen gcig pu nas kyang 1918lo'i zla)ba nas 1919lo'i zla1ba'i bar du skul slong gis mi khri 7lhag dmag la zhugs su bcug spru lung kris mi rnams la mtshon cha bzung ste mes rgyal la srung skyob byed pa gzi brjid du ngos zin du 'jug dgos na dmangs yongs kyi dmag don slob gsor shugs snon byed dgos par 'dod/rmang gzhi de'i steng nas/ kho rang gis khu si thi lo mo dang rmu la ci smi ar/hu'u ya sogs grong khyer du dmar dmag gi hri dang po dang bdun pa sgrig 'dzugs kyis dmag stobs rgya bskyed pas/ zing 'khrug rtsa gtor dang su'u we a'e srid dbang sra brtan du gtong bar byed nus gal chen thon/ 349

hphu lung kris dmag 'gan 'khur dus tang u hru'u ci'i las 'gan yang 'khur yod pas/ dmag don gyi bya ba 'dzin pa'i zhor la da dung tang gi bya las mang po zhig kyang sgrub dgos pa yin/ kho rang gi rgyab skyor 'og tu sa gnas so so'i tang rtsa 'dzugs kyis snga gzhug tu tang dang dmag don gyi gso sbyong 'dzin grwa bsdus/ 1918lo'i zla 12bar/ ye wan no wowa wo tshi nye zhan si sta ———zhe tsā pa 'i / zhe ske 7 tho sa 6 snye cho zu / ba ri tsho rig — rmi — — tsho ṭwā — —— mi — — 3 rmu lung kro yis ru dpung la lta rtog byed bzhin pa/— khe zhing chen(777cha ṣṭhaṣṭhatsho lo phra)u yon lhan khang gis gung khran ring lugs kyi dmag khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te g.yul sar bskyod pa dang /de ru shog sgrig dmag gi dmag spyis thad kur bkod 'doms byed rgyu'i gros 350

thag bcad/ 1919lo'i lo stod du/ mi100tsam gyis grub pa'i gung khran ring lugs kyi dmag khag btsugs zin pa khyab bsgrag byas/ dmag khag 'di'i dmag mi phal che ba gung khran tang yon yin/spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa'i 'jon nus ngom pa/hphu lung kri la phul du byung ba'i dmag don 'jon nus ldan par dmigs nas kho rang shar ngos kyi shog sgrig dmag khag bzhi ba'i dmag spyi la bskos/de nas bzung / kho rang gi ming du grags pa'i dmag don 'tsho ba'i 'go bcoms pa red/dmag don pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas kho rang gis dmag dpung la sgrig lam dam po bzhag pa ste/ thog mar dmag 'gan de 'khur dus/ dmag dpung gi sgrig lam lhod pa dang nges med rgol rdung dmag gi goms gshes sdug po yod pa red/ kho rang gis dmag bsher byed skabs dmag mi lu'e gcig gis rang snang gis dmag bsher la byol ba'i tshul mthong nas/ kho rang gis phyogs gcig nas skyon brjod nan mo byas la phyogs gcig nas dmag khag de'i dmag dpon la bka' phab nas goms gshes ngan pa de dag bsgyur dgos tshul bshad kyang kha ya ma byas pa red/ nyin gnyis par/ dmag bsher lakhyol ba'i lu'e de'i dmag dpon gyis rmu lung kri kho tshos bsdus pa'i tshogs 'du la bos/ hphu lung kris sku bcar dmag dpon 'khrid nas tshogs rar slebs/ kho rang gis dmag spyi'i thob thang bor te las gnas brtan srung byed pa'i gung khran tang yon zhig gi tshul gyis gtam bshad byas te tshogs zhugs mi sna dag la slob gso nan mo dang nor 'khrul gyi tshabs chen rang bzhin la dbye zhib byas/ mjug mthar/ dmag spyi'i tshul gyis tha tshig bsgrag don/ gal te su dmag khrims las 'gal tshe des cis kyang 'gan 'khur dgos zhes 3)sbyod/

kho rang gi gsung bshad kyis tshogs mi yongs la slob gso thebs shing tshogs 'du nas gyes dus tshang mas yar langs te gus 'dud zhus/ don dag de de ltar tshegs med du thag bcad pa dang de brgyud nas dmag dpung gi sgrig khrims je dam du song ba la/ 'thab 'dzing nus shugs kyang je cher 'phel/hphu lung kris mi'i 'jon nus la ltos nas las byed pa bsko 'then byed pa yin/ thengs shig ko ar khra khe jag dmag( losam lha)gis shar phyogs rgyal mtshams la rgol dus/ sngar mo si kho'i dmag don slob gling nas slob gnyer byas myong ba'i zhwa po dbyang(za tshes)shog sgrig dmag khag bzhi bar log tu bcug rtsu lung kris kho'i gzhan las 'phags pa'i bkod 'doms 'jon nus la cha rgyus gsal bo yod pas thog ma kho la lu'e krang gi dmag 'gan sprad pa dang mi ring bar hri krang la spar/ zlu lung kris bzo zhing ba'i khyim nas skyes pa'i dmag mi go 'then byed pa'i zhor la/ gsar brje'i bya gzhag la blo dkar ba'i dmag dpon rnying ba dang dmag don ched mkhas la'ang do snang brtsi 'jog byas/ sgrig lam lhod g.yeng che ba'i dmag khag dang bkod 'doms pa dag la kho rang gis kha ngo ci yang mi ster bar go gnas phab pa dang brje spor byed pa red/ spru lung kri yis bkod 'doms pa ni dus dang rnam pa kun du'ang yid ches kyis khengs pa zhig yin dgos par 'dod/1919lor ko ar khra khe'i jag dmag dang 'thab skabs/ hphu lung kris phar rgol byed dgos tshul bshad kyang / shog sgrig dmag khag dang po'i dmag spyi cwa dbyi yis phyir bsnar byas na legs tshul bshad/ rmu lung kris dmag 'khrug gi gal 'gangs rang bzhin la bsam nas ca dbyi go phab ma byas kyang thengs de'i phar rgol la bkod 'doms byed du ma bcug pa red/rmu lung kris dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi bzo dus yang nas bskyar du bkāswā /zhig byed pa yin pas/ thag bcad pa'i tshe na phyogs chen po nas

bsgyur bcos mi byed pa red/ kho rang gis rgyal nang dmag 'khrug gi skabs su 'phro rim 'phror dmag 'khrug gal chen mang por bkod 'doms byas te rgyal kha chen po blangs myong / dmag 'khrug 'di dag gi khyad chos gtso bo ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmag 'khrug gi bkod sgrig dang / rgol yul gtso bo gtan 'beb byed pa dang de'i lag bstar byed pa'i dus tshod 'dem pa 'os mtshams yin pa/ dpa' snying chen pos dmag stobs dang go mtshon legs gras rgol yul gtso bo'i phyogs su bsdu rub byed pa/ yul dus dang bstun mkhas la gra sgrig dmag bed spyod mkhas pa sogs so//1919lo'i zla bar/ ko er khra khe'i krung dbyang 'dus 'dzoms dpung tshogs kyis dpung 'jug drag po byas te g.yul sa'i gnas bab dza drag can du gyur/ byang phyogs nas dmar dmag gi shog sgrig dpung tshogs dang po dang bzhi ba/ thur khe'i(244)shog sgrig dmag khag bcas la 'jigs nyen chen po bzos/ spru lung kris zhib bsher dang zhib 'jug zab mo byas rjes/sharabyang phyogs nas dgra bo'i gzhogs zur la phar rgol chen po byas te dgra dpung phyir bskrod pa dang / dmar dmag gis skabs glags de dang bstun nas dgra bo'i rgyab phyogs nas phar rgol gyis cham la phab rtsis byas/ 'char gzhi 'dir nyen mchong gi cha cung tsam yod na'ang lag len byas chog pa zhig yin/ dus der/ spyi khyab dmag spyi khang la'ang 'char gzhi gzhan zhig yod de/nyung na'ang zla gcig gi ring la gra sgrig dmag mi 'bor chen bsdus dgos par 'dod/ shar ngos dmag gi dmag spyi khang gis 'char gzhi phyi mas myur rgol gyi dus tshod 'gor 'gyangs byas 'gro bar dogs nas hphu lung kri'i 'char gzhi la mos mthun byas/ don ngo mar/ zla pa nas bzung hphu phung kris gra sgrig dmag mi 'bor chen gsog 'jog byas yod pa red/ zla ba'i tshes7nyin/ spru lung kris shar ngos dmag gi dmag spyi ca smi nye hphu dang kha brda ring bo zhig ༵༵ te/

kho'i myar rgol gyi byed thabs rgyas bshad byas/ zla/ba'i tshes 10nyin/ spyi mthurno rgyal khab kyi gsar brje'i dmag don u yon lhan khang gis shar ngos dmag khongs su 'dus 'dzoms dpung tshogs gnyis btsugs te lho'i 'dus 'dzoms dpung tshogs kyi dmag spyir hphu lung kri bskos/ 'char gzhi lag bstar byed skabs/ ca smi nye blus hphu lung kri yis myur rgol byed dus 'tshub drags pa dang dus tshod 'dem pa 'os mtshams min par kha g.yar nas mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ de lta na'ang / rmu lung kris 'char gzhi dang de lag bstar byed pa'i dus tshod la 'gyur ldog gtan nas ma byas pa red/phyis su/ shar phyogs 'thab ra nas dmag 'khrug ches dza drag che ba'i sgang la/spyi :khyab dmag spyi khang gis ngos phyogs dmag gi dmag spyi brje spor byas/dmag spyi gsar bas ci mi snyam par dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi bzo bcos byas te dmag 'khrug gi dkyil snying lho nas byang du spar/ des don ngo mar lho'i 'dus 'dzoms dpung tshogs kha thor du btang ba yin/ dus der/ hphu lung kris jag dmag la phar rgol byed pa'i dmag 'khrug gal chen zhig la gra sgrig byed pa'i sgang yin/ kho rang gis mtha' gcig tu dmag spyi gsar ba'i lta tshul la dgag pa brgyab cing rgyu mtshan dang gnas lugs gsal bor bshad pas/da gzod dmag spyi gsar bas sngar gyi dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi de ji bzhin lag bstar byas pa red/ dmag 'khrug brgyab nas zla8ba'i 19nyin la slebs dus dgra dpung phyi bsdur byas/ dus der dmar dmag gis go skabs bzang bo dam 'dzin gyis dgra bo tsha 'ded byas te tshar bcad na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang / dmag spyi gsar bas rjes 'ded mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab/ hphu lung kris nor 'khrul can gyi bka' tshig der dgag pa mtha' gcig tu brgyab cing tang krung dbyang gis thad kur the gtogs byed rgyur re 'dun zhudi/54zla8pa'i tshes 29nyin/ le nyin gyis rmu lung kri'i bsam 'char la mos

mthun byed pa'i glog 'phrin btang /hphu lung kri ni rtul phod dang sbyang grung / mi zhum pa'i ngang rgyud dang ldan pa zhig yin/ 1919lo'i zla6par/ dmar dmag btsan shed kyis pe ho gtsang bor brgal te gsang stabs kyis dgra bor phar rgol byas/ nyin gnyis par/ dgra bos gtsang bor brgal te g.yul sa brtan srung byas yod pa'i dmar dmag la tshur rgol byas/ spru lung kris zhwa po dbyang la bka' phab ste dmag rogs su mngags shing / rang nyid rta las babs te me mda' bzung nas bkram dmag gnas thig gi dmag khrod du zhugs pa red/ des dmag mir bar shugs bsnan zhing 6 spu lung kri nga tsho dang mnyam du yod mices pa'i kha g.yang bsgrags bzhin phar mchongs te nyen 'gag gnas bab phyir bskor/1920lo'i za3par/ rmu pung kri g.yul sar lta zhib du yong nas phyir log dus/kho rang sdod sa'i me 'khor la dgra bos 'jab rgol thebs te srog nyen las thar thub tsam byung na'ang / mdun phyogs kyi lam dgra bos gtor zhig byas zin pa dang / de nas me 'khor phyir log tshe ldog lam yang gtor zin pa red/ dgra bos yang bskyar tshur rgol byas/ me 'khor steng na me phyogs dang me mda' sbag sbag sogs yod na'ang dgra bo'i stobs ha cang che bas 'gog dka' bar gyur/spu lung kris phyogs gcig nas rogs dmag 'bod du btang ba dang / phyogs gcig nas rogs dmag 'byor rag bar du 'gog rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pas/ dgra bos hphu lung kri gson bzung bya rgyu'i re 'dun ma 'grub pa red/1920lo'i dbyar khar/ rmu lung kris jag gtso khu'u ar pā zhi dang dngos su gros mol byas te kho rang su'u we a'e srid gzhung la zhugs su 'jug rgyu byas/mnyam du 'dzoms sa nas khu'u ar pā zhi la srung dmag mang po yod la/ rmu lung kri'i 'khris su sku bcar dmag dpon dang dmag don las byed mi sna gcig las med na'ang / kho rang la dngangs 'jigs spu tsam yang med ༵ byed/

mgazhir/ kho rang gis sngar nas rang phyogs kyi gnas bab cung legs pa'i skabs 'dir khu'u ar pā zhis kho rang la gnod skyel mi thub pa rtogs yod pa red/ don ngo mar yang kho rang gis sngon dpag byas pa nang bzhin kho rang la gnod pa ci yang byed ma thub/dmag don gzhung lugs0 rmang btings ba/rgyal nang gi dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/ su'u len mi dmangs zhi bde dang 'dzugs bskrun gyi lam du zhugs/ hphu lung kris rang gi mi tshe'i mjug mtha'i lo lnga yi ring dmag don gzhung lugs dang dmar dmag sgrig 'dzugs kyi ched du sngar bas kyang 'bad 'bungs lhod med byas/ kho rang gi dmag don gzhung lugs kyi brtsams chos la 〈gcig gyur gyi dmag don rig gzhung dang dmar dmag 〉 〈dmag don 'dzugs skrun gyi bshul lam〉 〈ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug steng gi g.yul sa dang rgyab phyogs〉 〈le nyin dang dmar dmag 〉〈dmar dmag dang su'u len gyi rgyal srung 〉sogs yod/rmu lung kris brtsams chos khrod du lta tshul 'di 'dra bton yod de/ su'u we a'e rgyal khab la cha mtshon na dmar dmag ni ches gal che ba zhig yin pas stobs shugs 'phri 'then gtan nas bya mi rung / rgyun grabs dmag dpung la shugs bsnon pa da gzod da lta'i su'u len gyi drag chas stobs shugs rtsa 'dzugs byed pa'i rmang gzhi yin/ dmar dmag gtor ba dang myur du dmangs dmag lam lugs brgal 'dod pa'i lta tshul ni nor 'khrul chen po zhig dang tha na nyen kha che ba zhig red/ dmangs dmag lam lugs la brgal bani rgyal khab kyi gron dngul gsog 'jog tshad nges can zhig la slobs dus/da gzod slob gso'i khyab brdal rmang gzhi byas te mngon 'gyur bya dgos pa zhiX byin/ der ma zad/ de'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni nges par du dmar

dmag la dmigs 'ben gtso bor 'thab rtsod byed pa'i nus shugs yod pa de yin 'os shes pa sogs so// wu'u khe len(674)dngakhole mu'u(mtshoṣṭha)yi bca' sdod dmag gi dmag spyi'i 'gan 'khur dus/ tshad ldan dmag mi dang dmangs dmag mnyam 'brel byed pa lag bstar byed rgyu'i phyogs la 'tshol snyeg rin thang ldan pa mang po byas/ kho rang gi dmangs dmag hri rtsa 'dzugs bya rgyu'i thabs bkod la tang krung dbyang gis bsngags brjod tshad med byas pa red/dmag dpung bsgyur bcos byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod du/ hphu lung kris dmagadapung gi rim pa so so'i 'go khrid lam lugs de dpon gcig can du bsgyur rgyu'i 'dod blo bcangs/ tang srid 'go khrid kyi cha rkyen yod pa'i bkod 'doms pas zhor du chab srid u yon gyi las 'gan 'khur pa las de la ched du las gnas mi 'jog par/ chab srid bkod 'doms pa gzhon pa'i las gnas shig bzhag pas 'thus par byas pa red/ de ltar byas na/ bkod 'doms pa'i dbang grags mthor 'degs byed thub pa ma zad/ da dung sa gnas kyi tang gi las khungs dang su'u we a'e las khungs bar gyi 'brel 'dris je zab tu gtong thub/hphu lung kri'i lta tshul la/ dmar dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs la shugs bsnon bya dgos na thog mar nges par du phul du byung ba'i bkod 'doms pa'i dpung khag cig skyed bsring byed dgos par sems/ kho rang gis dmag 'khrug gi lo zla'i nang nas nar son cing nyams myong yod pa'i bkod 'doms pa dag 'go khrid kyi las gnas su 'then par do snang chen po byed pa yin/ kho rang gi sems la bkod 'doms pa ni dmag don ched mkhas dang rtsa 'dzugs mkhan zhig yin dgos pa ma zad/ da dung phul du byung ba'i slob gso pa zhig yin dgos par 'dod/ dmag khag gi las byed pa'i slob gsor shugs 3)spyan

pa'i ched du/ rmu lung kris dmag don slob grwa che chung mang po bsgrubs pa red/der ma zad dmag don sgrig yig bzo ba dang bslab deb sgrig pa'i bya bar mthong chen byas/ kho rang gis gros 'go bton zhing sgrub 'dzugs byas pa'i smyo mthong rgya bskyed pa dang dmag don shes bya'i blo 'dri las khungs zhes pas las byed mi sna dag gi dmag don chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par nus pa chen po thon/ kho rang gis da dung las khungs de'i kru'u zhi'i 'gan 'khur ba red/hphu lung kris dmar dmag 'thab mo ba'i 'byung spus mthor 'degs gtong rgyu de dmar dmag sgrig 'dzugs kyi gtso gnad du bzung ba yin/ kho rang gis dmag mi'i bye brag gi slob gso dang dmag sbyong gi 'char gzhi gtan phab byed par mthong chen dang de'i lag len la lta zhib byed pa red/ kho rang gis nan gyis bstan don/ dmag sbyong dang slob gso brgyud nas/ dmag mi'i chab srid bsam blo dang lus rtsal/ blo rig lag rtsal/ shes yon sogs phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas 'byung du 'jug dgos la/ nam rgyun gyi dus dang dmag 'khrug gi dus gang yin yang / gsar brje'i spro shugs dang 'gyur med kyi spobs pa/ sgrig lam gyi 'du shes drag pos dgra bo mtha' dag zil gyis non pa'i snying stobs dgos pa yin zhes so//hphu lung kris deng rabs can gyi dmag chas sgrig sbyor byed pa ni dmar dmag sgrig 'dzugs la shugs bsnon pa dang dmag dpung gi 'thab 'khrug nus shugs mthor 'degs byed pa'i thad kyi bya ba gtso bo zhig yin par lta ba red/ kho rang gis rgyal khab la ches bzang ba'i go mtshon dmar dmag la sgrig sbyor byed par skul ba dang / mtshon cha gsar ba bzo rgyu'i 'char gzhi de rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor gyi spyi'i 'char gzhi ru 'jog rgyu'i bsam 'char bton/kho rang gis thog mtha' bar gsum du mtsho dmag dang mkha' dmag ni dmar nadīkā spya grub cha gtso bo yin par sems/ kho rang thengs mang por mtsho dmag

gi dmag gru'i rjes lus kyi rnam pa bsgyur ba'i tshul la lta bsher du yong / kho rang gi 'bod skul 'og tu wu'u khe len du mtsho dmag dril bsgrag cus btsugs pa red/ rmu lung kris ma 'ongs pa'i dmag 'khrug khrod du mkha' dmag gis nus pa khyad par can 'don pas na/ su'u len gyi gnam gru bzo skrun thad kyi rjes lus kyi rnam pa nges par bsgyur te rang gi rgyal srung dang 'tshams pa'i mkha' dmag sgrig 'dzugs bya rgyu nan bshad byas/ yang kho rang gi skul 'ded 'og 1923lo'i zla3par/ wu'u khe len du lha mkha' skyod dang mkha' 'phur mthun tshogs zhes pa btsugs la/ mthun tshogs 'di phyis su zu mkha' dmag gi mthun grogs mi zhes pa'i mthun tshogs su zhugs te/ mkha' skyod bya gzhag gi 'phel rgyas dang mkha' skyod lag rtsal khyab brdal byed par byas rjes chen po bzhag spru lung kri dus rgyun du thon skyed kyi khrod du dngos su zhugs nas gnad don thag gcod pa red/ skabs sheg ring gnam gru bzo bar mkho ba'i shing cha spus legs lag son ma byung ba'i dbang gis bzo grwas ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pas/ kho rang skabs de'i ches mtho ba'i dpal 'byor u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi'i 'gan 'khur pa'i ce ar ren si ci( po41lo7)la rgyu mtshan 'dri ru phyin/ ce ar ren si ci yis shing cha spus legs yod kyang shing sdong gtub gcod las rigs lam srol rnying ba'i dbang du gyur nas mkha' dmag la rogs skyor bya mi 'dod tshul bshad pa red/ de nas kho gnyis kyis ched mkhas tshan chung zhig btsugs nas shing cha'i 'byung khungs dang gnam gru bzo bar mkho ba'i shing cha'i lag rtsal gyi cha rkyen la bskyar du zhib bsher gtan 'beb byed pa sogs gnad don dag thag gcod byas/ cang ma 'gor bar/ gnam gru'i thon skyed rim gyis legs lam du 'gro 'go btsams/kyu lung kri ni su'u len dmag don gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'ding mkhan yin pa'i cha nas do snang bya 'os pa'i lta tshul mang po bton yod pa yi/5/9 kho

rang gis su'u len dmag dpung gis dmag 'khrug rgyag pa'i dmigs yul ni phyi'i rgyal khab kyi mi ser gyi khe dbang la gnod 'tshe gtong rgyu de min par rang rgyal gyi ngal rtsol pa'i rtsa ba'i khe dbang la srung skyob bya rgyu de yin par 'dod/kho rang gis dmag 'khrug 'di rigs ni khrims mthun dang bden don rang bzhin yod pa zhig yin la dmag 'khrug thabs lam dang de'i chab srid kyi ngo bo tshang ma 'gog srung rang bzhin can yin zhes zer/ da dung kho rang gi lta tshul la ma 'ongs ba'i dmag 'khrug ni gzhi rgya che zhing 'gal ba ltag sprod kyi lam lugs gnyis bar gyi khyod shi nga gson gyi dmar 'dzing yin pas na/ phyogs so po'i rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs dang mi'i stobs shugs bar gyi 'gran bsdur chen po zhig kyang yin pa dang / ma 'ongs dmag 'khrug gi ngo bo de lo rgyus steng gi dmag 'khrug dang khyad par chen po yod la/ ma 'ongs dmag 'khrug khrod du thag gcod pa'i byed nus 'don mkhan ni lag rtsal min par mi yin par 'dod pa red/ dmag don gyi 'thab jus gleng skabs/ kho rang gis 'thab jus la bsam blo gtong dus dmag don kho na mi bsam par chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ phyi 'brel sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la 'dang rgyag dgos zhes bstan/ yang dmag don gyi rnam pa gleng dus/ dgra bo'i dpung chen gyis rgyal mtshams mnan te go mtshon legs por brten nas su'u len la btsan 'dzul byas tshe/ su'u len dmag dpung gi 'gul skyod dmag 'khrug dang yul dus dang bstun pa'i dmag 'khrug de nges par du gzhi rgya che ba'i nges med rgol rdung dmag 'khrug dang zung 'brel dam po bya dgos zhes bstan/ 'di dag yod tshad ni su'u len mi dam ngas kyis phyi nang gi dgra bor dmag 'thab yun ring byas pa'i nyams myong yin la/ dmag don lo rgyus steng gi rin thang che ba'i nor bu'ang yin no//33925lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes31nyin gyi zhogs pa'i chu tshod 5dang skang ma

40yi steng du pho lo 4)la son ma thag pa'i hphu lung kri brel stabs kyis mi yul dang gyes/ kho rang gi sku gdung de mo si kho yi thang chen dmar po'i khu le mo len pho brang gi mkhar rtsa ru dur du sbas/ phul du byung ba'i 'byor med gral rim gyi dmag don pa dang dmag don gzhung lugs kyi rmang 'ding mkhan 'di mi rnams kyi sems khong du nam yang gson por gnas yod/

dmar dmag gi skya dmag spyi khyababakod 'doms pa pu chungaste/(777)zhus yun/zhe me'u thi dhā ye lo we chi sa chung nye(1883— 1973)ni su'u len dmag gi khyad du 'phags pa'i spyi khab bkod 'doms pa zhig yin la/ kho rang gis skya dmag sgrig 'dzugs dang 'phel rgyas byed pa'i thad la bla na med pa'i byas rjes bzhag myong /'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i sngon du/ kho rang gis skya dmag gi shog sgrig dmag khag dang pu chunganye/po'i dmag spyi dang skya dmag gi spyi'i lta skul ba/ rgyal srung mi dmangs u yon gzhon pa sogs kyi las 'gan 'khur/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su/ ches mtho ba'i bkod 'doms khang gi dmag sgar chen mor bya ba bsgrubs te 'jar man hpha shi si cham la phab par byas rjes mi dman pa bzhag myong / pu chung nye yis rang gi dmag don 'jon nus dang bkod 'doms sgyu rtsal la brten nas su'u len mi dmangs kyi sems su go sa mthon po bzung yod/362

skya dmag gi ru dpung sgrig 'dzugs byas pa/1917lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 26nyin/ pe ti po(ṣṭha 2)nas zla bcu ba'i gsar brje langs tshul kun la khyab/ tshul des dus der da dung hra hong gi dmag dpung khrod du skya dmag gi hrang hri dmag mi byed bzhin pa'i pu chung nye la ngar shugs chen po bstsal/ gsang ba'i tang mi hphu lung kri'i skul 'ded 'og tu/ kho rang gis thengs gnyis pa'i su'u we a'e 'thus mi tshogs chen gyis gros chod byas pa'i (zhi bde'i bka' khrims 〉dang 〈zhing sa'i bka' khrims 〉gnyis 'khyer nas pha yul phu la tho rmu si kha yā grol brdal(075lko rdo༅ma)du log cing / kho rang gi gsar brje'i 'tsho ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'go bcoms/1918lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 12nyin/ kho rang gis 'bad pa chen po byas 'og grong brdal gyi su'u we a'e srid dbang dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags byas/ der mthud nas ko sa kho(797)zhing pa'i su'u we a'e skya dmag sgrig 'dzugs byasate khra le cin(224)tshur len chen/ gsar brje'i ngo log dpung tshogs srung dmag dkar po dang dmar 'dzing byas/ cang ma 'gong bar skya dmag ru dpung 'di dmar dmag gi shog sgrig dpung khag bcu bar bcos te dmar dmag gi skya dmag thon dang por gyur/ pu chung nye yis thon krang gzhon pa'i 'gan 'khur ba red/pu chung nye yis skya dmag 'phel rgyas gtong ba des dmar dmag gi dmag 'thab nus shugs mthor 'degs byed par nus pa gal chen 'don pa gsal bor rtogs yod/ 1918lo'i zla7pa'i nyin zhig la/ khra le cin 'thab ra'i dmar dmag gi dpung tshogs kyi dmag spyi rmu lo zhi lo chu(ṣṭha༅lko lko)skya dmag thon la lta bsher du phebs dus/ pu chung nye yis 'dzem dogs ci yang med par gong rim la nges par skya dmag sgrig 'dzugs bya dgos pa~X /sa
