drag jus mi sna rjes su lus pa'i snang tshul rbad de bcad/ der mthud nas kho rang gis ches btsan pa'i dmag sgrig btsugs shing / dmag mi sus kyang dus nam yang rno lcags kyi rmog gyon dgos pa'i sgrig lam myur du btsugs/ dpon dmag la las de 'dra nan tan zhig byed e srid snyam nas sgrig lam myur du lag bstar ma byas/ kho rang gis gang sar rmog gyon med pa'i dmag mi btsal zhing de dag gral sgrig tu bcug nas gshe gshe btang don/ 6 ngas bka' mi brtsi ba'i skyag gzan su la'ang gu yangs ster mi srid/ mjug mthar ngas khyod tshor gdam ga byed pa'i go skabs shig ster/ yang na mi res a sgor 25yi chad pa sprod pa dang yang na dmag don khrims khang la skyel rgyu yin/ gsal bor bshad rgyu zhig la/ dmag don khrims khang la skyel tshe yig tshags su tho 'god byed nges yin ’ zhes bshad/ dmag mi de tshos a sgor 25yi chad pa sprad kyang dmag spyi gsar ba 'dir dmod mo sna tshogs byas/ gza' 'khor gcig gi dus tshod nang dpung khag gnyis pa'i sngar gyi shugs med gnyom chung gi rnam pa bsgyur zhing / za3pa'i tshes 17nyin dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ pā tun gyis bkod 'doms byas 'og dpung khag gnyis pas myur du shor zin pa'i sa khul 'jar man dmag gi lag nas phyir 'phrog pa ma zad/ 'thab tshad rgyal bas dmag mi'i ngar shugs je che nas je cher rgyas pa red/ dmag 'khrug gi go rim khrod du/ kho rang dang dmag mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba je legs su song /rgyu mtshan ni kho rang gis dmag mi'i shi rmas la ma ltos par dpung 'jug byed par ngo rgol byed pas yin/ thengs shig la kho rang gis da dung 66yod tshad blos btang ste mi mtho sa zhig 'phrog dgos pa'i bka' tshig de med par byas pa red/zla8ba'i tshes 14nyin/ yed sin ha'o we ar glo bur pā tun gyi sdod gnas su yong ste pā tun la bshad rgyur/ 66ngas bltas na khyod song nas /ho si ci /:lo6 'char gzhi bzos na 'grig mi ces bshad/ ed sin ha'o we

ar gyi sems la/ pā tun gyis dpung khag gnyis pa'i las 'gan yongs grub byas zin pa ste/ gson shugs med pa'i dmag dpung 'di la tshe srog gsar ba bstsal zin pa red/ da ni pā tun gyis phu ho si ci mi 'char gzhi bzo bar byed nus 'don pa'i skabs su bab 'dug snyam/zhi zhi le'i g.yul 'gyed las snyan grags kun la khyab pa/pā tun 1943lo'i zla3ba'i tshes 14nyin thu ni si dang gyes te gnam gru las a ar ci ar ya(khu1posku'ipokrokhru)la phyin nas ra ho si ci ’ dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi bzo ba'i gas su zhugs/ dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi 'di'i dmigs 'ben ni/ 'jar man btsan rgyal mnyam 'brel gyi dmag dpung zhi zhi le gling phran nas mthar sprod btang ste/ dbyi tha li'i rgyal khongs dang zhi zhi le gling phran bar gyi mo zhi na mtsho 'gag la tshon 'dzin bya ba de yin/ bkod 'doms dmag dpon ni dbyin ji'i dmag dpon chen mo ya li hran ta yin la/mnga' 'og gi mnyam 'brel dmag dpung ni meng ku mā les(za zalko/)bkod 'doms byed pa'i dbyin ji'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs brgyad pa dang pā tu/ gyisdu bkod 'doms byed pa'i a ri'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs bdun pa ga sa 66/ si/ ci midamag 'khrug gi mjug mtha'i 'char gzhi ni meng ku mā le yi bsam tshul ltar gtan 'beb byas pa yin/ 'char gzhi des mtsho ngogs kyi phar rgol las 'gan bgo dus ha cang 'dra mnyam min pa ste/ a ri'i dmag dpung shar nub phyogs gnyis rjen por mngon pa'i ce lha'i(lkoṣṭha)mtsho ngogs su skam sar 'bud dgos la/ de'i sa khul la lar bye ma'i bkag rgya yod pa ma zad/ da dung dmag chas mkho sprod byed sa lam phran zhig las med pa red/dbyin dmag skam sar 'bud sa ni zhus la go(77lha)dang5ci no'i/1swācha

cha)bar yin la mtsho ngogs su yib skung byed sa yod pa yin/ nam rgyun dgos med kyi bya ba phran tshegs tsam la'ang rtsod pa mtha' 'khyol byed pa'i pā tun khong khro chen po langs na'ang / ya le hran tas kho rang gi bsam 'char 'dri dus kho rang gis 6 dmag dpon lags/ ngas 'char gzhi mi bzo ste bka' kho na dang len bya rgyu yin mi zhes pa las ci yang ma bshad/1943lo'i zla7pa'i tshes 10nyin gyi zhogs pa'i dus chod 2dang skar ma 45yi steng du/ zhi zhi le'i dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams pa red/ pā tun gyis bkod 'doms byed pa'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs bdun par dpon dmag khri 8yod la/ rkang dmag hri dang khra ba ldan 'khor lo'i hri/ mkha' 'bab dmag gi hri sogs kyis grub pa red/ de ni kho rang gis skyes pa nas da bar du bkod 'doms byas pa'i dmag grangs ches mang ba'i dmag 'khrug thengs shig yin/skam sar 'bud pa'i dmag 'khrug de rgya khyon la dbyin le 69yod pa'i mtsho ngogs nas brgyab cing / thog mar cung bde blag yin te mtsho ngogs kyi dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung rtsa gtor byas nas snga dro'i chu tshod 8pa'i steng ce lā tshar 'phrog thub pa byung / 'on kyang cang ma 'gor bar dbyi tha li'i then khe'i dmag dpung dang 'jar man gyi khrab ldan 'khor lo'i dmag dpung gis ce lā nas skam sar bud pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung la phyir rgol byas te dmag 'khrug dza drag che bar gyur/ tshes 11zhin gyi snga dro'i chu tshod 9bar pā tun gru gzings las babs te skam sar bud cing / mdel char gdong gis bsus nas dmag 'khrug la bkod 'doms byas/ 'thab ra'i dbyin le 6la rlangs 'khor las bskyod de dmag khag so so'i zung 'brel gyis dmag 'thab byed par sdeb sgrig byas pa red/ phyi dro'i chu tshod 4yi steng nas da gzod lus yongs chu yis gsher nas gru gzings la log shog sgrig dpung tshogs bdun pas rtu/ ni/ kyis dmag 'thab byas pas skam sar bde blag tu bud pa ma zad/

da dung mdun phyogs su dpung skyod byas/tag tag dus der/ meng ku mā les bkod 'doms byed pa'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs brgyad pa'i phar rgol la bkag rgya thebs pa red/ des pā kun gyis rang gi bkod 'doms kyi 'jon nus ngom par go skabs bstsal/ dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams ma thag shog sgrig dpung tshogs brgyad pas zhus la go gru kha bzung yang / bkod 'doms gnyom zhing sger gcod thal che bas rjes su grangs 'bor rang las nyung ba'i 'jar dmag khag gcig gis mdun skyod kyi lam bu bkag pa red/ dmag 'khrug thengs 'di'i nang byas rjes 'jog 'dod pa'i meng ku mā le yis ya le hran ta la/ kho rang gi g.yon phyogs kyi gzhung lam las byang phyogs la dpung bskyod byed pa'i a ri'i dmag dpung gzhung lam las phyir 'then gyis gzhung lam kho rang la sprod pa'i re 'dun zhus/de ni a ri'i dmag dpung la gnod pa'i re 'dun zhig ste/ de ltar byas na a ri'i dmag dpung sngar yong sa'i sa ru phyir 'then byed dgos pa red/ blor mi shong ba zhig la ya le hran tas meng ku mā le yi lugs med kyi re 'dun de la chog mchan bkod de zla 7ba'i tshes 14nyin pā tun la bka' phab/ pā tun gyis mnga' 'og gi mis ngo rgol drag po byed par ma 'dzem par bka' de dang len byas/ kho rang gis myur du gzhung lam btang ste rang 'gul gyis nub phyogs su myur rgol byas pa red/ zla7pa'i tshes22nyin/ pā tun gyi dmag dpung gis zhi zhi le'i lte ba'i grong khyer pā le mo(༅ cho)blangs pa dang / der mthud nas shar phyogs su dpung 'jug gis 'jar dmag mthar sprod btang / zla8pa'i tshes 16nyin dbyin dmag gi sngon du mo zhi nā tshur blangs te zhi zhi le'i dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril ba red/zhi zhi le'i dmag 'khrug khrod du pā tun gyi snyan grags sngar bas che bar gyur/ mi rnams kyis kho ni a ri'i dmag dpon khrod kyi 'gul skyod che: snar

ba'i dmag dpon yin par bshad/ yin na'ang / kho rang gi brlang spyod kyis mi kha chen po zhig phog pa ste/ de ni kho rang gi dmag dpung mo zhi nā la dpung 'jug byed skabs dka' 'gag chen ngo ra 'phrad dus kyi bya ba zhig yin/ dus der pā tun gyi sems khams ha cang ma skyid par yod la sman khang du rmas mar 'tshams 'drir phyin tshe/ dmag mi zhig zhed snang gi dbang gis bla 'khyam pa ltaraganas pa mthong nas khong khro chen pos gshe gshe btang ba ma zad 'gram lcag gcig gzhus pa red/ yang gza' 'khor gcig kyang ma phyin par sman khang gzhan zhig tu na tsha byung ba'i dmag mi zhig la 'gram lcag gzhus/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyis ci nus kyis sba gsang byas na'ang mtha' mjug gsar 'god pas kun la bsgrags pa red/ tshul der a me ri kha'i rgyal nang nas ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur drag po bstan pa ma zad/ tha na tsung thung lo si tru(rmaglos)'ang khong khro chen po langs/ shugs rkyen ngan pa de med pa ra bzo ched/ed sin ha'o we ar gyis pā tun la dmag mi yongs la mngon gsal gyis dgongs dag zhu ru bcug pa ma zad/ kho rang dbyi tha li'i lho phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug la zhugs mi chog pa'i bka' phab/yo rab gling gi g.yul sa nas dpal rtsal ngom pa/pā tun la las rgyu ci yang med par sdod pa'i skabs su/ 1 94lo'i zla 1po'i tshes 22nyin/ glo bur mnyam 'brel dmag gi dmag spyi khang gis bskur ba'i glog 'phrin zhig 'byor ba red/ de las 6 khyod kyis sa de'i las 'gan med par byas zin la dbyin ji na las 'gan gzhan pa yod/ myur du a ar ci ar(7loṣṭhapo)gyi mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi dmag spyi khang la bka' len du shog mices bkod yod/ pā tun gyis nyin gcig gi nang du sa de'i bya ba swāhā/ bsgril rjes gnam gru las a ar ci ar la phyin pa dang / nyin

gnyis kyi rjes su lon ton(77)la 'byor te shog sgrig dpung tshogs gsum pa'i dmag spyir bskos/pā tun gyi thengs 'di'i las 'gan ni lha btsan bdag g.yul 'khrug lag bstar byed par sta gon bya ba de yin/ de ni mnyam 'brel dmag dpung hpha ran se'i nub byang phyogs nas skam sar bud de 'jar man la ngo rgol byed pa'i g.yul sa gnyis pa bskrun pa de red/ 6 btsan bdag mi g.yul 'khrug la sta gon byed pa'i dus skabs su/ pā tun gyis 6 shog sgrig dpung tshogs dang po'i ’ dmag spyi zhes pa'i ming tsam bzung nas bsdad pa ste/ ma gzhir de ni mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis 'jar man la mgo bskor ched/ tshab ming la 6 sdug bsran ’ du 'bod pa'i bsru brid 'char gzhi bskrun te mnyam 'brel dmag dpung cwa la'e mtsho 'gag(mebamojonyornganyathu)brgal nas cwa la'e nas skam sar 'bud rtsis byed khul byed pa zhig red/ de bas/ dbyin ji'i shar lho'i phyogs nas 6 shog sgrig dpung tshogs dang po'i ’ sgar btab cing dmag spyi la 'jar man pa ha cang skrag pa'i pā tun bzhag pa red/ pā tun de ltar byed par ma dga' yang mjug 'bras legs po smin pa ste 'jar man par mgo bskor byed thub song ba yin/ 'jar man pas pā tun la kha gtad gcog ched shog sgrig dpung tshogs 15ba hril bor cwa la'e mtsho 'gag srung du bcug1944lo'i zla6pa'i tshes 5nyin/ ches mtho ba'i dmag spyi khang gi bka' ltar mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi dmag khag so sos dbyin ci le (zolhas/)mcho 'gag 'phred brgal byas/ 'jar man gyi dmag spyi khang gis mnyam 'brel dmag dpung skam sar 'bud pa'i sa gnas tshod dpog byas pa nor te/no man te()josgyukhu6)mtsho 'gram du dmag mi hri 10las bzhag med pas/mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis las sla bor mtsho ngogs bzung ba red/ pā tun gyi shog sgrig dpung tshogs gsum pa skam sar 'bud pa'i dus tsho/ sbyang

'phyi la kho rang nyid zla7pa'i tshes 6nyin no man te la 'byor/zla7pa'i tshes 25nyin/ skam sar bud pa'i a ri'i dmag dpung gis 6 dug sbrul mig shel can zhes pa'i phar rgol byed 'go bcoms/ phar rgol gyi dmigs yul ni myur gol gyi thabs la brten nas mnyam 'brel dmag dpung lo wa ar(977)gtsang po rgyud nas pa li'i lho phyogs kyi o ar lang( po4)la dpung skyod byed pa dang der mthun nas shar phyogs kyi sa'i nā gtsang bor(677)skyod par lam 'byed pa de yin/ phar rgol 'go btsams ma thag pā tun gyis shog sgrig dpung tshogs gsum pa'i khrab ldan 'khor lo'i ru dpung drangs te bzhur chu dang 'dam gzhung / nags tshal brgyud de/ zla7pa'i tshes27nyin khu'u thang si blangs shing / zla7pa'i tshes 30nyin a spu lang hri (lo tsho6)la 'byor/ zla8pa'i tshes 1nyin/ a rgyu lang hri nas phar rgol byas shing khrab ldan 'khor lo'i ru dpung lam gsum la bgos te gdong mchong drag po byed du bcug khag gcig gis nub phyogs la dpung 'jug gis zla 8pa'i tshes 6nyin pu le then nye gling phran phyed ma'i steng gi 'jar dmag gi 'thab ru phar bcad pa dang / khag gcig gis lho phyogs su dpung 'jug gis zla8pa'i tshes 8nyin le kri(77)tshur blangs pa dang de nas byang du dpung skyod byas/ khag gzhan gcig gis shar phyogs su dpung 'jug gis zla8pa'i tshes 17nyin o ar lang tshur blangs pa dang tshes 18nyin zha thi le blangs pa red/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis par zhugs myong pa'i dbyin ji'i gsar 'god pa nyin le mo ar gyis bshad rgyur/ tsa pā tun gyis mnga' 'og gi dmag dpung la ches mgyogs pa'i myur tshad kyis mdun skyod byed chog pa'i sa khul yod tshad la dpung skyod gyis shig ces bka' phab cing / kho rang gi dmag dpung la phal cher gcig gyur gyi bkod 'doms med pa'i tshan du slopa~X /sa mnyam 'brel gyis dmag 'thab bya thabs med par gyur na'ang /

'thab 'bras ha las pa blangs pa red/ 'jar man gyi cha tshang ba'i dpung khag la la zhig nags tshal du hpha ran se'i 'gog rgol las 'gul gyi dmag mis gsod par zhed de khor rkyang du dmas 'thab byed pa'i a ri'i then khe'i ru khag la mgo 'bul lus 'bul byas mizhes dang / 2 a ri'i khrab ldan 'khor lo'i ru dpung mtha' med kyi thang chen nas mi med bang stong la slebs pa ltar gang 'dod du bang rgyugs byed ces bshad pa red/ skabs der pā kun gyi mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i hpha ran se'i khrab ldan 'khor lo'i hri gnyis pa'i hri krang le khu la'e ar(7༅lkoṣṭha)gyis/ tshul 'di ni tag tag1940lor 'jar man gyi then khe'i ru dpung gis hpha ran se bcom dus kyi gnas tshul bskyar du 'khrab pa dang 'dra la rgyal pham gyi phyogs gnyis go brje ba tsam red zer/ pā tun gyis myur rgol dang yul dus dang bstun pa'i dgra 'thab gyis no man te dmag 'khrug gi rgyal khar byas rjes chen po bzhag no man te dmag 'khrug khrod du/'jar dmag khri 40lhag gron pa dang then khe 1300/ dmag spyod rlangs 'khor 20000/ me phyogs 1500bcas brlags pa red/no man te dmag 'khrug ni zla8pa'i tshes 25nyin pa li bcings 'grol byas te mjug bsgril/ de'i rjes su pā tun gyi dmag dpung gis dpung 'jug gsar ba byas pa ste/ 1945lo'i zla3pa'i tshes 22nyin sngon du la'i yin gtsang bor brgal zhing / der mthud nas ston rlung gis sdong lo phyags pa ji bzhin dgra bo cham la phab ste mdun skyod byas/ za3ba'i zla stod du ce khe si lo hpha khe(chomamoX77)yi rgyal mtshams la 'byor ba red/ dus der/ pā tun skar ma bzhi can gyi hrang cang la go 'phar byas yod/zla8ba'i tshes 9nyin 'jar man la kha gtod pa'i dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril rjes/ pā tun pā hpha le ya'i(༅7nya/༅)srid 'dzin dmag don dpon chen du bskos/ 'byor ldan gral rim gyi langs phyogs kyi dbang gis ༵ stan

gyis 'jar man nā tshus(pos)par snying rje skyes 'go bcoms/ kho rang gis zla)pa'i tshes 22nyin bsdus pa'i gsar 'god pa'i sne len tshogs 'du'i steng du/ 'jar man nā tshos can med par gtong 'dod pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi 'char gzhi la mngon sum gyis dma' phab pa ma zad/ da dung 'jar man gyi nā tshos tang dang a ri'i spyi mthun tang ngam dmangs gtso tang rnams la khyad par chen po med par bshad pas mang tshogs 'ur chil ler song / thengs 'dir ed sin ha'o we ar gyis pā tun gyi kha ngor ma bltas par kho rang gi shog sgrig dpung tshogs gsum pa'i dmag spyi'i go sa phab cing ming tsam las sdin gyis stong ba'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs bco lnga ba'i dmag spyir bskos pa da/ 1945lo'i zla 12ba'i tshes)nyin/ pā kun gyis sems thag bcad nas a ri la log rtsis byed pa'i snga nub tu 'grim 'drud byung nyes byung ste(ltos)rmas phog cing / tshes 22nyin mi yul dang gtan du gyes/ skabs der khong gis pho lo 60yi skyes skar la rol ma thag pa yin/ pā tun gshegs rjes/ a ri'isrid gzhung gis kho rang gi lo rgyus dang mdzad rjes kyi skor dril bsgrag rgya /shā ༵༵ // a ri'i na gzhon rnams kyi drag rtsal gyi snying stobs skyed bsring 422

a me' kha'i skaralha'i thob can gyi dmag dpon nad sin nya'o 'thor/zhus yun/ te hed te ed sin ha'o we ar(45 cho 4 ke pa /khorsāsgro 3jimo'i16tshejimado)(1890— 1969)ni ༷ a ri'i snyan grags can gyi dmag don pa zungarmedang chab srid pa zhig yin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i skabs su yo rob gling gi mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi sbyi khyab phro dmag spyi 'khur myong la/ dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril rjes/ a ri'i tsung thung gi chad sin ha'o we ar/las gnas skabs gnyis la bstud 'dzin byas/ kho rang gi dmag don bkod 'doms kyi sgyu rtsal dang dmag don mdzad rjes kyis 'dzam gling gi dmag don lo rgyus steng du bsub thabs med pa'i go sa bzung yod pa yin/byis dus kyi sbyong brdar/ed sin ha'o we ar ni 1890lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 14nyin a ri'i mi khyim phal ba zhig tu skyes/ kho rang gi skya mdog gi skra lo dang dmar zhing grung sha dod pa'i mig zung cha gcig bkra ba'i ngo gdong ni yid du 'ong ba zhig yin/kho rang gi yab kyi khyim tshang gi sgrig rlom ni ha cang nan mo yin te/ bag med du gnyid mi chog pa dang mal khri'i steng nyal 'dug kyang byas mi chog 12 byin/

yab yum gnyis kyis da dung kho rang la khyim las las pa'i goms gshes chags par do snang chen po byas/ khyim gyi 'byor ba ha cang zhan pa'i dbang gis kho rang nam yang dbyar gseng gi skabs su g.yis 'tshag khang du gla byed du 'gro la skabs rer chu tshod 14tsam la las ka las dgos la chung dus nas ngal rtsol la dga' zhing gron bsris byed pa'i goms gshis bzang bo bslabs pa ma zad/blo spobs brtan po zhig yod pa yin/ thengs sheg kho rang gi pus mor rmas phog ste rus par nad btsas nas na zug chen po langs shing tsha mthon po brgyab pas mal sar lhung / sman pas khrag la nad dug phog 'dug pas myur du rkang ba bcad de srog skyob dgos pa'i tshul bshad pa na/ kho rang gis shi yang yan lag skyon can gyi mi zhig bya mi 'dod ces mtha' gcig tu ngo rgol byas pa red/nad rim gyis je sdug la song nas kho rang dran med du brgyal/ sman pas yab yum gnyis la myur du rkang pa gcod par skul yang / yam yum zung gis lan ni bu chung gi re 'dod dang bstun dgos zhes pa de yin/ nyen mchong la rgyal kha thob song ste/ kho rang nad las rgyal te khyad mtshar ba'i ngang rkang par skyon med par gyur/ kho rang chung dus nas dmag don skor gyi dpe cha klog par dga' la nā pho lun dang a ri'i rgyal nang dmag 'khrug skor gyi dpe char lta bar lhag par spro/ nar son rjes kyang gnad 'gag gi dmag 'khrug skor ma brjed par yod pa red/ slob 'bring 'grim dus slob la brtson pas mthar phyin dus slob grogs 31las sbyangs 'bras ang gsum pa zin pa yin/kho rang gi byis dus dang gzhon nu'i dus skabs ni 'di ltar don snying dang ldan par bskyal ba red/ de yis kho rang phyis su dmag don pa dang chab srid pa grags chen zhig byed par rmang gzhi btings/dmag don slob grwa'i bshul lam/42)ba 'bring mthar phyin rjes/ mi tshe'i lam bu ji 'dra zhig zhugs rgyu'i

thad du chad sin ha'o spe ar gyi sems na kha phyogs gsal bo med pas/ kho'i grogs po si we ti ho chi le thi(mo cho 74lko16)yis mtsho dmag slob grwa 'grim rgyu'i bslab bya byas/ mi ring bar zhi ten dmag dpon slob grwas slob ma bsdu skabs ming tho bkod/ rgyugs nan mo blangs pa brgyud de kho rang bsdu len byas pa red/ 1911lo'i zla6par/ kho rang khyim dang gyes te dmag mi'i 'tsho ba'i lo rgyus kyi 'go bcoms/zhi ten dmag don slob grwa ni a ri'i dmag dpon skyed bsring byed pa'i slob grwa ming grags can zhig yin/ dmag don gyi skor tsam ma zad da dung slob chen gyi bslab bya yod tshad bkod sgrig byas yod/ ed sin ha'o we ar ni rtsis rig dang lo rgyus la ha cang dga' zhing / skabs rer kho rang gi rtsis rig gi rtsi thabs de bslab deb kyi rtsi thabs las kyang legs pa red/ yin na'ang / kho rang gi sra brtan gyi blo spobs dang rang bkur gyi bsam pa drag po de zhi ten dmag don slob grwa'i sbyong brdar dang ma 'tshams pas/ kho rang gis gnad don skor zhig la rang tshugs kyis lta tshul bton la/ dmag don slob grwa'i 'go 'dren gyi ngo mdog la mi lta ba red/ de bas/ kho rang gi sbyangs 'bras ni phyi ngos nas bltas na yid tshims pa zhig min te/ mthar phyin slob bu 165las ang 61pa ma gtogs ma zin pa yin/ de lta na'ang kho rang gi dmag don rkyang rkyang gi sbyangs 'bras cung bzang / kho rang gis mi dang lab gleng byed dus gzhan gyi lta tshul nyan pa las tshig mtshams gtan nas mi gcod la/ gzhan gyi skyon cha ni brlang spyod min tshe gu yangs gtong bas slob grogs kyi khrod du kho rang la snyan grags yod pa dang / phyis kyi yo rob mnyam 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi 'khur dus de las ngom ston byas pa red/1915lo'i zla6pa'i tshes 12nyin/ chad sin ha'o we ar gyi zhi ten dmag don slob grwa'i 'tsho ba mjug bsgril zhing / dmag don slob grwa'i 4ཿ/sa

len u yon lhan khang gis kho rang la hro we'i dmag thob gnangs/dmag la zhugs pa'i mos 'dun brtan po/ed sin ha'o we ar gyi dmag la zhugs pa'i mos 'dun des kyag kyog gi lam bu zhig brgyud pa yin/ kho rang zhi ten dmag don slob grwa nas mthar phyin rjes/ khan sa si khul(79lo 〉5)dang mi ring pa'i hran mu'u zhi'u si tun gru kha(7777ma kha)nas bya ba las/ 1917lo'i zla ba'i tshes 6nyin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang por ye nas ma zhugs pa'i a ris 'jar man la dmag 'khrug brda yig btang / dus der/ chad sin ha'o we ar gyis hrang we'i dmag thob blangs yod cing rkang dmag thon 57pa'i nang du dmag 'gan 'khur yod/ rkang dmag thon 'dis nub phyogs rgya mtsho chen po brgal bar sta gon byed kyin pa'i sgang yin/ kho rang g.yul sar skyod par ha cang dga' bo byed de/ rgyu mtshan ni de ltar byas na byas rjes 'jog thub pa ma zad/ da dung don dngos las dmag don sgyu rtsal la rgyus lon byed thub pas yin/ kho rang gis rtsa 'dzugs kyi 'jon nus ngom ste dmag dpung tshad mtho ba'i dmag 'thab gra sgrig gi rnam par gnas su bcug 'on kyang / ed sin ha'o we ar gyi mos 'dun mngon du 'gyur ma thub ste/ 1917lo'i zla)pa'i tshes 20nyin/ kho rang dmag dpon sbyong brdar dbyin zhig tu slob khrid byed du mngags shing / zla 'ga'i rjes su yang bskyar dbyin gzhan zhig tu mngags nas dmag dpon la sbyong brdar byed du bcug slob khrid dmag dpon byed pa'i dus skabs su/ kho rang gi 'jon nus de 'go khrid kyi blor bab pas/der mthud nas kho rang la a ri'i then khe'i dmag dpung khag dang po sgrig 'dzugs byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ kho rang gis rgyang ring ba'i mig shes kyiswā /spya khe yis gnam gru dang 'dra bar dmag 'khrug khrod du byed nas gal

chen thon par nges shes gsal bo yod pa red/ dmag 'khrug las mngon pa'i then khe ni da dung nar ma son pa'i dus skabs na lus yod na'ang lag rtsal bsgyur bcos byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ kho rang gi sems la/ phyis su 'gul skyod dal zhing rgyu spus dma' ba'i then khe dag dor nas/ myur tshad mgyogs shing bsod rmas gtong shugs che ba'i then khe yis de'i tshab byed dgos par 'dod/ lta tshul 'di rigs yod mkhan ni skabs de'i a ri'i dmag dpon khrod du mang po med pa red/ kho rang gi then khe'i dmag dpung gi khyad du 'phags pa'i bya bar gzengs bstod byed ched/ 1918lo'i zla6pa'i tshes 17nyin kho rang la hro zho yi dmag thob gnangs shing / lo de'i zla 10ba'i tshes 14nyin/ yang bskyar krung zho yi dmag thob bstsal pa dang / krung zho yi bya dga'i rtags ma'ang gnangs pa red/ gzengs bstod byed sgo'i steng du/ kho rang la 6 sdug rus dang sngon dpag nus pa/ rtsa 'dzugs dang slob khrid/ sbyong brdar thad kyi srid 'dzin do dam gyi 'jon nus ldan mi zhes gdeng 'jog byas la/ kho rang gis sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung la'ang a ri'i dmag dpung khrod kyi ches phul du byung ba'i dpung khag yin par bsngags pa red/chad sin ha'o we ar de tsam gyis yid mi tshims par g.yul sar 'gro rgyu'i re 'dun zhu/ kho rang gi re 'dun la chog mchan bkod dus 'jar man pham nas mgo btags pas mngon 'gyur bya ma thub pa red/ de'i rjes su/kho rang rang nyid kyis las rigs bdams pa nor song ba'i dogs pa skyes shing /'jon nus bkol sa med pa'i lta tshul byung / dus mtshungs par kho rang gi lo gsum la son pa'i bu chung ta'e we( )nad kyis 'das shing de la rkyen byas nas chung mar dbang rtsa'i rigs kyi nad lci mo phog ste mal sar lhung / de'i dbang gis/ ed sin ha'o we ar sems khams ma skyid par dmag dpung las phyir 'bud 'dod skyes/ 1922lor kho rang pā na mā mis bzos 4/shāng

po'i(༅rsā667)rgyud du mngag gtong byas shing / de ru kho rang stabs legs nas a ri'i dmag dpung khrod kyi ches shes yon can gyi dmag dpon gyi gras yin pa'i khang nā ti'i( pos)lag 'og nas bya ba sgrub pa'i skal ba thob/dmag dpon chen mo 'dis chad sin ha'o we ar la 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam bzang bo yod pa mthong nas/ kho rang blo zhib mos skyed bsring byas pa dang nam rgyun dmag 'khrug bzlog tu med tshul skor bshad de kho rang la mu mthud dmag la zhugs pa'i dgos phan khyad par can nges par byas pa red/ de nas bzung / yed sin ha'o we ar gyi dmag la zhugs pa'i mos 'dun brtan por gyur la/ rtsed 'jo'i go skabs yod tshad dor nas 'bad pa chen pos dmag don gyi ched rtsom la zhib 'jug dang dmag don gyi gsung rtsom 'bor chen la lta klog byas/ dmag dpon chen mo khang nā ti dang lab gleng byas pa brgyud phyogs yongs nas dmag don gyi sgyu rtsal la rgyus lon zab mo byung / 1925lor khang nā tis mtshams sbyor rgyud kho rang le wun lo si gru kha'i(lko/4ṣṭha skyo )drag jus slob gling du slob gnyer la phyin zhing / de ru kho rang gi sbyangs 'bras slob ma 275yi yang rtser son/ mthar phyin rjes/ kho rang yang bskyar khang nā tis mtshams sbyor brgyud de yun ring bor hpha ran se nas bya ba bsgrubs pa ma zad/'khrug chen dang po'i skabs su a ri dmag 'khrug la zhugs pa'i skor gyi dpe cha rtsom sgrig byed 'go brtsams/ de brgyud nas kho rang gis g.yul 'khrug gal chen dag gi bye brag gi gnas tshul la zhib mor rgyus lon bya thub pa byung ba red/a ri la phyir log rjes/ kho rang yang bskyar hwa hrin tun gyi skam dmag slob gling du zab sbyong la phyin/ 1928lor mthar phyin rjes dmag don slob gling 'dzugs pa'i bya bar gzhol/ kho rang gis bris pa'i yig cha a ri'i dmag gi spyikhyab drag jus dmag dpon me khu a sig(zam 0)gi blor bab/ de'i rjeswā sbyaḥ/ kho rang gis ched du me khu a sig gis rgyal tshogs la phul ba'i snyan zhu

dang gtam bshad kyi tshig rtsom 'bri byas pa red/ me khu a sig gis a ri'i hphi li phen(lkoṣṭharsā)du sdod pa'i dmag don gyi blo 'dri sa byed dus kho rang gis lag rogs pa'i 'gan 'khur/ 1936lor chad sin ha'o we ar la krung zho yi dmag thob las med na'ang / kho rang dmag don gyi thad nas yongs su nar son yod pa yin/mi rgyas lon zhing bkol spyod byed mkhas pa/'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa langs rjes/ 1942lo'i zla3pa'i tshes 9nyin/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyis drag jus khang gi dmag 'thab khru'u yi khru'u krang thog ma'i 'gan 'khur ba dang dus mtshungs su/ hro cang gi dmag thob kyang gnangs ba red/ mi ring bar kho rang lon ton la mngag gtong gis yo rob gling gi g.yul sa'i dmag spyir bskos/ las 'gan 'di 'dra'i lci mo zhig phrag tu len par yid rton 'pher ba'i lag rogs skor zhig med du mi rung ba yin pas/ kho rang la mtshon na lag rogs gdam ga byed pa de gnad don gal chen zhig yin/ kho rang gi mnga' 'og gi pā tun ni 'jon nus gzhan las 'phags pa'i a ri'i mtho rim dmag dpon zhig yin/ yin na'ang kho rang ni mi ngang thung zhig yin pa red/ hphe gling byang ma'i dmag 'khrug khrod/pā tun gyis dmag sgrig la ma 'dzem par sman khang du nad bcos byed bzhin pa'i dmag mir sdigs rdeg byas te shugs rkyen ngan pa bzhag myong / don de ed sin ha'o we ar gyis thos ma thag pā tun la dmag mi de dang tshul de mthong ba'i sman khang gi las byed mi snar dgongs dag zhu ru bcug pa red/da dung don dag 'di 'dra byung na sngar bzhin 'di ltar thag gcod byed rgyu yin pa khyab bsgrags byas/ yin yang cung ma 'gor bar/ mi re 'gas don de gsar 'gyur las rigs la bshad pas/ re zhig ring ed sin ha'o we sdu/ la

mi kha drag po phog na yang / kho rang gis mi kha'i gnon shugs gzed de pā tun sngar bzhin rang gi dmag khrod du bzhag pa red/ kho rang gis pā tun ni 'gad gtor rang bzhin gyi gtam bshad spel bar goms pa gsal bor shes pas/ kho rang la dmag 'khrug khrod 'gan khur gal chen 'khur du 'jug pa ma gtogs/ mi mang tshogs sar gtam bshad spel du mi 'jug pa red/ yin na'ang / lon ton du 'du tshogs zhig gi steng du/ pā tun gyis 'khrug chen mjug sgril rjes dbyin ji dang a ri gnyis mnyam 'brel gyis 'dzam gling bdag skyong bya dgos zhes pa'i gtam bshad spel pas/ yang bskyar mi kha chen po byung ba dang / la las mngon sum gyis pā tun shog sgrig dpung tshogs kyi dmag spyir mi 'os tshul bshad pa red/ chad sin ha'o we ar ni pā tun gyis gshes ka de je legs su bsgyur mi thub par sems khral chen po skyes/ de lta na'ang / kho rang gis don der mjug mtha'i sdom tshig ma bkod par zhib bsher byas pa na/ de ni bdag pos yang yang re 'dun zhu pas pā tun gyis da gzod ngo ma bzlog par gtam bshad spel ba ma zad/ da dung de ni srid phyogs la 'brel ba med par sger gyi 'du phyogs shig yin pa sngar nas bshad yod pa red/ don de'i dbang gis pā tun gyis kyang las gnas dgongs zhu byas na'ang / ed sin ha'o we ar gyis kho rang la ma 'ongs ba'i shog sgrig dpung tshogs gsum pa'i dmag spyi'i go gnas bzhag pa red/ des pā tun la sems 'gul chen po thebs pa dang phyis kyi dmag 'khrug khrod bkod 'doms byas pa sngar las legs par gyur ba red/ chad sin ha'o we ar gyis 'jon ndha/ can gyi dmag dpon gzhan dag la'ang 'di lta bu'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa dmag skyong bar thabs dang ldan pa/43spyan yongs la bdag dam byed pa'i mtho rim bkod 'doms pa zhig

yin pa'i cha nas/ yed sin ha'o we ar gyis ji ltar dmag mi skyong ba dang ji ltar dmag mi la brten dgos tshul gsal bor rtogs yod pa red/ kho rang gi lta tshul rnyar na/ dmag mir bka' ji bzhin brtsi srung byed du 'jug dgos pa ma zad/ da dung dmag mir de ltar byed dgos don ci yin pa shes su 'jug dgos pa dang / dmag mir rang gi dmag dpung gi snyan grags la thugs khur dang rogs pa'i bsam 'char la brtsi 'jog gong rim gyi bka' ji bzhin brtsi dgos pa'i skor gyi slob gso gtong ba de ha cang gal che bar sems/yin yang a ri'i dmag mis de las kyang dmag 'khrug rgyag dgos don ci yin shes 'dod pa red/ de shes na da gzod kho tshos dpa' ngar chen pos dmag 'thabasten pa yin/ dmag mis kyang mes rgyal srung skyob kyi 'os 'gan sgrub dus da gzod rang gi yod 'os pa'i khe dbang la rol thub par 'dod/gal te dmag mis kyang bkod 'doms pa dang mnyam du las 'gan lci mo de 'khur dgos na/ bkod 'doms pas nges par phyogs yongs nas dmag mir 'brel 'dris byed dgos pa yin/ 'di ni chad sin ha'o we ar gyis dmag mi skyong ba'i dam tshig gtso bo zhig yin/chad sin ha'o we ar gyis dmag dpung gis dmag gzigs mdzad sgo bsdus nas kho rang la gong bkur byed par bkag 'gog byed pa dang / ras gur du 'dug dgos kyang yangs shing rgyas spros che ba'i gzhung las khang du sdod mi 'dod pa yin/ dbyi tha li ru rang gi gzhis ka de dmag mi'i nad gso khang byas pa red/ tshul de a ri'i dmag mi'i khrod du ches gleng 'dod pa'i skad char gyu/ma/ ga dpung la lta bsher byed thengs re rer/ kho rang gis thog mar lta bsher byed sa ni mtshon cha dang sgrig chas min par dmag mi'i bza' bca' dang bde thang gi gnas tshul yin pa red/ lta bsher mjug bsdus rje13/1 kho

rang gis dmag mi dang mnyam du za ma za ba dang de brgyud nas mkho sprod kyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon byed/ nam rgyun/ khom glags re rnyed tshe dmag mi'i khrod du song nas kha brda byas te dmag mi'i ngar shugs slong ba yin/ mi la las de ni dus tshod chud zos su btang bar 'dod kyang kho rang gis de ni bkod 'doms dmag dpon zhig la yod thos pa'i 'byung spus yin par sems/ dmag mi'i ngar shugs slong bar phan pa'i don yod tshad la kho rang gis bka' 'dri zhu nges yin/ rgyu mtshan ni dmag mi'i sems la rang gi 'tsho ba'i thob thang 'os 'tshams yin pa dang 'go khrid kyis rang la thugs khur byed pa/ rang gi byas 'bras la yod 'os pa'i gdeng 'jog thob pa'i bsam tshul byungan da gzod kho tsho'i dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyi snying stobs de tshad med par gtong nges pa dang / de las ldog tshe/ dmag mir khong khro skyes te 'thab sems la shugs rkyenathabs srid pa red/ thengs shig la/ hphe gling du g.yul 'khrug rgyag bzhin pa'i mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gis khrog le(po(7)zami thub pa dang tha mag 'then mi thub pa'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas pa ma zad/ kho tshos shes pa ltar na dngos po de dag mkho sprod sde khag la thon yod pa red/ed sin ha'o we ar gyis sa de'i bkod 'doms dmag dpon la yang yang tsha 'dri byas pa na rgyu mtshan ni skyel 'dren yo byad med pa de red/ kho rang gis myur du rgyab phyogs la kha par brgyab ste g.yul sa'i dmag mir thob 'os pa'i dngos rdzas kyi skal ma 'byor bar du mkho sprod sde khag la dngos rdzas phran tsam yang ster mi chog pa'i bka' phab pas/ da gzod skyon cha de yo bsrang byed thub pa byung / yang thengs sheg la/ g.yul sa'i phyogs nas yod 'os pa'i rlangs snum dang tha mag med pa'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas shing / yid rton 'pher ba'i gsang 'phrin ltar na/ dngos rdzas de dag pa li'i lkog tshong khrom ra/ ༵༵ yod tshul bshad/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyis myur du rtog zhib byas

pa na/ mkho sprod sde khag gis gzhi rgya che ba'i lkog tshong dra ba zhig btsugs yod pa shes/ kho rang ha cang khros te myur du gtug bsher byas te dmag mi yongs la nyes pa can khrims las 'gongs ma thub pa'i tshul shes su bcug pa dang dus mtshungs su/ nyes can mang por nyes bshags byed pa'i go skabs bstsal te g.yul sar zhabs 'degs sgrub pa'i khrod du rang gi gnong ba yod tshad bshags su bcugachad sin ha'o we ar gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i dmag skyong gi sgyu rtsal gyis rgya che ba'i dpon dmag gi 'thab sems dang ngar shugs bslangs shing /'jar man hpha shi si las rgyal ba'i nor bu zhig tu gyur ba red/chab srid pa'i blo khogayo rob mnyam 'brel dmag gi spyi khyab dmag spyi 'khur rjes/ chad sin ha'o we ar gyis chab srid pa'i blo khog spyad de 'thab 'khrug rgyag par dmag don gyi steng nas 'char bkod zhib mo 'god pa ma zad/ chab srid kyi steng nas rgyang ring bo'i 'char bkod 'god pa red/thog mar kho rang gis mnyam 'brel rgyal khab dbyin ji dang 'brel ba dam po bzung bar mthong chen byas/ dbyin ji'i blon chen chi'u ce ar(2tshipo)ni kha gtad gcog dka' ba'i chab srid pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ da dung dmag dpon chen mo'i dmag thob yod mkhan zhig yin/ 1943lo'i zla8par/a ri'i rgyab rogs dmag dpung 'char gzhi ltar hpha ran se'i lho phyogs kyi gru kha nas skam sar bud de myur stabs kyis yo rob gling gi g.yul sar 'jug rtsis byed skabs/ chi'u ce ar gyis hpha ran se'i nub byang mtshams kyi pu le thā nye(bosto/ 2)gling phran phyed ma nas yo rob gling la 'jug pa'am yang na dbyi tha li'i g.yul 'khrug la zhugs na 'os par sems la/ de ltar byas na 435ga

mthar ya ti le ya(sgrotso lko/༅)rgya mtsho brgyud nas pā ar kun gyi rgyal khab la dpung 'jug byed bde bar snyam pa red/ ed sin ha'o we ar ni chi'u ce ar gyis 'char gzhi rang snang gis bsgyur bar ha cang ma dga' par kho rang dang thad kur rtsod pa brgyab/ thog mar chi'u ce ar gyis rang gi lta tshul mkhregs 'dzin byas pa ste/ kho rang gi lta tshul ltar byas na sngon gyi 'char gzhi las dpung skyod lam thig phan 'bras ldan tshul dang / hpha ran se'i lho phyogs nas phar rgol byas na a ri'i dmag dpung la god chag tshabs chen 'byung nges tshul bshad/ 'on kyang / ed sin ha'o we ar gyis gsang 'phrin brgyud nas hpha ran se'i lho phyogs su 'jar dmag nyung ngu las med pa shes yod la/ de ru mnyam 'brel dmag dpung myur stabs kyis byang phyogs su dpung skyod byas chog pa red/ kho rang gis bgro gleng byed skabs chi'u ce ar la chab srid kyi dmigs yul nges can zhig yod pa tshor ba ste/ chi'u ce ar gyis dmag 'khrug mjug sgril rjes nub phyogs rgyal khab dang lhag par dbyin jis pā ar kun(3por)khul gtso bor 'dzin 'dod pa de red/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyis dmag don gyi ngos nas chi'u ce ar gyi 'dod tshul la mos mthun ma byas pa red/ kho rang ma zad nyams myong ldan pa'i dmag dpon su zhig yin yang hpha ran se'i lho phyogs nas phar rgol byed pa'i 'char gzhi lag bstar bya nges pa yin/ chi'u ce ar gyis 'char gzhi lag bstar byed pa'i snga nub tu'ang rang gi lta tshul mkhregs 'dzin byed na'ang / cang ma 'gor bar rang gi 'dod tshul mngon 'gyur byed mi thub pa shes nas da gzod sngar gyi 'char gzhi la mos mthun byas pa red/ed sin ha'o we ar dang dbyin dmag gi spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa mong ko mā le bar gyi 'brel lam cung rtog 'dzing che yang / thog mtha' bar gardiswā ༵ mnyam 'brel byas nas mtha' 'khyol bar byas pa red/ kho gnyis kyi

dmag don thad kyi lta tshul mi mthun pa de gtso bo so so'i chab srid kyi khe phan gyis thag gcod pa yin/ chi'u ce ar dang chad sin ha'o we ar gnyis kyis dmag 'khrug 'char gzhi bsgyur min gyi rtsod pa rgyag dus/ mong ko mā le yis glo bur du g.yul 'khrug gi go rim hril po'i khrod du sa gnas dmag dpung gi 'thab rtsal snyoms sgrig byed pa'i tshod 'dzin dbang cha mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs bya dgos pa'i re 'dun bton pa yang de las ma 'das/ re 'dun de ni mngon 'gyur bya thub pa zhig min te/ rgyu mtshan ni mi gcig gis g.yul sa zhig gi 'gan khur sgrub pa'i zhir la g.yul sa so so'i bya bar yang dag pa'i lta skul bya thabs med pas yin/ ches mtho pa'i bkod 'doms khang dang shog sgrig dpung tshogs kyi dmag spyi'i bar du kher tshugs kyi sa gnas dmag dpung gi dmag spyi khang zhig 'dzugs 'dod pa ni dpe mi srid pa zhig yin pa red/chad sin ha'o we ar gyis gnas lugs gsal bor rtogs su bcug pas mjug mthar mong ko mā le yis kho rang gi bsam 'char dang len byas/ dmag 'khrug mjug bsgril rjes/ mong ko mā le yis 'phrin yig cig tu kha khog med par brjod don/ 2 dka' tshegs che zhing zing long rgod ba'i lo zla'i nang /khyedakyis nga rang lam log tu 'gro ru ma bcug pa ma zad/ da dung nga la slob ston mang po gnangs/ 'di dag yod tshad la ngas sems gting nas bka' drin zhu bzhin yod ’ ces so// ed sin ha'o we ar gyis rnyog 'dzing gi 'brel ba 'di dag 'os 'tshams kyis thag bcad pa ni las sla bo zhig ga la yin/chad sin ha'o we ar gyis da dung hpha ran se'i phyi rgyal 'gog rgol phyogs khag gi gtso 'dzin te ko le dang 'brel lam bzang bo btod myong / a ris dmag 'khrug mjug bsdus rjes rang gis hpha ran se nas khe phan len par dmigs nas/ te ko le la rgyab skyor ma byas par a ris kha lo sgyur bzhin pa'i dmag dpon chen mo ci lo la rgyab skyor byas pa red/ yin na'ang / ekā byin

ha'o we ar gyis tshor shes rnon pos hpha ran se'i 'gog rgol las 'gul gyi mtshon byed ngo ma ni te ko le yin pa shes/ de bas/ kho rang gis thabs lam sna tshogs spyad de te ko le dang mnyam 'brel byed par shugs snon byas/1944lor mo a tin dmag 'khrug rgyag skabs/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyis mnyam 'brel dmag dpung si thi la si po sa khul nas phyir 'then bya rgyu thag bcad/ dus der te ko le ni si thi la si po yi bde 'jags la sems khur skyes bzhin pa'i sgang yin/ 1945lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 3nyin/ te ko le kho rang dang 'phrad par yong zhing / sa khul de ni 1870lo'i phu hpha dmag 'khrug brgyab pa nas bzung da bar du hpha ran se'i mi dmangs kyi mtshon byed yin pas/ dus thung du'i nang phar shor ba la'ang hpha ran se'i mi dmangs la gdung sems tshad med skye nges pa'i tshul bshad pa dang / da dung dus la bab tshe si thi la si po yi nye 'khor la 'jar 'gog dmag dpung yod tshad drangs nges shing dmag dpung yongs su bstim dgos kyang 'dzem dogs byed mi srid pa'i bsam tshul bstan/ ed sin ha'o we ar gyi sems la te ko le yis chab srid kyi ngos nas gnad don la 'dang brgyab pa yin pas rang 'dod gtsor bzung ba ni dngos don gyi gtan tshigs dang mthun pa zhig min par 'dod/ de bas/ kho rang gis te ko le la gal te bka' dang 'gal tshe hpha ran se'i 'jar 'gog dmag dpung dang 'brel thag gcod nges pa'i tshul gsal 'debs byas/ yin yang rjes su kho rang gis dmag don gyi ngos nas yang bskyar bsam gzhig byas te te ko le yi re 'dun de la'ang gnas lugs yod par snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni si thi la si po btang tshe mnyam 'brel dmag dpung hpha ran se'i rgyal khongs yongs la skyod pa'i 'grim 'grul lam thig dang mkho sprod lam thig la shugs rkyen thebs nges pas red/ de'i dbang gis/ kho rang gis dmag dpon chen mo ti hphe si la rdibye 6'then byed pa'i 'char gzhi bskyur te dmag dpung gis si thi la si po

brtan srung byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ thag gcod des te ko le la dga' ba chen po skyed cing chi'u ce ar gyis kyang bsngags brjod byas pa red/tag tag chab srid pa'i blo khog yod pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i dmag don pa 'dis/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su a ri'i skar lnga'i thob can gyi hrang cang gi go sa blangs shing / a ri'i tsung thung gi las 'khur skabasaganyis la bsdud 'dzin byas te 'dzam gling gi grags che ba'i lo rgyus mi snar gyur/ de lta na'ang / kho rang ni 'byor ldan gral rim gyi chab srid pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas srid dbang 'dzin dus/ gung khran ring lugs par zhed snang dang 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam blo drag po yod cing krung go dang a ri bar gyi 'brel lam je sdug tu btang ba red do//437

'khrug che'in gnyis pa'itshoskabs kyi dmag spyi chezad mo mong ko mā le/gi'u yong / rnape nā )lozhumong ko mā leyi po41 lho zaca198 887—976ni dbyin ji'i skam dmag gi ma la dmag spyi yin la/ khyad du 'phags —9ji pa'i dmag don pa zhig yin/ 'khrug chen gnyis pa'iskabasasudabyin ji'i rang//tshogs khagabargyadapa'i dmag dpung sgojirigasica rmegi dmag spyi bzung zhing / skad grags che ba'i hphe gling byang ma'i dmag 'khrug ci 464khrilolo/la bkod 'doms kyang mong ku'u ma res/byed myong / kho rang gis dbyin ji'i dmag dpung la sne khrid de 'jar man gyi dmag dpung bye thang gi wa mo lung me ar pham par byas pas mtshan snyan phyogs bzhir khyab cing / patshobatsu co'o zhes pa'i cho lo'ang thob/ 'khrug chen gyi rjes su no man ti'i rgyal srid 'phrog rgyu'i 'char gzhi gtan 'bebs byed pa'i bya bar zhugs shing / nub byang gi mna' 'brel dmag gi dmag spyi byas te dmag sne drangs nas hpha shi si'i dmag tshogs cham la phab/ 'khrug long dngas rjes dbyin ji'i btsan rgyal ridwa sdusas kyi spyi khyab dmag dpon dang / nub rgya mtsho chen po'i byang khul gyi

thun mong rtsa 'dzugs tshogs pa'i ches mtho'i dmag spyi tshogs pa'i spyi khyab dmag spyi gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1958lor las 'khyur byas rjes snga phyir 〈dmag spyi mong ko mā le yi rjes dran zin tho〉dang〈srid 'dzin pa'i lam du 'jug byed kyi them skas/〉〈'thab 'khrug gi lo rgyus〉sogs brtsams te dpe skrun byas/dmag sne hphe gling byang mar drangs// 'thab jus btsan pos pha rol bcom//phyogs kun nas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i g.yul 'khrug langs bzhin pa'i skabs su/ 1942lo'i zla8tshes 4la mtho rim dmag gi slob grwa nas tshad ldan sbyong brdar la zhugs myong ba'i krung cang mong ko mā le hphe gling byang khul du mngags te dbyin ji'i dmag dpung tshogs khag brgyad pa la bkod 'doms byed du bcug skabs de'i hphe gling byang khul gyi gnas babs de dbyin dmag la mtshon na ha cang dka' khag che ba'i gnas tshul zhig la thug yod/ 1941lo'i lo mjug tu 'jar man dang dbyi tha li'i hpha shi si dmag tshogs kyis skor dkyil rgya mtsho'i mkha' lam bdag 'dzin dbang cha dang mtsho ngos bdag 'dzin dbang cha tshang ma ham 'dzin byas pa dang / 1942lo'i zla dang por phyogs 'khor 100bsnan te mu mthud du dbyin dmag la tshur rgol byas/ zla 5bar 'jar dbyi dmag tshogs kyis glo bur du dbyin dmag gis mtha'asrung sa thig pe ar ho mu'u brgal te thu'u phu lu khe ru rgol ba byas/ e cib kyi nub phyogs brgyud nas mtsho 'gag mā the lu gru kha(66 stsa)dbang 'dzin byas shing / zla 7pa'i stod la ā la man(༅74)gyi shar khul du slobs pa dang ya li hran ta'i mtsho 'gag(༅77shā 6)dang bar thag spyi le 40las med pa'i bar slebs/ mtshams 'dir dmag spyir slebs ma thag pa'i shārnyi ko

mā le la mtshon na las 'gan ha cang ljid de 'di nas dgra phyogs la phyi rgol byed rgyu ni snang chung byed rgyu'i las ka zhig gtan nas min/ kho rang gi bsam par da nas 'thab 'khrug gcig pos btsan 'dzul ba mthar sprod dgos snyam pa dang / rang gis rang la yid ches brtan po byas/mong ko mā le yis dmag shugs ni dgra las rgyal ba'i rtsa ba red bsam pa dang / rtog zhib byed dus dmag mi rnams kyi gdong mdog nag por gyur yod padang / dka' las ha cang che bzhin pa shes pa ma zad/ dmag dpon la las rang gis rang la yid ches chung bas 'thab 'khrug langs ma thag ha cang sla yang mtha' mjug slar yang pham kha nyo bzhin pa shes/ mong ko mā le yis de dag la skul slong dang dka' khag khyad gsod kyi phyir du dmag spyi bkod 'doms pa skor zhig dang dmag jus blo 'don pa(ṣṭhaṣṭhaṣṭha)skor zhig bsdus nas gtam 'dri ba dang thabs bkod 'then te dgra dmag pham par rgyag par yid ches med pa dang bros byol byed 'dod kyi bsam pa rtsa ba nas bsgyur dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bsgrags pa ma zad/ nga tshos 'di nas dgra dmag dang khrag dmar gyi khrod du 'thab 'khrug byed ces yongs su bsgrags/ kho rang giblo thag chod po'i gtam de dag gis 'thab dmag yongs la skul slong dang yid ches rgyas shing / kho rang gis rang gis rang la nga ni ru bkra shis pa'i mi mizhig yin pa ma zad/ rgyal kha'i mtshon byed yin zhes bsgrags/ dmag dpon gzhan dag gis rang nyid ngos 'dzin gsal bo yod phyir kho rang gis thog mar dbyin dmag gi dpon po'i bkod 'doms zhwa mo ma gyon par o si khru li ya'i shing lo'i zhwa mo gyon pa dang / mi ring bar slar yang mdog nag po can gyi me phyogs dmag gi zhwa mo gyon/ kho rang gis dus tshod bkod sgrig 'os babs byas te dmag dpon rnams la gros mol byed pa dang / rang nyid dang spyi babs kyi las4 / dam du 'brel dgos pa'i bsgrags gtam yang yang bton/ da dung

dmag dpung bkod sgrig gsar du byas pa dang / dmag tshogs(zarngi3tsho)la shugs snon byas te hri 44pa dang hri 51pa phyogs gsum gyi khul nas phyir 'then byas te byang lam phyed ma'i g.yul sa'i dmag tshogs gsum la shugs snon dang rgyab skyor byas shing / gra sgrig dmag dpung je nyung du btang / sngar yod dmag dpon nus pa med pa mtha' dag sngar nas kho rang gi lag 'og tu bya ba sgrub myong ba'i dmag dpon dag gis las brje byas/ dper na krung cang( stsa)ma'e ar se teng phu'u zhi(༅po skya po)mdel 'gog 'thab dmag(lko stso)khag 10ba'i dmag dpon bzung ba dang / krung cang o li hphe na si( lko1stoXlko146)dmag khag 30pa'i dmag dpon du mngag pu'u le yin ho lu khi si(bo ṣṭharsā77lo)dbyin ji nas gdan 'dren byas te dmag khag 13par bkod 'doms byed du bcug pas sra brtan stobs shed can gyi bkod 'doms ma lag zhig chags thub pa byung ba red/dmag dpon rnam pa'i stobs shugs gcig sgril yong pa dang / bkod 'doms mtha' chod pa'i phyir du mong ko mā le yis khyim mi su yin yang dmag khul du yong mi chog pa'i bka' bsgrags pa dang / dmag mis gong rim gyi bka' rgya la sgor dang dngos po brje byed mi chog par bka' bzhin nges par du sgrub dgos pa dang / sgrub mi chog pa dag nges par du mtshams 'jog dgos par bsgrags/mong ko mā le yis thengs dang po'i bkod 'doms de dag gis dmag khag brgyad pa la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'gyur ldog cig byung du bcug ste/1942lo'i zla 10bar dmag khag brgyad pa'i dmag mi'i mi 'bor 1950)tsher bud pa dang / then te(77)1kha59 bud pa dang 'thab 'go 'dzin skabs kyi 'jar dbyi dmag dpung gi stobs shugs las yongs su brgal/ 441

rnam dpyod can la mthong chen rgyas// tshad ldan dmag dpon g.yul du bskul//rnam dpyod che ba'i dmag spyi mong ko mā le yis hphe gling gi g.yul sar ches 'os 'tshams dang / ches gsar ba'i thabs jus kyi sgo nas dmag dpon dag la dmag dpung gi sna 'dren byed du bcug de ni kho rang gis dmag khag brgyad pa'i si ling(73)a'o cen le'i khu krin gyi dmag bkod pa te cin kun te bod spyad pa'i gnas tshul las gsal bshad byed thub ste/ kho gnyis g.yul sa nas thog mar ngo mjal byung dus/ te cin kun te yis rang gi mdun lam ci 'dra yin pa mi shes pa dang / kho tsho sngon chad grogs po yin na'ang lo mang bo'i ring la thug 'phrad ma byung ba dang / gshes ka dang dga' phyogs tshang mar khyad par chen po byung ste mi mthun sa gang mang byung yod/mong ko mā le yis khyad par de dag ni bya ba mi legs pa zhig gtan nas min par phan tshun la mi 'dang sar kha skong byed thub par 'dod/ kho rang gis te cin kun te yi rnam dpyod la mthong chen chen po byas shing / bed spyod byas te kho rang tshan dmag jus blo 'don pa(ṣṭhaṣṭhaṣṭha)la yar 'then byas pa dang /rang nyid kyi tshab byas nas gtam bshad spel chog pa'i dbang cha sprad/ de'i phyir phyis kyi 'thab 'khrug khrod te cin kun te yis nus pa khyad par ba bton/yang dper na/ ā la man 'thab 'khrug(༅74lo7)'go rtsom pa'i snga rol du/ mong ko mā le yis lho khul gyi dam srung sa mtshams kyi dmag spyi pu tun yin hu lo khu si btsal te mnyam du 'khrug jus(loṭha)dang gnas bab la shin tu yid ches yod pa'i dbye zhib byas/ kho rang gis hu lo khu si la go skabs dam 'dzin dang gra sgrig legs po byas nas lung me ar g.yon gshog lta bu'i dbyinā )mag gi dpung tshogs pham par rgyag dgos pa'i gsal 'debs yang

yang btang ba dang / 'phro brlag byed mi dgos pa'i mdel rdzas gron chung dang / g.yol thub pa'i chag sgo ci nas kyang g.yol dgos par bstan/ nye sngon dmag khag 13pa'i 'gog srung sa khul gyi 'char gzhir mi 'tshams pa'i gnad don rnams dag bcos sgrig byed chog kyang nges par du yang dag tu 'gro dgos pa dang / da lta'i bya ba'i gnad 'gag ni dmag khag de'i hri slobs dmag srung byas pa'i hwa le'e tha'i ri khul nas 'jar man gyi dmag shugs ngoms rgyu de red ces yang yang bdams/ sngon chad ltar na/ hwa le'i pho'i ri khul ni btsan sa bzang po zhig yin/ 'di nas ci ltar byas kyang dmag shugs 'thor zhig tu gtong ba'i 'thab ra 'dzugs mi thub pas 66'di ni me stogs dmag gi 'thab 'khrug gi rtsen ra ’ yin/ rgyu mtshan ni sa sra zhing 'thas pas me phyogs bgrod bde ba yin/ hu lo khu si yis dngos su dbye zhib yang dag byas te lung me ar gyis hphe gling yongs su rgol nges pa ma zad/ dmag khag 13pa'i 'gog srung sa khul brgyud nges yin pa thag gcod byas/ sngon 'gog gi 'thab 'khrug rgyag ched/ kho rang gis a ri'i rtags can gyi then khe gsar ba 60can gyi stogs dmag khag 22pa de mtho tshad 102mtshams su yib sdod byed du bcug pa dang / phyogs dmag khag 10ba nas a ri'i rtags can gyi then khe 60gra sgrig byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi bton/ skad grags che ba'i dbyin ji'i dmag spyi chi'u ce er(2tshipo)gyis 'thab jus de blo yul du ma 'char ba ma zad/hu lo khu si yis dmag khag 13pa'i g.yul sa nas 'gog rgol byas par le bda' byas/ hu lo khu si yis 'di ltar byas na lung me ar gyis tshur rgol byed skabs mjug skyong thub pa'i 'grel bshad brgyab/ chi'u ce ar gyis da rung ha ma go bas yid ches ma byas na'ang mong ko mā le yis hu lo khu si bos te rang nyid kyis bkod sgrig ltar byed dgos par bshad/ rjes nas 'khrug 'go bcoms pa nas hu lo khu si yi bkod sgrig ltar phyogs 'khor rnams thun mong gi shāspyad

'doms ltar g.yul sar zhugs/ lung me ar gyis dmag shugs bed spyad de rgol ngan 'joms bsam yang dbyin dmag gis g.yul sa btsan srung byas pas 'thab 'khrug bar gyi khe phan tshang ma dbyin dmag la thob/ lung me ar gyis hu lo khu si yi then khe bed spyod bsam yang don smin ma byung bas mthar dmag dpung phyir 'then byed dgos byung / skabs der/ mong ko mā le yis hu lo khu si yi 'dod pa la yid mthun byas te dmag khag gcig mngags nas smyo sgo brgyab ste khyi brdungs pa'i mi jus gzhi spel bas lung me ar la rang shugs kyis khyad gsod thebs/ de ni mong ko mā le yi rgyab skyor dang skul slong la brten nas hu lo khu si yis thog mtha' bar gsum du rang nyid kyi jus gzhi rgyun 'khyongs byed thub pa byung ba yin/rtog bzo'i jus thabs sna chogs kyis// dgra bo'i dpung chogs rmongs par byas//mong ko mā le yi rtog bzo sna tshogs byas te dgra phyogs mgo 'thoms su 'jug par ha cang mkhas/ ā la man g.yul 'khrug khrod du/ dbyin dmag gis ring tshad dbyin li(༅༅)45yod pa'i g.yul sa'i sa phyogs kun nas 'jab rgol byas na chog mod/ mong ko mā le yis thabs bkod sna tshogs 'then nas lung me ar gyis phyogs gang nas tshur rgol byed mi shes par bzos/skabs der dbyin dmag khag 30pa'i bdag dbang sa khul du 'gro bar lam gnyis yod la/ lung me ar gyis bgrod lam mi rnyed phyir dmag dpon mong ko mā le yis zla 10nas 'go bcoms te 'gog srung sa thig ltar then khe rdzun ma dang / me skyogs kyi btsan rdzong / dmag chas nyer mkho'i yo byad nyar khang bkod sgrig byas/ de'i phyir/ dgra bos spyir btang gi rtog zhib tsam gyis dardodri rdzun dbye ba 'byed mi thub par byas/ 'on kyang dbyin dmag gis

mtshan lam brgyud nas drag chas dngos mas rdzun ma'i tshab byed thub/ yang lung me ar gyis dbyin dmag gi tshur rgol byed pa'i dus tshod gsal bor mi shes phyir/ mong ko mā le yis phyogs gzhan zhig tu ched du g.yo jus byas te/ring tshad la spyi le 30yod pa'i tshab mtshon snum blugs sa tshigs btsugs pa dang / de dang mnyam brgyud kyi lcags lam bskrun pa ma zad/ lam mdor chu 'don sa tshugs bskrun/ da rung de'i las 'grub dus tshod spyi zla 11pa'i stod la gtan 'khel byas/ de ni lung me ar gyis dbyin dmag gis tshur rgol byed pa'i dus tshod ni sbyi zla 11pa red snyam pa'i 'khrul snang byung ba red/ de dang dus mtshungs su/ mong ko mā le yis khā khre/rdosto)dang then khe la dpe len gyis gsar bzo byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi rdzun ma bkod sgrig byas/ de dag ha cang mngon gsal che ba'i gnas su bshams nas ched du 'jar man pa'i brtag dpyad 'phur gru(4los7)la brnyan phab byed du bcug thabs jus des lung me ar yongs su mgo 'khor te/ dbyin dmag gis dngos su tshar rgol byed dus/ kho rang gis da rung sa phyogs gang yin yang ngos 'dzin byed ma thub/1944lo'i zla 4bar/ dbyin me mna' 'brel dmag gis no man te skam sa brgyud nas g.yul 'khrug gnyis pa slong rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ no man te skam sar bgrod pa'i g.yul 'khrug khrod/ mong ko mā le yis yang dgra dmag mgo 'khor ba'i thabs bkod byas/ thog mar/ skam sar bgrod pa'i sa khul du/ rang nyid dngos su zhugs nas gtan 'khel byas pa'i mtshon rtags tshang ma smyo 'gyur med gtan tshigs 〉kyi 'char gzhi 'then/ dmigs yul ni skam sar bgrod 'go ma brtsams gong dgra bos mnya' 'brel dmag dpung skam sar bgrod lam ni cwa la'e yin par yid ches skye phyir yin/ de'i phyir/mnyam 'brel dmag gi bkod 'doms pu'u nas dmag khag gcig cwa la'e sa khul nas skam sar mdun skyod byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi bton/ dma~X /ga

'dis nges par dbyin ji'i lho phyogs su gzhi tshugs dgos pa las nub khul dang gzhan khul la gtsigs chen ma byas na chog snga gzhug tu dgra bos dmag khag 21dang gsar 'dzugs byed bzhin pa'i dmag khag 12pa las gzhan/dmag khag gsum pas dbyin ji'i lho khul du dpung 'jug byed bzhin yod pa dang / rgol gnas gtso bo cwa la'e sa khul yin par yid ches byed phyir yin/jus legs des lung me ar gyis dbyin me mna' 'brel dmag gis no man te skam sar bgrod 'go tshugs rjes rang nyid kyi dmag khag 15dmag shugs kyis no man te sa khul gyi 'jar dmag la rogs skyor byas nas tshur rgol byed mi thub par bzos/ don dngos su/ 'char gzhi rdzun ma ltar gyi dmag khag de la dmag mi gcig kyang shi rmas ma bas la/ dmag dpon rdzun ma ni 'char bkod kyi rnam dpyod can cha'o kri pā tun(lkolko khya smo)yin/ dus mtshungs su/ mong ko mā le yis ched du 'jar dmag gi rtogs dpyod 'phur grus par du brgyab pa'i dmag khag bcos ma 'di'i bkod sgrig byas pa'i khang ba bcos ma dang / dmag dpung gi rlangs 'khor bcos ma/ sman lang bcos ma/snum mdzod bcos ma sogs yod tshad yang bskyar lta rtogs byed du bcugaskam sar bgrod pa'i dus tshugs thad/ kho rang gas lhag par du thabs brgya jus stong gis dgra bor mgo 'khor du bcug de ni phyogs gcig nas mong ko mā le yis dbyin dmag la no man te skam sar bgrod rgyu'i gra sgrig byed du bcug pa dang / phyogs gcig nas dgra bos zla 6pa'i gza' 'khor dang bor mong ko mā le dbyin jir med par yid ches su bcug pa dang / dbyin me mna' 'brel dmag gis skabs 'di la brten nas skam sar 'gro rgyu min pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin par byas/ 'dis kho la rang nyid kyi tshab byed zhig btsal nas skam sar ma bgrod pa'i snga rol du kri pu lo'u tho'u sa khul dang ar cer sa khul4 sta6 mngon gsal gyis bya 'gul spel thub par byas yod/ de ni dbyin

dmag gi khrod du ming la kun mu'u si(ṣṭha7lo)zer ba'i gnyer ba zhig yod pa mong ko mā le yi byad gzigs dang ha cang 'dra ba zhig yin/ dmag spyi mong ko mā le yis thengs dang bor kun mu'u si mthong dus ya mtshar chen po skyes/ kho gnyis kyi skye gzugs dang byad bzhin tshang ma ha cang 'dra mtshungs yin/ phyis su/ kun mu'u si yis dmag gos gyon zhing / phrag rtags dang gong rtags(khrirsā7lorsā)btags te mong ko mā le yi khyad chos ldan pa'i pe le'i zhwa mo(70skya)gyon pa dang / rgyun du 'chang ba'i 'khar rgyug lag tu bzung thog mong ko mā le zhes pa'i bsdus ming dpar yod pa'i lag phyis zhig kyang 'chang yod/kun mu'u si ni spyi zla 5tshes 25nyin gnam grur bsdad de kri pu lo'u tho'u ru slebs pa yin/ dmigs 'ben sa tshigs su slebs rjes/ kho them skas kyi steng du bud nas dga' bsu zhu mkhan mi dmangs kyi snga sor tsa mong ti(rsālko) min rnam 'gyur bzung / de'i 'phror rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas spyi 'doms pu'u ru chas pa dang de nas dga' bsu chen po thob/ nyin der mong ko mā le slebs nges pa'i gsar 'phrin de ltar yid kyis 'das pa dang / phyi nyin/ kun mu'u si er cer la chas/ gnam grur zhugs par bskyod pa'i lam bar du/ rlangs 'khor ru khag gis ched du dbyin ji'i bzo las dmag mis sgrub bzhin pa'i bgrod lam las rgyu je mgyogs byas pa dang / dmag mi rnams kyis 6 mong ko mā le ’ mthong rjes skad gseng mthon pos ‘ mong ti la gus 'dud zhu ’ zhes dga' 'bod byas shing / phyogs mang bo nas do snang rgya cher byed ched dbyin dmag gis gnam grur gnod skyon shor yod par kha g.yar nas gnam gru 'phur rgyu'i dus tshod 'gor 'gyangs byas/ kun mu'u si yis kri pu lu'u tho'u nas rgyal kha'i ngang nas bcos gzugs sna tshogs byas pas 'jar man pas mong ko mā le yi bya 'gul spel stangs dngos su shes song snyam/ kun mu'u si er cer slobs rjes kyang sne len gzab rgyas byas/ 'char bkod 'dis dmag spyi mong ko / 4lta yi

bkod sgrig ni ha cang blo yul las 'das pa'i thabs bkod dang ldan pa gsal bshad byas yod/skabs la bstan nas bsgyur bsgrig gis//don gyi gnad sgo 'chor med byas//dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang bstun nas dmag rtsal la zhib 'jug byed pa dang / 'thab 'khrug gi 'char gzhi bzo ba sogs ni mong ko mā le yis 'thab 'khrug la bkod 'doms byed pa'i khyad chos gzhan zhig yin/ no man te yi skam sar bgrod pa'i gnas tshul gzhir bzung na/ 1944lo'i zla 6par bgrod 'go brtsams pa'i nyin der/ dbyin me mna' 'brel dmag gis ri 'dabs kyi grong khyer la phar rgol byed rgyu yin mod/ zla 6tshes 12nyin mna' 'brel dmag gis glo bur du thad phyogs nas spyi le30dang 'phred zheng la spyi le 13nas 19yod pa'i sa khul du brtan srung sngon skyod dmag sgar brgyab/ de la mi 126547dang rlangs 'khor 54186/ dngos po tun 104428bcas yod/g.yas g.yon phyogs gnyis kyi 'thab 'khrug gi 'dam gzhung yang brtan srung byed thub pa byung / 'on kyang ri 'dabs kyi grong khyer de'i nye 'gram nas 'jar man pa'i dmag gis 'jab rgol thebs pas mu mthud du sngon skyod byed ma thub/ de'i gnad don ni bkod 'doms pas blo rgya skyed ma thub pas dmag dpung sngon skyod byas rjes grong khyer mgyogs por bdag 'dzin byed par rngam pa las nang rdzong brlag pa'i bkod 'doms ma thub pas red/ don rkyen de'i go skabs bzang bo 'ga' stong zad du shor ba dang / mtshan mor bsgug nas phar rgol byed dus 'jar man dmag gis hri 21pa'i phyogs 'phrul dmag dpung rogs snon du btang ba dang / snga gzhug tu skyogs 'phrul dmag dpung khag//spyas bsnan te stobs shugs bskyed/ mong ko mā le yis da ni mgyogs

por grong khyer bdag 'dzin byed mi thub pas 'char gzhi bsgyur rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ thog mar 'jar man dmag gi phyogs 'khor rnams grong khyer du 'ong du bcug pa dang / phyogs khag g.yas ma'i a me ri ga'i dmag dpung nub phyogs dang lho nub phyogs su sngon skyod kyi re don smin par byas/1944lo'i zla8tshes 25nyin mna' 'brel dmag gis pa li'i sa char phar rgol byas rjes/ bar der dbyin ji'i skam dmag gi dmag spyi(7)/khro)ru go sa 'phar ba'i mong ko mā le yi bsam par pa li lte bar bzung ste/ stobs shugs gcig sgril gyis byang shar phyogs su phar rgol gyis dgun ma slobs pa'i snga rol du 'jar man gyi lu'u er( po)bzo las khul yongs bdag bzung byas thog 'jar man gyi dmag don bzo las yod tshad rtsa brlag byed rgyu'i yid ches byas/ de phyir ad sen ha'o we ar(4lko rsā77)gtso byas ches mtho'i dmag spyi khag gis 6 gzhi rgya skyed pa'i (2217)'thab 'khrug lag tu bstar bar 'dod/ se nā chu bo dkyil snying byas nas byang du ho lan gyi mtsho mtha' dang / lho ru su'e tser gyi sa mtshams bcas rgya che ba'i sa khyon du/ la'e en chu bo'i khul rgyud kyi grong rdal phyogs su dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'jar dmag la phar rgol byas/ 6 gzhi rgya skyed pa'i mi 'thab 'khrug lag bstar gyi go rim khrod du/ phar rgol gyi gzhi rgya che drags pas mna' 'brel dmag gi stobs shugs phyogs gcig tu 'du ma thub par phyogs so so nas zhan cha mang bo mngon/zla 12tshes 16nyin 'jar man dmag gis mna' 'brel dmag gi zhan cha gzhir bzung nas/ ā teng sa khul(aṣṭha72)nas mna' 'brel dmag gi g.yul sar 'jab rgol thebs pa dang / 'jar man gyi gnam grus mna' 'brel dmag gi gnam gru thang du gzhi rgya che ba'i gtor bshig byas pa ma zad/mna' 'brel dmag gi gnam gru mang bo gtor brlag byas/ ā teng sa khul gyi 'thab 'khrug khyon yongs nas bltas na/ 'jar man dmag gi pha/4 /sa

tshabs chen yin na'ang / mna' 'brel dmag la yang bla lhag gis chag sgo thebs/ mna' 'brel dmag gi dmag khag 106tshang ma 'jar dmag gi btson mar gyur ba dang / dmag khag 28pa dang / phyogs 'phrul dmag dpung khag 7pa sogs la chag sgo tshabs chen bzos/ mna' 'brel dmag la khyon bsdoms mi 77000la shi rmas thebs pa dang / then khe dang skyogs rdo 773chud zos su song / mthar mong ko mā le yis dmag sne khrid nas dgra dmag bkag pa dang / des 'jar man dmag gi tshur rgol gyi stobs shugs 'gog thub pa byung / zla 12pa'i zla smad du/ byang khul dmag dpung la gcig mthun gyis bkod 'doms byed bzhin pa'i mong ko mā le yis 'khrul ba med pa'i brda 'phrin la brten nas 'jar dmag gis byang lam la smyo ham chen po'i tshur rgol byed nges pa'i gdal thag bcad/ kho rang gis rang nyid kyi gra sgrig phun sum tshogs po yin par yid ches byas pa dang / 'jar man dmag gis phyir 'then byed skabs dang bstun nas phar rgol byed rgyu byas/ da rung kho rang gi bsam par gal srid dgra dmag gis tshur rgol ma byas na/ 6stong glegs (lnga sa) de dang bstun nas yang bskyar rtsa 'dzugs dang bkod 'doms/dmag mi gong bsgrigs bcas byas/ rjes nas 'jar dmag gis 'char gzhi bsgyur te dmag mi rnams pā si thu ne(3lo79)ru 'du tshogs byas pas don dngos steng nas mna' 'brel dmag la rin thang che ba'i dus tshod thob/ mong ko mā le yis 1945lo'i zla 1tshes 3nyin 'jar man dmag la phar rgol byas pas rgyal kha chen po thob/1945lo'i zla 23 3par mong ko mā le yis sne khrid pa'i dmag khag 21pa'i dmag dpung gis la'e en chu bo'i 'gram rgyud nas 'jar dmag la padī /sdu byed rgyu'i 'thab 'khrug gi mgo brtsams/ mkha' lding dmag(0

༅)gi bkol spyod thad/ mong ko mā le yis yang rgyun srol gyi 'thab 'khrug srol lugs las ldog pa'i thabs shes spyad/ rgyun srol ltar na/ thabs lam gcig ni sa ngos kyi 'thab 'khrug 'go ma brtsams pa'i snga rol du mkha' lding dmag gisagayul bshams dgos pa red/ de ltar byas na dgra dmag gi phyogs su 'jigs skul ba'am rnyog zing bzo thub pa red/ thabs shes gzhan zhig ni sa steng gi 'thab 'khrug 'go ma bcoms pa'i snga rol du mkha' lding dmag rnams dgra bo'i g.yul sa'i rgyab phyogs kyi bar thag nges can zhig gi sar bskong dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni sa der thad kur rgol rdung thebs pa'i nyen kha ha cang chung / de bas dmag shugs rtsa 'dzugs byed pa'i dus tshod yod pa ma zad/ dgra bo'i bkod 'doms pu'u la phar rgol byas kyang chog pa red/ da rung dgra bo'i rgyab snon dmag(ṣṭha 5)la 'gog rgol byed chog pa bcas phyogs yongs nas dgra bo la nyen kha bzo thub pa yin/ skabs der/ mna' 'brel dmag gis drag shugs la brten nas la'i en chu bo brgal ba'i 'thab 'khrug byed tshul ni/ su'u dmag(74 )dang dbyin me mna' 'brel dmag gis phyogs gnyis nas 'jar man dmag bar du bcug pa red/ shi the les dmag khag 19pa rgyab snon du btang ste mtha' srung sa thig chi ku spre(rsha lko )ru btsugs te ches mtha' ma'i g.yul 'gyed bsam yang mtha' srung sa thig ring drags pa dang / dmag shugs sngar bzhin stobs zhan pa/ dmag mi'i rgol sems kyang gcig thog tu 'du ma thub pas mna' 'brel dmag gis gzhi rgya che ba'i tshur rgol thengs gcig byas na 'jar man dmag la shi lam las gzhan med/ de phyir/ rgol rdung la mkhas pa'i dmag spyi mong ko mā le yis thog mar rkang dmag ru khag mtshan lam brgyud nas chu bo las brgal rgyu thag bcad pa dang /nyin gnyis par dmag khag 18pas la'e en chu bo'i shar rgyud kyi spyi le 10nas 15mtshams su mkha' lam nas babs te 'jar dmag gi gra sgrig ru khag/5sdu

5)gi rgyab snon la 'gog rgol byed rgyu dang / rkang dmag la 'brel nas mdun bskyod kyi sa rgya je cher skyed thog phar rgol gyi stobs shugs rgyab snon byed rgyu byas/ mong ko mā le yis myur du dmag sne khrid nas dpung 'jug byas pa dang /su'u dmag dang mnyam du 'jar dmag khri 15zhal mgo 'dogs byed du bcug1945lo'i zla 5tshes 8nyin yo rob gling gi 'khrug gzhi yongs su mjug rdzogs/mong ko mā le yis 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i khrod/ yo rab gling mna' 'brel dmag gi rkang dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo byas nas rang nyid kyi dmag don thad kyi rnam dpyod che ba'i dge mtshan mngon par byas pas kho rang ci gi mdzad rjes nam yang nyams pa med par gyur/ 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i rjes su/ kho rang gis mu mthud du dmag don gnyer ba dang 1958lo'i zla)bar las 'khyur ngal gso byed pa'i bar rgyun 'khyongs byas/ kho rang la dbyin ji'i dmag rtags mtho shos tshang ma thob pa ma zad/ rgyal khab gzhan pa mang bo'i dmag rtags kyi gzengs bstod kyang thob/ de'i nang su'u len gyi 66rgyal kha'i dpungartags (chos/lorsā)dang rim pa dang po'i 6 su'u o lu rgyu'i dpung rtags (ṣṭhaṣṭha/:(7rsā)kyang thob/ 1976lo'i zla 3tshes 24nyin mong ko mā le nyid or tun(tshopo rsā)du tshe las 'das/ skabs der dgung lo 89yin/452

'jar man gyi skam sa'i dmag gi spyi 'doms pa lung me mar/wu'uste chon/194lo'i zla 4pa'i tshes 14nyin gyi phyi dror/ 'jar man hpho then pa'o pang ho ar len kun sde ba'i gzhis min spro khang zhig tu/ gzugs thung zhing rnam 'gyur gzab nan can gyi spyi 'doms dmag dpon zhig gis/ lag tu bkod 'doms dbyug pa thogs te sgo chen nas mngon te/ dmag dpon gsum gyi mnyam bskyod 'og der yod pa'i rgyal srung dmag rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor du 'dzul/ 'gul skyod 'phrul chas kyi 'ur sgra dang mnyam du rlangs 'khor pu'u la'o pa'o ar phyogs su kha lo bsgyur/ dmag dpon 'di ni shi the li'i gsod ched dug 'thung nas rang srog bcad pa'i 'jar man skam sa'i dmag gi spyi 'doms pa lung me ar red/ skar ma 25rjes su/ kho rang gi yul du kha par zhig 'byor te/ 66skam sa'i dmag gi spyi 'doms pa lam bar du grib phog nas sku gshegs sa zer/ kho rang ni 'jar man rgyal khyab kyi shi the le gtso byas pa'i spyi tshogs tang gi dmag dpon drag rim rnams dang 'dra bar dmag don thad 'jon thang ha cang chen po yod zhing / lhag par du shi the le'i snying rje ba'i rngon khyi zhig kyang yin/gtum drag che ba'i gzhon nu dmag dpon/er wan lung me ar ni 1891lo'i zla 11par 'jar man lho khul hpho then pa'o pang gi he tan he mu'u grong brdal du slob chen gyi dge rgan shā/ mo

zhig gi bu ru skyes/ chung dus su lus stobs zhan khar nad pa zhig kyang yin mod/ kho rang 'phrul chas rig par shin tu dga' po yod pas/ blo gcig sems gcig gis sbyang ba hur len byas te 'phrul chas bzo bkod pa zhig byed rgyu'i chod sems bzhag 'on kyang kho rang gi pha rgan gyis nam rgyun kho rang dmag mi zhig byed dgos pa'i re ba nan mo dang bcas skul ma byas pasi ngo ma ldog par/ 1909lor rkang dmag thon ang 126par zhugs/ ma 'gyangs par tan tse gong ma'i dmag khul du slob sbyong byed par 'dems thon byung /1911lo'i zla 11nang mthar phyin rjes sngon gyi ru khag tu phyir log nas krung we dang pha'e krang gi 'gan 'khrur/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po langs ba'i rjes su/ lung me ar gyis ru dpung dang chabs cig 'thab 'dzing nub phyogs su gdong gtad de/ ro ma nyi ya dang ar phe si ri bo sogs su g.yul 'gyed byas nas gtum spyod gang sar khyab/ 1914lo'i zla)pa'i thengs dang po'i dmag 'khrug khrod/ lung me ar gyi rkang ba g.yas par rmas phog na'ang / kho rang gis mda' zad kyi bo'u zhig bzung nas hpha ran se'i dmag mi gnyis dang shi 'thab ro 'thab byas/ de'i stabs kyis/ kho rang la rim pa gnyis pa'i lcags kyi rgya gram bya dga' thob/phyi lo'i zla dang po'i nang / kho rang gis grangs nyung ba'i dmag skor zhig khrid de hpha dmag gi sgar du bsres nas/ g.yul sa gsum blangs pa ma zad/ hpha dmag gi sgar gcig gi 'gog rgol pham par byas/ der brten/ kho rang la rim pa dang po'i lcags kyi rgya gram bya dga' thob/1917lo'i dpyid kur/ 'jar dmag spyi khyab pu'u yis dbyi tha li dang 'thab nas pham nyes byung ba'i o dmag gi rgyab dpung mngags/ lung me ar gyi dmag sgar la pā hpha li ya'i sgar srung rkang dmag thon gyi g.yas phyogs nas 'dīkā /la byas par 'gebs srung ci nus byas kyang / rkang dmag thon der shi

rmas thebs skabs/ lung me ar la ru dpon gyis chog mchan gnang ba bzhin/kho rang gis dmag dpung khag gsum la kha lo bsgyur te g.yul las rgyal zhing dbyi tha li'i dmag mang po gson bzung byas/ de'i rjes su ru dpon gyis kho rang la yang dmag dpung khag gsum sprad pa dang / kho rang gis dmag dpung rkang lam phra mo zhig brgyud du bcug ste/ mi khyi gnyis kyis mi go ba byas nas dgra bo'i sgar du bsres/ ci cha med par dmag sna chu sna brdol ba bzhin 'khol byung bas/ nyams snang med pa'i dgra dpung zang zing lang long du bzos shing / dmag mang po 'thab pa'i re ba bral nas mgo sgur/ yang chu tshod 50lhag gi dmar 'dzing brgyud de/ lung me ar gyis mā thā yi'u ar zhes pa'i ri rtse blangs/ dbyi tha li'i bros dmag rnams phi ya we chu bo'i bar du bros shing chu zam bshig lung me ar rang gi dpung dmag dang mnyam du 'jigs pa med par me mda' skor gon nas chu rgyal nas brgal ba dang / dgra dmag bye'u khras bdas pa bzhin gyis mi stong lhag 'dzin bzung byas shing dbyi tha li'i dmag dpung ming gi lhag mar bzos/ byas rjes chen po de gzengs su bstod ched/ thengs der kho rang la phu'u lu'u hri ches mtho'i bya dga' thob/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug rdzogs rjes/ lung me ar hrang we ru 'phar ba dang phyir sngon gyi ru dpung du log nas ru dpon gyi 'gan 'khur ba ma zad/ lu'u ar sa khul gyi nyen 'gog bya ba'i las 'gan yang 'khur/kho rang 'jar man gyi dmag dpung chen por zhugs pa ni gzi brjid cig tu sems kyin yod la/ rgyu mtshan ni kho la mtshon na/ 'bangs mi zhig byed pa ni rgyun gos gyon pa'i mi thabs chag shig ste/ blo yul la shar thabs bral ba zhig yin par sems yod/1920lo'i zla 10par/ lung me ar rgyal srung rkang dmag thon 13pa'i ru dpon du las gnas spar ba dang / lo brgyad kyi rjes nas yang te le ༵ snan

rkang dmag slob grwar 'thab rtsal gyi dge rgan du bskos/ kho rang gis rang nyid kyi 'thab 'dzing nyams myong bkol nas thabs rtsal slob khrid ches gson nyams dod po byas pas/ slob grwa der dga' bsu chen po thob pa'i dge rgan khrod kyi gcig yin/ kho rang gis dmag 'thab kyi nyams myong dang rkang dmag sbyong brdar thad bsam tshul yongs rdzogs 〈rgol rdung khrod kyi rkang dmag〉ces pa'i deb chung zhig tu bkod/ dpe deb 'di 'jar man gyi na gzhon klog mkhan mang po zhig gis dga' bsu chen po thob pas/ par skrun rjes su brin bde'i dpe deb tu gyur/ 1933lo'i zla 10par/ hro zho go gnas 'phar zin pa'i lung me ar ko si la ar du sdod pa'i rkang dmag ru dpon du gnas spar ba dang / 1935lor/ po'o tshi than skam dmag slob grwa'i slob dpon gyi 'gan 'khur/ ma 'gyangs par/ rgyal srung dmag dang rgyal khab na gzhon tshogs pa'i mnyam 'grel dpon du bskos shing / skabs de nas bzung shi the lis mthong chen byed 'go btsams/ bshad pa ltar na/ lung me ar gyi re 'dod gtso bo chab srid skyong rgyu ma yinamod/ rkang dmag las nar son pa'i shi the li(rgol rdung khrod kyi rkang dmag〉ces pa'i dpe chas yin sems drangs par brten/ lung me ar nyen srung ru dpung gi ru dpon du bsko rgyu thag bcad pa dang / skabs de nas bzungakho rang chab srid kyi gar stegs su bskyod 'go bcoms pa red/ don dag gzhan pa zhig yod pa ni/ shi the lis kho rang la mthong chen byas shing nyen srung ru dpung gi ru dpon du bskos rjes/ nyin zhig shi the li phyi rol du lta rtog la 'gro skabs/ lung me ar la bshad rgyur/ kho rang gi rlangs 'khor gyi rjes su ches mang na'ang rlangs 'khor drug las yong mi chog pa'i brda btang / yin yang / lung me ar gyis pho brang gi rgya srang g.yas g.yon du shi the li dang mnyam du / /seng la phebs pa'i pu'u krang dang khul dpon/ dmag dpon rnams kyi

rlangs 'khor gyis khengs yod pa mthong zhing / de nas rlangs 'khor bdun 'gror bcug rjes kho rang rgya srang dkyil du 'grengs te/ rlangs 'khor gzhan rnams bskyod mi chog pa'i brda byas kyang / mtho rim dpon rigs dag gis 'jigs snang dang sdig dmod byas pas/ kho rang gis me phyogs gnyis lam gyi dkyil du kha lo bsgyur nas kho tsho'i 'gro lam bkag pa red/ don dag de'i rjes su/ shi the lis kho rang la bstod bsngags tshad med btang /zu gdon 'dre'i rgyal bo 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs gnyis pa'i sngon gyi nyin 'gar/ lung me ar la shi the lis bka' btang ba bzhin/ 'jar man ches mtho'i bkod 'doms pu'u yi bkod 'doms dpon chen zhig gi 'gan 'khur dgos zhes bshad pa dang / lhag par dmag dpon chen po'i go gnas su 'phar ba red/'on kyang lung me ar la go gnas de thob pa'i yid tshims ma byung bar/ drag chas spras pa'i ru dpung zhig gi bkod 'doms pa zhig byed 'dod skyes mod/'jar man spyi khyab bkod 'doms pu'u yis kho rang gi re ba dang len ma byas par/ kho ni rkang dmag gi sbyong brdar thob pa'i dmag dpon zhig yin pas/me skyogs kyi phyogs la ci yang mi shes par sems yod/ yin yang / shi the lis kho rang gi re 'dod skong phyir/ 1940lo'i zla gnyis par drag chas ru dpung bdun pa'i ru dpon du bskos/ lung me ar gyis 'gan de khur rjes kyi don dag dang po sgrub pa ni/ bkod 'doms thon gyi dpon rnams ngal gso'i dus skabs byin nas bshad rgyur/ 6 bdag gis gnas tshul la rgyus lon ma byas pa'i sngon du khyod tsho dgos mkho mi 'dug mi zer/ zla gsum gyi rjes su/ kho rang gis rang nyid kyi 'bad brtson la brten nas me sgrogs 'thab 'dzing gi gzhung dang bkod 'doms sbyong brdar la zhib 'jug gting zab byas ༵ 5)nga /

kho'i blo yid mi mthun pa'i bkod 'doms pa 'ga'i las gnas phab tu bcugade ni mi 'gar chad gcod nan mo byas na/ mi gzhan pa rnams la blo stobs skye srid par 'dod pa'o//1940lo'i zla 5tshes 10nyin/ lung me ar gyis bkod 'doms byas pa'i drag chas ru dpung bdun pa 'jar dmag gi nub phyogs dmag 'khrug tu zhugs pa dang / ang 13pa'i dmag tshogs kyi sgrig khungs su btsud/ dmag tshogs de'i 'gan 'khur ni ho lan dang pi le hri byang phyogs nas rgol rdung byed rgyu de rejo/ dmag 'khrug gi nyin dang por/ lung me ar gyi ru dpung mgyogs myur ngang mtha' mtshams brgal te/ pi le hri btsan gyis mgo sgur du bcug zla 5pa'i tshes 12nyin gyi dgong mor/ drag chas ru dpung 7pa me mdel gyi 'gebs srung 'og mā si chu bo brgal ba dang / kho rang gis thad kur dmag gru 'gar bkod 'doms kyis hpha dmag 'gog srung sa mtshams gtor/lhag par du tshes 16nyin che hpheng the en nags tshal la slebs/ bde 'jags dang mgyogs myur sgos nags tshal 'di brgal ched/ lung me ar gyis me mda' gcig kyang brgyab mi chog pa dang / me phyogs dmag mis dar dkar g.yab g.yab byed bzhin mdun du bskyod dgos pa'i bka' btang / nags tshal der gab yod pa'i hpha dmag gis glo bur du dmag dpung chen po zhig slebs byung bar ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar me skyogs sogs kyang ma brgyab par bsdad/ kho chos shes rtogs byung rjes yod tshad zin pas/ 'jar dmag gis btsan rdzong bde blag ngang gtor ba red/ nyin de'i dgong mor/ drag chas ru dpung bdun pa spyi le 60lhag gi sar bskyod yod pa dang / zla 5pa'i tshes 16nyin nas 17nyin gnyis kyi ring / lung me ar ru dpung gi mi 94shi mod/bzung dmag khri 1las brgal yod/45snang me ar dmag dpung mu mthun du mgyogs myur ngang nub phyogs su

bskyod pa dang / kho tsho'i 'thab grogs ru dpung rgyang thag ring ba'i sar lus yod/ zla 5pa'i tshes 27nyin/ lung me ar ru dpung li ar phyogs su bskyod pa dang / kho rang gis rang nyid 6 li ar du 'dzul ba'i 'jar dmag dang po mi byed ched/ nyin mtshan byas nas bshar bas phyir nyin snga mor grong khyer der slebs/ skabs der/ grong khyer de'i srang lam gang sar hpha dmag gis khyab yod pas/ brel 'tshab ngang dmag dpung phyi snar byed dgos byung /zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin/ lung me ar gyis bka' btang nas su'o mu'u chu bo brgal du bcug pa dang / nyin rer spyi le 70 — 80yi mgyogs tshad kyis nub phyogs su bskyod pa red/ tshes 8nyin lu'u ang du 'byor ba dang / tshes 13nyin mtsho 'gram sa khul du 'byor nas/ dbyin ci li mtsho 'gag mthong /nyin der/ hpha ran se ang dgu ba'i bkod 'doms dmag dpon dang dbyin hā'i dmag dpon bcu lhag bros kyang ma thar bar mgo 'bul byas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 16nyin/ lung me ar ru dpung sa'i nā chu bo brgal nas lho phyogs su bskyod pa dang / nyin gnyis kyi 'thab 'dzing brgyud nas/ zla 6pa'i tshes 18nyin hpha ran se ches gtso bo'i chu rags 'gag blangs/lung me ar nub bskyod dmag 'khrug la bsdoms pa'i gza' 'khor drug ma gtogs song med cing / kho rang gi ru dpung du mi stong tsho gnyis lhag shi rmas byung ba dang / me phyogs 42lhag gi gyong gud thebs yod mod/ dgra bo'i bzung dmag khri 9 7lhag la nye ba 'dug thengs 'dir rgyal kha chen po thob pas/ lung me ar la rim pa dang po'i lcags kyi rgya gram bya dga' thob pa ma zad/ shi the lis kyang dga' bsu chen po gnang ba red/6 bye thang gi wa mo mi'ajar dmag gis hpha ran ser phar rgol byed skabs/ hpha zhi si ༵༵ tha

lis kyang dbyin phor dmag rgyag rgyu'i brda byed bzhin yod/ de dang dus mnyam du dmag gi gnam grus byang phyogs su bskyal nas dbyin ji'i mnga' khongs e cib dang su'o ma lir phar rgol byas te/ su'u ye hri mis bzos gtsang po blangs nas bskor dkyil rgya mtsho dang hin rdu rgya mtsho chen mo'i 'grim lam 'dzin rgyu'i ham sems bcangs/ 'on kyang / dbyin dmag gi 'gog rgol gyis dbyin dmag bsdud mar pham par byas pas/ mo'o sa'o li nyis 'jar dmag la rgyab dpung bcol ba'i re ba zhus/ 1941lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes — 2nyin/ shi the lis dmag dpon rnga steng ci chen po lung me ar gyis dmag snye dngas te dbyi dmag skyobs cho dzodagos pa'i b.la' ltar/ ru /sto dpung gnyis kyi dmag khrid de hphe smyo tsho gling byang ma'i phyogs su bskyod pa sdud ri'i ci zerdod/ 3 zla 2pa'i tshes 12nyin lung 7 riring 9 me ar li po'o lir 'byor ba dang / li po li srung ba dang zhi the 'gag skyob pa'i 'os 'gan phras tu blangs/ nyin de'i phyi dro kho rang gis g.yul sar lta rtogs thongs —— ribyas nas ru ches bzang bo'i 'gog srung ni phar rgol yin lung me ar/ pa'i sdom tshig rnyed/ kho rang

gis dbyin dmag gis mu mthud du mdun bskyod byed pa'i ham pa med pa shes rjes/ myur du 'gul skyod byed pa'i gra sgrig lag bstar byas/ zla 3pa'i mjug tu/ lung me ar gyis dbyin dmag drag chas ru dpung bdun pa e cib tu phyir 'then pa'i glags dang bstun te/ ā ku'e lar dmag 'khrug bslangs/kho rang gis dbyi tha li'i ches mtho'i bkod 'doms pas mu mthud mdun du bskyod par 'gog pa snang med byas nas 'chi ba phangs sems med par mdun bskyod byas/ lung me ar dus rgyun du wang chu'u spo lo rwa bar 'babs thub pa'i gnam gru chung chung zhig tu bsdad nas/ ru dpung gi gnas tshul blta rtog dang mdun bskyod byed par skul 'ded byed kyin yod/ thengs shig la ru khag cig gis ngal gso bzhin yod pa kho rang gis gnam gru nas mthong bas/ shog bu zhig gi ngos su 6 khyod tsho myur du mdun bskyod mi byed na kho bo sar 'bab rgyu yin/gelung me ar nas mizhes bris te kho tsho'i mdun du 'phangs/ 'di ltar ru dpung ni lung me ar gyi skul 'ded dang bkod 'doms 'og rgyal kha bstud mar thob pa ste/ zla 4pa'i tshesaḥnyin ti ar nā phar rgol byas nas blangs pa dang / tshes 10nyin thu'o pu'u lu'u khe yongs su bskor/ tshes 15nyin e cib byang khul gyi mtha' mtshams sa'e lu'u mu'u phar rgol byas nas blangs pa red/spya/spya shāḥkā sdi / gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug gi mjug 'bras ni pham nyes tshabs 1941lo'i zla 6par su'u 'jar dmag 'khrug langs pa'i rjes su/'jar dmag spyi khyab bkod 'doms ru khag gis stobs shugs gtso bo shar phyogs su bskyed yod pas/ hphe gling byang ma'i dmag 'khrug la dmag dpung 'bor chen mngags mi srid/ yin yang dbyin dmag gis rgyab dpung 'bor chen bsnan pas/ lung me ar la gnon shugs thebs 'go brtsams/ lo 'di'i zla 11pa'i tshes 18nyin/ dmag khri 10dang me skyogs 800lha16 sbyad

pa'i dbyin dmag 2 nyi lo'u chu bo'i dmag dpung ’ gis tshur rgol byas/ dmag khri 4dang me sgrogs 244tsam yod pa'i lung me ar dmag dpung kho tsho'i gdog len byas pa red/ca lung me ar gyis phyogs gcig nas phyir 'then dang phyogs gnyis nas skabs bstun gyis ngo rgol byas/ tshes 22nyin gyi dmag 'khrug khrod/kho rang gis drag chas ru khag cig pha rol ba'i sgar du 'dzul bcug nas/dbyin dmag ang 30pa'i ru dpung gi 173lhag gi me sgrogs gtor nas kho tsho spyi le 50lhag gi sar phyir 'then byed du bcug zla 12pa'i tshes 28nyin/dbyin dmag gi rgyab ru g.yul sar phar rgol byed ched/ kho rang gis drag chas ru khag gi gtso shugs e cib kyi mtha' mtshams brgal du bcug nas shar phyogs su mngags nas/ dbyin dmag la 'jigs snang dang zang zing bzos/dbyinadamag la rgyab dpung mang po bsnan pa dang lung me ar dpa' bo rgyab chad du gyur ba'i rkyen gyis tho'u pu'u lu'u khe skor rgol byed rgyu bskyur nas/ ā ku'e la'i phyogs su phyir 'then byas/1942lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 20nyin/ lung me ar la hphe gling drag chas ru dpung gi thon si ling gi go gnas 'phar/ skabs 'dir bskor dkyil rgya mtsho'i gnas bab la 'gyur ldog chen po byung nas/ 'jar dmag gis yang bskyar mtsho de bdag tu bzung / kha snon gyi gru hphe gling byang ma la shar bskyod byed thub pa byung / lung me ar la me skyogs 288dang ru khag bcu gcig lhag gi dmag rogs 'byor rjes/ phar rgol byed rgyu'i gros thag bcad/ zla 1pa'i tshes 21nyin/ hphe gling dmag dpung thon gyis dbyin dmag gi ru khag sdun ma tshar gcod byas nas/ tshes 28la pan cwa zhi blangs pa dang / zla 2pa'i tshes 7nyin cwa kra lar dpung mjug byas pa red/ 'bar rdzas dang dpal 'byor la khagasab myur du byed dgos pa'i rkyen gyis lung me ar gyis dpung 'jug re zhig byed ma thub/462

zla 5pa'i tshes 26nyin gyi dgong dro/ lung me ar la yo byad dag 'byor rjes/ yang bskyar phar rgol byas nas dbyin dmag gi 'gog srung de ma thag tu gtor/ zla 6pa'i tshes 19nyin/ tho'u pu'u lu'u khe'i phyogs su par rgol byas/dus tshod 14dmar 'dzing brgyud nas gal che ba'i 'dzing rags chen po 'di blangs pa red/ dbyin ji'i bzung dmag khri 3lhag dang rgyu dngos 'bor chen thob/ der mthud nas dmag dpung yang bskyar e cib tu bskyod pa dang /zla 6pa'i tshes 28nyin ma'i the lu'u 'gag sgo blangs shing / zla 7pa'i mgor ā la man sa khul du 'byor ba dang / sa de nas nyi lo'u chu bo dang spyi le 100yas mas las med pas/ e cib kyi rgyal sa khe lo'u zang zing lang long du gyur/skabs der/ lung me ar gyi snyan grags shin tu rgyas yod la/ kho rang gis hphe gling byang ma'i dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha'i rtsa ba spyi bsdoms byas pa ni 6 myur tshad ang dang po miyin pa de'o// lung me ar la bkod 'doms kyi nus pa chen po ldan zhing bye thang gi gnas bab dang gnam gshis sogs dang bstun nas dmag rgyag mkhas pa'i rkyen gyis dbyin dmag la pham nyes chen po thebs pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis kho rang la 6 bye thang gi wa mo ’ zhes pa'i ming thogs pa 'di'ang kho rang gis dmag 'dren dus thun min khyad chos yod pas yin/dbyin ji'i gong ma chi'u ce ar gyis sngon chad yid smon ngang bshad rgyur/6 nga tshor dpa' mdzangs rdul phod kyi dgra zla zhig la 'phrad pa red/ gal te dmag 'khrug gi gnod skyon bskyur nas gleng na/ kho ni rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin zhig red ’ ces bshad myong /yin yang / shi the li su'u 'jar dmag 'khrug la brel ba che stabs/ kho rang gis lung me ar la glog 'phrin zhig bskur ba las mkho ba'i rgyu dngos skyel 'dren ma byas pas/ skabs der lung me ar la gyong gud chen po thebs pa dang de'i khar nyi mar tsha gdug cher phyin pa dang / bye rlung gis mya ngan ༵/ pa/
