dmag 'dzing gi dka' khag brgyud pa bcas kyis ru dpung gi stobs shugs zadade mdun bskyod byed thabs ma byung bar 'gog srung kho na byed kyin yod/lung me ar gyis o si khru ri ya nas ngal gso ba'i skabs/ ming grags che ba'i mong gi ma li dmag dpon gyis dbyin dmag ang brgyad pa'i thon si ling gis 'gan bzhes shing / zla 10par dza drag che ba'i g.yul 'gyed bslangs/ shi the lis gnas tshul mi legs pa de mthong nas myur du lung me ar hphe gling du mngags/ yin yang skabs der kho rang gis dmag dpung pham nyes las skyob ma thub pa red/ 1943lo'i zla 3par/ lung me ar la yang bskyar ches mtho'i bkod 'doms ru khag gi bka' babs nas kho'i 'gan blangs te nad gso ru bcug zla 5pa'i zla dkyil du/ hphe gling byang ma dbyin dmag gis blangs shing /'jar dmag ru dpung gnyis kha 'thor rtsa med du btang /rkyen ngan la byol thabs med/1943lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 15nyin/ me dbyin mnyam 'brel dmag zhi zhi li gling gi skam sar 'gos/ shi the lis brel 'tshub ngang lung me ar gyis dbyi tha li'i byang phyogs ru dpung gi thon spyi khyab si ling gi 'gan 'khur dgos pa dang dbyi tha li'i dkyil khul 'gog srung byas nas mnyam 'brel dmag gi tshur rgol la ya lan sprod dgos pa'i brda btang / 'on kyang ma 'gyangs par/lung me ar dang lho phyogs g.yul sa'i spyi khyab si ling khe se lin bar du dbyi tha li nas 'gog srung byed rgyu'i thad lta tshul ma mthun pa dang / shi the lis kyang mjug mthar khe se lin gyi bsam 'char lag bstar byas nas/ lung me ar hpha ran se yod pa'i ang 13pa'i ru dpung thon gyi spyi khyab si ling la las gnas spar/ 1943lor lung me ar hpha ran ser 'byor rjes/ rang nyid kyis thag gardokā sad pa'i dbang cha ci yang ma byung / lung me ar gyis thog dang po nas

me dbyin mnyam 'brel dmag pi li hri nas su'u mu'u chu bo'i 'gram nas skam sar 'gos rgyu yin pa shes nas/ sa 'di nas drag chas dmag gi dpung bsgrig dgos par 'dod kyang / bsam tshul de gong rim nas yid mthun ma byung /lung me ar gyis drag chas dpung tshod 'dzin byed dgos pa'i re 'don zhus kyang / 'jar dmag spyi khyab bkod 'doms ru khag gis hpha ran ser yod pa'i drag chas ru dpung mu mthud nas shar phyogs su bskyod du bcug 'di ltar/lung me ar gyis mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'gos pa 'gog rgyu'i yid ches rtsa ba nas gzhom zhig tu gyur/1944lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin gyi zhogs par/ me dbyin mnyam 'brel dmag no man ti nas skam sar 'gos pa dang / me stogs mang po'i ldir sgra yis 'jar dmag gis 'gog rgol byed pa'i blo spobs zhum par byas/ nyin der/ lung me ar tag tag pha yul gyi ho ar lin gin gyi spro skyid khang zhig tu bza' zla'i skyes skar la rten 'brel zhu bzhin yod dus/ dmag spyi zhig gi kha par 'byor te 6 dgra bo'i tshur rgol 'go brtsams byung zhes pa go ma thag kho cirang gi ngo mdangs skya bor gyur nas myur du rlangs 'khor la bsdad nas hpha ran ser slobs/ dgong mor si ling pu'u la thon pa na/ mnyam 'brel dmag gis spyi le 10lhag gi skam sa bzung tshar 'dug zla 6pa'i tshes 12bar du/ mnyam 'brel dmag skam sar 'gos pa'i mi grangs khri 33la slebs/ 'jar dmag spyi khyab bkod 'doms khang gis drag chas ru dpung gsum dang sbag sbag ru dpung gcig las ma mngags/ no man ti'i 'jar dmag la drag chas ru dpung 12lhag gi kha snon byung yod pa red/ shi the lis ru khag gis thabs jus dang sgrig bkod gsar ba ci yang byas mi chog pa dang / kho rang nyid dngos su yong nas dmag 'khrug bkod 'doms bya rgyu yin pa'i bka' phabs/ de nas zla 6pa'i tshes 17nyin su'u wa sung du 'byor ba dang / khong khro chen pos 4)snag

dpon rnams la bka' bkyon gnang ba ma zad/ lung me ar ru dpung las bud de ngal gso ba'i bsam 'char la yid 'thad ma byas/ zla 7pa'i dus 'gor/ me dbyin mnyam 'brel skam dmag khri 100slebs shing / hpha ran se nub byang nas g.yul chen bshams pa'i sta gon byas/'di'i yar sngon du/ lung me ar yang 'jar pan nang khul gyi shi the lir ngo rgol byed pa'i las 'gul dang 'brel ba nges can yod/ kho rang gi dmag dpon si phe ta ar sngon nas shi the lir ngo rgol byed pa'i lkog g.yor zhugs yod pa dang / dus rgyun kho'i mdun du 6 sems khams pham pa mi 'am shi the lir dga' bo byed kyin med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ bshad pa ltar na/ ming la rong hre ar zer ba zhig gis〈zhi bde'i rtsom yig phyogs bsdus〉zhes pa bris yod pa dang / dpe cha klog rgyur mi dga' ba'i lung me ar gyis dpe deb de bklags pa na nges shes zab mo skyes/ yin yang / lung me ar gyis shi the lir lkog gsod byed ma 'dod par/ bshad nas pham par btang ste 'thab 'dzing gi lta ba bsgyur dgos par 'dod pa dang / gal te bshad nas kha ma nyan na 'jar pan khrims khang du bskyal dgos bsam/ zla 7pa'i tshes 17nyin/ lung me ar gyi rlangs 'khor la a ri'i dmag gi gnam gru'i me mdel thebs te kho rang la rmas lci mo phog pas/ yang 13pa'i ru dpung la bkod 'doms byed thabs bral/ tag tag nyin gsum gyi rjes su/ 'jar man du shi the li lkog gsod byed pa'i don rkyen la rgol rdung byed pa'i las 'gul langs pas/ don dang 'brel ba'i mi mang po zhig bzung ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis rang srog bcad/ 'ga' zhig rgyal khab gzhan par bros/ gyod don zhib dpyod kyi brgyud rim khrod lung me ar dang dmag dpon gzhan pa zhig kyang der 'brel ba yod pa shes/ zla1tshes 6nyin/ pha yul du nad gso bzhin pa'i lung me ar la swā 6/ ar dmag dpon gyis bshad rgyur/ 6 shi the li zer ba'i rdzun rkyal

mkhan da skabs dngos gnas smyos zin ’ zer/ skabs der shi the li nges par du gsod dgos rgyu zhig tu 'dug pa shes mod/ yod tshad 'phyis pa red/zla 10pa'i tshes 14nyin/ shi the lis skam dmag dmag dpung gi dmag don pu'u krang sogs mi 'ga' mngags te lung me ar sdod sar slebs/ kho tshos lung me ar la bshad rgyur/ shi the lis gnas tshul thams cad shes pas dug 'thung nas rang srog gcod dgos pa'i bka' gnang byung la dug rdzas kyang kho tshos khyer yong yod zer/ de ltar ma byas tshe/ sna mi dmangs khrims khang gis khrims thag ’ gcod srid pas/ lo na 53la son pa'i lung me ar gyis ngo tsha 'dor ched da gzod dug 'thung nas rang srog 'dor rgyu 'dems pa red/zla 10pa'i tshes 17nyin/ shi the lis lung me ar gyi bza' zlar glog 'phrin bskur nas/ smyo dmag dpon khong sku gshegs pa kho rang mya ngan chen mo zhus pa yin la/ kho rang gi mtshan snyan o gling dmag dpung dpa' bo'i byas rjes bzhin nam yang nyams pa med ’ zer/ 'di ni dngos gnas byi la shi ba la tsi gus sems sdug khul byas pa ste/ shi the lir srog btsong ba'i mi ga tshod khos bkod sgrig byas pa'i rkyen ngan las thar thub yod dam/467

'jar man gyi 8 khrabatshog dmag dpung gisib chenas ko'u ti yis man(lha tshoṣṭha)/wu'u khe chon/glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i khrab ldan dmag dpung gi 'jab rgol ni 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa'i dus 'gor 'jar man nā tshus bas rgyal kha rtag par len pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/ 'jar man gyi khrab ldan dmag dpung gi gsar gtod mkhan ni he dbyin tshi la len ko'u ti lis an(lotstshaṣṭha 75tshe oṃcho༅0)yin/ kho rang la 'jar man gyi 6 khrab ldan dmag dpung gi yab chen :du gsol zhing / lung me ar(ṣṭharsā7)dang man hri than dbyin(4 ༵/shā)gsum la skabs de'i 6 'jar man gyi dmag dpon chen mo gsum du khrab ldan dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs byas pa/ko'u ti lis an ni spyi lo 1888lo'i zla 6par 'jar man gyi he lung no(྾sau45)grong gi dmag dpon zhig gi khyim du skyes shing / rjes sor khar gis lo dmag mi'i slob ga(rdopozlo747)dang krung dbyang dmag dpon slob grwa nas rim par mthar phyin rjes/ me tshi 'thab 'khrug(lo6lhayilophug)slob grwar dmag sbyong byas/ spyi lo 1908lo nas bzung dmag la zhugs pa dang / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs skya dmag gi dmag dpon dma' rim pa'i 'gan 'khur/ 'khrug chen rjes su rgyal srung dmag dpung las ka gnyer/19dzādzāsbyar kho rang rgyal srung pu'u yi skam dmag skyel 'dren khru'u la bya ba sgrub tu

mngaga~X/ des kho rang gi khrab ldan dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs byed par mthun ko/ spyi ༵/sa an gyis rgyal srung pu'u yi skam dmag skyel 'dren khru'u la bya ba sgrub dus sbag sbag rnam pa'i dmag dpung ji ltar myur mgyogs sgos skyel 'dren byed pa'i skor la zhib 'jug byas/ rjes sor sbag sbag rnam pa'i dmag dpung sbyong brdar khrod kho rang la blo skyed byung ste/ gal te 'jar dmag gi 'phrul 'khor khrab ldan 'phrul 'khor du bsgyur na 'thab 'khrug khrod rang srung la phan khe chen po yod par bsam/ de nas bzung kho rang gis khrab ldan dmag dpung gi skor la zhib 'jug rnal mo byas//ko'u ti lis an gyis skabs de'i dbyin ji'i ming du grags pa'i dmag don pa hwa the hphu lu tin(tsho tshim)sogs kyi khrab ldan dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i gzhung lugs la khungs bcol nas sbag sbag ru dpung de 'thab mo ba'i ru dpung du bsgyur ba'i lta ba bton/ yin na'ang kho rang gi lta ba de 'khrug chen dang po'i skabs kyi dmag mi gon gras kyis log ltar bzung /rjes sor ko'u ti lis an gyis dbyin dmag gi dmag sbyong dang khrab ldan 'thab 'khor gyi sbyong brdar khrod byung ba'i lag len la gzhi bcol te/ ma 'ongs pa'i g.yul sa'i khrod kyi rgyal mo ni khrab ldan dmag dpung yin pa las rkang dmag min la/ dmag 'khrug khrod than khe yis nus pa gtso cher thon pas dmag 'thab khrod khrab ldan dmag dpung btsugs te than khe yis nus pa gtso cher bton te/ gnam gru dang than khe sogs mthun 'grig sgos 'jab rgol byed dgos pa'i dgongs pa bton/ yin na'ang / kho rang gi lta ba gsar ba 'di'ang gzhan gyis dang len ma byas/1931lo'i zla 10bar kho rang sbag sbag rnam pa'i dmag dpon du bskos pa dang / de nas bzung kho rang gis khrab ldan dmag dpung gi sgrig ga~X spyang

rtsa 'dzugs bya bar zhib 'jug byas/ skabs der kho rang gis khrab ldan dmag dpung gi sgrig gzhir bton pa'i re ba ni rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'thab 'khor gnyis te/ gcig ni yang ba'i rigs kyi 'thab 'khor dang / cig shos ni 'bring rim gyi 'thab 'khor red/ rigs mi 'dra ba'i 'thab 'khor 'di gnyis gtan 'khel byas rjes/ 'jar man gyis 'thab 'khor 'di gnyis thon skyed rgya cher byas/ 1932lo'i dbyar khar 'jar man pas thengs dang por rkang dmag dang 'thab 'khor zung 'brel gyi dmag sbyong la grub 'bras chen po blangs shing / ko'u ti lis an gyi 'thab jus der shi the li yi gzengs bstod thob/1934lor 'jar man gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung btsugs shing / shi the li yis ko'u ti lis an dmag dpon la bsko bzhag byas/ 1935lor 'jar man gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung hri gsum btsugs pa dang / ko'u ti lis an hri gnyis pa'i hri krang la bsko bzhag byas/ 1938lo'i zla gsum par ko'u ti lis an gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung la ru 'dren byas te wi en nā ru dmag drangs/ dbyin li 6000lhag gi lam thag la dus tshod 48nang dmag dpung yongs su slebs thub byung /6 glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i jus ldan dpa' bo/mi ko'u ti lis yan gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i dmigs yul ni glog dmar 'khrug 'dra'i phar rgol gyi dmag jus de lag bstar byed pas yin la/ kho rang gi bsam pa' 'thab 'khrug khrod gzhi rgya che zhing bsdu rub drags pa'i sgo nas than khe bkol spyod byas te/ gnam gru dang zung 'brel gyis phar rgol bsdud mar byas na/ da gzod mgyogs myur ngang bas/ ༵ rgya skyed thub pa dang / dgra dmag dpung tshogs 'joms thub par ma

zad/ than khes phar rgol byas te dgra dmag gi 'thab ru dang ji ltar nye na de ltar gyong gud nyung ba dang / 'thab 'bras kyang de ltar che bar 'dod/ ko'u ti lis an gyis rang gi rtsa don 'di dag gzhir bzung ste 'jar man gyi khrab ldan dmag dpung ru 'dren byas nas o gling gi g.yul sa nas rgyal kha chen po blangs pas/ dmag don pa re 'gas khong la 6 glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i jus ldan dpa' bor ’ 'bod/1939lo'i zla)ba'i tshes 1nyin gyi zhogs par 'jar man pas po lan la glo bur 'jab rgol byas/ de ni ko'u ti lis an gyis rang gi glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i 'thab jus la thengs dang por tshod lta byas pa red/thengs der/ dmag dpon ko'u ti lis an gyi 'gan 'khri ni po lan gyi rgyal mtshams la brgal nas po lan dmag dpung gi bgrod lam gtso bo 6 po lan bar khyams ’ gcod rgyu de yin la/ ko'u ti lis an gyis than khe'i dmag dpung gi stobs shugs la brten nas 6 po lan bar khyams min sdod pa'i po lan gyi dmag dpung de yongs su theg med byas/6 po lan bar khyams 'thab 'khrug mjug rdzogs pa dang ko'u ti lis an gyis slar yang dmag dpung khrid nas po lan la phar rgol byas/ zla)ba'i tshes 12nyin kho rang gis hwa hra'i(47)nye 'gram nas po lan gyi dmag dpung yongs su bskor te/ po lan gyi dmag dpung la mgo 'dogs byed du bcug1940lo'i zla gnyis par 'jar man skam dmag gi dmag spyi chen mo'i nub lam phar rgol gyi tsa ser po'i jus gzhi mi bcos bsgyur byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ jus gzhi 'di ni tshogs pa'i dmag dpung man hri than dbyin(kro mtha)gyis bzos shing / de ni skabs de'i hpha ran se'i dmag dpung gis 'gog srung byed pa'i ma chis no'i(67glo)khyad chos la gzhigs nasas7dzugasum gyi tshogs pa'i dmag dpung gis 'thab 'khrug byed pa'i zheX/ra

bkod yin/ 'di gsum las tshogs pa'i dmag dpung ni gtso shugs dmag dpung yin la/ ko'u ti lis an gyis sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung yang 19ba nisatshogs pa'i dmag dpung gi khongs su gtogs la jus gzhi de lag bstar byed par nus pa chen po thon gyin yod/1940lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 10nyin 'jar dmag gis dmag hri 136dang than khe 2580/ gnam gru 3824bsdu rub byas te/ ho lan dang pi li hri/ lu tsem pog glog dmar 'khrug 'dra'i phar rgol byas/ ko'u ti lis an gyi dmag dpung lu tsem pog brgal nas pi li hrir slobs pa dang hpha ran se'i dmag dang 'thab mo sbran/ tshes bcu gnyis nyin ko'u ti lis an gyi dmag dpung gis zhi mong si(po lo)gtsang bo brgal te skad cig nyid la ming du grags pa'i gna' bo'i mkhar rdzong se tang(6zi)bzung / tshes 13nyin gyi phyi dror ko'u ti lis an gyi dmag dpung mkha' dmag dang sgrogs dmag gnyis ram 'degs 'og myig ko(77)gtsang bo btsan gyis brgal nas dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung pham nyos bzos/ de nas ko'u ti lis an gyis dmag dpung khrid de mu mthud du nub phyogs su skyod/ nyin der 'jar dmag sis hpha dmag gi than khe 70dang dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag dpung gi gnam gru 150gtor/tshes 15nyin hpha dmag gi mjug mtha'i 'gog lam gtor te 'jar dmag dbyin ci li mtsho 'gag tu bgrod pa'i sgo mo yongs su phyes/ko'u ti lis an gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung la ru 'dren byas nas mgyogs myur ngang su'u mu'u gtsang bo ( 077)btsan gyis brgal te/dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag mi khri 40lhag btsan gyis bdas nas tung khi ar khyi(marngo /po )sa cha'i mtsho 'gram la ded/ 'jar man gyi dmag dpung gi 5 tshur rgol drag po'i 'og tu dbyin hpha mnyam 'brel dmag mi khri 40de srog nyen gyi kā/sdu su 'khyar/ yin na'ang skabs der shi the li yis metshogs pa'i dmag

dpung gi khongs gtogs khrab ldan dmag dpung de phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i bka' phabs/ ko'u ti lis an gyis dmag dpung phyir 'then byas rjes than khe tshogs pa gnyis pa'i dmag spyi ru bsko bzhag byas/ zla 6pa'i tshes9nyin ko'u ti lis an gyis ru 'dren byas pa'i than khe dpung tshogs bde blag ngang ma yin gtsang 'gram du 'byor ba dang / tshes 14nyin dmag dpung yongs rdzogs gtsang bo'i pha rol du brgal/ de nas kho rang gis ru dpung khrid de nan ki li si(tshe ༅lo)phyogs su mu mthud du dpung rgol byas/ thengs 'di'i phar rgol dmag dpung de nyinaḥkyi nang du dmigs sar slebs shing /ko'u ti lis an gyis dmag dpung ang 19pa dang 41pa mnyam 'brel gyis ma chis no 'gog srung sa cha'i dmag dpung la bskor rgol byas pas/ tshes 22nyin hpha ran se'i srid gzhung gis 'u thug thabs zad ngang 'jar dmag dang mi 'thab pa khas blangs/ko'u ti lis an gyis nub lam phar rgol gyi 'thab 'khrug khrod glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i 'thab jus spyad pa des ni hpha lan zhis(ṣṭha༅po)'thab 'khrug gi las dbang bdag gir bzung ba yin la/ 'thab 'khrug mjug sgril rjes kho rang rim pa dang po'i dmag spyi la bsko bzhag byas/su'u ti g.yul sa nas pham kha nyos pa/1941lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 22nyin ko'u ti lis an gyis khrab ldan dmag dpung la ru 'dren byas te/ 'jar dmag gi sne khrid nas su'u lan la phar rgol byas/ thengs der ko'u ti lis an gyis dmag dpung la sne khrid de pu'u le si thi(bo(576)wa spe tho hphu si khi'i(༅6〉lo7)phyogs gnyis nas su'u dmag gi 'gog rgol brgal nas zla 7pa'i tshes 19nyin bde blag ngang si mo len si khi(loṣṭhaṣṭhaglom)sa cha bcad bzung byas/ 473

si mo len si khi 'thab 'khrug mjug sgril rjes su'u dmag gis 'jar dmag gi tshur rgol la rdung deg tsha nan byas pas/ shi the li yis sngar gyi phyogs gsum nas phar rgol byed pa'i 'char gzhi mi bsgyur ka med byung / zla8pa'i tshes mgor ko'u ti lis an gyis krung dbyang tshogs pa'i dmag dpung gi dmag don tshogs 'du'i steng stobs shugs yod tshad sgos su'u lan gyi rgyal sar phar rgol byed pa'i re 'dod de shi the li yis dang len ma byas/ zla8pa'i tshes 23nyin ko'u ti lis an gyis sngar ltar shi the li la re 'dod zhus kyang 'bras bu ci yang ma lon/ skabs de dag la su'u dmag gis zla 'ga'i dus yun spyad de 'jar dmag la phar rgol byed par gra sgrig tshags su chud pa byas/de'i rkyen gyis ko'u ti lis an gyi khrab ldan dmag dpung gis mo si kho la par rgol byed dus su'u dmag gi 'gog rgol tsha nan byas pa dang / gzhan yang dgun kha'i nam zla 'khyags shing kha ba mthug pas than khe bgrod mi bde ba sogs kyi dka' khag rabs dang rim pa byung rkyen/ zla 12pa'i tshes mgor 'jar dmag gis mo si kho la phar rgol byed pa'i 'char gzhi yongs su dor/skabs der ko'u ti lis an gyis thengs de'i pham kha bzod ma nus par shi the li la nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i dmag spyi byed pa'i re ba bton par shi the li yi ma rangs par ko'u ti lis an gnas dbyung btang / de nas dus yuḥ ngepa can zhig gi nang du kho rang gis po lan nas las 'khyar ngal gso'i 'a ba1 913/lo'i zla 2par/ 'jar dmag la si ta len ki lig(spomatho 7)nas pham nyes tshabs chen thebs/ de nas bzung 'jar dmag 'gog rgol dang phyi nur mi byed ka med byung / shi the li yis slar yang ko'u ti lis yan phyir 'bod byas/ ko'u ti lis an gyis shi the li yi bka' dang len byas rjes miX sta4 grags pa'i 6 stag gzig rigs kyi than khe gsar ba bzo bskrun byed

par skul ba dang chabs cig 'jar man nas than khe de rigs gzhi rgya che ba'i ngang thon skyed dang bkol spyod byas/1943lo'i dbyar khar/ shi the li yis khu'u er si khi(sgopolo7)la ming la 6 btsan rdzong du 'bod pa'i phar rgol gyi 'thab 'khrug chen mo zhig slong ba'i 'char gzhi 'then pa na/ ko'u ti lis an gyis shi the li la bkag 'gog byas mod/ shi the li yis rang nyid kyi 'char gzhi de lag bstar byed pa sems thag bcad/ zla 7pa'i tshes lnga ba nas 'go bcoms shing zla8pa'i tshes 23nyin mjug sgril ba'i khu'u er si khi dmag 'khrug ni dmag 'khrug lo rgyus steng gi ches che ba'i than khe'i 'khrug chen thengs shig yin/ thengs de'i dmag 'khrug khrod 'jar dmag gis dmag mi khri 50lhag dang phyogs chen3000/gnam thu3700/ than khe 1500lhag rtseg med du btang /194lo'i zla 22nyin/ a ri dang dbyin jis dmag dpung hpha ran se'i no man tis sa cha nas skam sar thon te/ su'u dmag la gzhi rgya che ba'i dpung rgol drag po byas/ skabs der ko'u ti lis an gyis 'jar dmag gi dmag spyi'i 'gan khur yod la/ shi the li dang khong gnyis kyi bar yang bskyar 'gal ba byung bas/ shi the li yis bka' phab ste dmag spyi 'di nyid phyir rang yul du bskud pa dang go gnas kyang phab/o gling g.yul sa nas hpha zhi se la rgol ba'i 'thab 'khrug mjug sgril rjes/1945lo'i zla 10bar/ ko'u ti lis an a ri'i dmag dpung gi bzung dmag tu gyur ba dang / btson grol nas lo 'ga'i rjes te 1954lor tshe las 'das/kho rang gi bcoms chos la〈than khe la mnyam 'jog byed dgos〉zhes sogs yod la/ gzhan da dung hpha zhi se'i 'thab 'khrug gi gnas tshul dang 'brel ba'i dran tho zhig bris yod do//475

'jar phan mtshodamag gidamag dpon hran mun nga drug pa/wu'uste chon/1941lo'i zla 12pa'i ches 7nyin gyi tho rangs khar/ a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo'i dmag gru'i ru khag gi gnas gzhi mu tig gru kha'i(lkolko )mkha' dbyings su nyi gzhon ser lam mer 'phags shing / rlung bu med pa'i mtsho ngos ni gos sngon yug gcig btings pa dang 'dra bar zhi 'jags se gnas/ spro skyid ldan pa'i gza' mjug gi bde snang nyams su myangs pa'i a ri'i dpon dmag dag kyang mal las langs byung / glo bur du/ gshog 'gyur rgyag pa'i kha ta dang 'dra ba'i 'jar dmag gi gnam gru gar yong 'di yod med par slebs shing / yang bskor bskyar bskor gyi 'bar mdel dbyugs byung /yud tsam la/ gra sgrig gru kha de me lce dang dud zhags kyi klong du lhung tada'adini zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi slong rkyen 6 mu tig gru kha'i don rkyen ’ yin la/don rkyen 'di 'char 'god dang lag bstar byed mkhan ni ming du grags pa'i 'jar pan mtsho dmag gi dmag dpon hran pun nga drug pa yin/'jar pan dpa' rdul gyi bu/hran pun nga drug pa ni 1884lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 4nyin 'jar pan srol rgyun dpa' rtul gyi dud khyim zhig tu skyes/ hran pun nga drug pa skyes dus ni tag tag yab ko yus krin ci( yolha)dgung grangs nga drug par son pa dadwa 〉zlo 'grig pas ming la 6 nga drug pa mizhes bos pa red/ kho rang gi rus

hran pun du 'bod don ni phyis su hran pun ti ta'o(7lhas7)yis tsha bo'i tshab tu bskyangs pas de ltar bsgyur ba red/1868lor 'jar pan mun kri gsar sgyur(7phya so/byas rjes/ ko yus krin ci dang 'dra ba'i 'jar pan dpa' rtul khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba ha cang dka' ba'i gnas su gyar/ hran pun chung dus su/ dbyar khar sngo tshod ra ba bdag skyong bya dgos la dgun khar kha ba phyags dgos pa ma zad/ lo hril bor nya 'dzin pa'i las kur 'tham dgos pa yin/ de lta na'ang / kho la chung dus nas 'jar pan dpa' rtul phyag lam gyis shugs rkyen zab mo thebs pa red/ kho rang byis dus nas lus po thang shing stobs dang ldan la lus rtsal bya 'gul la dga' po yod pa dang slob grwa'i nang du dmag don sbyong brdar gyi slob gso myangs pa red/ der ma zad/ hran pun slob sbyong la brtson pa ha cang che/phyis su kho rang gis da dung krung go'i sung tsi dmag thabs〉dang nub phyogs kyi dmag dpon grags can gyi gsung rtsom sogs la zhib 'jug kyang byas myong ba red/ gzhan yang kho rang mig mangs rtsed par spro shing snying stobs che la rig lam myur ba'i rgyal 'jog mkhan zhig kyang yin/ kho rang gi khyad chos 'di dag phyis kyi dmag 'thab bkod 'doms khrod du gsal bor mngon yod pa red/hran pun nga drug pa dmag la zhugs rjes de ma thag ma lag cha tshang ba'i mtsho dmag gi shes bya'i slob sbyong dang sbyong brdar nyams su blangs/1901lor/ pho lo 17la son pa'i kho rang cang then gling phran gyi(18lo)mtsho dmag dmag dpon slob grwar rgyugs 'phrod cing / lo gsum gyi rjes su slob mthar phyin nas mtsho dmag la zhugs te smyo ri cin mi rtags can( bra ṣṭha ṣṭha)gyi khrab ldan mtsho skor dmag gru'i lta sbyong dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur pa dang / 198 — 1905lo'i u ru su dang 'jar pan gyi dmag 'khrug la zhugs/ 'thab 'dzing khrod du kho rang la rmas phog ste lag pa'i mdzub mo 4/ltos

shor ba red/ 1908nas 1911lo'i bar/ kho rang gis mtsho dmag gi skyogs rtsal slob grwa nas slob gnyer byas shing / 1914lor/ yang bskyar mtsho dmag slob chen 'grims/ phyi lor hro zho yi go sar 'phar/ 1916lor mthar phyin rjes dmag gru'i ru khag dang mtsho dmag gi bkod 'doms pa'i 'gan 'khur/skabs der/ kho rang sngar nas tshad ldan gyi mtsho dmag dmag dpon zhig dang me phyogs kyi ched mkhas pa zhig tu gyur yod pa red/zab cing rgya che ba'i mig rgyang /hran pun nga drug pa ni gzugs bongs chung zhing ljid tshad spyi rgya 50tsam las med pas phyi tshul la bltas na dmag mi zhig gi dpa' nyams med kyang /skabs de'i 'jar pan dmag rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag dpon khrod du ches 'jon nus can du brtsis chog pa yin/ kho rang la 'thab jus mig rgyang nges can ldan la ma 'ongs pa'i mtsho thog gi dmag 'thab kyi 'gyur ldog la zhib 'jug byed par ha cang mthong chen byed pa dang / lhag par mkha' dmag gi mtsho thog dgra 'thab kyi gal chen rang bzhin la nges shes gsal bo rnyed yod/1924lo'i zla)par/ hran pun gyis zhwa phu mtsho dmag mkha' skyod ru khag gi ru dpon gzhon pa dang slob ston pa'i 'gan 'khur/ kho rang pho lo 40la son yod na'ang gnam gru kha lo bsgyur ba'i lag rtsal slob rgyu'i blo thag bcadade nyin rer chu tshod 'gar 'phur skyod sbyong brdar zhugs/ ring bo ma 'gor bar rang skya thub bar gnam gru kha lo bsgyur thub par gyur zhing mkha' skyod dmag mi'i 'brel yod shes bya khong du chud/ kho rang gis las 'gan dang du blangs rjes/ phul du byung ba'i 'phur skyod lag rtsal gyi dregs pas rgod po mthur med du gyur ba'i mtsho dmag mkha' skyod dmag mi dag gi bsam spyod la dkā ༵༵ nan mo byas/ dmag sgrig ci nus kyis skyar gso byas pa ma zad/ da

dung dmag mi yongs kyi mgo skra gtsang mar bzhar du bcug dus skabs nges can zhig gi dag ther brgyud rjes dmag mi'i 'phur skyod lag rtsal dang dmag sgrig la yar rgyas chen po byung /1925lo'i zla 12par/ hran pun thengs gnyis par a rir phyin nas 'jar pan gyi a rir sdod pa'i drag rtsal dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur/ kho rang gis mtsho dmag gi 'thab jus 'phel rgyas kyi 'gyur ldog la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug byas te rgyal nang la 'brel yod gsang 'phrin mkho sprod byas pa dang /skabs de'i a ri'i mkha' skyod bzo las dang 'phur skyod lag rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas gtsigs chen du mthong zhing / a ri'i gnam gru'i kha lo ba lin pe(77)yis thengs dang por nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i mkha' lam 'phred kyis brgal ba des/ kho rang gis ched du a ri'i phyogs ston lag rtsal la zhib 'jug byed par skul lcag thebs/ a ri ltar dpyad chas la brten nas phyogs ston byed pa'i thabs lam dang len gyis 'jar pan dmag mis mig zung dang tshod dpag la brten nas 'phur skyod byed pa'i rnam pa bsgyur dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ 1930lor hran pun 'jar pan la phyir log rjes/ mi ring bar hro cang dmag dpon gyi go gnas la 'phar ba dang mnyam por mtsho dmag mkha' spyod dmag gi lag rtsal dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur/ kho rang gis 'jar pan mtsho dmag gi chu mdel phar rgol 'phrul chas dang rgyang ring 'gas gtor 'phrul chas gsar bcos byas pa tsam ma zad da dung myur mgyogs 'thab 'dzing gnam gru'i thon skyed de 'char gzhi khrod du bzhag 1933lo'i zla 10bar/ hran pun gyis mkha' skyod ru khag dang po'i dmag spyi'i 'gan 'khur rjes/ gnam gru'i kha lo ba rnams la srog bsdos kyis sbyong brdar byed pa dang /sbyong brdar khrod kyi 'das grongs ni 'thab 'dzing khrod kyi 'das grongs dang gnyis med du lta dgos pa'i re 'dun bton/ kho rang gis 6 'jarā snan

dmag gru ru khag gi mkha' skyod dmag stobs de rgyal khab gzhan gyi rjes su lus 'dug 'jar pan la mtshon na/ bar thag 'di bskang dgos na nges par du dza drag gi sbyong brdar bya dgos zhes bshad/1935lor/ kho rang gis mtsho dmag mkha' skyod dmag gi dmag dpon gyi 'gan 'khur rjes/ skabs de'i 'jar pan mtsho dmag gi smyo dmag gru dang po ’ 'am 6 gru chen phyogs chen ring lugs kyi 'thab jus la dgag cing /6 mkha' dmag rang tshugs ring lugs kyi 'dod tshul bton/ kho rang gi lta tshul la/ gnam grus ma 'ongs dmag 'thab khrod kyi phar rgol nus shugs je che nas je drag tu 'gyur nges pas/ dmag gru chen mo dag ni ma rtsa mtho ba'i mkho med dngos por 'gyur pa ni mi 'gyangs pa ra mngon sum du 'grub nges par 'dod/ kho rang gis bongs che ba'i dmag gru chen mo 6 tā ho ’ rtags can( oṃ776)dang 66lu'u tshang mirtags can(za sto)gyi bzo bskrun 'char gzhi la dgag pa brgyab cing / dmag gru de gnyis bzo ba'i ma dngul de mtsho dmag gi mkha' skyod dmag stobs 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i phyogs su bkol rgyu'i 'dod tshul bton na'ang / kho rang gi bsam 'char la nyan mkhan ma byung bas rang gi dbang cha'i khyab khongs nas mtsho dmag gi gnam gru'i zhib 'jug dang gsar bcos kyi bya bar shugs snon byas/dus skabs der/ hran pun gyis dbyin ji dang a ri la 'drog mi slong ba'i phyir du 'jar pan gyi dmag stobs rgya bskyed pa'i bya las de mngon chung gis bsgrub dgos pa'i 'dod tshul bton/ 1934lor/ kho rang 'jar pan gyi tshab byas te lon ton(77)du bsdus pa'i mtsho dmag tshogs 'du'i sta gon 'du tshogs su zhugs/ dus der/ 'jar pan mtsho dmag gi nang khul du ming rtags bkod zin pa'i hwa hrin tun(thong76—1)mtsho dmag dmag stobs chi)sdu /ga skor gyi rtsod gleng ha cang dza drag yin pa red/ phyogs khag gcig

ni 6 chings yig smra ba ste/ kho tsho'i 'dod tshul ni 'jar pan gyi rgyal stobs zhan pas/ a ri dang dbyin ji/ 'jar pan gsum gyi dmag gru'i theg tshad b.ragyi bsdur tshad 865 5 3 yin pa'i sngar gyi thag gcod de 'jar pan phyogs la phan phyin bsgyur bcos ma byas na legs par 'dod/ phyogs khag cig shos ni mu dmag gru smra ba ’ ste/ kho tshos chings yig gis 'jar pan gyi la rgya shor du bcug yod pas rtsa med gtong dgos par bsams/ hran pun ni a rir snga phyir thengs gnyis la phyin te a ri'i bzo las kyi sbas shugs la rgyus lon cung gsal bo yod pas/ 6 chings yig smra ba'i phyogs su 'greng yod pa red/ kho rang gi 'dod tshul la/ gal srid 'jar pan mtha' med pa'i dmag gru bzo ba'i 'gran rtsod du zhugs tshe/ mi ring bar thon khungs zad pa'i mjug 'brasasmin srid pas na/ dus skabs 'di lta bur nges par bab brling gis rang gi stobs shugs je cher gtong dgos par sems/ lhag par/ mkha' skyod dmag gi 'phel rgyas je mgyogs su btang na nam zhig a ri dang dbyin jis 'jar pan dang gleng sol byed pa'i dus shig slobs nges ba'i lta tshul bcangs/ hran pun gyis de sngon lon ton gyi sta gon tshogs 'du'i steng du dmag gru'i theg tshad thad a ri dbyin ji dang 'dra mnyam yong bar 'bad cing don smin ma byung ba des/ 'jar pan gyi mig snga'i stobs shugs kyis a dbyin gnyis kyi dpung ya ye nas mi yong ba ra sprod yod pa red/1936lo'i zla 12par/ hran pun mtsho dmag gi 'go 'dzin gzhon par bskos yod dus/ 'jar pan mtsho dmag dang rkang dmag gnyis kyis 'jar man dang dmag don mnyam 'brel bya min thad 'gal ba dza drag byung / hran pun gyis ljar man dang dmag don mnyam 'brel byed pa'i don der btang snyoms kyis rnam 'gyur bzung bas/ rkang dmag g.yon lhung phyogs khag gis kho rang dgra ru mthong ste smyo a dbyin la dga' ba'i phyogs khag mi tu lta ༵ /da/

don ngo mar/ skabs de'i 'jar pan mtsho dmag gis sngar nas a ri dgra bor dmigs yod kyang / rkang dmag dang mi 'dra sa ni go skabs ci 'dra zhig dang ches legs pa'i thabs jus ji 'dra zhig gdam rgyu de yin/ yin yang / hran pun la nam rgyun rgol rdung phog gan yod pa dang / tha na 'jigs skul gyi 'phrin yig bskur te lta tshul bsgyur ba'am yang na las gnas las 'bud dgos pa'i re ba bton/ da dung bshad tshul ltar na g.yon lhung tshogs pas hran pun lkog gsod bya rtsis byas skad/'jabargol legs grub byung ba/193a'i zla8pa'i tshes 31nyin/ hran pun nga drug pa 'jar pan dmag gru mnyam 'brel ru dpung gi dmag spyi la bskos/ kho rang las gnas la 'byor rjes kyi nyin gnyis par/ shi the li yis yo rob gling nas dmag 'khrug chen mo'i me lce sbar/ cang ma 'gor bar/ shi the li yis yo rob dkyil ma dang nub ma/ hpha ran se bcas bcom zhing / dbyin jis rang sar phyi bsdur gyis bsrung dgos byung / shi the li yi gnas skabs kyi rgyal khas ngar chu blud pa'i 'jar pan gyis mdung rtse a ri la gtad pa'i 'jar man dang dbyi tha li/'jar pan gsum gyi dmag don chings yig bzhag hran pun gyi sems gting nas a ri dang 'thab mi 'dod na'ang / dmag gru mnyam 'brel ru dpung gi dmag spyi yin pa'i kho la mtshon na nges par 'byung srid pa'i a 'jar dmag 'khrug gi dgra 'thab jus gzhi gtan 'beb bya bar mno bsam gtong dgos byung / dus der/ kho rang gis mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol bya rgyu'i jus gzhi blor mi shong ba de bton pa red/hran pun gyis bton pa'i a ri dang 'thab pa'i jus gzhi yis 'jar pa/ ༵༵ dmag gis rang srung bya ba'i rtsa don de bsgyur dgos pa'i 'dod tshul

bcangs/ a 'jar dmag 'khrug 'go brtsams rjes/ 'jar pan gyis stobs shugs yod rgus hphi li phin tshur blangs te a ri'i ya gling dang zhi bde rgya mtsho'i gnas gzhi gtso bo tshur 'phrog pa dang / de nas phar rgol gyis dpung rogs su yong ba'i a ri'i dmag gru'i ru dpung rmeg med bzos te zhi bde rgya mtsho nub ma bdag gir bzung ba de'o// 'on kyang / hran pun gyi lta tshul de las ldog ste a ri dang 'jar pan gyi dmag 'khrug khrod a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru'i mu tig gru kha nas tshur rgol bya nges pa dang / 'jar pan gyi dmag gru dang tha na 'jar pan rgyas khongs la mkha' dmag gi 'jigs nyen chen po 'ong srid pas/ a ri'i mche ba lta bu'i mu tig gru kha thog mar meg med gtong dgos par 'dod la/ gal srid a ri'i dmag gru'i gtso shugs tshar bcad tshe/ 'jar pan gyis a ri'i lus stobs ma sos pa'i yar sngon du zhi bde rgya mtsho dang hin rdu rgya mtsho'i 'gag sa 'dzin thub pa dang a ris mnyam 'brel chings yig mi 'jog thu med du 'gyur nges par 'dod/ 1941lo'i zla 7par/ hran pun gyis skabs shig ring gi mno bsam brgyud rjes/ skabs de'i hed zhang ( lko)ci khron ko kri lung(7)//mcho khyi)la 'phrin pa cig bsrings pa'i nang du/ mu tig gru khar 'jab rgol bya ba'i skor gyi 'char bkod gsal por bris yod pa red/ kho rang gis dmag 'khrug 'go bcoms ma thag gdong mchong dmag dpung hrag bsdus kyis mu tig gru khar sdod pa'i a ri'i dmag gru'i gtso shugs rmang nas gtor te/ 6 a ri'i mtsho dmag dang dmangs kyi ngar shugs bcag nas blo pham 'u thag gi gnas su bskyal dgos pa'i bsam tshul bton/ 'jab rgol gyi jus gzhi dngos su grub rjes/ mtsho dmag dmag spyi khang dang mnyam 'brel dmag gru'i ru dpung nang khul nas rtsod gleng chen po byung / la la 'jab rgol ma byas sngon la dgra bos tshor bar 'jigs pa dang / la la 'jab rgol dmigs 'ben g.yol te mi rnye18 snar

dogs/ la las jus gzhi nyid la ngo rgol byas/ yin na'ang / hran pun gyis re rer rgol lan sprad cing tha na kho rang las gnas las 'bud nges pa'i 'jigs skul la brten nas jus gzhi la chog mchan thob par byas pa red/jus gzhi 'di mngon du 'gyur ched/ hran pun gyis mi ring bar 'gan khur 'di lag len bya mkhan gyi dmag gru'i ru khag la sa bab mu tig gru kha dang 'dra ba'i lu'u ar gling phran du( 166)dmag sbyong nan mo byas pa dang mtshungs su/ jus gzhi ltar sngon 'gro'i sta gon zhib phra byas pa ste/ dper na/zhwa we yus(za cho)gling phran du myul ma mngags gtong gis mu tig gru kha'i a ri'idamag gi gnas stangs la rgyus lon byas shing tshul der gsang rgya nan mo byas pa red/ 1941lo'i zla 10par/ tung the'u dbyin ci(lko〉rsā7)yis srid 'gan 'khur rjes/ hran pun gyis gtan la phab pa'i jus gzhi ltar zla 11pa'i zla mgor 'jab rgol gyi sta gon yongs su grub par byas shing / zla 11pa'i tshes 5nyin/ a ri dang dbyin ji/ ho lan la 'thab 'go slong ba'i bka' lung dang po bsgrags/ zla 11pa'i tshes 26nyin/ dmigs bsal gyi dmag gru'i ru khag nyi hong(5lha)dang gyes shing / zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin/ nyi hong gi mtsho dmag dmag bkod khang gis zla 12pa'i tshes 8nyin phar rgol byed rgyu thag bcad/ rgyu mtshan ni nyin de ni zhwa we yus kyi zla 12pa'i tshes 7nyin yin la tag tag gza' nyi mar khel yod pas yin/ nyin de'i phyi dro'i chu tshod 5dang skar ma 30stong / hran pun gyis dmigs bsal dmag gru'i ru khag la zla 12pa'i tshes 8nyin 'jab rgol bya rgyu'i bka' phab/ zla 12pa'i tshes 6nyin ni tag tag zhwa we yus kyi cu bla na med pa'i gza' mjug mi yin la/ nyi hong dmigs bsal dmag gru'i ru khag gis nyin gcig gi myur bskyod la brten nas zhi bde rgya mtsho byang skyod lam thig brgyud de 'jab rgol gnam gru 'phur sa sdu/ khul du 'byor ba red/

zla 12pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi chu tshod 7dang skar ma 50stong / mu tig gru kha'i a ri'i dmag gis ci yang ma tshor ba'i ngang la/ nyi hong gi 'gas gtor gnam gru 51dang chu mdel gnam gru 0/ mtsho ngos 'gas gtong gnam thu49/'thab 'dzing gnam gru 43gyis grub pa'i phar rgol ru khag dang pos hu'u ho gling phran(7lo6)gyi a ri'i gnam gru 'bab thang du mar yang bskor bskyar skor gyis 'gas gtor rgya chen byas/ skar ma 5tsam gyi nang du hu'u ho gling phran gyi a ri'i mkha' dmag gi stobs shugs rdul du brlag pa red/ chu tshod 7dang skar ma 58stong du/ mu tig gru kha'i bar snang du yang bskyar nyi hong gi chu mdel gnam gru 'bor chen slobs shing / gru kha'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag la phar rgol byas/ nyi hong gi 'jab rgol thengs 'di chu tshod gnyis tsam gyi yun la bsrings shing / a ri'i 'thab 'dzing dmag gru chen mo 40lhag dang /gnam gru 260lhag dmag mi 4500lhag tsam rmig med du btang ste/ a ri'i spra bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag phal cher rtsa ba nas gtor pham btang ba rid/ mu tig gru kha'i 'jab rgol legs grub byung ba des/ nyi tong dmag rgyal ring lugs pa dag la dga' spro dpag med byin zhing / hran pun nga drug pa'i snyan pa'i grags pa rgyas pa'i yang rtser slebs/pham nyes rang la phog pa/nyi hong gis mu tig gru kha'i 'jab rgol lag bstar byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ zla 12pa'i tshes 10nyin/ ma le gling phran phyed ma'i(zalkosko6)kon tan(47)shar phyogs kyi mtsho khul du dbyin ji'i dmag gru ru khag gi dmag 'thab gru gzings che gras gnyis gtor ba red/ tshul des hran pun gyi dmag 'thab gru gzings che gras dkyil snying byas pa'i mtsho thog gi 4༷/ba

'khrug mjug rdzogs zin pa dang / bar tna nga gi bdag dbang med na rgya mtsho'i bdag dbang 'dzin mi nus pa'i 'dongatshul der gnas lugs dang ldan pa ra sprad pa red/ yin na'ang / phyis kyi dam ga 'thab khrod du hran pun gyis rang gi 'dod tshul de logs su bskyur te/ dmag 'thab gru gzings che gras dkyil snyingakhyapa pa'i mtsho 'thab kyi lam bur phyir log pas mtha' mjug pham nyes byung ba mu /ga/ gru khar rgyal kha chen po thob rjes hran pun gyis nus shugs shor ba'i a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag rjes med btang ste dmag 'khrug thengs 'di myur bar mjug bsdu rgyu'i chod sems bcangs/ a ris mu tig gru kha'i nub byang phyogs kyi krung thu'u gling phran(lta lo)du mu tig gru khar srung skyob byed ched skor zhib dmag gru'i gnas gzhi bskrun yod par dmigs nas/hran pun gyis krung thu'u gling phran la myur rgol gyis a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru'i ru khag tshur bslus te rgyal pham thag chod kyi dmar 'dzing bya rgyu'i blo thag ba~X/2lo'i zla 5par/ nyi hong gi mtsho dmag mnyam bsdus kyis bka' la sgug cing 'dug la/ zla 6pa'i tshes 7nyin krung thu'u gling phran tshur len pa'i sta gon byed/ hran pun gyis khog rtsis 'di 'dra rgyag gin yod de/ zla 6pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi sngon gyi nyin gsum par dmag dpung khag gnyis su bgos te/khag gcig gis mtsho thog nas ā lig hrun gling tshom(61tsho sa༈cha)la phar rgol gyis a ri'i dmag gru ru khag tshur bslus te dgra bo'i dmag stobs kha thor du gtong ba dang / gtso shugs ru dpung gis nub byang phyogs nas krung thu'u gling phran la phar rgol gyis zla 6pa'i tshes 7nyin tshur blangs te rgyab rogs su yongasrid pa'i a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru'i ru khag kyang de nyid nas rmedi bye/ gtong rgyu de'o// phyi ngos nas bltas na/ jus gzhi 'di cha yongs su

'dzoms pa lta bur snang yang / don dngos su lag tu bstar dus rtsa 'dzugs mi dam zhing gsang rgya'i rang bzhin yang zhan pa red/ nyi hong dmag rgyal ring lugs pa'i sems la rgyal kha rang lag tu yod pa lta bur 'dod yod pa red/1942lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 'gor/ hran pun nga drug pas dngos su dmag gru 200lhag gi sne khrid de krung thu'u gling phran dang ā lig hrun gling tshom la dpung 'jug byas/ 'on kyang / a ri'i mtsho dmag gis nyi hong dmag gi jus gzhi tshor te/ a ri'i zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi nye mus tshi(khuṣṭha)yis gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings pyikrung thu'u gling phran gyi shar byang mtsho khul du yib du bcug cing / go skabs legs po zhig la nyi hong gi gtso shugs ru dpung la 'jab rgol bya rgyu byas/ dmag 'thab thengs der a ri'i dmag gis nyi hong gi gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings che gras 4dang /skor skyod dmag gru 'bring tsam 1/ mthar skyod gtong byed dmag gu2/ gnam gru 332bcas gtor ba dang / a ri'i gnam gru 'bab sa'i gru gzings 1dang mthar sprod gtong byed dmag gru 1/ gnam gru 147ma gtogs ma gron pa red/de ltar/ hran pun nga drug pa'i krung thu'u gling phran gyi pham kha de zhi bde rgya mtsho'i dmag 'khrug gi skyogs mtshams su gyur ba red/1942lo'i zla8pa nas bzung / a ri dang nyi hong gnyis kyis zhi bde rgya mtsho lho ma'i so lo men gling tshom(ṣṭha༅/cig lo)gyi kā tā ar kha nā ar gling phran(lo 7lo polo6)du dza drag che ba'i 'phrog rtsod dmag 'khrug brgyab/hran pun gyis dmag gru'i ru khag drangs te g.yul 'khrug thengs shig rgyag bsams kyang / 'bar rdzas chad pa sogs rkyen mang po'i dbang gis 'dod don ma 'grub pa red/ 1943lo'i zla 2par/ nyi hong dmag gi sa de ga'i dmag 'khrug rtsa ba nas pham zhing dmag 'khrug spyi'i gnas tshul yang nyi hong la gnod pa'i tshul byung ba red/ lo de'i zla 4par/ hran pun gyis nyi hong sdu/ma

zlonā kārsha cing dmag gru ru khag gi bkod bdoms pa lus yon(27)la rmas hran pun nga drug pa ni skabs de'i nyi hong dmag rgyal ring lugs pa'i dmag dpon khrod kyi yang rtse yin na'ang / kho rang dmag rgyal ring lugs pa'i yo byad tsam du 'gyur dgos byung zhing mtha' mar de'i ched du tshe srog shor ba red/ nyi hong gi dmag sgar chen mos hran pun shi ba'i don des spyi tshogs la g.yo 'gul 'byung bar dogs te zla gcig lhag la gsang rgya bya dgos byung /zla 5pa'i tshes 21nyin da gzod tsa mnyam 'brel dmag gru ru khag gi dmag spyi hran pun nga drug pa lo 'di'i zla 4par g.yul sar dmag dpung la bkod 'doms byed dus/ dgra bo'i gnam gru dang 'phrad de gzi brjid ngang rang srog shor ’ zhes khyab bsgrags byas pa red/489
